jobs.title: Asset Management Growth Leader – Water Utilities
jobs.description:
The Asset Management Growth Leader - Water Utilities is responsible for driving market strategy, business development, and client engagement to grow AECOM’s water-sector portfolio across the globe. This role strengthens client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and positions AECOM for success in delivering water, wastewater, and conveyance infrastructure projects throughout the world.

You will lead strategic pursuits, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and help establish AECOM as a trusted partner for major water infrastructure initiatives across the most rapidly expanding markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Market Expansion

• Develop and execute growth strategies that expand AECOM’s Asset Management services in various Water markets across the globe.
• Provide market leadership for the Water sector and guide regional sales planning.
• Leverage existing and new relationships with utilities, municipalities, and regional water authorities.

Business Development & Pursuit Strategy

• Lead major water-sector pursuits, including capture strategy, win themes, proposal messaging, and fee strategies.
• Conduct risk/reward analyses for new opportunities and recommend go/no-go decision-making.
• Represent AECOM at industry conferences, utility forums, water association events, and client-focused engagements.

Client & Project Leadership

• Strengthen and expand relationships with key municipal, state, and federal water-sector clients.
• Serve as a Client Account Manager for clients in the region, supporting high-quality project delivery and long-term client satisfaction.

Team Development

• Mentor, coach, and grow a high-performing regional Water team aligned with increasing market share.
• Cultivate a collaborative environment across disciplines and offices.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

• Experience in asset management, particularly in the water sector (though other infrastructure sectors are also considered).
• A strong understanding of strategic planning, risk management, or asset lifecycle decision-making.
• Relevant qualifications or certifications (e.g., IAM Certificate/Diploma in Asset Management), though a passion for learning and growth is just as important.
• A degree in Engineering, Economics, or Environmental Science

Minimum Qualifications

• BA/BS + 12 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership

Preferred Qualifications

• 15+ years of relevant engineering experience
• Professional engineering licensure in your home country or equivalent credential.
• Knowledge of water infrastructure funding programs (state and federal) and capital project delivery models.
• Demonstrated consulting sales ability within complex technical markets and long sales cycles.
• Ability to develop long-term client relationships that lead to sustained contracting opportunities.
• Experience negotiating contracts with water-sector clients and teaming partners.
• Experience delivering major water, wastewater, or stormwater projects as a Client, Project, or Market Leader.
• Strong communication and presentation skills.
• Marketing and sales experience on a global scale.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Chief Expert Robotics
jobs.description:
At Bosch Research, we pioneer cutting-edge AI algorithms for high-impact industrial applications, from automated driving to intelligent agentic systems. Our innovations are the foundation for high-performance, robust, and safe AI solutions across the Bosch Group. Join us as a Chief Expert in Robotics and shape the future of autonomous systems.

• Drive End-to-End Robotics Deployment: As a Chief Expert Robotics, you will lead the technical implementation and architecture of advanced robotic systems by translating complex algorithms into reliable, production-ready hardware and software solutions.
• You will take physical robots from the concept and laboratory stage directly into real-world operating environments, whether in manufacturing, logistics, or field applications.
• Strategic Technology Leadership: Furthermore, you will define and drive the long-term robotics research roadmap by identifying emerging technologies in perception, manipulation, motion planning, and AI/ML.
• As a technical expert, you will make key decisions regarding system architecture, hardware-software co-design, and make-or-buy strategies.
• Foster Agile & Pragmatic Engineering Culture: Within interdisciplinary teams, you will foster a fast-paced, startup-like prototyping culture focused on rapid iteration, fail-fast principles, and continuous testing on physical hardware.
• You will mentor and coach researchers across multiple disciplines, including mechanical engineering, electronics, software engineering, and artificial intelligence.
• Stakeholder & Ecosystem Collaboration: You will work closely with business units, product managers, and external partners to ensure that our robotics innovations solve real customer needs and deliver a clear ROI.
• Last but not least, you will scout and collaborate with leading robotics startups, venture partners, and academic institutions to integrate state-of-the-art technologies.

• Education: Completed Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent professional experience (minimum 8+ years in robotics/autonomous systems development)
• Required Experience and Knowledge:Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in robotics and autonomous systems, with demonstrated success in building or deploying advanced physical AI/robotic systems in production environmentsProven background in robotics organizations, including startups, scale-ups, or innovation-focused teamsDeep technical expertise in core robotics technology stacks (e.g., ROS/ROS 2, modern C++, Python, Linux/RTOS)Hands-on experience with GPU-accelerated simulation tools (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo) and teleoperation/data collection pipelinesPractical experience with modern robotic learning methodologies (Imitation Learning, Diffusion Policy, ACT, Reinforcement Learning, or Foundation Models including VLMs/VLAs)Demonstrated knowledge of perception and state estimation techniques (sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D vision, LiDAR/camera calibration)Expertise in manipulation and grasping systems (end-effectors, tactile sensing, teleoperation)Professional experience with Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, safety protocols, and design for reliabilityDemonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges across full-stack systems, from electrical and CAN bus issues on physical robots to software race conditions and edge casesProven ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executive leadership, customers, and cross-functional teamsTrack record of implementing iterative prototyping methodologies that enable rapid development cycles
• Languages: Fluent written and spoken English

This position is open to Sunnyvale, CA; Pittsburgh PA.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position in Sunnyvale, California is  $330,000-$350,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. This range does not include annual bonus percentage nor any other monetary considerations for the total compensation package. Your Recruiter can share more details about the specific salary range for this position during the interview process.

In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement plan with an attractive employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; long term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave. Pay ranges included in the postings, when included, generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, or additional benefits.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

*Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.

jobs.title: IC Deeding Closing Officer
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

Serve as Account Manager after the Sales Rep has made initial sale through continuing with—and finalizing—the sales process by verifying the terms of the purchase, solidifying the sale while explaining the various required contract documents, and managing each new account until the initial down payment, closing costs, and other applicable fees have been paid in full. This includes formulating and implementing alternative strategies where needed to close the deal.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Manage all aspects of the new owner account until the deal has become “good” inclusive of relationship management with owners and managing follow-through of down payment, closing costs, and applicable fees until paid-in-full. This includes:

o Perform daily closing/deeding responsibilities

o Liaise with the NOW (New Owners at Westgate) Team while all deals are within rescission.

o Interact with the P2G (Pending to Good) Team until all initial monies/fees have been paid.

o Work directly with new owners if the terms of the initial contract need to be reviewed and/or modified in order to bring an account to “good” status.

o Contact all new owners within rescission to offer any additional help or answer any additional questions.

o Maintain statistical records of personal closings including:

o Rescission cancellation rates

o Bolt rates

o Rewritten deals

o Pending Delinquency rates This can be removed

· Exercise authority to rearrange down payment and closing costs within Sales guidelines

· Apply discretion and authority to deviate from normal procedures needed to bring the deal to good in accordance with Sales Operating Standards.

· Collaborate with Sales and Deeding Directors to formulate, rework the terms and conditions, and revise sales agreements as needed to save the sale.

· Ensure timely and pertinent communications with owners and internal departments, keep abreast of the status and needs of the account at each step in the closing process, and take appropriate actions to optimize closing and rescission percentages for the Sales Office and the Deeding Department.

· Offer new terms and implement changes to sales contracts under direction from Sales and Closing Officer Directors.

· Attend applicable training and pertinent meetings.

· Other duties may be assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Valid real-estate license applicable in the respective state, notary public license and at least one year as a top producing Westgate Sales Representative. Individuals must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed herein are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

A High School Diploma or the equivalent is required. College education is a plus.

At least 1 (one) year with Sales experience, specifically timeshare related

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions form groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interests, commissions, proportions, percentages, area circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram from and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Time Share, Real Estate License and/or Escrow License.

Notary Public License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Must be able to and capable of standing, walking, sitting, for eight (8) hour shift. Must be able to reach with hands and arms and have use of hands and fingers. Must be capable of distance vision and depth perception. Must be capable of hearing within what is considered to be a normal range.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Moderate office noise levels.

PROFESSIONAL ATTIRE REQUIRED WHILE PREFORMING PUBLIC DUTIES

• Proficient in a scripting language such as Python/Perl

jobs.title: Senior Assistant Program Controls Manager (PCM)
jobs.location: San Juan, United States, Puerto Rico
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend Heery, Puerto Rico is seeking an experienced Senior Assistant Program Controls Manager (PCM) to work on a fast paced, large-scale construction program in the pharmaceutical field. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, able to take the initiative and drive activities with limited supervision. With a keen eye for detail and experience of identifying continuous improvement opportunities, the candidate should have experience working in the construction industry.

Responsibilities

• The Senior Program Controls Manager shall oversee Change Control & Compliance, Estimating, Document Control, Scheduling, Risk Management, Cost Control and Reporting for the Program.
• Support management to ensure appropriate tools for budget preparation, tracking and reporting are in place and fully utilized. Ensure procedures are in place to control financial records, statistics and reports.
• Implement and execute cost and schedule management program for projects. Support planning and execution efforts at various stages. Facilitate development of cost estimates and budgets and establish reasonable cost and schedule baselines.
• Perform trend analysis and actively evaluate project cost and schedule performance to identify potential risk areas, validate forecasts, and communicate those quickly to key stakeholders. Provide integrated reporting information to internal stakeholders.
• Implement change management practices and appropriately capture related costs and schedule activities.
• Develop and manage Cost / Change Control procedures, including change order origination, review, negotiation, recommendations, and delay analysis.
• Cost/schedule management tracking.
• Budget Management and Tracking. Manage contingency draw. Compile as-built cost estimate records for benchmarking purposes.
• Develop and manage Document Control procedures.
• Tracking of all key project documents, including change orders, invoices and payments, lien releases, etc.
• Invoice / Payment Application processing, tracking and reporting.
• Support Management Team in producing monthly reports.
• Manage Program Database, Power BI dashboards.
• Format and providing accurate reports on a weekly, monthly, yearly, and as needed basis.
• Produce earned value reports.
• Review GC’s cost tracking reports.
• Reconcile GC actual costs with GMP/ Schedule of Values.
• Contract Administration (retention, T&Cs, insurance, allowances, contingency, incentives).
• Compiling as built cost estimate records for benchmarking purposes.
• Maintain cost benchmarking database.
• On Site Records and Document Control.
• Tracking of all key project documents, including change orders, invoices and payments, lien releases, etc.
• Initiate close out process prior to project completion, typically two to three months in advance.
• Establish close out documentation procedures and requirements; collect and track receipt of all close out documents until completion, including warranties, as-builts, O&M manuals, etc.
• Setting and attending change control and cost meetings as required.
• Attend risk meetings and maintain risk log.
• Monitor, track and analyze schedule progress in the field (actual vs. forecast).

Key Elements

• Work with project managers to develop and maintain the Project Management Plan along with RFP/SOW/change order templates for various projects and support the development of service agreements and SOW’s as needed.
• Track proposal reviews, negotiations and contract execution. Manage/ coordinate and track the supplier delivery plan to ensure suppliers meet the demand per the plan.
• Provide reports for the progress and status of SOW’s open for long periods of time. Coordinate closure of POs at project-end and keep track of work orders status.
• Periodically review financial reports to ensure compliance with budget targets, reconcile project charges against approved contracts and support gathering data related to unit costs within sites.

• 15+ years of applicable experience, preferably in large scale programs ($10 million +) with multiple sub-programs.
• Good knowledge of construction industry technical matters, such as different procurement routes, value management and value engineering.
• Comprehensive understanding of construction estimating, scheduling and risk management methodologies.
• Advanced skills with spreadsheets, report writing and presentations.
• High proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite of applications.
• Experience with cloud-based software.
• P6 scheduling knowledge preferred.
• Skilled in the use of industry accepted applications for cost, planning and progress measurement.
• Self-Motivated and proactive.
• Demonstrates a high level of self-organization, coordination and planning.
• Good organization skills, ability to multi-task, be a team player and integrate easily with others.
• Must have strong and professional English oral and written communication skills.
• Experience working in a cost-focused Project Controls role in the construction industry.
• Mission critical, manufacturing, or pharmaceutical related experience preferred.
• College degree; ideally in construction, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or related.
• Experience with cost and resource loaded schedules.

*On-site presence and full-time residency in San Juan, Puerto Rico, required.

*Relocation may be provided for the right candidate.

*Spanish language knowledge would be helpful for life on the island but is not required for this role*

SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

jobs.title: Senior Inside Sales Advisor (Remote/Central Time)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Inside Sales Consultant, you will work with families who have already begun their search with A Place for Mom and guide them through the final stages of their decision.

This is a high-activity, performance-driven inside sales role focused on re-engaging families, managing a pipeline of opportunities, and converting interest into move-ins.

You will be responsible for consistent follow-up, strong consultative selling, and disciplined execution across every stage of the sales process.

You will play a critical role in helping families make one of the most important decisions of their lives. Your ability to follow through, guide effectively, and drive outcomes directly impacts both family experiences and business success.

What you will do:

 - Manage a pipeline of families who have previously engaged with A Place for Mom and require continued guidance toward a move-in decision.

 - Execute consistent, high-volume outreach across phone, text, and email to re-engage and advance families.

 - Drive outcomes by moving families from tour to decision, including scheduling additional tours and providing new referrals when needed.

 - Apply a structured follow-up cadence to maintain engagement and prevent pipeline stagnation.

 - Build trust quickly with families, understand their needs, and guide them to the best-fit care options.

 - Partner with senior living communities and care providers to coordinate tours, share feedback, and support move-in conversion.

 - Maintain accurate, real-time documentation in CRM to reflect pipeline status, next steps, and forecasts.

 - Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales targets and conversion expectations.

 - Participate in ongoing coaching, call reviews, and training to continuously improve performance.

What will make you successful:

 - High daily activity and consistent follow-up execution

 - Strong pipeline management and organization

 - Ability to convert engaged families into move-ins

 - Consistent achievement of sales targets

 - Responsiveness to coaching and continuous improvement

Who you Are:

 - A results-driven sales professional who thrives in a high-activity, metrics-based environment

 - Skilled at closing and advancing deals, not just generating interest

 - Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple families and timelines simultaneously

 - Comfortable owning a pipeline and being accountable for outcomes

 - Coachable, resilient, and motivated to improve performance

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of experience in a quota-driven sales role, preferably inside or phone-based sales

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets

 - Experience managing and converting warm lead pipelines

 - Strong communication and active listening skills

 - Ability to multitask (phone + CRM documentation simultaneously)

 - Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools

 - Ability to work remotely with a high level of focus and accountability

Preferred:

 - Bachelor’s degree

 - Strongly preferred Senior Living Community Sales Experience

Work Environment:

 - Fully remote role with a required dedicated home office space

 - High-speed, hardwired internet connection required

 -  Company-provided laptop, VOIP system, CRM access, and tools

 - Schedule includes some evenings, weekends, and holidays

Compensation:

 - Hourly Base Salary: $51,500 ($24.76 an hour)

 - On Target Earnings: $86,500 ($35,000 variable bonus (Uncapped) 

 - Benefits:
   
   - 401(k) plus match
   
   - Dental Insurance
   
   - Health Insurance
   
   - Vision Insurance
   
   - Paid Time Off

#LI-JR1

About A Place for Mom

A Place for Mom is the leading platform guiding families through every stage of the aging journey. Together, we simplify the senior care search with free, personalized support — connecting caregivers and their loved ones to vetted providers from our network of 15,000+ senior living communities and home care agencies.

Since 2000, our teams have helped millions of families find care that fits their needs. Behind every referral and resource is a shared goal: to help families focus on what matters most — their love for each other.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Viam

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We’re inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We’re a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

The role

This is a product marketing role for someone who can build. Our users are software engineers and developers, and they can tell right away when marketing doesn’t understand the product. You’ll understand it well enough to demo it, write the tutorial, answer the hard question on a webinar, and explain why our architecture choices matter to the person evaluating us.

You’ll own how developers learn what Viam does, why it works the way it does, and why that matters to them. That means fewer slide decks and more working examples.

What you’ll do

• Set the developer positioning. Own the messaging architecture for the developer platform: who it’s for, what it replaces, and how it compares to ROS-based stacks, in-house tooling, and other robotics platforms. Write the framework that product, sales, solutions, and community teams work from, and keep it current as the product and the market change.

• Bring developer evidence into product decisions. Work with product leadership on what ships, how it’s packaged, and how it’s presented to developers. Back up your input with usage data, win/loss conversations, competitive research, and what you hear in the forum.

• Explain the product. Turn platform capabilities like fragments, OTA updates, the Module Registry, and data and ML pipelines into clear narratives, docs-adjacent content, and demos that engineers trust.

• Run technical programs end to end. Produce partner webinars and workshops: shape the story, build or coordinate the demo, prep the speakers, and handle the follow-up.

• Make security legible. Work with engineering to document Viam’s security architecture (auth, network model, data handling, fleet access) so security reviewers and technical buyers get straight answers without a sales call.

• Position and package our free developer courses. Work with technical content engineers on how each course is positioned, described, and promoted, so developers see right away what they’ll build. Extend that into SEO and AEO content, social, and nurture that gets registrants to their first working robot.

• Own launches. Write messaging, launch briefs, and enablement for new features. Make sure sales, solutions, and community teams can explain each feature correctly.

• Stay close to developers. Use the product every week. Read and contribute to our community forum and the developer groups where robotics builders spend time, and bring what you learn there back to product and marketing.

What you bring

• 6-8+ years in product marketing and/or developer marketing at a developer-first infrastructure company (Datadog, Vercel, Twilio, MongoDB, Stripe, or similar).

• A technical foundation, ideally a degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience shipping software.

• Comfort writing and running code. You can stand up a sample project, read an SDK, and spot a vague claim in a technical doc.

• A track record of designing the story and the programs around complex systems, from positioning to demos to content, so engineers come away understanding the product, not just the pitch.

• Experience producing technical content or events: webinars, workshops, tutorials, launch content.

• Judgment about proof. You’d rather show a config file than call something “easy.”

Nice to have

• Exposure to robotics, embedded systems, IoT, or anything involving real hardware.

• Experience with security, compliance, or trust content for technical buyers.

• Experience positioning or packaging a developer education or certification program.

• A public body of work: blog posts, talks, repos, videos.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

• You can give a live Viam demo from scratch.

• Your first partner webinar ships, with a clear story and measurable registrations and follow-on signups.

• A first public version of our security architecture explainer is live.

• Updated positioning and content for our course lineup is live.

Full-time Benefits

Viam’s base salary range for this role is posted above. In addition to cash compensation, Viam offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants, health benefits, and more.

• 100% covered medical/dental/vision insurance plans, commuter benefits

• 25 days paid vacation and generous holiday observances

• Free lunch every day that you’re in the office

• One Medical Membership

• Citi Bike memberships

• Monthly wellness stipend to be used for a variety of fitness-related items like gym memberships, fitness classes, fitness equipment, and more

• Paid parental leave

• Reproductive Health Benefits, including Fertility Benefits and Abortion Access Travel Benefits

• Yearly Learning and Development Budget for your own personal learning goals

Values:

• Vision Driven

• Collaborate Openly

• Act Decisively

• Succeed Through Diversity

• Hold Ourselves Accountable

• Lead with Curiosity

To all recruitment agencies:

Viam does not accept unsolicited agency resumes or calls from recruitment agencies or search firms. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or Viam employees. Viam is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Internal Control, Audit & Compliance

Continuous Improvement & Control Excellence

• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies, and process bottlenecks across finance and operational workflows.

• Promote “control by design” principles in system implementations and process transformations.

jobs.title: Vascular Surgeon
jobs.description:
Job Title: Vascular Surgeon
Location: Austin, TX
Employment Type: Full-time or Part-time
Salary: $250,000 – $500,000 per year for Full-time

Vascular Surgeon Jobs in Austin, TX: Your Wound Expertise, a Better Way to Practice

Few specialists understand chronic wounds like a Vascular Surgeon. You’ve spent your career treating the arterial and venous disease behind non-healing ulcers and fighting for limb salvage. But with a nationwide shortage of vascular surgeons, many carry heavy call schedules, get pulled in overnight for ruptured aneurysms and acute limb ischemia, and spend long hours in lead aprons during endovascular cases. Skilled Wound Care, a premier national physician group, is hiring Vascular Surgeons in Austin, TX to work as wound care physicians and lead wound care initiatives in skilled nursing facilities across the area.

Maybe you’re a Vascular Surgeon ready to step away from emergency call, long OR days and the physical strain of the procedure suite. Maybe you want a part-time role alongside your current practice. Either way, this no-call Vascular Surgeon job offers a high-impact career without the corporate red tape.

Why Vascular Surgeons in Austin, TX Choose Wound Care

In a specialty where being on call can mean a 2 a.m. ruptured aneurysm or an emergency limb salvage case, we offer a refreshing alternative:

• The “No-Call” Lifestyle: No nights, no weekends and no pagers. No middle-of-the-night vascular emergencies. This is a true Monday–Friday surgeon job, so your evenings and weekends belong to you and your family.

• Put Your Wound Expertise to Work: Arterial ulcers, venous ulcers and diabetic foot wounds are already part of your world. Your vascular training makes you a natural fit for wound care.

• Keep Your Surgical Skills: Surgical debridement and bedside procedures stay part of your daily practice.

• A Sustainable Surgical Career: Leave behind long cases and hours in heavy lead aprons. Bedside procedures are far easier on your back, neck and shoulders, so you can keep practicing for years to come.

• Clinical Autonomy: Direct patient outcomes based on your surgical expertise, not a hospital committee or department hierarchy.

• Smarter Documentation: Our custom software is designed to slash admin time, so you’re not stuck charting at midnight when you could be home at a reasonable hour.

Vascular Surgeon Responsibilities

Use the latest advancements in wound healing to change lives in communities across Austin, TX:

• Surgical and sharp debridement and other bedside procedures

• Evaluation and treatment of chronic, non-healing and complex wounds, including arterial, venous and diabetic ulcers

• Advanced dressings and specialized wound protocols

• Collaborative care in skilled nursing facilities and the post-acute setting, where you follow patients through healing

Vascular Surgeon Salary & Compensation

• Full-Time Average Annual Earnings: $250,000–$500,000 (no earning cap as an independent contractor)

• High Achievers: Top performers earn $500,000+ through performance bonuses

• Pay Structure: Per-patient and per-procedure pay, plus quarterly bonus programs

Vascular Surgeon Schedule

We offer consistent weekday schedules with no nights or weekends, in part-time or full-time options:

• Part-Time: 2–3 days per week

• Full-Time: 4–5 days per week

Vascular Surgeon Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Vector Search - Elasticsearch
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Relevance team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This technical leader is responsible for contributing to the technical direction and vision for our search capabilities, including design and implementation of new search features, enhancements to search functionality, and resolving bugs.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

• Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading search engine offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.

• Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.

• Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.

• Be an expert on Elasticsearch search relevance. You'll identify and drive improvements this area based on your questions and your instincts.

• Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.

• Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!

What You Bring

• You have implemented novel techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or progressed the field of academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.

• Professional experience with search or vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.

• You have solid skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.

• You work with a high level of autonomy and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.

• You're comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you've collaborated over the internet because that's harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That's even harder, but we do it anyway because it's the best way we know how to build software.

• You've used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.

• You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

• You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities

• You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

• You've built things with Elasticsearch before.

• You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.

• Experience with data storage technology.

• You have experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.  In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

$133,100—$210,600 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

jobs.title: Sr Account Manager, AMER (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, I’m TJ Jackson, Manager of Account Management at Customer.io, and I’m hiring a Sr. Account Manager to join our North America's team. This is a sales role. You’ll own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers and be accountable for generating expansion pipeline, closing new revenue, and securing renewals.

You’ll build on existing customer relationships and prospect beyond them. That means cold calling people who haven’t worked with us, identifying new buying teams, and winning business with additional brands within the same parent company. You’ll lead discovery, build relationships with multiple stakeholders, and own each deal from the first conversation through negotiation and close.

We’re looking for someone with a track record in B2B sales who can walk us through an expansion deal they sourced and closed. You should be comfortable generating your own pipeline, multi-threading across complex accounts, and using a sales methodology such as MEDDICC to qualify opportunities and move deals forward.

This role is open to candidates based in US and Canada only.

What we value

• Commercial ownership — you treat your book of business like it's yours, because it is

• Forecasting discipline and data-driven decision-making, not gut feel

• Multi-threaded relationships — you build trust across the org, not just with one champion

• Expansion through value, not feature gates or mechanical levers

• Close partnership with Customer Success — you see CS as a collaborator, not a handoff

What you'll do

• Own the full commercial strategy for a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts — renewals, expansion, and churn mitigation

• Drive growth by helping customers adopt Customer.io more strategically, identifying new use cases and articulating ROI clearly

• Forecast renewal and expansion pipeline accurately with a clear, repeatable methodology

• Build multi-threaded relationships from day-to-day operators to Directors and VPs, becoming a trusted commercial advisor

• Partner closely with Customer Success on account health and with Sales on expansion deals

• Engage Legal and Finance on complex renewals and collaborate cross-functionally to move deals forward

What we're looking for

• 3+ years in Sr. Account Management, Sales, or a related SaaS commercial role with direct ownership of a revenue number (5+ years preferred)

• Experience managing $5m ARR, predominantly in the MM space

• Proven ability to grow customer spend outside of overages or true-ups — genuine expansion through adoption and value articulation

• A forecasting methodology you can walk through clearly — it doesn't need to be a named framework, just logic you own

• Comfortable pulling usage data, tracking health scores, and building your own dashboards

• Strong communicator — clear and persuasive with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Based in the UK or Ireland

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $142,900 - $171,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in your local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role is a 70/30 OTE split. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• Take-Home Assignment

• 1-hour Assignment Review Call with the team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Crunchtime helps multi-unit restaurants operate every location like their best one. Trusted by 850+ brands across 150,000+ locations worldwide, Crunchtime connects the full operations management lifecycle across inventory management, labor and scheduling, kitchen management, and operations execution, in the industry’s only complete, AI-powered suite. Top operators, including Jersey Mike’s, Five Guys, Smoothie King, Wingstop, and Chili’s, rely on Crunchtime to achieve profitability and deliver great guest experiences every day in every store. To learn more, visit Crunchtime.com.

About the Role

The Fulfillment Operations Specialist executes daily hands-on fulfillment, inbound/outbound logistics, hardware prep, and inventory management. Unlike a conventional entry-level warehouse position, this role combines active floor operations (picking, packing, dock receiving, pallet jack handling) with business communication, digital order tracking, and cross-team troubleshooting. Working alongside the Senior Fulfillment Coordinator and reporting to the Logistics Operations Manager, the Specialist ensures fast order turnaround, accurate serial data logging, and seamless carrier dispatches.

What You'll Do

• Inbound Receiving: Inspect, verify, and log inbound freight, parcel deliveries, and hardware returns against purchase orders and packing lists; report damaged or discrepant goods immediately.

• Order Picking, Kitting & Packing: Accurately pick hardware items, scan serial numbers, assemble hardware kits/bundles, and package orders in compliance with carrier (UPS, LTL freight) and brand protection guidelines.

• Hardware Testing: Execute standard hardware configuration, run diagnostic tests on returned or refurbished hardware, and prep hardware bundles for customer deployment.

• Digital Systems Data Hygiene: Maintain real-time record accuracy across NetSuite and Salesforce; process status changes, enter tracking information, and maintain clean inventory allocations.

• Dock Safety & Inventory Replenishment: Operate pallet jacks and dock staging equipment safely; maintain warehouse organization; perform scheduled cycle counts; and proactively monitor shipping supply stock levels.

• Cross-Departmental Communication: Communicate order statuses, receiving notices, and dock inquiries via Slack and email; participate in daily standups and department Zoom meetings.

What You'll Bring

• 1–3 years of experience in technical fulfillment, logistics operations, or inventory-driven warehousing.

• Experience operating material-handling equipment safely (pallet jacks, hand trucks) and coordinating with freight/parcel couriers.

• Comfort with business software: email etiquette, Slack, Google Workspace, and exposure to ERP/CRM platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce).

• Strong organizational skills, acute attention to detail with serial numbers/SKUs, and disciplined work habits.

• Aptitude or enthusiasm for learning hardware troubleshooting.

• Ability to lift, bend, and move inventory up to 50 lbs and remain on feet throughout fulfillment windows.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• On-time fulfillment rate against internal customer SLAs.

• Picking and shipping error rate (<0.5%).

• Cycle count accuracy and timely inventory status logging in NetSuite.

Compensation & Transparency

The annual base compensation range for this position is $43,500-$45,000. The reasonably estimated total cash compensation (base + variable) range for this full-time position will be $46,762-$48,375.00.

Actual compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualifications, education, experience, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

At Crunchtime, we are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic.

We have an inclusive and diverse workplace where every team member is respected and valued. As a global software development company, we believe that our diverse employee population enriches our work environment.

Join us in our mission to provide the best software solutions to the food industry. We encourage you to apply regardless of your background or experience; even if you don’t meet all the qualifications, because we believe unique experiences and perspectives make us a stronger team.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer, Global Security
jobs.description:
Global Security is advancing toward an integrated, intelligence-led, and AI-enabled operating model. The function generates and consumes significant operational, intelligence, investigative, resilience, travel risk, product protection, physical security, emergency communications, case management, threat intelligence, access control, video surveillance, visitor management, workflow, and enterprise security data. The Global Security Data & Analytics team seeks to unlock the full value of these data assets by bringing technology, data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to the forefront of security decision-making through scalable, fit-for-purpose analytics solutions.

The Principal Data Engineer, Global Security role is a key technical leadership role responsible for enabling advanced analytics capabilities across Global Security operations. The role influences data strategy and technology strategy in support of Global Security's analytics and artificial intelligence vision. Establishes standards and best practices to ensure consistency. Accountable for gathering cross-functional input. Identifies opportunities for automation to scale advanced analytics capabilities including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Stays abreast of industry trends and identifies new opportunities and value propositions.

Responsibilities

1. Data Strategy and Integration

Collaborates with Global Security stakeholders, system owners, analysts, and cross-functional data stewards to identify appropriate data sources and enable streamlined data flow for Global Security analytics, intelligence, reporting, investigations, resilience, and automation capabilities.

2. Cross-Functional Analytics Enablement

Collaborates across Global Security functional areas to link data, intelligence, investigations, operational metrics, and key learnings for broad impact on complex cross-functional initiatives involving advanced analytics methodologies and artificial intelligence capabilities.

3. Standards and Best Practices

Leads and helps establish design principles and standards to ensure analytical work products, data pipelines, integrations, and reporting capabilities are consistent across Global Security programs where appropriate and that user experience is optimized.

4. Data Quality and Operational Excellence

Implements standardized, automated operational and quality-control processes to deliver accurate and timely data and reporting.

5. Continuous Improvement

Leads functional process-improvement initiatives and lessons-learned activities, including hands-on work to map current-state workflows, identify data and process gaps, build prototypes, test automation opportunities, document improvement requirements, and translate operational pain points into scalable data, reporting, and workflow solutions.

6. Advanced Analytics and AI Enablement

Employs advanced analytics programs, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical methodologies to prepare data for predictive and prescriptive modeling, threat detection, investigations, anomaly detection, intelligence analysis, and operational analytics capabilities. Performs hands-on enablement work such as data exploration, feature identification, model-readiness assessment, dashboard and prototype development, AI use-case intake, prompt and knowledge-base testing, validation of outputs, and translation of analytics concepts into practical Global Security decision-support solutions. Develops solutions to improve data reliability, efficiency, and quality.

7. Leadership and Talent Development

May include indirect supervision of employees, contractors, implementation partners, and vendors.

8. Future-State Architecture and Technology Investments

Collaborates with Business Technology Solutions and identifies opportunities to future-proof Global Security analytics infrastructure. Influences future technology investments.

9. Security Data Ecosystem Integration

Collaborates with Global Security platform owners, enterprise technology teams, business partners, Legal and HR to integrate and govern data originating from security, intelligence, investigations, resilience, workflow, and enterprise systems to support reporting, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence capabilities.

Key Outcomes

• Integrate data across security, intelligence, investigations, resilience, risk, and enterprise platforms.
• Reduce manual data collection, preparation, and reconciliation efforts.
• Improve data quality, reliability, consistency, and scalability.
• Deliver consistent reporting, dashboards, KPI/KRI frameworks, and executive scorecards.
• Enable predictive analytics, threat detection, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted investigations.
• Support intelligence-led security decision-making and operational planning.
• Accelerate automation, machine learning, and artificial intelligence initiatives.
• Expand enterprise visibility through consistent and reusable data assets.
• Improve security analytics infrastructure and future technology readiness.
• Enable Global Security long-range AI, analytics, and digital transformation objectives.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in statistics, mathematics, analytics, data science, computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or equivalent field with 8+ years of related experience for a bachelor's degree, 6+ years for a master's degree, or 4+ years for a doctoral degree.
• Experience with enterprise data integration and management technologies, such as Informatica PowerCenter, Big Data Management, Master Data Management, or comparable platforms.
• Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale data pipelines, data integration solutions, and analytical data products.
• Strong experience with SQL, relational and analytical data modeling, data warehouses, data lakes, Lakehouse architectures, and enterprise data platforms.
• Experience implementing automated operational, monitoring, reconciliation, and data-quality control processes.
• Experience preparing data for advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and reporting capabilities.
• Demonstrated ability to influence data strategy and technology strategy, establish standards and best practices, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives.
• Experience collaborating with business stakeholders, data stewards, technology teams, system owners, and enterprise partners to define requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
• Strong communication, consultation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions.
• Experience developing solutions that improve data reliability, efficiency, scalability, and quality.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or comparable cloud-based analytics and data technologies.
• Experience with Python, Spark, or other programming languages commonly used for data engineering, analytics, automation, or artificial intelligence.
• Experience supporting enterprise reporting, KPI/KRI frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytics environments.
• Experience implementing data governance, metadata management, master data management, lineage tracking, data cataloging, and role-based access controls.
• Experience preparing structured and unstructured data for enterprise search, retrieval-augmented generation, natural-language interfaces, or AI-enabled decision-support solutions.
• Experience integrating data across multiple enterprise platforms, applications, APIs, and operational systems.
• Familiarity with physical security, investigations, intelligence, crisis management, resilience, travel security, product protection, supply-chain security, or enterprise risk management.
• Experience operating within regulated, privacy-sensitive, highly controlled, or security-focused environments.
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate data and AI capabilities into practical business value.
• Experience coaching technical resources and providing leadership across employees, contractors, vendors, and cross-functional project teams.

jobs.description:
Lighthouse Behavioral Health Solutions (LBHS) offers a full continuum of care, including outpatient, intensive outpatient, partial hospitalization, residential treatment, psychiatric services, and medication‑assisted treatment. We take pride in creating a welcoming, compassionate environment where individuals feel supported. Our team believes in every client’s ability to achieve recovery and rebuild meaningful, engaged lives in their communities.

Offering Hiring Bonus: $5,000
Position: Licensed Clinical Therapist (LCDC II/LCDC III/LSW/LPC/LICDC/LISW/LPCC)

Job Summary: Assisting individuals recovering from addiction or mental health challenges by providing specialized clinical services. This position reports to a Clinical Supervisor.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Provides clinical services such as individual and group therapy, case management, and crisis intervention services to Lighthouse clients within the scope of practice and as privileged by the supervisor.

• Completes the crisis and safety plan, treatment plan, service notes, transition and discharge plan, forms, and miscellaneous job-related reports about a person served in the time frame required by the center, accreditation and certification bodies, respective professional licensing boards, and funding sources.

• Maintains an accurate and complete clinical record for each client served under Quality Improvement and billing standards.

• Assists in program development and planning as assigned.

• Responds to requests for clinical information on clients served as allowed by law and applicable rules and regulations. Verbal and written communications of Protected Health Information (PHI) must comply with 42 CFR Part 2, mental health laws, and HIPAA. The Counselor shares only information within the scope of practice and professional licensing standards.

• Keeps abreast of community resources, educates clients about those resources, and makes appropriate referrals as needed to meet client needs. Activates Case Management or CPST Services as medically necessary to help remove barriers to recovery (e.g., problems with finance/poverty, living arrangements/housing, occupation, skill-building/education, and support system).

• Collaborates and coordinates with other service providers involved in client care in the community to promote integrated and holistic care.

• Responds to community professionals in a timely manner, after contacting Lighthouse staff.

• Promotes progressive pro-social interventions (e.g., client connectedness in the community, involvement in a safe and supportive environment, participation in activities where the client finds social acceptance), and positive reinforcement strategies.

• Person-centered, strength-based, and culturally sensitive approach when promoting client engagement in the community.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work or related field or equivalent experience.

• Active license (LCDC II/LCDC III/ LSW/LPC/LICDC/LISW/LPCC)

• Must pass BCI check, all Corporate Compliance checks, and employment drug screen.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

Compensation Ranges:

$50,000 – $57,500 LCDCII & LCDCIII
$60,000 – $67,500 Bachelors LSW
$65,000 – $72,500 LPC, Masters LSW, LICDC, & LICDC-CS
$70,000 – $80,000 LISW & LPCC
$75,000 – $83,500 LPCC-S & LISW-S

**Compensation is dependent on licensure and years of experience

Location: Lima, OH

Our benefits package includes paid time off (PTO and sick time), paid holidays, medical/dental/vision, 401(k), life insurance, paid continuing education with supervision, parental leave, and eligibility for loan forgiveness programs.

jobs.title: Document Control Technician I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Document Control Technician I will provide document control support to Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) within the Airport Development: Capital Planning, Oversight, Management, and Analytics program. Initial assignments include TDIP and ADP. The role receives, processes, distributes, files, retrieves, maintains, and archives project-related records received and sent by LAWA, using LAWA’s Project Management Information System (PMIS) and hard-copy filing system. The technician also responds to records requests and helps prepare project files and administrative records for project closeout and records retention.

This is a full-time, hybrid position: telework on Monday and Friday, onsite Tuesday through Thursday (see LAWA’s Pilot Policy for details). A laptop will be provided. After training, the technician may be co-located with the construction management team in a field construction environment. The estimated assignment runs from December 21, 2026 through June 30, 2027. Overtime and various shifts may be required as needed.

Key Identifiers

• Candidates must have a minimum of five years of experience with document processing and data management.

• Candidates must have a two-year technical degree.

• Candidates must have mastery of Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat Professional.

• Candidates must have the means to drive between office and field locations.

• Candidates must be able to occasionally wrap, lift, and move boxes or packages of up to 40 pounds.

• Candidates must be able to work overtime and various shifts as needed.

• Candidates must be able to climb stairs, ladders, and scaffolding, and access trenches, excavations, and other areas associated with the work being inspected.

Daily Duties

• Receive, log, scan, index, retrieve, file, and distribute project documents in PMIS and related document management systems.

• Maintain electronic and hard-copy project records according to established document control procedures. This includes internal Airports Development Group (ADG) records and records exchanged with City agencies, consultants, and contractors.

• Manage the flow of records to project participants, including correspondence, technical submittals, project reports, Requests for Information (RFIs), contract plans, and specifications.

• Prepare routine transmittals and distribute and retrieve documents through PMIS.

• Communicate document updates and new versions to the Document Manager.

• Assist the Project Manager, Construction Manager, and project team with all matters related to project records and the control and distribution of documents in PMIS.

• Support project teams in organizing workflows and approvals.

• Perform quality reviews to make sure project records are complete, accurate, and properly filed.

• Identify issues in document workflows and escalate them when needed.

• Participate in project meetings as necessary.

• Provide backup support to Senior Technicians during PTO, absences, or as operational needs require.

• May assume other duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience with document processing and data management.

• Required: experience with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel, Word) and Adobe Acrobat Professional.

• Demonstrated experience with routine document control hardware and software, such as scanners and optical character recognition (OCR).

• Preferred: experience with large-scale document control software, with PMIS and/or Documentum highly desirable.

• Highly desirable: certification for document control professionals.

• Highly desirable: experience supporting document control activities for large-scale international airports.

• Highly desirable: previous experience in a construction environment.

• Proven accuracy, reliability, and completeness in job performance, shown by satisfactory performance, acceptance of responsibility, and growth in previous positions.

• Effective oral and written communication skills.

• Ability to work with people of varied technical levels and educational backgrounds while keeping a positive customer-service attitude.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to produce consistently accurate and timely results at a fast pace.

• Proactive self-starter with a results-oriented, “can-do” attitude, willing and able to take on additional responsibilities.

• Sensitive to deadlines and able to adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Required Education

• Two Year Technical Degree.

Featured Benefits

401(k), Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, 100% employer-paid premiums

Additional Information

For over 50 years, Leland Saylor Associates (LSA) has been a nationally recognized construction consulting firm providing expertise in the areas of estimating, scheduling, value engineering, and construction management. Saylor is a great place to work where your opinion matters, where you can grow with a supportive staff and make a difference in our project outcomes. We are proud to be an advisor on some of the largest, most technically complex projects in the nation.

We seek like-minded professionals who have a passion for estimating, drive to achieve results, creative problem-solving ability, and a dedication to client service and relationship management. We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. Come join us and partner with our world-class team and do your best work.

Saylor is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. The Globalization team is dedicated to expanding Block’s multiple brands worldwide. Our mission is to build on Block’s success and continue to deliver innovative, seamless, and fully localized experiences for multilingual Sellers and Customers domestically and abroad.

We are seeking a Quality Program Manager, Globalization to oversee and enhance our quality management at scale. This role involves managing key programs across quality planning, assurance, and control processes. It requires strong collaboration with both cross-functional partners and our suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality. The ultimate goal is to measure, optimize, and sustain quality throughout the localization process in order to protect customer trust, support conversion in global markets, and reduce regulatory risk.

• Partner with legal, risk, compliance, and product teams to ensure Block’s localization quality program meets regulatory requirements across markets.

• Assess existing tools and collaborate cross-functionally to optimize them through automation as a way to enhance scalability, productivity and efficiency.

• Use AI tools, such as LLM-based translation quality checks, to scale quality evaluation.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Weld Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

We are seeking an accomplished and innovative Senior Structural Weld Process Engineer to join our team and establish the welding and heavy fabrication capabilities for our large-scale, ISO container-sized weldment structures. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and validating structural weld processes from the ground up while leading the physical setup of the weld shop floor, including welding machines, welding tables, jigs, and fixtures. You will collaborate closely with mechanical design, manufacturing, quality, and equipment vendor teams to build a scalable, safe, and reliable fabrication operation that meets performance, cost, and throughput targets.

This position presents an opportunity to influence structural product design from its inception, enabling early integration of Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Excellence (DFX), and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles. As a critical interface between product development and industrialization, you will translate heavy-duty structural concepts into production-ready welded enclosures that meet the demands of high-reliability manufacturing.

Responsibilities

• Define, develop, and standardize structural welding processes (GMAW/MIG, GTAW/TIG, FCAW, SMAW, etc.) and create Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Procedure Qualification Records (PQR) for ISO container-sized structural steel and/or aluminum weldments

• Lead the end-to-end setup and layout of the weld manufacturing area, including specifying, procuring, installing, and commissioning welding power sources, modular welding tables, positioners, fume extraction systems, and material handling equipment

• Design, build, and validate heavy-duty welding fixtures, jigs, and tacking stations to control distortion, maintain tight dimensional tolerances, and ensure repeatable part geometry across large assemblies

• Utilize CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, AutoCAD) to design weldment fixtures, floor layouts, and review 3D structural assemblies and 2D weld symbol callouts

• Contribute to product DFM and DFA, such as joint design, weld accessibility, distortion mitigation, material selection, and tolerance stack-ups, to improve structural integrity and reduce fabrication cycle times

• Partner with quality, structural engineering, and external fabrication suppliers to support First Article Inspections (FAI), weld qualification, non-destructive testing (NDT), and process window optimization

• Lead weld design reviews, fixture reviews, and Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) risk assessments

• Identify opportunities for weld process automation (e.g., cobots/robotics), cycle-time efficiency improvements, equipment preventative maintenance, and cost reduction

• Work closely with EH&S teams to ensure weld shop operations, ventilation, PPE, and hot-work protocols meet regulatory compliance and safety standards

Qualifications

• BS or MS in Welding Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent extensive industry experience)

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in structural weld process engineering and heavy fabrication manufacturing

• Proven experience setting up a weld shop or production cell from scratch, including specifying welding equipment, tables, and custom fixturing for large-scale weldments (such as ISO containers, heavy machinery frames, or structural skids)

• Deep working knowledge of welding processes (MIG, TIG, Flux-Core), weld metallurgy, distortion control, and structural welding codes (e.g., AWS D1.1, AWS D1.2, ISO 3834)

• Experience with CAD software (3DEXPERIENCE (3DX), CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo, etc.) for fixture design and weldment reviews

• Experience with DFM/DFA methodologies for welded structures and sheet metal/plate fabrication

• Good understanding of GD&T, weld symbols, and tolerance stack-ups across large structural assemblies

• Ability to mentor junior engineers, welders, and weld technicians

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 15%, including internationally

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Bonus Qualifications

• Certified Welding Engineer (CWEng) or Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) credentials through the American Welding Society (AWS)

• Experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for structural or weld distortion/thermal simulation (e.g., Ansys Mechanical)

• Hands-on experience with supporting fabrication processes, including CNC laser/plasma cutting, press brake forming, machining, and industrial powder coating/painting

• Experience integrating robotic or collaborative welding (cobot) cells into production environments

• Familiarity with non-destructive testing (NDT) methods (VT, PT, MT, UT) and weld quality management systems

• Experience manufacturing large enclosures or structural skids for power electronics, energy storage (BESS), data centers, automotive, or aerospace applications

Please note: This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.

While this role is listed for the location above, we may consider candidates in other locations on a case-by-case basis.

Onsite Collaboration Rationale:

Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.

Why Join Amperesand

• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems

• High ownership and visibility

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure

• Fast-moving startup environment

Pay Disclosure & Benefits

Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.

The benefits outlined below apply exclusively to employees located in the United States:

• Competitive Salary + Incentive Stock Options

• Medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees and their dependents, effective from the start of hire

• Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 401k retirement savings plan through Empower

The benefits outlined below apply to employees located in Singapore:

Additional benefits may be available depending on the role and employment type. Benefits are subject to the terms of applicable company policies and plans.

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.

Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.
