jobs.title: Senior Scientist I/II - Solid Sate Characterization
jobs.description:
AbbVie Analytical Research & Development (Analytical R&D) is a global analytical scientific organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative small molecule medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules to Late Stage Clinical.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.  We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.

Position Description:

This Senior Scientist – Solid State Characterization position will be in a technical specialty group - Physical Analytical Chemistry (PAC) withing Analytical R&D.  The PAC group is a global team of experienced and innovative scientists which utilize a diverse set of physical analytical tools to advance CMC development programs by providing insights and driving the understanding of materials, processes, and products.  Additionally, the group contributes to development and justification of control strategies and authors relevant sections of regulatory submissions across all development phases.

We are looking for a subject matter expert in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of drug substances (DS) and drug products (DP), from early form discovery through regulatory filing. The role focuses on single crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD), Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), electron diffraction (3D ED/MicroED), Rietveld refinement, quantitative phase analysis (QPA), and phase-appropriate polymorph quantitation methods both in drug substance and drug products. The scientist will work closely with Molecular Profiling Drug Development, Process Chemistry, Formulation, Process Engineering, Analytical, Operations, Quality Assurance and CMC-Regulatory.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support new product development with advanced methods development and validations, technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements.
• Serve as technical SME in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of DS and DP; Responsible for PXRD method development for DS and DP, validation/technical transfer packages, and generation of technical data in support regulatory requirements
• Serve as the PXRD expert for supporting solid form screening, identification, crystallinity, and stability studies; perform indexing, Pawley/Le Bail fitting, Rietveld refinement, and structure determination from powder data.
• Perform quantitative phase analysis: Quantify polymorphic and amorphous content in DS and DP using Rietveld, whole-pattern, and multivariate approaches, addressing low drug load, excipient interference, preferred orientation, and micro absorption.
• Apply advanced diffraction such as VT/VH-XRPD, in situ, synchrotron, and PDF analysis to study phase transformations and poorly crystalline/amorphous materials.
• Apply SCXRD and 3D ED/MicroED structure determination, including absolute configuration and crystal packing of APIs, salts, cocrystals, hydrates, and solvates; generate calculated powder patterns and CIF reports.
• Conduct orthogonal solid-state characterization including X-ray diffraction, thermal analysis, moisture sorption, microscopy, spectroscopy as applicable for solid form, impurity and stability studies
• Support solid form control strategies per ICH Q6A, author Module 3 sections and health authority responses, and ensure GMP and data integrity compliance.
• Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory work, method development and troubleshoot; processing, interpreting, and visualizing data to facilitate project team decisions
• Represent PAC on CMC teams, lead form-change investigations, mentor scientists, and implement new diffraction technologies.
• Build strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team to enable higher performance.
• Routinely demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity in research or development activities and maintain a high level of productivity in the lab.
• Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding code of conduct, safety, appropriate handling of materials, controlled drug and radioactive compounds, and GxP compliance, where applicable.

Qualifications:

• Bachelors, Masters, or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Material Science, Physics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field typically with minimum 10 (BS), 8 (MS), or 0 – 2 (Ph.D.) years related industry experience.
• Strong technical background in solid state characterization, excellent analytical problem-solving, communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Capable of independently developing and troubleshoot analytical methods.
• Extensive hands-on PXRD experience, including indexing, Rietveld refinement, QPA, and polymorph and amorphous quantitation.
• Track record of developing and validating PXRD methods for DS and DP in a GMP environment, with knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), Q6A, Q14, and USP <941>.
• Expertise in small molecule SCXRD structure solution and refinement, including disorder modeling and absolute structure; and knowledge of 3D ED/MicroED approaches.
• Proficiency with tools such as Olex2, SHELX, CrysAlisPro, TOPAS, Diffrac Eva and DQuant, GSAS-II, HighScore, Mercury, and the CSD.
• Hands-on experience with DSC, TGA, hot-stage and polarized light microscopy, DVS, and strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
• Experience with Raman/FTIR/NIR, solid-state NMR, SEM, SAXS, micro-CT, and crystal structure prediction, and particle characterization is preferred.
• Experience with AI/ML and data science for automation of phase identification and Rietveld/QPA workflows, chemometrics, and Python or R scripting is preferred.
• Experience with biophysical characterization tools of nanoDSC, DLS, SEC-MALS, CD, AUC, nanoDSF in peptide, LNP and biologic materials, formulations and process characterization is preferred.
• Strong pharmaceutical industry experience in solid state characterization is preferred
• Ability to coordinate activities and work simultaneously on multiple projects, in a global, fast-paced setting where priorities may change quickly.
• High attention to detail and creative problem solving while exhibiting strong interpersonal skills and proven ability to work independently as well as part of cross functional teams
• Knowledge of instrument set-up, troubleshooting, management and maintenance.
• Experience extracting insights from multidimensional data sets, along with other physical analytical characterizations, and connecting to pharmaceutical materials, processes, and products
• Practical knowledge of organic structure, functional groups, chemistry, and modern spectroscopic techniques as applied to small-molecule analytical analysis.
• Create a learning environment, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement.
• Embrace the ideas of others, nurture innovation and manage innovation to reality.

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.



Field CTO Position Summary

The Delinea Field CTO is a senior, hands-on technical advisor for a region or vertical, reporting to the GTM CTO. The Field CTO is the architect a customer's engineering leadership invites into its design decisions, engaging with AI platform leaders, principal engineers, and architecture boards to open and shape strategic accounts on technical merit.

The Field CTO partners closely with both Sales and Sales Engineering to ensure a unified and smooth path through the sales process. The Field CTO sets the architecture direction for agentic-AI security in each strategic opportunity and hands to Sales Engineering to carry it to the technical win, so the customer experiences one motion from the first architecture conversation through deployment. During evaluations, the Field CTO gives the Delinea sellers the technical justification for the proposal, supporting both deal size and close velocity. Field CTOs also build and maintain the reference architectures and technical points of view the field sells from, aligned to the GTM CTO's external Field CTO  |  INTERNAL   

technical point of view. The role carries Delinea's technical depth into its territory and raises the field's ability to engage on architecture. It is a senior seat assigned to the top book of business, measured on its contribution to net-new ACV in the territory.

What You'll Do

 - Own the territory's contribution to net-new ACV.

 - Build and hold technical relationships with the engineering leadership at the top book of business in the region or vertical: AI platform leaders, principal engineers, and architecture boards. Lead the architecture conversations that open and shape accounts, and create technically qualified demand.

 - Set the architecture direction for each strategic opportunity: runtime authorization for agents, zero standing privilege through credential injection, identity for autonomous agents and MCP, and the control model that ties them together. Hand to Sales Engineering for the technical win.

 - Partner closely with both Sales and Sales Engineering to ensure a unified, smooth path through the sales process, from the architecture conversation to the technical win.

 - Engage where it advances Delinea's customer-centric relationships in the territory, with clear entry and exit.

 - Build and maintain the reference architectures, blueprints, and technical points of view the field sells from, aligned to the GTM CTO's external technical point of view.

 - Carry the field's and customers' technical priorities into Product Management and Engineering through the GTM CTO, including product quality and fix advocacy for the territory.

 - Pair with the Field CISO in the territory, supplying the architecture findings that ground the Security Assessment motion in the customer's actual estate.

 - Raise the technical depth of the Sales Engineering team in the territory on agentic-AI security through mentoring and joint customer work.

What You'll Bring

 - 12–15+ years across security engineering, identity or infrastructure architecture, or technical consulting, with the credibility to hold the room with principal engineers.

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of identity security and privileged access, and of modern access architectures: proxy-based credential injection, zero standing privilege, and runtime authorization.

 - Fluency and proven accomplishments in AI, including agentic systems, the Model Context Protocol, and the security of autonomous agents.

 - The ability to translate an architecture into business outcomes alongside Sales, and executive presence with technical leaders. This is a senior-director-equivalent seat.

 - A recognized technical voice through open-source work, speaking, or published architecture, direct knowledge of the PAM/IAM competitive landscape, and vertical or regional depth relevant to the assigned book of business are a plus.

Why work at Delinea? 

 - We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

 - We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

 - What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.



At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

 - Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

 - Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

 - Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

 - Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

 - Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

 - Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. 

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

The Patient Flow Coordinator role is performed from within designated Northwestern Medicine ICC locations and requires in-clinic orientation.  This position will work 12-hour shifts and include weekend and holiday requirements.

The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer -  Marketing
jobs.description:
About Point

✨ Real Impact, Real People: Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

✨ Funding: With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we’re scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

✨ Game-changing Product: We're building a category defining company in home equity. We’ve earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

✨ Great Place to Work: Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection: Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

Local or 100% Remote

About the role

Point helps homeowners unlock the equity in their homes without taking on a monthly payment, and we find those homeowners through a multi-channel marketing program that keeps growing: millions of pieces of direct mail a month, paid search and social, affiliates, CTV and a fast-growing broker channel. The data behind all of it lives in Snowflake and dbt, and today the marketing analysts build their own pipelines and dashboards on top of it. You will be the first analytics engineer dedicated to marketing. You own the models, the definitions and the activation feeds the team runs on, so every dashboard, experiment and audience reads the same numbers. You sit on the central data team and work day to day with the marketing analysts, with data scientists working on incrementality and media mix modeling, and with the product and engineering teams whose changes decide what gets captured. The work is visible: dashboards that load, attribution that reconciles, an audience and suppression table that replaces spreadsheets, and a semantic layer our AI analyst tooling can trust.

Your responsibilities

• Own the dbt models behind marketing reporting and activation: channel, campaign and source definitions, lead and funnel tables, attribution inputs. Layered, tested, with freshness checks.

• Build and maintain a governed semantic layer for marketing (channel, campaign and funnel definitions) so Sigma dashboards and AI-assisted analysis return the same answer to the same question.

• Move heavy transformations out of Sigma workbooks into dbt so the dashboards marketing leadership relies on load fast, then right-size the warehouse behind them.

• Keep activation pipelines healthy (Hightouch syncs, Google Ads and other Conversion API uploads, DSP feeds) and onboard new channels and partners through a repeatable pattern rather than bespoke work.

• Build the warehouse foundations for measurement: experiment assignment and universal control tables, holdout flags, and the feeds our media mix modeling vendor and incrementality analyses depend on.

• Build and maintain the audience and suppression table in Snowflake, with eligibility, model scores and suppression flags per property, feeding direct mail, email and the Audience and Campaign Manager so a suppression entered once applies everywhere.

• Partner with product and engineering before launches that change what the data captures (a new channel like broker, a new flow like Bridge) and define how they land in the models so reporting is right from day one.

• Take engineering work off the marketing analysts: review their PRs, hold the standard that new dashboards read from dbt models, and turn recurring requests into reusable data products.

• Monitor data quality on the marketing marts and close reliability issues so they stay closed: channel mismatches, missing affiliate payouts, unattributed spend.

About you

• 5+ years building data models for a business team as an analytics engineer, data engineer or engineering-minded analyst.

• Strong SQL and production dbt experience: layered models, tests, documentation, performance tuning.

• Hands-on with marketing data: ad platform exports (Google, Meta or similar), CRM and marketing automation sources, campaign and channel taxonomies, attribution logic.

• Semantic data modeling. You can turn a messy business question into a durable definition and defend it with the people who use it.

• Comfortable owning a pipeline end to end, including syncs to and from marketing platforms, with monitoring and alerting you set up yourself.

• Clear communicator who works well embedded with a non-engineering team, and who will choose a reusable model over a quick hack and explain why.

• Able to prioritize a queue of requests from several stakeholders and say plainly what will ship and when.

• Git-based workflow and code review as a habit, not a chore.

Nice to have

• Snowflake, AWS and Sigma (or another BI tool where you have refactored slow dashboards onto modeled tables).

• Medallion-style layering in dbt.

• Reverse ETL and activation tooling (Hightouch or similar) and Conversion API integrations.

• Data foundations for experimentation: assignment tables, holdouts, incrementality or media mix modeling data prep.

• AI-assisted engineering workflows (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) in daily use, and interest in building the data layer an AI analyst can query.

• Consumer fintech, lending or direct mail marketing background.

• Python for pipeline glue.

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

• Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $132,600 - $163,800

• Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $117,300 - $144,900

• Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $108,800 - $134,400

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point’s states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

Our benefits

• Generous health benefits: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (Health Care FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).

• Unlimited paid time off: Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.

• Flexible remote and onsite work: Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.

• Fully paid parental leave: Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.

• Equity: We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success.

• Financial wellness: We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.

• Extra work/life benefits: We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor.

Point is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn.

jobs.title: Senior Data Security Engineer
jobs.location: Santa Clara, California, United States; Toronto, Ontario, Canada
jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Data Security Engineer to lead data security posture management (DSPM), data loss prevention (DLP), AI data governance, and technical export-control enforcement across our SaaS estate, cloud, AI pipelines, and silicon engineering filesystems. As a senior member of the Operations Security (OpSec) team reporting to the Head of Information Security, you will protect our RISC-V and AI silicon IP, customer-confidential programs, and export-controlled data without slowing engineering down. This is a hands-on role for a data security engineer who builds their own tooling.

This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

• A DSPM/DLP specialist across Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub/GitLab, and AWS who writes code to fill the gaps off-the-shelf tools leave.

• AI-native: you use coding agents and LLMs to build tools and reports, and you design the guardrails that keep credentials and IP out of unauthorized models.

• Able to turn export-control rules (EAR, CMMC) and customer confidentiality agreements into enforceable identity groups and access controls.

• Pragmatic and high-signal, favoring high-confidence controls over noisy rules that frustrate engineers.

What We Need

• Deep experience designing and running DSPM and DLP controls across Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and AWS to stop unauthorized sharing and exfiltration.

• Strong grasp of AI security posture management: governing what data flows into AI tools, inference providers, and autonomous agents.

• Programming and automation skills (Python, TypeScript, or Go, plus Terraform and Docker) to build classification and permission-reconciliation pipelines.

• Experience with networked filesystems (NFS, SMB, AD/POSIX ACLs) and translating export-control boundaries into identity pipelines through Entra ID and Active Directory.

• Experience securing backups (immutability, customer-managed encryption) and running live disaster recovery drills with SRE.

What You Will Learn

• How to architect export-control data boundaries and confidential project enclaves for RISC-V processors and AI accelerators.

• How to build AI-native DLP and data classification pipelines across agent workflows and LLM gateways.

• How to lead end-to-end disaster recovery validation across source control, PKI, virtualization clusters, and endpoint fleets.

• How to turn complex permission and data-posture audits into repeatable automation using Tenstorrent's internal AI tooling.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

jobs.title: Production Control I (Contract)
jobs.description:
Summary

The Production Control I role is responsible for supporting production scheduling, monitoring material availability, tracking production activities, and coordinating with various departments to help ensure efficient workflow and adherence to production schedules. This position assists in identifying production challenges, material shortages, schedule discrepancies, and other issues that may impact operational timelines. Working under the guidance of the Production Control Supervisor and experienced team members, this role helps maintain accurate production information, facilitate communication between departments, and support the timely resolution of production-related issues.

This is a temporary role employed through an agency.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Production Problem Resolution

• Communicate with production personnel to identify and report production challenges or delays.

• Assist in coordinating with other departments to gather information and support the resolution of issues impacting production schedules.

• Identify production or project concerns requiring attention and escalate them to the Production Control Supervisor.

• Maintain and provide updates on production status, potential delays, and outstanding issues.

Monitor Part Shortages

• Monitor and track material availability and shortages that may impact production schedules.

• Communicate identified material shortages to the Production Control Supervisor and appropriate stakeholders.

• Coordinate with Supply Chain Management (SCM) to obtain updates on material availability and expected delivery dates.

• Assist in tracking shortage resolution activities and maintaining accurate records of outstanding material requirements.

ERP Schedule Coordination

• Assist the planning department with monitoring production schedules and maintaining accurate information within the ERP system.

• Review production schedules for discrepancies and communicate identified issues to the appropriate personnel.

• Track schedule updates and assist in communicating changes to affected departments.

• Support efforts to maintain production timelines by identifying and escalating potential scheduling concerns.

MIR Operations Accuracy

• Assist planning and quality departments in maintaining accurate Manufacturing Inspection Record (MIR) operations and related documentation.

• Review information for completeness and accuracy and communicate discrepancies to the appropriate personnel.

• Support the timely communication and tracking of MIR-related information across departments.

• Escalate identified process or documentation discrepancies to the Production Control Supervisor.

Lean Product Flow Support:

• Assist in identifying opportunities to improve product flow and production efficiency.

• Support departmental efforts to streamline processes, reduce waste, and improve workflow.

• Communicate observed process inefficiencies or obstacles to the Production Control Supervisor.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives as directed.

OSP Request Coordination:

• Assist in tracking OSP (Outsourced Processes) requests to support timely processing and completion.

• Monitor the status of outsourced activities and communicate delays or outstanding requirements to the appropriate personnel.

• Maintain accurate records and documentation related to OSP requests.

• Escalate issues impacting outsourced process timelines or production requirements.

Engineering Collaboration for Design and Drawing Releases:

• Coordinate with engineering and production personnel to obtain updates on drawing releases and design changes.

• Assist in communicating released drawings and approved design changes to the appropriate production personnel.

• Help track outstanding drawing releases and identify potential impacts to production schedules.

• Escalate drawing discrepancies or missing information that may affect production activities.

Cross Departmental Communication:

• Maintain effective communication with logistics, quality, program management, engineering, planning, and other departments to support production activities.

• Assist in gathering and communicating information related to project status, production schedules, and outstanding issues.

• Ensure production-related updates are communicated accurately and in a timely manner.

• Support collaboration across departments to help maintain efficient production workflows.

Other Duties as Assigned:

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the Production Control Supervisor, in alignment with departmental goals

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies:

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence, and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

High School diploma or equivalent required.  0-2 years’ relevant experience in an aerospace production environment.  Vocational and technical schooling preferred.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to communicate effectively with others, both verbally and in written format.

• Basic mathematical knowledge and ability to apply it toward routine problem-solving.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Ability to learn and navigate ERP systems and production scheduling tools.

• Ability to follow established processes and procedures and recognize when issues require escalation.

• Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with cross-functional departments.

• Ability to work under general supervision.

• Ability to travel.

• Ability to work outside of core business hours, as required.

Physical Requirements.

• Able to climb and work on step stools and/or ladders.

• Able to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds without assistance and ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds with assistance.

• Able to reach overhead.

• Able to work in a non-dust-free environment.

• Normal or corrected vision (required to perform exacting tasks).

• Full range of motion with both hands.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, you will be the first face a patient or visitor sees when they walk into one of our clinics. Working alongside the clinical team, you will be responsible for greeting patients and visitors, completing patient registration, updating new and existing patient records, collecting payment, and ensuring patients with or without pre-existing reservations are seen in a timely manner.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who's looking to get their foot in the door at a growing medical company or someone looking to kickstart their career in customer service or the medical field. If you enjoy working with people, staying organized, and are a pro at multi-tasking, we encourage you to apply!

Your Impact

• Patient Interaction: Engage with patients in a welcoming and professional manner, addressing inquiries and providing assistance both in person and over the phone. Welcome and greet patients to the clinic with a friendly and professional demeanor. Register patients efficiently, ensuring completion of all required forms with accurate information. Handle insurance and billing inquiries, providing clear and concise information to patients. Aid ill or distraught patients as necessary and with available resources.

• Payment Collection: Collect payments, insurance co-pays, and prescription charges following clinic financial policies. Proactively and confidently request a card on file, follow-up on patient balances, and ensure timely patient payments.

• Clinic Coordination & Collaboration: Collaborate with the healthcare team to ensure seamless patient flow and efficient clinic operations, contributing to a positive and organized environment. Manage patient reservations (online and walk-in) and registration, optimizing patient satisfaction and provider schedules. Assist in scheduling specialist referrals as needed for patient follow-up. Work with attention to detail in all tasks, navigating between multiple software systems to follow protocols established by our occupational health partners in support of our Employer Services team.

• Front Desk Management: Answer and direct phone calls in a professional and timely manner. Keep the reception area organized and tidy, creating a welcoming environment for patients. Perform various administrative duties, including photocopying, filing, and maintaining daily activity logs.

• CMD Technology & Offerings Expert: Become familiar with scope of services provided at CMD and costs affiliated with all services. Navigate and utilize various software systems for reservation scheduling and electronic medical records.

Required Availability

• Must be able to work 12-hour shifts in consecutive and or non-consecutive days: For full-time: Must be able to work three (3) 12-hour shifts a week with at least four (4) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For part-time: Must be able to work two (2) 12-hour shifts per week with at least two (2) shifts a month on a Saturday or Sunday. For per diem: Must be able to work four (4) 12-hour shifts per month, ideally working one (1) shift each week.

• Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays.

• When needed, must be able to work at a minimum of three (3) other ConvenientMD locations within a one (1) hour travel distance from your primary clinic.

• Required to travel for training shifts which will occur outside of your primary clinic within a one (1) hour commute.

Who You Are

• Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

• Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills: Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and handle a fast-paced work environment.

• Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.

• Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

• Effective communicator and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with patients, team members, and stakeholders across the organization.

• Excellent team player: You enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.

• Driven and self-motivated: Capable of working independently, possess a level of initiative and enthusiasm to help drive results. Actively identifying better ways of working. Uses resourced to achieve the best outcomes for patients, the team, and the organization.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: Able to comprehend, interpret, and apply the appropriate sections of applicable laws, guidelines, regulations, ordinances, and policies.

• Trustworthy: Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle all patient information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Bonus Qualifications

• Medical Receptionist certification

• Previous experience in a medical receptionist role or similar customer service position

• Familiarity with medical terminology and basic knowledge of insurance processes

• Experience using electronic records management software and other related programs used for medical registration and collection of HIPAA documentation

• Experience working with insurance billing and coding information

#INDSMA1

Pay Transparency

In order to maintain equity among team members, ConvenientMD has established defined hourly pay ranges for each role. Individual pay is determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, years of relevant experience, current market conditions, and budget considerations. The pay range listed reflects the potential compensation for this role within this region. Final compensation is determined at the conclusion of the interview process. If your desired compensation falls within the listed range, we encourage you to apply and learn more.

$20—$25 USD

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

There's a job and then there's purposeful, transformative work. Our aim is to create a workplace where you can learn, grow, and continuously refine your skills. Applicants rarely meet every single job requirement, and we appreciate that many skills and backgrounds can make people successful in this role. We are committed to creating a strong sense of belonging for all team members, and our process is designed to prevent discrimination against applicants regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, disability status, or any other aspect which makes you unique. If you’re looking for a great next step, and want to feel good about what you do, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About us
Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place.
We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution.
Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures.

Why join us:
You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work.


About the role
We’re seeking a driven and commercially minded Account Executive to join our US team. We're rebuilding our go-to-market around accountancy, financial institutions and corporates, and now we need someone exceptional to grow our customer base.

You'll be based in our New York office, selling to professional services firms, financial institutions and large corporates across North America. This role comes with real responsibility, real earning potential, and a team that is fully invested in helping you succeed..

You'll get to...

 - Own your own book of business, taking prospective customers through the full sales cycle from prospecting to close

 - Sell a product that partners genuinely love, into a market that is still largely running on legacy tools

 - Build real relationships with senior stakeholders at law firms across the US, understand their world and work closely with partners who are acting on some of the largest transactions and legal cases in the world.

 - Become an excellent natural salesperson - we are skill-based, not methodology-dependent, and the way we sell here will help you grow your capabilities

 - Travel regularly across the US to meet clients in person, with trips to our wider global team in Europe a couple of times a year

 - Be part of an ambitious team where progression is fast for people who deliver, with leadership accessible when you need support

You'll thrive in this role if...

 - You have 1-2 years of experience closing deals. A SaaS background is helpful but not required; we’re just as interested in someone from an adjacent industry where you’ve guided customers through a buying process

 - You’re motivated by building your own pipeline and managing your own book of business

 - You’re coachable and genuinely open to learning a new way of doing things - we’ll teach you everything you need to know to execute our sales process

 - You can manage high volume without losing the detail - you’ll be working a substantial number of accounts at once, each needing consistent, thoughtful follow-up

 - You’re independent enough to operate without hand-holding, but self-aware enough to ask for help when you need it

 - You’re curious about how complex organizations are structured, and keen to learn a data-rich product well enough to hold your own with senior and technical buyers

 - You’re willing to travel regularly within the US. In-person client visits are an important part of this role

 - Experience selling into professional services, financial services, or corporate legal, tax or finance teams would be a strong plus, but not a dealbreaker

jobs.title: Social Professional
jobs.description:
AECOM Panama is seeking a Social Professional to support infrastructure, energy, mining, water, transportation, urban development, and territorial development projects in Panama and the Caribbean. The role combines social assessment, stakeholder engagement, fieldwork, information management, and preparation of technical deliverables. The selected candidate must be available for field assignments and travel, including occasional international travel.

The responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Collect, organize, and analyze social, socioeconomic, demographic, cultural, and territorial information from primary and secondary sources.

• Support the design and implementation of surveys, interviews, focus groups, field visits, socioeconomic baseline studies, and other social research instruments.

• Contribute to the characterization of communities, populated places, administrative areas, and project areas of influence, including identification of vulnerable groups, access barriers, exclusion risks, and differentiated impacts.

• Support the identification, assessment, and documentation of social risks and impacts during project planning, construction, operation, and closure.

• Analyze potential effects on livelihoods, access to land and natural resources, mobility, social cohesion, economic activities, public services, and intangible cultural heritage.

• Contribute to the design, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of social prevention, mitigation, compensation, livelihood restoration, and monitoring measures.

• Support stakeholder mapping, segmentation, and analysis, including communities, authorities, civil society organizations, local businesses, and vulnerable groups.

• Prepare and conduct interviews, meetings, workshops, information sessions, consultations, and other stakeholder engagement activities.

• Document concerns, agreements, commitments, and outcomes, and maintain engagement records, follow-up matrices, and traceability systems.

• Support the design and operation of grievance mechanisms, stakeholder engagement plans, and disclosure and communication strategies.

• Systematize field information and maintain social databases, stakeholder matrices, commitments, and supporting evidence.

• Process survey and interview results and prepare tables, charts, maps, and other inputs for social analysis.

• Draft social sections of EIA/ESIA, ESDD, ESMP, memoranda, presentations, methodologies, work plans, and technical proposals.

• Apply quality, consistency, confidentiality, and traceability controls to social information.

• Support projects developed under the IFC Performance Standards, the World Bank Environmental and Social Standards, and requirements of the IDB, CAF, CABEI, or other financial institutions.

• Participate, under senior supervision, in assessments related to land acquisition, economic or physical displacement, compensation, livelihood restoration, human rights, gender, GBVH, vulnerability, and Indigenous Peoples.

• Coordinate social inputs with environmental, technical, legal, planning, and GIS teams.

• Conduct project site visits and field inspections, including travel within Panama and, when required, to other countries in Latin America.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Sociology, Social Work, Anthropology, Social Psychology, Economics, Rural Development, Human Geography, or a related discipline. With +4 YORE or demonstrated equivalence of experience and/or education.

• Professional license (idoniedad) preferred or registration when required by Panamanian law or the contractual scope.

• Demonstrated experience in surveys, interviews, community work, socioeconomic data collection, stakeholder engagement, or social baseline studies.

• Experience preparing technical reports and managing social databases, stakeholder matrices, or field records.

• Clear technical writing in Spanish and functional English.

• Basic qualitative and quantitative analytical skills.

• Strong organization, active listening, intercultural judgment, and ability to handle sensitive information.

• Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and deliver high-quality work according to project schedules and quality-control requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Over five years of relevant professional experience for a junior-to-intermediate role. Candidates with less experience may be considered when supported by a strong combination of education, field practice, and analytical ability.
• Experience in infrastructure, energy, mining, water, transportation, urban development, or territorial development projects.

• Exposure to EIA/ESIA, ESDD, IFC Performance Standards 1 and 5, or environmental and social standards of multilateral development banks.

• Experience working with rural populations, vulnerable groups, land acquisition, physical or economic displacement, compensation, or livelihood restoration.

• Additional training in social impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, public participation, research methods, data analysis, GIS, human rights, gender, or environmental and social standards.
• Availability for fieldwork and travel, including occasional activities outside regular working hours when community schedules require them.

• Professional proficiency in both Spanish and English preferred.

jobs.title: Robotics Field Service Engineer - Road Warrior
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.

Ready to take your robotics career on the road? As Formic’s customer base and robot fleet continue to grow, so does our need for skilled Robotics Field Service Engineers who are ready to go where the action is! Our engineers travel across the U.S., working hands-on with cutting-edge robotic systems, troubleshooting challenges, and keeping automation running. If you’re passionate about robotics, love solving problems, and are open to travel up to 100%, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and be part of the future of industrial automation!

About the team:

The Fleet Operations Team drives uptime and operational performance across Formic’s growing fleet of deployed robotic systems. Working inside live manufacturing environments, the team diagnoses issues, restores production, and continuously improves system reliability at scale. Fleet Operations operates at the intersection of robotics, controls, and real-world factory execution, ensuring Formic’s automation delivers consistent, measurable performance across diverse industrial applications.

About the role:

As a Robotics Field Service Engineer, you are the front line of technical ownership across Formic’s deployed robotic cells. You will diagnose failures, restore systems to production, perform preventative and corrective maintenance, and represent Formic directly within customer facilities.

This is a hands-on, high-accountability role in uptime-critical environments. Success requires strong troubleshooting discipline, calm execution during production interruptions, and structured documentation. Your work directly impacts fleet performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term system reliability.

In this role, you will:

• Perform preventative, corrective, and predictive maintenance on robotic manufacturing cells

• Respond to remote and on-site escalations, diagnose root causes, and restore systems quickly

• Provide hands-on technical support to customer operators and maintenance teams

• Log service activity, asset updates, and spare part requirements in CMMS

• Coordinate field scheduling and support with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders

• Monitor system performance remotely using Formic dashboards and fleet tools

• Document service work, root cause analysis, and follow-up actions with clarity and precision

• Identify recurring failure patterns and escalate systemic risks for broader improvement

• Build professional, trusted relationships with plant managers and site personnel

• Operate with strict adherence to safety standards, including LOTO and industrial compliance

• Participate in RCA sessions, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives

• Continuously expand technical depth across robotics, controls, networking, and industrial systems

What makes you a great fit:

• 3+ years of hands-on field service experience supporting robotic or industrial automation systems

• Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, PLC, or robotic control systems

• Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and pneumatic drawings

• Experience using CMMS platforms to track and report maintenance activity

• Comfortable with travel up to 100%

• Clear written and verbal communicator capable of producing structured service documentation

• Demonstrated commitment to safety and disciplined field execution

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with 6-axis robot brands such as FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots

• Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick-and-place, or conveyor systems

• Experience in food, beverage, packaging, CPG, or other high-speed manufacturing environments

• Prior customer-facing field experience

• Spanish language proficiency

Our Total Rewards:

At Formic, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package for full-time, U.S.-based team members, including:

• Equity in Formic: Participate in our stock option program and share in the success of a fast-growing start-up backed by leading global investors

• Competitive & Uncapped Commission Structure: Designed to reward performance and impact in commission-eligible roles

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Unum, with 99% of employee premiums covered and 75% coverage for dependents, with optional buy-up plans available

• Additional Insurance Benefits: FSA and DCFSA, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability through Unum, all 100% employer-paid

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Fully funded by Formic, offering support when you need it most

• Paid Parental Leave Program: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored 401(k): Invest in your future with our company-facilitated retirement savings plan

• Home Office Stipend: A one-time allowance for fully remote and hybrid employees to support an at-home or on-the-road work setup

• Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement: Monthly stipend toward personal phone and internet expenses

• Paid Time Off: Take the time you need, when you need it. 15 days of paid time off, in addition to company holidays

Compensation Philosophy

Formic’s pay and equity packages are thoughtfully benchmarked against peer companies at a similar growth stage. Equity represents a meaningful part of our mutual investment: when Formic succeeds, so do you.

This role is paid hourly with a posted range of $25–$32 per hour. Based on the nature of field service work - which consistently runs approximately 50+ hours per week including travel, site activity, and documentation - total annualized earnings typically range from $71,500 - $91,520, depending on experience, hourly rate, and actual hours worked. Overtime is paid in accordance with applicable federal and state law for all hours worked over 40 in a workweek.

Hourly Rate:

$29—$44 USD

What we look for:

We’re building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you!

• Fearless Optimism: You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren’t paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn’t yet exist.

• Create the Magic: You absorb complexity so customers don’t have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value-added, and outcome-driven. You don’t say “not my job.” You make things work.

• Today, Not Tomorrow: You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don’t confuse activity with results.

• Seek Truth: You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer.

• Made of Rubber: You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit.

• One Formic: You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit.

Equal Opportunity Employment:

Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person’s merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to accessibility@formic.co.

jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Embedded Software Engineer on the Flight Software team is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves & operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. They are responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

• Develop reliable firmware to control how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate through the entire mission.

• Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.

• Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.

• Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.

• Build highly reliable and available software systems.

• Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) techniques.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Experience developing and testing real-time embedded hardware / software systems.

• Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.

• Experience with additional programming languages such as Python or Rust.

• Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, data structures, and computer networking.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior Software: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

About the role

Chime's Product Security team is looking for a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer II to help secure the cloud infrastructure and data platforms that power Chime. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll work side by side with infrastructure, platform and data engineering teams to find real risks, build guardrails and automation that scale, and make the secure path the easy path. Your work will span AWS, Kubernetes, network edge and data security, and it directly protects the millions of members who trust Chime with their money.

In this role, you can expect to

• Design, build and improve security controls, guardrails and automation across our AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms and data systems.

• Partner with infrastructure, platform and data engineering teams to find and fix security risks, with practical guidance that keeps teams moving.

• Strengthen our cloud security posture across infrastructure configuration, network and edge security (including WAF and bot management), identity and access, and sensitive data protection.

• Review architecture and technical designs, assess new technologies, and turn what you find into clear, prioritized recommendations.

• Drive security vulnerabilities from discovery to fix, prioritizing by real exposure and exploitability.

• Use AI and automation to speed up security reviews, triage and remediation, and cut down repetitive operational work.

To thrive in this role, you have

jobs.title: Structures Technician (Composites)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

STRUCTURES TECHNICIAN (COMPOSITES)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Trim and finish composite and metallic assemblies

• Assemble structures including setup, bonding, and fastener applications

• Support with surface prep, using grit blast, hand abrade, and power abrasion techniques

• Use tooling holes, pilot holes, or by hand (as required) per drawing or tooling instructions

• Align parts and secure in place using clecos or tooling/hand clamps

• Select drill bits, reamers, and/or countersinking tools for pilot and full-size holes

• Drill, ream, countersink full size holes in parts/assemblies, in proper sequence and to correct size using drill motor

• Set countersinking tools to proper depth as required

• Disassemble parts and deburr holes using chip chasers, deburring tools, and files to prepare for installation of fasteners

• Load and unload ovens to bond detail parts to assemblies

• Handle and dispose of hazardous materials in approved manner

• Determine and obtain correct type and size fasteners

• Support with cold working holes to prepare for close tolerance fastener installation.

• Install bushings into housings using arbor press and/or hydraulic puller

• Apply liquid nitrogen to facilitate installation of bushings

• Install fasteners in correct sequence per drawing, using correct tools (e.g., rivet gun and bucking bar, drill motor, power screwdriver, C-squeeze, ratchet wrench, nut runner)

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 1+ years of experience using hands tools in the aerospace, manufacturing, marine or automotive industry OR certificate from a credited trade school

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with reaming, honing, and/or countersinking of uniform close tolerance holes in proper sequence while using the correct tool for the job (e.g., rivet gun and bucking bar, drill motor, power screwdriver, "C" squeeze, ratchet wrench, nut runner)

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, an understanding for drawing symbols, flag notes, and general notes

• Experience working with composites

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and read SOPs (standard operating procedures)

• Attention to detail and accuracy while working within a fast-paced production environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching are generally required to perform the functions of this position

• Willing to work all required shift hours, overtime and weekends as needed; this position is for Monday-Friday, 1st shift (5AM-3:30PM) or 2nd shift 3:00PM - 1:30AM)

• Able to lift and carry up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $23.00 - $27.00
Level 2: $26.00 - $32.50
Level 3: $31.00 - $38.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Triumvirate Environmental, one of the largest environmental services firms in North America, is seeking a strategic and business-focused Vice President of Business Technology & Enterprise Apps to lead the vision, roadmap, and evolution of enterprise business applications across the organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this executive will serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders and be responsible for ensuring technology investments drive operational excellence, scalability, and measurable business outcomes.

This leader will build a business partnership model with a named IT business partner for each function, hands-on in delivery, not just taking demand. They will partner closely with executive stakeholders including the COO, CCO, CFO, CHRO, and Chief Transformation Officer to develop technology strategies that modernize business operations, optimize processes, and support continued organizational growth.

The Vice President will own enterprise application strategy, functional roadmaps, and platform ownership across critical business systems, including Oracle ERP and HCM, CPQ, and custom platforms. This leader will be expected to deliver within IT's enterprise delivery framework, including portfolio intake, stage gates, and benefits tracking, and to help mature that framework as it scales. Flodesk is recognized in the Inc 5000 as one of the world's fastest-growing email marketing companies, built to help entrepreneurs sell online and design emails that people love to get. About the role

Next year, Flodesk hosts its first-ever conference. We've never done this before, and we want our debut to be the moment people feel everything this brand stands for: design, warmth, and belief in small business owners and creators.
