jobs.title: Systems Engineering, Director (Numenor)
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

The Numenor team is building Valar’s next reactor, the flagship program that will define how we deliver nuclear power at scale. This dedicated team owns the entire plant, from the reactor core and helium systems to cooling, plant modules, and the Citadel, uniting mechanical, systems, safety, IC&E, quality, and supply chain under one mission. The work starts with bringing the first unit to life and ends with a production line that delivers reactors faster with every build. What this team builds will power the critical infrastructure of the future.

The Role

Valar Atomics seeks a Director, Systems Engineering for the reactor program. This role will build and lead the systems engineering organization for the reactor program. The scope covers the systems engineering process, the product breakdown structure (PBS), and the structure and technical accuracy of the reactor design basis. The role will lead systems integration and engineering from the first unit through scaled production, delivering reactors at an increasing rate.

The role demands someone who can develop, implement, and maintain a systems engineering architecture and high-value tools that enable Valar to produce and license Numenor series reactors at scale. Success in this role means producing and maintaining a tight design basis that scales, while always keeping a clear design thread for the required traceability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Own the systems engineering process for the reactor program.

• Own the plant architecture and the PBS, so every system fits one integrated design.

• Lead the reactor program’s design basis document set, including requirements baselines, system design descriptions, and functional analysis, and be responsible for its technical accuracy.

• Own safety classification and codes and standards with the safety basis team.

Integration, Verification and Readiness

• Run interface management across every system and close discrepancies in the model before they reach the floor.

• Own the V&V strategy, from requirement to evidence, through factory test, integrated test, and commissioning, working closely with the test director and test team.

Program and Team Leadership

• Build, lead, and mentor the systems engineering team, including design basis, V&V, and architecture leads.

• Own the systems engineering tools and data (Polarion, MBSE, PBS database) as the single source of truth.

• Work closely with mechanical, safety, IC&E, quality, program controls, and supply chain so the plant stays integrated.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline.

• 15+ years of engineering on complex hardware, including 5+ years in systems engineering.

• Owned requirements, interfaces, and V&V on a program that reached hardware and test.

• Led a team of systems engineers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Nuclear experience: DOE (DOE-STD-3009, 1189, 1073) or NRC, and safety basis interfaces. A plus, not a prerequisite.

• First-of-a-kind systems in aerospace, defense, or naval programs.

• Leadership of cross-functional engineering teams across mechanical, I&C, safety, and test.

• Requirements and MBSE tools: Polarion, DOORS, or Jama; SysML or Cameo.

• Integrated test, commissioning, and scaling from prototype to series production.

• INCOSE CSEP or ESEP: a plus.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary

jobs.title: Sr Analyst, Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

You’ll bring statistical rigor to the team’s hardest go-to-market questions: forecasting, propensity, conversion, churn, and measuring what actually caused a change. You’ll work across sales, marketing, partner and customer success rather than owning a single domain, and you’ll deliver models as analysis and scored datasets that feed the team’s reporting and AI tools.

What You’ll Do

• Build statistical models for go-to-market questions, such as account propensity across product families, renewal and churn risk, stage-to-stage pipeline conversion, and time to close.

• Build pipeline and bookings forecasts with intervals that show how far the forecast could miss.

• Measure impact where randomized tests aren’t possible, using matched control groups, cohort comparisons and difference-in-differences, and say plainly what the data can and can’t support.

• Deliver model outputs as scheduled, scored datasets in dbt and Databricks so they feed dashboards and AI skills, following Data Engineering’s standards.

• Review the team’s analyses for statistical soundness, including sample size, selection effects and multiple comparisons, and teach those methods to other analysts.

• Translate results into recommendations leaders can act on, and present them.

What You’ll Bring

• 4–7 years in analytics, with substantial work on statistical modelling or forecasting.

• Applied statistics: linear and logistic regression, time series, hypothesis testing, and causal inference fundamentals.

• Strong Python (pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and expert SQL.

jobs.description:
Company:

In Common With + Quarters

Reports to:
Director of Sales

Location:
Tribeca, New York

Employment:
Full-Time, Hybrid + Travel

Compensation:
$100,000-$120,000 annually, plus commission

Direct Reports:
-

Expected Start Date:
February 1, 2027

Application Deadline:
December 31, 2026

In Common With + Quarters

In Common With is a design studio defining a new vocabulary for interiors, in which old-world craft meets at-scale manufacturing. Founded in 2018, our practice brings endless curiosity, exceptional materials, and unparalleled adaptability to lighting and objects for all spaces—created with our team of expert craftspeople, artists, and engineers around the world. In 2024, we opened Quarters, a hybrid retail and hospitality destination in Tribeca. Through ongoing collaborations with our peers in the worlds of art and design, Quarters crafts a vision of home that’s unfolding and alive.

Our obsessions with craft and collaboration originate from a boundless interest in people, objects, and an ongoing conversation between the two. Every product we make and every partnership we cultivate has that in common.

The Role

We're seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Senior Commercial Account Manager to join our team full-time. You will own our established contract sales business — hospitality, multi-family, and commercial projects, whether we are specified by the design team or sourced through procurement or distribution — from first conversation with A&D through proposal, negotiation, procurement, and close.

You'll own the accounts and day-to-day execution for the segment, and partner with the Director of Sales on sales strategy and forecasting, while delivering consistent revenue growth, well-managed contracts, and strong client relationships that support the company's broader commercial goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen with organizational discipline and thrives in a fast-paced, design-driven environment. You'll report to the Director of Sales and collaborate with marketing, production, and operations teams to ensure a scalable, well-run commercial and contract sales function.

Core Responsibilities

Commercial & Contract Account Management

• Own the full sales cycle for commercial and contract accounts, from prospecting and specification through proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Stay accountable after the sale, through submittals, samples and mockups, lead times, and delivery, in partnership with production and operations.

• Negotiate and manage contract terms, project pricing, and master pricing agreements with hospitality groups, developers, procurement firms, and distribution partners, within approved pricing and discount authority.

• Own pipeline management in the CRM, keeping opportunities, account status, and next steps current.

• Develop account strategies for existing clients to grow order size and repeat orders.

• Keep accurate records of contracts, quotes, and account terms.

Client Engagement & Business Development

• Give every commercial and contract client a warm, knowledgeable, and consultative experience.

• Recommend products and solutions based on each client’s project requirements, budget, specifications, and design goals.

• Build a steady flow of new opportunities by calling on hospitality, multi-family, and commercial A&D firms, procurement agencies, developers, and operators globally.

• Represent ICW at industry events, trade shows, and client meetings to build visibility and bring in new opportunities.

Commercial & Contract Sales Strategy

• Shape and execute the sales strategy for the commercial and contract segment, including priority sectors, annual targets, and growth plan, in partnership with the Director of Sales.

• Own forecasting and revenue planning for commercial and contract accounts, and present the forecast to the Director of Sales against department goals.

• Conduct competitive analysis of the commercial and contract market to identify opportunities and risks.

Product Knowledge

• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the product line, including materials, finishes, and design approach

• Participate in regular product training for existing and new products

• Collaborate with clients on customization options, offering expert guidance on selections and specifications

Ownership + Working Style

• Independently own the commercial and contract segment end to end, with guidance from the Director of Sales on strategy rather than day-to-day direction, and accountability for revenue, margin, and forecast accuracy.

• Turn strategy into actionable plans and measurable targets, and adjust course based on performance and changing conditions.

• Identify inefficiencies in processes or projects and implement improvements to enhance effectiveness.

• Apply contract-market expertise to influence product, pricing, and operations decisions, including contract-grade product requirements, certifications, finishes, and lead times.

• Document and refine the contract sales playbook, including qualification criteria, quoting and approval workflows, CRM standards, and handoffs, so the function can scale and onboard additional sellers or partners.

Requirements

• 8+ years of relevant professional experience, including 5+ years owning a sales segment or book of business independently in the A&D community.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Demonstrated specification sales experience in commercial or contract lighting, furniture, or related categories,.

• An established network across hospitality, multi-family, and commercial A&D firms, procurement agencies, developers, and operators

• Proven experience owning forecasting, pricing strategy, or account strategy

• Experience managing complex sales cycles, contract negotiation, and terms management

• Proficiency with a CRM platform and Google Workspace.

• Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience selling to hospitality procurement firms and ownership groups, with familiarity with FF&E specifications, contract-grade requirements, and compliance requirements.

• Experience building or scaling a contract sales channel, including managing independent reps, distribution partners, or junior sellers

• Familiarity with custom and made-to-order product, including shop drawings, mockups, and complex lead times

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and communication skills

• Ability to work effectively with others across functions, and levels.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and change; able to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to own work, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments.

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Open to giving and receiving feedback as part of a culture of growth and learning.

• Conducts work with integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.

• A genuinely empathetic group. We have a non-negotiable no jerks policy. Being nice is free.

Studio + Compensation

• This is a full-time position based in Tribeca, New York. Hours are Monday–Friday from 9 am to 6 pm ET.

• Travel required: up to 50%, including client meetings, project sites, and industry trade shows.

• Salary range: $100,000–$120,000 base salary, plus uncapped commission.

• Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 100% monthly premium coverage options), PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, and profit sharing.

How to Apply

Apply below with your résumé and a brief cover letter explaining your interest in In Common With and Quarters. Please share in your cover letter why you are a good fit for the studio, and what unique perspective you bring.

Submissions without a cover letter or any other required materials will not be considered. All candidates must go through the same application process; we do not review or accept materials submitted by email for open roles. The deadline to apply is Thursday, December 31st.

Due to the level of responses we receive, we will not follow up with all applicants directly, but if we feel you are a good fit, we will follow up with qualified candidates within one week of the application deadline. Thank you for your interest in joining our studio!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
TL;DR

Staff Software Engineer. Set the technical direction of an AI-native tax & accounting firm. Own the cross-cutting systems everything else is built on – tax data model, AI correctness, integrations – and multiply the engineering team around you. Work directly with the founders (scaled to millions of users, $100m+ exits).


THE OPPORTUNITY

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.


THE ROLE

As a Staff Software Engineer, you are the technical counterpart to our founders. You look beyond a single product area: you shape the architecture across the platform, make the decisions that are expensive to reverse, and make sure we scale from one country to many without rewriting the core.

You stay hands-on and write a lot of code – but your impact is measured by what the whole engineering team ships.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Technical direction: Define architecture and tech strategy across the platform; write and drive RFCs for the decisions that matter.

 - Core systems: Own the foundations every product area builds on – the domain model for tax and accounting logic and the integration layer to third-party systems.

 - AI correctness at scale: Set the standards for how we build, evaluate and monitor AI pipelines that have to be correct, not just plausible.

 - Scale and reliability: Prepare the platform for more countries, more customers and higher compliance demands – security, auditability, observability.

 - Engineering bar: Shape how we build – review standards, tooling, delivery practices; mentor senior engineers and own the technical hiring bar.

 - Partner to the founders: Translate business strategy into a technical roadmap and spot where technology creates leverage.


OUR TECH CONTEXT (GREENFIELD)

 - Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.

 - Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …

 - Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.

 - You will decide how this stack evolves as we scale.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

As part of the Engineering organization, Mechanical Engineering designs and develops the mechanical systems, components, and equipment that power Valar's advanced nuclear technologies. The team ensures designs are robust, manufacturable, and optimized for long-term performance.

The Role

Our TRISO fuel fabrication line turns U3O8 powder into finished TRISO compacts through three core process families: sol-gel kernel production, chemical vapor deposition (CVD) coating, and high-temperature furnace processing. Each runs on purpose-built process skids that our team designs, procures, builds, and commissions.

The Lead Engineer for Mechanical Equipment owns the design of robotics and mechanical equipment throughout these process areas end to end: from system design through fabrication, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, and handover to fuel production operations. Reporting to the Director of Fuel Equipment Engineering, you will be the technical authority for mechanized equipment and lead the engineers who build it.

This role is hands-on. You will design and build equipment fuel production processes, while guiding a small team as the program scales from development to production.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership – Mechanized Equipment

• Own the equipment design basis for mechanized equipment throughout our fuel facilities

• Lead design of robotics, presses, rotating machinery, and other motorized equipment

• Partner with process engineering and I&C team to translate fuel parameters into equipment requirements and control philosophy

Equipment Design, Fabrication and Commissioning

• Develop P&IDs, layouts, and detailed designs for development and production equipment

• Oversee factory acceptance testing and on-site commissioning activities

• Lead troubleshooting and root cause investigations for equipment reliability issues

• Establish maintenance, spare part, and consumable strategies for 24/7 operation

Team and Vendor Leadership

• Lead and mentor a team of mechanical and equipment engineers

• Manage equipment schedule, scope, and budget within the fuel equipment program

• Select and manage suppliers and partners for key components

• Collaborate closely with leadership across fuel process, I&C, quality, and operations.

Basic Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience with robotics or mechanized equipment

• 2+ years leading engineers as either a technical lead or a people manager

• Hands-on experience taking process equipment from design to deployment

• Experience working safely with flammable, toxic, or corrosive process gasses

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Direct experience with Uranium processing equipment design

• Familiarity with fissile material criticality safety requirements

• Experience with Balance of Plant design for hazardous environents

• Experience in a start-up or high growth environment

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

jobs.title: Strategic Consultant, SMS & Messaging
jobs.description:
About Airship

Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more.

Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.

We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.

To learn more about us, visit www.airship.com, read our blog or follow us on LinkedIn.

About the Role

Do you love helping brands build text message programs that customers actually want to get? This could be your role. You’ll be Airship’s go-to expert on SMS marketing strategy and compliance. You’ll work directly with some of the world’s best-known brands to design and grow high-performing SMS programs.

You’ll join Strategic Services, part of Airship’s Professional Services team. Our consultants and campaign specialists partner with leading brands to design, build, and improve mobile engagement programs across app, SMS, and other channels. They’re looking for someone to lead the SMS strategy practice worldwide.

This is a senior individual contributor role with global reach and no sales quota. Your focus is expertise and customer results. You’ll guide customers through a complex and changing set of regulations. You’ll help brands moving from other SMS platforms get more out of the channel than ever before. You’ll also raise the bar for the whole team by building the playbooks, training, and standards that help everyone advise with confidence.

What You'll Do*

• Lead SMS strategy for key customers: Run SMS strategy projects for strategic customers around the world. This covers everything from program reviews and goal-setting to subscriber growth, content, message timing, audience segments, and customer journey design.

• Connect SMS with other channels: Design programs where SMS and app messaging complement each other to increase engagement and performance.

• Be our SMS compliance expert: Serve as the go-to expert on SMS rules in the U.S., UK, and EU. You’ll design strategies that are compliant from the start, and you’ll know when to bring complex questions to our legal team.

• Build and maintain playbooks: Create and update Airship’s global SMS best practices and compliance playbooks as mobile carrier rules and regulations change.

• Guide migrations and onboarding: Build smooth migration plans for customers moving from other platforms, so their business keeps running and they see value quickly. Partner with onboarding project managers, lead consultants, and technical specialists to set strategy, success measures, and compliance foundations from day one.

• Turn strategy into technical plans: Work closely with our technical SMS specialist on message delivery, registration, and setup. Together, you’ll turn big-picture goals into clear technical requirements.

• Coach and grow the team: Mentor consultants and campaign specialists, lead internal training, and review SMS work across the team to keep quality high.

• Support high-impact deals: Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic SMS opportunities. This includes conversations with customers considering a switch from another provider and presentations to senior leaders.

• Share market insights: Track customer trends, market changes, and new technology such as Rich Communication Services (RCS), and share what you learn to help shape our product roadmap.

• Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to create efficiencies, automate processes, and free up more of your time for high-value strategic work.

*Duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

What We're Looking For

• Mobile marketing experience: 6+ years in SMS or mobile marketing. That includes 3+ years advising brands on SMS strategy at an SMS platform, an agency, or a large brand.

• Hands-on SMS compliance knowledge: Strong practical understanding of SMS regulations and industry standards. This includes the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA), CTIA messaging guidelines, 10-digit long code (10DLC) registration, U.S. state laws, and UK and European consent laws.

• A record of measurable results: Proven success growing SMS programs against business goals such as subscriber growth, revenue, and customer retention. You test, learn, and let the data guide you.

• Lifecycle marketing know-how: A strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and how SMS works alongside app messaging, email, and web channels.

• Confident communication with senior leaders: Excellent communication skills. You have experience presenting complex regulatory and strategy recommendations to senior marketing and legal leaders.

• Framework and playbook building: Experience creating frameworks, training, and standards that help a whole team grow its skills.

• Global collaboration: You’re comfortable working across time zones with teams and clients in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

• AI Curiosity: You’re eager to use AI tools to work more efficiently and automate repetitive tasks.

We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have

• Prior experience with a specialized SMS marketing platform, e.g., Attentive, Postscript, or Klaviyo

• Experience leading complex SMS migrations from one platform to another

• Familiarity with RCS, rich media, and two-way conversational messaging

• Industry experience in retail, e-commerce, quick-service restaurants, media, or financial services

Work Location & Travel Requirements

Airship’s ‘Digital First’ approach to work means that for the majority of our roles, work can be performed remotely, either some or most of the time. Airship believes that flexible work contributes to a more productive and more equitable work environment, and that Airshippers are able to collaborate, innovate, and support one another across different locations and timezones.

Some roles may require that employees perform their work from a specific location to support business activities, and/or be within proximity to an Airship office location or customer or partner locations, while other roles can be performed 100% remotely.

This position is fully remote and may require up to 10% travel based on business needs or as requested by your manager.

Compensation

Starting Pay Range: $105,000-$135,000 USD per year

This is a good faith estimate of the base compensation we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire. Actual starting pay may vary based on factors such as relevant skills, work experience, market demands, and location. All offers include stock options so employees have the opportunity to benefit from Airship’s success.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your dependents

• Flexible time off, company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid volunteer time off

• Support for your overall wellbeing with mental health and wellness resources

• Employer-subsidized life insurance as well as short-term and long-term disability

• A digital-first work environment and a monthly stipend to support remote work

• Mentorship and growth opportunities to build skills and accelerate professional development

• And more!

AI in Recruiting

We use artificial intelligence tools in our recruitment process as decision-support tools only. Airship's People Operations team reviews all AI-generated scores and recommendations before making any hiring determination. No applicant is rejected solely on the basis of an AI-generated output. Depending on your location, you may have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted employment decision or to opt out of AI evaluation. To make a request or learn more about how we use AI in hiring, contact privacy@airship.com or visit airship.com/legal.

California residents can view the CCPA disclosure notice here.

**Please Note: To ensure the security of your personal information, Airship will only contact candidates through email addresses ending with “@airship.com”.

Hiring Commitment

Airship is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We welcome your application and our hiring and employment decisions are made irrespective of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. In alignment with our commitment to equal opportunity, Airship will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a way that adheres to the principles of fairness and the requirements of local Fair Chance laws, where applicable.

By submitting this application, I affirm that the facts set forth in it are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that if I am employed, false statements, omissions, or misleading information given in my application, interview(s), or in a background check may result in dismissal.

jobs.title: Lead Counsel, Litigation
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb’s Legal Department is a global team that will require working with diverse international colleagues around the world. The successful candidate will be someone who is adaptable, collaborative and embodies Airbnb’s Core Values. Candidates will be required to approach complex legal issues with a balance for local and global perspectives, while being adaptable to cultural differences and nuances. A genuine and demonstrated interest in Airbnb and a commitment to ethics, integrity and fostering a workplace that emphasizes diversity and belonging is a must.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s Legal team embodies the company’s innovative, forward-thinking spirit. At the frontier of the new sharing economy, Airbnb is breaking new ground in matters of policy, law, and government relations. Where some see obstacles, we see the opportunity to find creative, practical solutions, right at the cutting edge. Our adventurous, fast-moving legal team is committed to building a team of talented, collaborative and self-motivated legal professionals across the globe who believe in Airbnb’s mission and leading as a 21st century company.

The Difference You Will Make:

Airbnb is looking for an experienced litigator to join our Risk and Regulatory group. Reporting to Airbnb's Associate General Counsel, Litigation & Policy, the Lead Counsel, Litigation will own high-stakes disputes, investigations, and strategic counseling from first assessment through resolution, directing outside counsel and shaping our approach at every stage.

This role is for you if you work well with business partners, bring a steady and positive presence, and thrive in a collaborative environment. Where some see obstacles, you see room for creative, practical solutions that move Airbnb's global mission forward. You are energized by complex disputes, comfortable engaging regulatory and administrative bodies, and ready to be a trusted voice on the matters that matter most. This role is based in San Francisco, California.

A Typical Day:

As Lead Counsel, Litigation you will:

• Serve as a strategic leader on a diverse portfolio of complex litigation, pre-litigation, and regulatory matters across numerous jurisdictions.

• Handle highly sensitive matters with a strategic mindset and strong judgment.

• Manage outside counsel across the full life of a case: budget, strategy, work product, and results.

• Drive matters through every stage, from early strategic case assessment, discovery, witness preparation, depositions, dispositive motions, trial, mediation, and settlement recommendations.

• Proactively identify and resolve potential disputes, giving business clients practical risk mitigation advice that supports their objectives.

• Partner with public policy, compliance, and legal colleagues inside and outside Airbnb to solve problems that cross functions and borders.

• Analyze legal risk across the business, including in the development of new products and services.

• Build processes and procedures that scale with a rapidly growing global business.

Your Expertise:

• J.D. from an accredited law school and strong academic credentials.

• 10+ years of significant litigation practice with a demonstrated record of owning meaningful parts of complex legal or regulatory matters.

• Civil litigation experience required, preferably at a large law firm. Trial experience strongly preferred. Strong writing skills.

• Active California bar membership in good standing, and residence in the San Francisco Bay Area.

• Background in antitrust and regulatory matters strongly preferred. Tax controversy, class action, and commercial tort experience is a plus.

• Time spent representing technology companies is preferred.

• Sound judgment and discretion in handling highly sensitive matters and difficult subject matter.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to advocate firmly for a position while staying open-minded.

• Organized and self-directed, comfortable running multiple matters at once in a fast-paced environment, both on a team and independently.

• Interest in expanding the scope of your practice, close attention to detail, and comfort with ambiguity.

• Passion for travel and home sharing, and deep appreciation for the Airbnb community.

• Good sense of humor, disdain for drama, and a bias toward getting things done.

Your Location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in the San Francisco Bay Area to be able to conduct their work. Currently, employees can not be located in: Alaska, Indiana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Delaware And Rhode Island. This list is continuously being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list.  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$240,000—$300,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Empathy – Understand and serve with compassion
Curiosity – Explore new ideas and question the status quo

Ownership – Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We look forward to building the future of lending together.

jobs.description:
TL;DR

Senior Software Engineer. Build v1 → v10 of an AI-native tax & accounting firm. Own a product area end-to-end – from data model to UI – alongside experienced entrepreneurs (scaled to millions of users, $100m+ exits).


THE OPPORTUNITY

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.


THE ROLE

As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a product area – e.g. bookkeeping, payroll or client onboarding – and take it from problem to production. You work directly with the founders, product and our tax experts, and you decide how things get built in your area.

We are past the founding phase but still very early: most of what you touch is greenfield.


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Your product area, end-to-end: Turn customer and tax-expert problems into shipped features (spec → ship → measure).

 - APIs, data models and services: Design and build the backend your area runs on – and ship the UI on top.

 - AI that is correct, not just plausible: Build AI-powered workflows with evaluation, fallbacks and human review where it matters.

 - Quality and operations: Tests, monitoring and incident response for what you ship.

 - Raising the bar: Code reviews, mentoring, and active part in hiring engineers.


OUR TECH CONTEXT (GREENFIELD)

 - Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.

 - Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …

 - Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.

 - Tooling budget for whatever makes you fast. No legacy, no yak-shaving.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7+ years building and operating web applications in production, end-to-end

 - Strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals; React on the frontend (Next.js or comparable)

 - Backend depth: API design, relational data modelling (PostgreSQL), third-party integrations

 - A track record of owning features from idea to production with real users

 - Product mindset: you talk to users, challenge requirements and cut scope to ship

 - AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work – beyond autocompletion

 - Experience with containerised deployments (e.g. Docker) and CI/CD

 - A degree in computer science or a related field – or an equivalent track record

 - Very good English (min. C1); German is a plus

 - A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich


NICE TO HAVE

 - LLM-based features in production (RAG, agents, evaluations)

 - Experience in a start-up or scale-up

 - Exposure to fintech, accounting, tax or payroll


THE PROCESS (FAST, MEANINGFUL, NO HOMEWORK)

 1. Intro call with a recruiter

 2. Get to know a fellow engineer, virtually or in person (up to you)

 3. Meet our founding team in a final interview (in person, ~3h, incl. live coding)


ABOUT US

We’re building the tax firm of the future. Radically simple. Highly automated. 100% client-focused.

We are rethinking tax advisory from the ground up: simple, fast and transparent – for clients and for our team. Where other firms struggle with manual processes and long waiting times, we build a digital, proactive, AI-powered experience. Repetitive work largely runs by itself, leaving time for advice, special cases and smart solutions.

What sets us apart from other “digital firms”: more than half of our team are software engineers. We build the tools our tax experts use every day – for their real problems, not off the shelf.

We are an experienced team of tax advisors, accountants, digital entrepreneurs and software engineers with an exit track record of €140m, backed by €12m from leading investors. Together with you, we want to build one of Germany’s leading tax firms.

jobs.title: Vice President, Architecture Research Lab
jobs.description:
Please Note:

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

The successful candidate will lead pioneering research on next-generation memory-centric AI system architectures. This role entails the end-to-end co-design of AI workloads, system-level modeling, and hardware platforms. The objective is to develop high-performance AI systems that utilize Samsung’s advanced memory solutions and technologies to eliminate bottlenecks related to memory capacity, bandwidth, and interconnect.

Location: Daily onsite presence at our San Jose Headquarters in alignment with our Flexible Work policy

Research & Innovation Management

• Define the research vision and strategy for memory-centric AI systems, aligned with Samsung’s memory technology roadmap.

• Deliver strategic architectural recommendations to senior leadership and external partners.

• Manage multidisciplinary research teams, including AI system architects and CPU architects, and technical roadmaps to ensure high-impact publication and patent output.

• Build and scale a world-class research organization by recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent.

• Drive strategic partnerships with leading hyperscalers and academic institutions.

AI System Architecture Leadership

• Collaborate with SAIT HQ teams to ensure modeling insights are effectively integrated into real-world AI system implementations.

• Establish system-level architectures designed to overcome memory capacity, bandwidth, and interconnect bottlenecks for large-scale AI workloads, including LLMs and recommendation systems.

• Direct rack-scale performance modeling, simulation, and design-space exploration to inform strategic architectural decisions across performance, power, and cost.

• Spearhead architecture path-finding for large-scale AI training and inference, focused on throughput, latency, and energy efficiency.

• Oversee system architecture specifications, including memory hierarchy design, to optimize AI workload execution.

What You Bring

Education: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Experience: 10+ years in system‑level architecture research or large‑scale computing platform design, with a strong focus on AI workloads.

10+ years of experience leading, building and managing high performing Engineering teams

Technical Expertise Required:

• Proven track record of designing system-level architectures for large-scale AI inference, from node up to rack or cluster scale, with a strong understanding of memory, networking, accelerators, and AI models.

• Comprehensive understanding of modern AI accelerator and system architectures (GPU, NPU, TPU) and heterogeneous integration strategies (CPU ISA knowledge is a plus).

Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication; proven ability to deliver technical presentations to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

• Strong background in performance modeling and quantitative analysis of compute-memory-interconnect systems to inform architectural decisions (e.g., large-scale design-space exploration and PPA trade-off studies).

• Deep understanding of AI models (e.g., LLMs, MoE, recommendation models), with experience driving HW/SW co-design and HW-aware model optimization.

• Understanding of the inference serving and training software stack, with experience optimizing inference serving performance across multiple devices.

• Proven track record of publishing high‑impact research papers (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, MLSys, ISCA, MICRO, HPCA).

• Strong collaborative history with cross‑functional teams (hardware, software, memory technology).

• Experience working in global, multi-geographic environments (e.g., U.S.-based or international technology companies), with proven effectiveness in cross-cultural collaboration across geographies and time zones.

jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

KPNX-TV Phoenix, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Phoenix is searching for an ambitious Digital Content Producer who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content.

Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across all KPNX-TV Phoenix website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. They work as part of the larger content team to break news and tell great stories in a 24/7 news environment.

The ideal candidate is an avid news consumer and writes accurate, compelling content with a sense of urgency.

Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. They should also have solid news judgment and experience producing and copy-editing content for digital platforms. Experience with SEO best practices and audience listening are a big plus.

We’re also looking for someone with strong initiative and an inner drive who is ready to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:

• Write and distribute original and accurate breaking news content

• Curate and schedule news content on all station platforms, including website, mobile app, social media and streaming platforms

• Edit reporter stories for grammar, clarity, structure, AP style and optimize the content for digital

• Use creative production or story-packaging techniques, like subheads, hyperlinks, graphics and media (viewer pictures, user-generated content, etc.) to enhance digital stories

• Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner

• Research for facts and credibility

• Monitor news releases and use social listening to find new content, enterprise stories and make community contacts

• Analyze and actively use data and metrics to inform editorial and strategic decisions

• Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or senior digital producers

• Ensure the newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the station brand across platforms

Requirements:

• BA/BS in journalism, communications and/or equivalent experience in the field

• 3-5 years of experience writing breaking news articles or writing news articles in AP style

• Strong communication and organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure and meet deadlines

• Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and rapidly changing coverage

• Strong news and editorial judgment, and an understanding of the tenets of professional journalism

jobs.title: Principal, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

About the role
Do you know where the best specialized talent actually lives, and how to reach them before they ever look for a job? We're looking for a Principal, Talent Acquisition to handle market mapping, research and talent sourcing for Hut 8's most critical growth functions. The value of this role is created long before a hiring need reaches your desk.

This is not a queue of reqs to clear. You will research the talent landscape, map the companies and people that matter, build a proactive pipeline, and design each search strategy from the ground up. You will give our Talent Acquisition (TA) Partners and hiring leaders a clear view of who is out there and what it takes to win them.

You will be a trusted member of our TA team, translating business priorities into sourcing strategies, bringing market evidence to every conversation on scope, timing and compensation. You will own research and sourcing first and, as you earn credibility and trust, take on full-lifecycle searches of your own. We expect you to bring a point of view on how Hut 8 competes for niche talent.

What You'll Own

• Market mapping. Build and maintain talent maps by function, organization or segment. Know the target companies, the org structures, the key individuals and where the real depth of talent sits.

• Market research and intelligence. Produce a market brief for every search covering supply, likely motivators, competitor activity, compensation benchmarks and relevant constraints. Keep a running view of talent availability, competitor hiring and org moves. Use it to equip TA Partners to challenge assumptions on scope, timing and pay when the market says otherwise, and share regular, decision-ready insight with leadership.

• Proactive sourcing. Find the people who don't apply. Bring creative approaches to identify top talent, build personalized outreach that earns engagement, and give every candidate an excellent experience.

• A live talent network. Build and maintain relationships with specialized energy talent and industry connectors year-round, not only when a role is open. Keep tiered, current pipelines for our most critical future hires.

• Partnership. Turn each search into a clear sourcing strategy, flag talent constraints early, and run multiple niche searches at once with the rigor, quality and urgency they require.

• Earned ownership. Take on select full-lifecycle requisitions as you build credibility with TA Partners and hiring managers, and grow your scope and ownership over time.

What We're Looking For
You've built talent maps and pipelines for specialized roles, and you know the difference between posting a job and actually finding the people who don't apply. You've worked directly with senior stakeholders and know how to push back with evidence, not just execute. You're comfortable building from scratch in a company that moves fast.

• Experience in executive search, talent sourcing or talent intelligence for specialized or senior roles, at a search firm or in-house.

• You have a proven track record of market mapping and research: building target company lists, org charts and talent maps, and turning them into search strategy and hires.

• You are a hunter. You know where top talent lives, what motivates them, and how to engage them before they're looking.

• You apply advanced, data-informed sourcing methods to find talent others miss, and you keep improving how we find it.

• You communicate with precision regardless of audience. You are able to partner with senior leaders, push back on unrealistic requirements, and keep their trust. You know how to earn credibility and ownership over time.

• You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and you're energized by ambiguity rather than slowed by it.

Work setting

This role is based onsite five days a week at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Candidates must be Miami-based or willing to relocate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for Autobody Preppers with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive bodywork experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Experienced Auto Body Repair Technician, you’ll be expected to perform bodywork on multiple panels, including:

• Heavy plastic welding

• Minor metal pulling

• Roof and rocker panel repair

• Large area, heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of prep roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

• Mid-Level Prepper (min 3-5 years professional experience): perform bodywork on multiple panels, including heavy plastic welding, minor metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, stud welding, and large area heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• Experienced Prepper (min 5 years professional experience): train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including plastic welding, metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, and stud welding

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

• Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI

• Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies

• Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business

• Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction

• Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans

• Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models

• Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes

• Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling

• Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform

• Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI

• Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues

• Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences

• Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes

• Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis

• Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies

• Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires

• Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership

• Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems

• Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering

• Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs

• Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture

• Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions

• Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments

• Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture

• Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

• 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines

• 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders

• Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy

• Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution

• Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows

• Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies

• Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models

• Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture

• Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support

• Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption

• Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies

• Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness

• Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk

• Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms

• Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality

• Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions

• Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners

• Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change

• Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

• Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off

• US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave

• Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

• Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account

• Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$175,000—$290,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. The Executive Assistant performs a variety of clerical, secretarial and operational duties to support the efficient day-to-day management and coordination of office procedures under the direction of the VP/SVP.

Responsibilities:

• Receives, screens, distributes or files all incoming correspondence and other mail.
