jobs.title: IT Support Specialist
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We’re looking for an IT Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems and helping people get the most out of their technology. As a primary point of contact for employee IT support, you’ll resolve everyday issues and help ensure employees have the equipment, applications, and access they need to do their best work.

We’re looking for an IT Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems and helping people get the most out of their technology. As a primary point of contact for employee IT support, you’ll resolve everyday issues and help ensure employees have the equipment, applications, and access they need to do their best work.

Your work will span hands-on troubleshooting, employee onboarding, equipment management, and software administration. You’ll partner with IT Engineering and application owners, build helpful resources for employees, and identify ways to make support more efficient. This role offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of workplace technology and make a direct impact on the employee experience.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Resolve IT support requests & maintain knowledge base: Triage, prioritize, and resolve employee technology issues; document troubleshooting steps and escalate complex engineering issues while building easy-to-find user guides and support documentation.

 - Manage hardware & equipment lifecycle: Fulfill equipment requests, maintain inventory records, track refresh schedules/warranties, and coordinate repairs, procurement, and secure disposal.

 - Support employee transitions & access administration: Manage onboarding/offboarding setup, administer SaaS licenses and user permissions, and route privileged access requests to application owners.

 - Ensure audit readiness & event AV support: Maintain accurate Helpdesk records for compliance/audits and provide technical setup and troubleshooting for company meetings and events.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, IT operations, or systems administration.

 - Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, operating systems, SaaS applications, user accounts, and workplace connectivity.

 - Experience using a ticketing system to prioritize requests, document steps, track issues through resolution, and create useful support documentation.

 - Service-oriented mindset with strong written/verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to nontechnical users clearly and patiently.

 - Familiarity with employee onboarding/offboarding, account access, basic security practices, and sound judgment for escalating issues or handling sensitive data.

 - U.S. citizenship, ability to work standard PT business hours (8 a.m.–5 p.m.), and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with hardware deployment, endpoint management (macOS/Windows), and IT asset lifecycle planning.

 - Experience administering SaaS platforms (such as Okta, Jira, Google Workspace, Slack), managing identity, access, MFA, and role-based permissions.

 - Experience conducting user access reviews, application audits, IT compliance activities, vendor coordination, and tracking IT expenses.

 - Experience supporting warehouse technology, conference room AV equipment, or technical needs for company events.

 - Degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field, or certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Google IT Support.

jobs.title: Production Technician, Gateways (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PRODUCTION TECHNICIAN (STARLINK)

SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable.

We are looking for talented technicians to help with the full-scale production of Starlink Gateways. Starlink Gateways are advanced ground stations antennas that are responsible for delivering internet from the ground to satellites – they must be high-precision, low-cost, high-performance in all weather conditions (from the Arctic Circle to the desert), and ultra-reliable over long periods of time.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, enjoy solving complex problems with high-impact solutions, and love the challenge of building something from scratch, then this role will be an ideal next step in your career.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Execute startup and shutdown procedures for production equipment

• Build and test mechanical/electrical gateway components and perform wire harnessing work

• Own mechanical/electrical subassemblies and integration of final vehicle assemblies

• Read, interpret, and follow technical documents such as manufacturing work instructions

• Run functional testing of built hardware including setup, instrumentation, test execution, and teardown

• Perform test setups as needed to support developments across several test regimes - thermal, shock, vibration

• Provide feedback on failure modes and support engineering to drive root cause of yield limiters

• Recommend improvements to manufacturing processes and work with engineers to develop, implement, and refine processes with a specific focus on reducing cost and downtime and increasing yield

• Ensure production equipment is maintained and calibrated while keeping track calibration schedules

• Responsible for some preventative maintenance activities on test equipment and data acquisition systems

• Ensure 5S standards are upheld by maintaining a clean and organized work area

• Manage schedule priorities and independently execute work to meet company deliverables

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school degree or equivalency certificate

• 1+ years of experience working in a hands-on technical position OR an associate degree in a STEM field

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 3+ years of experience in electro-mechanical assembly, integration, or mechanical assembly

• Proficient in using a PC, Microsoft Windows, and the Microsoft Office suite

• Ability to read, interpret, and work from layout drawings, mechanical drawings, assembly procedures, schematics, engineering drawings, and parts lists

• Experience working in an electro-mechanical manufacturing, precision manufacturing, or high-volume manufacturing company

• Electro-mechanical assembly and prototype development experience

• Experience setting up and conducting tests and experiments

• IPC and/or J-STD certification

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willing to work all shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed to support critical milestones

• Standing for long periods, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

• Able to lift up to 25lbs. unassisted

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: GNC Engineer, Satellite Power Systems (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GNC ENGINEER, SATELLITE POWER SYSTEMS (STARLINK)

SpaceX designs, builds, flies, and operates Starlink: thousands of satellites, user terminals, and the software that ties them together. It is the world’s largest satellite constellation, providing fast and reliable internet to over 10M+ users.

This role is on the Guidance, Navigation, and Control team and applies your fundamental background to the electrical power system—not attitude or orbital control. You will own control and estimation for how power moves through Starlink satellites: solar arrays, batteries, and power converters. Take the design from trade studies and high-fidelity simulation into flight software running live on the constellation. When hardware or algorithms misbehave, find the cause and ship the fix. Analyze the fleet and fold your conclusions into the next design.

Launch and fly with the team and put better power control on every satellite. Make high-speed internet available everywhere, all the time.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, implement, and maintain control systems for electrical power flow on Starlink satellites, and take them from analysis into flight software.

• Build high-fidelity simulations to design and validate control and estimation algorithms before they fly.

• Develop ground-side and on-vehicle estimators for battery, solar array, and converter health, safety, and performance. Use fleet telemetry to check that those estimates are right.

• Investigate anomalous hardware or algorithm behavior. Reproduce it in simulation or test and ship software that detects or removes it.

• Communicate the work to the engineers who use it: document your design, review theirs, present the results, and make the case when something has to change.

• Work directly with software, test engineering, reliability, satellite operations, and the wider GNC team to design, test, and fly the power system.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in aerospace, physics, computer science, or an engineering discipline.

• Experience writing software in C++, Python, MATLAB, or related language.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Hands-on work with batteries, solar arrays, or power converters.

• Control design and analysis in both state space and the frequency domain, demonstrated on a real project.

• Control-oriented modeling, numerical simulation, and system identification from test or flight data.

• State and parameter estimation applied to a project: Kalman filtering, recursive least squares, or similar optimal recursive methods.

• Optimization applied to a real control, design, or estimation problem.

• Embedded C++. Python, MATLAB, and Simulink for analysis.

• Spacecraft operations and flight software development, testing, and deployment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when a vehicle, a campaign, or an on-orbit issue requires it.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) Hybrid Remote

Location: San Diego, CA and Surrounding Areas (Hybrid Option Available)

At Cortica, our Board-Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) use a strength based, holistic approach to clinical programming for children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences. Our valued BCBAs are leaders who make a difference and create a supportive environment where all clinicians in our transdisciplinary team can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful, long-term impact for families.

You'll provide groundbreaking, neurodiversity-affirming care, while enjoying the flexibility and support you deserve.

Why Choose Cortica?

We're excited to support your continued professional development, growth, well being, and ability to make a meaningful impact as part of a transdisciplinary team. That's why our compensation and benefits package has been designed to support you personally and professionally:

• Total Earning Potential (Salary + Bonus): $91,061 - $113,820

• Generous Time Off to Recharge and Maintain Work-Life Balance: Up to 22 days off in your first year, increasing to 26 days after 12 months.

• Flexible Hybrid Role: Up to 50% of this role can be done remotely, allowing you to balance your clinical work and administrative tasks on your terms. **Telehealth is determined by the BCBA when its clinically effective for the client and BT**

• CEU Stipend: $2,000 annually to support your continued professional development.

• License Reimbursement: We cover the cost of your BCBA license renewal.

• 401(k) Matching: Helping you plan for your future with matching contributions.

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, plus pet insurance—because we care about your entire family, furry friends included!

• Set Scheduling: Predictable work hours help you balance your work and personal life.

Your Role and Impact
As a BCBA at Cortica, you'll play a pivotal role in overseeing neurodiversity-affirming clinical programming for patients receiving ABA treatment. You'll lead a team of behavior technicians (BTs)  empowering them to make a lasting difference in the lives of children with developmental differences.

What you'll love about this role:

• Achievable Targets: You'll average 26 billable hours per week, with reduced targets during shorter weeks to ensure a manageable workload.

• Uncapped Bonus Potential: You'll have an opportunity to earn more by increasing your billable hours, but it's entirely up to you—work at a pace that suits your lifestyle.

• Growth and Advancement Opportunities: You'll have the chance to advance through BCBA levels I, II, III, and IV, increasing your leadership impact along the way. At BCBA levels III and IV, productivity targets are reduced to 22, allowing you to focus on developing leadership skills, cultivating other talents, and exploring broader professional interests.

• Autonomy over Your Schedule: You'll have full control over when and where you supervise your cases, empowering you to design a schedule that works for you.

• Administrative Support: Focus on what you do best—clinical care—while our dedicated team handles scheduling, billing, and credentialing, leaving you with more time to focus on your work and patients.

Qualifications and Requirements

• Master's degree in human services or a related field.

• Current BCBA (Board-Certified Behavior Analyst) Certification required.

What Makes Cortica Different from Other ABA Companies?

At Cortica, we believe in going beyond traditional ABA practices to offer a more comprehensive, patient-centered approach that is different from other ABA companies:

• A Transdisciplinary Approach to Care: Unlike many ABA companies that focus solely on behavior therapy, Cortica offers a holistic, multidisciplinary model of care. Our team includes experts from a wide range of fields—occupational therapy, speech pathology, pediatrics, and more—allowing us to address the whole child and deliver more integrated, effective care.

• Focus on Collaboration: At Cortica, we don't just implement therapy—we collaborate with families, caregivers, and other clinicians to create individualized care plans that empower everyone involved. This approach ensures that each child's unique needs are met, and that the entire team is aligned in their goals for success.

• Quality Over Quantity: We take pride in value-based care partnerships with health plans that prioritize quality over quantity. Our patients benefit from the time we dedicate to collaborative, integrated care, and our clinicians are supported with more time for thoughtful clinical decision-making. Unlike other providers, we are reimbursed based on outcomes, not just the number of sessions delivered.

By joining Cortica, you'll be part of a team that's redefining ABA therapy—combining compassion, innovation, and collaboration to deliver results that matter.

Ready to make a difference? Apply today to learn more.

Cortica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This posting is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Please review the full job description here: Job Description.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Legal Engineer
jobs.location: New York, NY; Salt Lake City, UT; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the Role

Flex is seeking a Legal Engineer to design, build, and maintain the AI-enabled tooling that powers our Legal team. Our legal organization is already on the bleeding edge of AI adoption, and this role exists to push that further: turning commercial and corporate legal work into automated, scalable workflows, and equipping our product and regulatory advisory colleagues with tools that let them advise at the speed of the business. By owning legal automation end to end, you will help Legal stay lean, keep pace with the business, and ensure risk is managed by design rather than by headcount.

This is a builder role with a product mindset. You will sit at the intersection of law, operations, and technology: spotting where work can be automated, scoping and prioritizing solutions like a product manager, building them yourself, and measuring whether they work.

What You Will Do

• Own Legal’s AI use-case roadmap: identify, scope, and prioritize automation opportunities across commercial, corporate, and product/regulatory advisory work, and make build-versus-buy recommendations backed by a clear business case.

• Design, build, and maintain AI-enabled tools and workflows (custom agents, prompt templates, review checklists, intake pipelines, and system integrations) that automate contract review, drafting, and corporate housekeeping.

• Connect legal tooling to the systems the business already runs on (e.g., Ironclad, Salesforce, Snowflake, Superblocks) so data flows end to end and the business can self-serve through intake paths, FAQ tooling, and dashboards.

• Partner with product and regulatory counsel to build tools that help them advise on product launches, marketing, and regulatory change quickly and consistently.

• Build risk management into every workflow: define where AI output requires attorney review or escalation, and ensure AI usage aligns with Flex’s AI-usage policy and data-classification rules.

• Own the tooling behind the team’s knowledge management, including playbook repositories and playbook-maintenance automation, with substantive playbook changes routed to attorney review.

• Build and maintain Legal’s metrics and reporting infrastructure (cycle-time baselines, dashboards, and leadership-ready reporting) and use the data to measure tool impact and decide what to build next.

• Evaluate and optimize the legal-technology stack, including vendor evaluation, pilot design, and pricing negotiation.

• Deliver projects end to end, from proposal through launch, training, and documentation, and train the Legal team on effective, compliant AI use.

Who You Are

• 5+ years of experience in legal operations, legal engineering, legal technology, or a related product, solutions, or automation role, ideally supporting an in-house legal team.

• Hands-on builder with a track record of designing and shipping AI-enabled workflows, automations, and integrations (not just administering tools) using LLMs, low-code platforms, APIs, and scripting.

• Creative, product-minded problem solver: you turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped solutions, prioritize ruthlessly, and iterate based on user feedback.

• Strongly analytical: comfortable working with data (SQL a plus), defining metrics, and using evidence to measure impact and make the case for investment.

• Working understanding of commercial contracting and corporate legal workflows, and sound judgment about where legal risk calls for human review.

Preferred

• Familiarity with our internal tools, including Claude, Superblocks, Snowflake, Ironclad, and Salesforce.

• Prior fintech, financial services, or other regulated, high-growth experience.

• Experience with AI governance in practice: output-review protocols, acceptable-use standards, and data-classification requirements.

• Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to drive adoption among lawyers and business stakeholders alike.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) and Tier 3 (Salt Lake City) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$184,000—$230,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City)

$156,400—$195,500 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

jobs.description:
About the team

The AI Platform Go-to-Market (GTM) team, part of Strategic Operations, ensures ServiceNow’s AI Platform innovations translate into successful market launches and customer adoption. We ensure go-to-market readiness and adoption enablement across the AI Platform portfolio. Each GTM owner runs the end-to-end operating rhythm for a solution pillar, connecting Product strategy and roadmap execution with ecosystem readiness and customer adoption. We also build the shared processes, tools, and AI-native ways of working that every pillar uses.

What you get to do in this role

You will be the GTM owner for one of our AI Platform solution pillars. You will work with Inbound and Outbound Product Management, Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Partners, and Marketing to make sure your pillar’s products are ready for market and successfully adopted by customers.

Own GTM readiness and delivery for your pillar

• Turn the product roadmap into a GTM plan. Work with Product Management to understand scope and release timing, keep the facts about what is shipping (naming, availability, what changed) accurate, and define for each audience who must be ready, by when, and what “ready” means.
• Run the readiness process for monthly and quarterly releases and new product introductions, including plan reviews, checkpoints, and scorecards. Set regular cadences with Outbound Product Management and other stakeholders, hold each group to its commitments, and escalate risks and dependencies early.
• Coordinate enablement, messaging, pricing and packaging changes, and partner and services readiness. Functional owners build the assets, and you make sure the right ones are scoped, scheduled, and delivered.
• Serve as the front door for GTM requests for your pillar. Triage requests, prioritize them against the plan, and route work to the right owner.
• Maintain a single source of truth for pillar status, risks, and choices, and prepare concise readouts for senior executives.
• Help stakeholder groups adopt the readiness process and manage the change as the process evolves.

Drive adoption and learn from the field

• Track adoption metrics for your pillar’s products and keep them visible to executives.
• Work with the field and adoption teams to find what is blocking customer adoption, and feed those insights back to Product.

Grow into strategy and continuous improvement

• Your first year will emphasize building deep pillar expertise and establishing a highly reliable GTM operating rhythm. As that foundation matures, your scope will expand toward shaping GTM priorities with Product and the field, identifying adoption opportunities and recommending changes to the GTM plan.
• Help improve how the whole team works by contributing to shared templates, standards, and processes, and by replacing repeated manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows.
• Use AI tools to improve program efficiency, judgment, communication, and risk management.
• Collaborate across pillars on launches and bundles that span more than one product area, and adapt as pillar boundaries evolve.

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

• 8+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree (or 6+ with a Master’s, or equivalent experience) in technical program management, GTM or product operations, strategy and operations, or product launch and readiness.
• 4+ years running GTM readiness, product launch, or enablement programs for a SaaS company.
• A record of guiding cross-functional work through influence across product, sales, solution consulting, marketing, customer success, and partners, including holding peers to commitments without formal authority.
• Excellent facilitation skills in guiding planning meetings, readiness reviews, and retrospectives with senior executives (VP/SVP).
• Familiarity with technical products. You can understand how a platform works well enough to plan around it and talk credibly with Product and the field.
• Comfort with ambiguity. You can build a plan and keep it moving while org structure and priorities change.
• A process-focused approach, with a habit of building repeatable processes, templates, and automation so the same work isn’t redone every release.
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including executive-level narratives and presentations.
• Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work. You can describe a recurring workflow you replaced or sped up with AI, and you are curious about how enterprise AI products (agents, LLMs, workflow automation) are built and sold.
• Availability for regular overlap with US Eastern and Pacific time zones, and willingness to travel a few times a year (e.g., Santa Clara) for team and executive meetings.

It would be great if you also have:

• Experience with ServiceNow or another enterprise platform company.
• Exposure to agentic AI concepts such as MCP, orchestration, and evaluation.
• Experience launching new products, pricing and packaging changes, or sales and partner enablement.
• A professional certification such as PMP.

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. AI is central to that mission—and on the AIMS (AI Marketing Solutions) team, you’ll help shape how Generative AI powers HubSpot’s next chapter of growth.

jobs.title: Key Account Leader, Public Safety T1200
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Team: Public Safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand.

About the role: As a Key Account Leader, T1200 at Skydio, you will own a territory of public safety agencies with 101 to 550 sworn personnel. This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying role: you find the opportunities, run the deals, and close them. Your number is yours, and so is the territory plan behind it.

You will be the person an agency trusts with one of the most visible programs it will stand up this decade. That means understanding how the agency actually works, who has to say yes, and what it will take to get there, then running a process that gets the program funded, approved, and deployed. You will report to the Key Account Director, T1200, and work alongside Sales Engineering, Business Development, Channel, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success.

We sell autonomous flying robots and the artificial intelligence that powers them. Every seller here uses AI tools as a normal part of running a territory: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, responding to RFPs, and analyzing pipeline. We expect you to as well.

This is a highly competitive market, and much of the work happens alongside our channel. You will sell against incumbent platforms and well-funded challengers, and win on the merits.



Location: National (Remote, United States)



How we work

These are the standards we hire to, and they describe how the best people on this team already work.

 - High integrity. Public safety is a tight-knit community. Chiefs and Sheriffs talk to each other, and a reputation for straight answers travels fast. We sell what the ecosystem is actually capable of, we are clear about where the product is today and where it's headed, and we win on our own merits. There's no compromise here.

 - Sales is a team sport. One team. No lone wolves. Deals are won by account leaders, sales engineering, business development, channel, marketing, strategic relationships, government relations, and mission success pulling in the same direction, and our partners are part of that team, not a channel to be managed around. The best people here care more about the collective number than their own slice of it.

 - Great conversationalists. This is the craft of the job: asking better questions than anyone else in the room, listening for what a chief or sheriff isn't saying, real curiosity about how an agency operates. Not polish, not a rehearsed pitch. Trust in this market is built one honest conversation at a time, and it is the thing competitors cannot copy.

 - Curious, and fluent with the tools. Everyone on this team uses AI as a normal part of their work: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, analyzing pipeline, drafting and then editing. That takes taste more than technical skill: knowing what a quality result looks like, describing a problem precisely enough to get it, and catching the tool when it is confidently wrong. The same muscle makes a great seller. Discovery is specifying the problem; qualification is checking the output. We hire people who are curious about how things work, whether that's an agency's budget, a council's politics, or the aircraft's autonomy, and who have spent the last two years embracing AI rather than waiting to be told to use it.

How you'll make an impact

Build pipeline

 - Own your territory plan: know the agencies in it, which are likely to move this year, and why

 - Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, and partners rather than waiting on inbound demand

 - Get in early and shape the criteria the agency will use to make its decision

Win

 - Run full-cycle deals from first conversation to award: discovery, demonstration, proof of value, proposal, procurement, and approval

 - Qualify with MEDDPICC rigor, and walk away from deals that are not real

 - Build consensus across the people who have to say yes: the chief or sheriff, command staff, the city or county manager, IT, finance, procurement, and the council or commission

 - Sell against incumbents and challengers: frame Skydio's unique differentiators, run displacement plays, and defend accounts under attack

Partner

 - Sell with and through channel partners, and structure deals that get customers to yes

 - Bring in Sales Engineering, Business Development, Government Relations, and Mission Success at the right moment, and keep them pointed at the same outcome

 - Hand off cleanly to Mission Success after award and stay close enough to the account to grow it

Run your territory

 - Forecast honestly and keep your pipeline clean enough that your Director can trust it

 - Use AI tools daily for agency research, call prep, RFP response, and pipeline analysis, and never let anything AI-drafted reach a customer unreviewed

 - Bring what you hear in the field back to the team: competitive intelligence, product gaps, and what is changing in how agencies buy

What makes you a good fit

Required

 - 5+ years carrying an individual quota in enterprise software, hardware, or SaaS sales, with attainment you can state year by year, including the year you missed and what you changed

 - Personal success running full-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals from first conversation to signed contract

 - A record of building your own pipeline, and a clear view of how much of your closed business you sourced

 - Disciplined qualification and a forecast your manager could trust

 - Fluency selling with and through channel partners

 - Daily, systematic use of AI tools in your own work, and at least one workflow, analysis, or tool you built or changed in the last two years that made you measurably better (we will ask you to show it, not describe it)

 - Presence with agency leadership and high personal integrity under quota pressure

 - Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, and based in your assigned territory.

Preferred

 - Experience in public safety, specifically law enforcement, fire, or emergency management

 - Experience selling into SLED customers, with working knowledge of procurement vehicles and budget and grant cycles

 - You have built something with AI that other people use, whether a research tool, an analysis, or a workflow, and you can talk about what the first version got wrong

 - Curiosity that shows: you can explain how something outside sales works (an agency budget, an airspace waiver, the aircraft's autonomy) in plain language, and you learn fast

 - Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Salesforce, Clari, BGov, GovWin, Slack, and Google Workspace

 - UAV, robotics, or emerging technology background, and comfort in a fast-moving environment

What to expect from our process

We run a structured process and we tell you what it is. A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. A deep dive on your selling record: attainment year by year, how you built pipeline, and the mechanics of deals you won and lost. A working session where you use your own AI tools on a realistic problem from this territory and walk us through your choices. A panel where you run a discovery conversation and walk us through how you would win a deal in this segment. A conversation about how you think. References with people who managed you and worked alongside you. Every interviewer scores independently against the same rubric before we compare notes.

On AI in the process: draft your resume yourself and refine it with AI if you like; we want your real experience, well expressed. Use whatever tools you want to prepare. Expect to use them in the working session. Leave them off during the conversational interviews so we can see how you think in real time. We use AI to draft job descriptions like this one and to take notes, and a human makes every hiring decision.



Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $137,000 + Commission*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Radar Systems Engineer, Early Career
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Radar Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for both lab & field integration and test of payloads, subcomponents, amplifiers, and antennas. You will leverage your knowledge in electronics/RF design, testing, and troubleshooting to rapidly test & integrate both internal and third-party built RF systems. You will develop test set-ups that allow for the validation of device performance using state-of-the-art RF equipment, such as spectrum and network analyzers. You will support flight test events and large-scale, customer facing validation exercises. If you are someone who enjoys building and delivering compelling next-generation autonomous capabilities and supporting actual vehicle integration, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Test RF systems (power measurements, pulse response/synchronization, network analysis, environmental & stress testing, etc.)

• Drive air vehicle integration and checkout efforts (EMI/interference testing, installed performance testing, data analysis)

• Validate system performance in close cooperation with design & system engineers

• Work closely with AD&S teams to successfully integrate & deliver high-performance systems to our customers

• Communicate results in multiple forms internally and externally

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Communications, sensors, and effector domain experience in RF based systems (e.g. Radar, ESM, EW, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with RF test equipment and measurement techniques

• Experience in RF system integration and validation, the more the better

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Active Clearance

• Advanced sensing domain experience (e.g., EO/IR, ESM, EA, EW, LIDAR)

• Experience with air vehicle design, integration, test, & fielding

$117,000—$150,000 USD

Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

We’re proud to partner with the world’s leading companies in automotive, aerospace, industrial, and technology sectors, providing strategic guidance and hands-on execution that drive innovation and efficiency. Whether we’re launching advanced manufacturing systems, deploying digital simulation tools, or scaling global operations, PAC thrives at the intersection of technology, engineering, and problem-solving.  Joining PAC means joining a dynamic, fast-paced, and global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Role Purpose: Support automotive vehicle development through mass properties engineering, weight management, and vehicle attribute optimization. Ensure vehicle mass, weight distribution, and center of gravity targets are achieved throughout the product development lifecycle, collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to balance performance, efficiency, safety, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop, monitor, and maintain vehicle mass properties, including curb weight, gross vehicle weight, payload, axle loads, and center of gravity.

• Support vehicle attribute development by evaluating the impact of mass and weight distribution on performance, efficiency, handling, and vehicle dynamics.

• Establish and track vehicle-level and subsystem-level mass targets throughout development programs.

• Analyze mass properties and identify weight reduction opportunities across vehicle systems and components.

• Perform mass calculations, weight estimations, and engineering trade-off studies.

• Collaborate with Vehicle Architecture, Body, Chassis, Powertrain, Electrical, CAE, and Product Engineering teams.

• Evaluate engineering changes and their impact on vehicle mass, weight distribution, and attribute targets.

• Support design reviews, engineering assessments, and vehicle development milestones.

• Maintain accurate mass tracking databases, engineering reports, and technical documentation.

• Support benchmarking activities and continuous improvement initiatives related to vehicle weight optimization

Deliverables:

• Vehicle Mass Properties Reports.

• Mass Tracking and Weight Management Reports.

• Vehicle Mass Target Assessments.

• Weight Distribution and Center of Gravity Analyses.

• Mass Reduction Opportunity Studies.

• Engineering Change Impact Assessments.

• Vehicle Attribute Performance Reports.

• Technical Documentation and Engineering Presentations.

Required Skills & Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in Automotive Engineering, Vehicle Development, Mass Properties, or Vehicle Attributes.

• Experience with vehicle mass management, weight distribution, and mass properties calculations.

• Understanding of vehicle architecture, automotive systems, and component integration.

• Ability to evaluate the impact of mass on vehicle performance and engineering targets.

• Experience working with engineering data, technical reports, and vehicle development documentation.

• Advanced Excel skills for engineering calculations, analysis, and reporting.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional automotive engineering teams.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Advanced English (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers.

• Knowledge of vehicle dynamics, ride and handling, energy efficiency, and vehicle attribute development.

• Experience using Siemens NX, CATIA, or equivalent CAD software.

• Familiarity with PLM systems, including Teamcenter.

• Experience with vehicle-level mass optimization and weight reduction initiatives.

• Knowledge of automotive benchmarking, engineering validation, and vehicle development processes.

• Experience supporting EV or ICE vehicle programs.

The salary range for this position is dependent upon experience, education, and qualifications.

$160,000—$170,000 USD

You'll lead a team of behavior technicians (BTs) and Assistant Supervisors, empowering them to make a lasting difference in the lives of children with developmental differences.

What you’ll love about this role:

• Achievable Targets: You’ll average 26 billable hours per week, with reduced targets during shorter weeks to ensure a manageable workload.

• Uncapped Bonus Potential: You’ll have an opportunity to earn more by increasing your billable hours, but it's entirely up to you—work at a pace that suits your lifestyle.

At Cortica, we believe in going beyond traditional ABA practices to offer a more comprehensive, patient-centered approach that is different from other ABA companies:

Our team includes experts from a wide range of fields—occupational therapy, speech pathology, pediatrics, and more—allowing us to address the whole child and deliver more integrated, effective care.

• Focus on Collaboration: At Cortica, we don’t just implement therapy—we collaborate with families, caregivers, and other clinicians to create individualized care plans that empower everyone involved. This approach ensures that each child’s unique needs are met, and that the entire team is aligned in their goals for success.

• Quality Over Quantity: We take pride in value-based care partnerships with health plans that prioritize quality over quantity. Our patients benefit from the time we dedicate to collaborative, integrated care, and our clinicians are supported with more time for thoughtful clinical decision-making. Unlike other providers, we are reimbursed based on outcomes, not just the number of sessions delivered.

By joining Cortica, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining ABA therapy—combining compassion, innovation, and collaboration to deliver results that matter.

Ready to make a difference? Apply today to learn more.

If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a results-driven Sales Account Manager I to serve as the strategic partner for our high-potential Growth customers. In this hybrid role, you will bridge the gap between relationship management and revenue generation. You will own a book of ~120-150 customers and be responsible for retaining their revenue, driving full platform adoption, and identifying opportunities to expand their Brex usage. You will be tasked with understanding their financial workflows—accounting processes to stakeholder dynamics—and translating those insights into measurable business value.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Team members are expected to work in-office three days per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for a book of customers, ensuring Brex is an essential part of how our customers operate

• Drive revenue by proactively identifying expansion opportunities and tying Brex’s value to measurable business results - including running structured discovery calls, creating commercial proposals, and negotiating pricing terms

• Deeply understand each customer’s workflows, accounting processes, and financial priorities to uncover pain points and steer stakeholder dynamics to influence full adoption

• Build relationships across multiple levels of stakeholders (from controller up to CFO) across the finance team, tailoring your communication and value framing to each audience and flagging risks or opportunities early with a recommended plan of action

• Work cross-functionally with Risk, Underwriting, Legal, and Deal Desk to ensure we are balancing customer needs with revenue impact

• Bring operational excellence through strong documentation, proactive communication, and project management. Keep customers and internal teams aligned on progress, blockers, and next steps via forecasting, CRM hygiene, activity tracking, and deal qualification.

• Lead quarterly business reviews to translate insights and data into recommendations that help customers maximize their ROI from Brex

• Advocate for customers internally by surfacing themes and insights that influence product direction and improve customer experience

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in customer-facing roles managing a book of business, owning account health, executive relationships, renewals, and expansion strategy

• Fluency in the language of modern finance, demonstrated through hands-on experience with the ecosystem of financial technology - including ERPs, spend management platforms, or AP automation tools

• Experience and comfort interacting with a high volume of customers at different stages of the customer lifecycle

• Strong business acumen with a finance-first mindset and comfortable speaking the language of CFOs, Controllers, and FP&A teams

• Ability to analyze product usage data and detect important insights and trends.

• Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration and influencing internal roadmaps based on customer needs

• Coachability and grit, with an interest in growing your sales career

• Bachelor's degree; finance, business, or related fields

Bonus Points

• You understand the bigger picture of customer value

• Experience in this or a similar role within a rapidly expanding start-up

• You are energized by building relationships across a wide range of levels and roles

• Experience in the credit card management space, including understanding limits, rewards, and underwriting

• Background in corporate accounting or financial systems

• Familiar with sales tools like Gong, Salesforce, and others

• Series 7 license

The expected OTE range for this role is $113,000 - $141,250. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

jobs.title: Sr. Design Validation Technician
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The LV Test and Validation team verifies the reliability, electrical performance, and compliance of low-voltage vehicle electronics. The team works with LVEE hardware design engineers and internal and external laboratories to produce decision-ready validation evidence. Its work spans component testing, test automation, failure investigation, and laboratory operations.

Role:

As a Sr. Design Validation and Test Technician, you will execute low-voltage component validation and maintain an organized, dependable DVT laboratory. Reporting to the Low-Voltage Test and Validation manager, you will work closely with design engineers and laboratory partners to complete DVP commitments on time. You will combine hands-on execution with disciplined analysis, documentation, and issue closure. Success in the first year means repeatable tests, complete evidence, and timely resolution of issues affecting current and future vehicle programs.

• Daily Component Testing: Oversee and execute LVT&V component tests in internal and external laboratories using test plans provided by Lucid Engineering.

• Bench and DUT Preparation: Set up test benches and fixtures, instrument devices under test, and execute controlled test procedures.

• ECU Support: Provide practical engineering support for ECUs, including laboratory equipment use, soldering, and cable assembly.

• Failure Investigation: Debug failures and anomalies with engineers to identify causes and potential corrective actions.

• Test Documentation: Maintain rigorous, detail-oriented test records and progress reports that make execution status and results clear.

• Laboratory Management: Organize and maintain DVT laboratory space, equipment, and inventory to support safe, repeatable testing.

Qualifications:

• AA/AS degree and 5+ years of related experience.

• Detail-oriented execution of procedures with the ability to work independently under an engineer's direction.

• Experience with laboratory test equipment including environmental chambers, power supplies, DAQ systems, and oscilloscopes.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You're a dynamic partner marketer with a passion for turning relationships into revenue and structure into scale. You thrive in cross-functional, fast-paced environments and are energized by creating compelling, result-driven marketing programs with strategic technology partners. You understand the nuances of MDF programs—how to unlock them, maximize them, and report ROI that makes stakeholders lean in. You're equally adept at managing incentives, SPIFFs, and rebate tracking with precision and transparency. You're equal parts project manager, creative thinker, and data-savvy executor. If you're ready to build something meaningful at the intersection of partnership and performance, this is your launchpad.

About The Role

As a Partner Marketing Manager at Myriad360, you’ll be a foundational member of our established Partner Marketing function. Reporting directly to the Head of Partner Marketing, you will execute co-marketing programs with our top-tier technology partners across cybersecurity, networking, cloud, AI, and XaaS. This role will focus heavily on managing market development funds (MDF), overseeing campaign execution, supporting incentive and rebate programs, and aligning marketing initiatives with revenue goals. You’ll be a key driver of programs that elevate Myriad360’s presence and pipeline across our strategic partner ecosystem.

Must be based in the United States.

Other responsibilities include:

MDF & Incentive Program Management

• Own the end-to-end MDF lifecycle, including proposal development, submission, execution, proof of performance, and reimbursement.

• Maximize available partner funding and ensure timely, accurate MDF utilization with measurable ROI.

• Manage partner portals and documentation associated with MDF, SPIFFs, and rebate programs.

• Collaborate with Finance, Sales, and Alliances to oversee and report on incentive programs including SPIFFs and performance-based rebates.

• Support the strategic planning and implementation of incentive-driven campaigns tied to sales and marketing initiatives.

Partner Campaign Execution

• Build and launch co-branded campaigns that include but are not limited to; digital advertising, events, content syndication, and solution-based messaging.

• Collaborate with partner and internal teams to create compelling joint value propositions and marketing collateral.

• Maintain a clear calendar of partner campaigns, coordinating deliverables and timelines across internal functions.

Cross-Functional Integration

• Work closely with Strategic Alliances, Sales, and Engineering to ensure marketing strategies directly support partnership and revenue objectives.

• Align with demand generation and brand marketing teams to ensure partner programs are integrated across channels and maintain Myriad360 brand integrity.

• Support sales enablement with the creation and distribution of co-branded materials and tools.

Reporting & Analysis

• Track, measure, and report on campaign performance, lead conversion, MDF ROI, and incentive program impact using standardized dashboards.

• Support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) by presenting marketing contributions, program effectiveness, and optimization opportunities.

Process, Tools & Governance

• Utilize and optimize partner portals, MDF tracking systems, and marketing templates/playbooks.

• Ensure partner compliance with co-branding, messaging, and legal requirements in all external-facing materials.

• Act as a trusted resource for sales and alliance stakeholders navigating the rules, timelines, and opportunities across MDF, rebate, and SPIFF programs.

Tools for Success:

• Core Tools: Excel (advanced proficiency), PowerPoint, SharePoint, Salesforce

• Marketing Platforms: HubSpot, CVENT, Monday.com, Jira

• Partner Systems: Familiarity with MDF portals and partner program platforms (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto, Dell, HPE, etc.)

• Project Management: Proven ability to manage concurrent initiatives, budgets, and cross-functional collaboration

Key Attributes:

• Deep understanding of partner marketing dynamics within the technology ecosystem

• Proven ability to manage and maximize MDF, SPIFFs, and rebate programs with strategic partners

• Strong communicator who builds trust across teams and external stakeholders

• Highly organized, deadline-driven, and skilled in managing budgets and reporting

• Strategic thinker with tactical execution skills and a “no task too small” mindset

• Collaborative team player aligned with Myriad360’s “We Before Me” ethos

• Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section

• Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts

• Other duties as assigned

Desired skills and experience:

• 3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing with at least 2 years in a partner, channel, or alliance marketing capacity

• Demonstrated success in MDF and incentive program management, including SPIFFs and rebate support

• Experience working with technology partners across cybersecurity, cloud, networking, or XaaS

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or related field

• Experience in or with solution providers, systems integrators, or service providers strongly preferred

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

• We Before Me: We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.

• Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.

• Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

Some of Our Benefits

• Incentive compensation plans for all employees

• Zero-cost employer-covered health insurance

• Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500

• Transparent, candid culture with 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and a consistent feedback loop

• Quirky, diverse, respectful, high-performing coworkers you’ll want to achieve greatness with!

Must be based in the United States.

jobs.title: Mission Systems Engineer, Early Career
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Mission Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for both lab & field integration and test of payloads, subcomponents, amplifiers, and antennas. You will leverage your knowledge in electronics/RF design, testing, and troubleshooting to rapidly test & integrate both internal and third-party built RF systems. You will develop test set-ups that allow for the validation of device performance using state-of-the-art RF equipment, such as spectrum and network analyzers. You will support flight test events and large-scale, customer facing validation exercises. If you are someone who enjoys building and delivering compelling next-generation autonomous capabilities and supporting actual vehicle integration, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Test RF systems (power measurements, pulse response/synchronization, network analysis, environmental & stress testing, etc.)

• Drive air vehicle integration and checkout efforts (EMI/interference testing, installed performance testing, data analysis)

• Validate system performance in close cooperation with design & system engineers

• Work closely with AD&S teams to successfully integrate & deliver high-performance systems to our customers

• Communicate results in multiple forms internally and externally

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• Communications, sensors, and effector domain experience in RF based systems (e.g. Radar, ESM, EW, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with RF test equipment and measurement techniques

• Experience in RF system integration and validation, the more the better

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters Degree in STEM (Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, or other relevant engineering discipline)

• Active Clearance

• Advanced sensing domain experience (e.g., EO/IR, ESM, EA, EW, LIDAR)

• Experience with air vehicle design, integration, test, & fielding

US Salary Range

$117,000—$150,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

Alpaca is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Tokenization Analyst to join our Tokenization department.

This individual will work directly with the General Manager of Tokenization, supporting the development, commercialization, and execution of Alpaca's tokenization strategy.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, product, business development, and operations. The ideal candidate is a versatile problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity, and is comfortable taking ownership of projects from conception through execution.

This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to multiple facets of a rapidly emerging industry while helping build the infrastructure powering the future of tokenized financial markets.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Business Operations

• Work directly with the GM of Tokenization to execute the department's strategic priorities and business objectives.

• Track key departmental initiatives, product milestones, and cross-functional dependencies, ensuring accountability and timely execution.

• Monitor departmental KPIs and develop recurring reporting on business performance, including revenue, transaction volumes, partner adoption, and other strategic metrics.

• Prepare executive presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

Product & Go-to-Market Enablement

Market Research & Ecosystem Development

• Identify, research, and evaluate prospective clients, strategic partners, and emerging commercial opportunities.

• Monitor competitive developments, market trends, regulatory changes, and technological innovations impacting tokenized securities.

• Develop market maps, competitive analyses, and strategic recommendations to support business development and product decisions.

Commercial & Partnership Support

• Support the evaluation and execution of strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities.

• Prepare partner briefings, meeting materials, commercial proposals, and supporting analyses.

• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout partnership discussions, integrations, and launches.

• Track commercial opportunities, partnership progress, and follow-up actions to help accelerate execution.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Serve as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Compliance, and Operations for key tokenization initiatives.

• Proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies, escalating issues and recommending solutions.

• Establish and improve internal reporting, documentation, and operating processes to increase departmental efficiency.

Qualifications

Required

• 1–3 years of experience in strategy, business operations, product, consulting, financial services, fintech, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop actionable recommendations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create polished presentations and communicate complex concepts clearly.

• Exceptional organizational and project management abilities, with strong attention to detail.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate stakeholders, and independently drive projects forward.

• Strong proficiency in spreadsheets, presentations, and analytical tools.

• Genuine interest in financial markets, digital assets, blockchain technology, and tokenization.

Preferred

• Familiarity with securities markets, market structure, trading, clearing, custody, or settlement.

• Exposure to tokenized securities, stablecoins, DeFi, or blockchain infrastructure.

What Success Looks Like

How We Take Care of You:

AI is changing emergency response, and the conversation about what it should do, who should control it and whether it can be trusted is only getting louder. RapidSOS has supported more than one billion emergencies. We intend to help lead that conversation, and we are hiring a Senior Director, Communications to make it happen.

The story of how that works, and why it can be trusted, is the story you’ll tell. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com.
