This is a brand-new, senior role on our Marketing team, built for someone who will set RapidSOS’s voice in the market and own it end to end. You’ll shape our point of view on AI in public safety, make our executives the people others want to hear from, and build the communications function from the ground up. We prefer candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and we’ll consider remote candidates with exceptional experience.

What you’ll do:

• Own the story. Define RapidSOS’s point of view on the issues that matter in public safety, AI and the future of emergency response, and make sure it is heard by the people who decide.

• Take the lead on the message. Bring leadership the positioning, the evidence and the plan. Hold the line when the conversation gets difficult.

• Make our leaders known. Book, prep, ghostwrite for and media-train our CEO and executive team across podcasts, stages, bylines and LinkedIn, and push for the time and participation it takes.

• Earn coverage. Run the earned media engine as one tool among several. Pitch and land stories yourself in business, technology, public-safety, government and enterprise outlets, and build the relationships behind them.

• Direct the content engine. Set the messages we reinforce in the market and the content that proves them, including stories built from our data, partnerships and customer proof. Carry each idea across every channel it fits, and make RapidSOS easy to find and trust wherever buyers research, including AI tools.

• Own announcements and crisis readiness. Plan and land company news. Hold and rehearse the crisis plan, and lead messaging alongside Legal when it counts.

• Lead the team. Set priorities for the team, direct contract resources and outside partners, and use AI to move faster with a human on every final call.

• Measure what matters. Build a track record of connecting communications to business outcomes by setting baselines, reporting results in business terms, and putting effort behind what works.

What we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:

• 10+ years across communications, journalism, editorial work or public affairs, with a track record of running programs end to end, not only overseeing them

• Exceptional writing and editing skills, including in an executive’s voice; please bring a portfolio of work from the last 12 months

• AI fluency: Deep, hands-on experience communicating about AI; you’ve built and defended an AI narrative for a company or cause, fielded hard questions about trust, safety or accountability, and can speak credibly with technical leaders, policymakers and journalists about what AI can and can’t do.

• Political and policy fluency: you understand how government, technology and public safety intersect and how narratives form in that landscape. Experience in public affairs, political campaigns, or government or policy-adjacent communications is a strong signal

• Proven under scrutiny, with crisis or issues communication experience in a high-stakes environment and a record of holding the message when it counted

• Modern media instincts: you think beyond the traditional PR playbook, across executive social, podcasts and owned channels, and you create opportunities instead of waiting for them

• Coverage you landed yourself in tier-1 or trade outlets, with relationships you can name, not just coverage you managed

• Experience as an executive advisor who can manage up, advise a CEO and leadership team, push for what you need and give candid feedback

• Strong editorial judgment: the curiosity to chase the story behind the story, the fact-checking discipline to keep it accurate, and the confidence to tell us when an idea isn’t interesting

• AI forward: you run your own AI workflows today and have clear views on where a human must make the final call

• A data mindset: you define metrics beyond activity and are honest about what can and cannot be attributed

• Experience leading a small team and directing contract resources while staying hands-on

• Grit and mission: you’re inspired by helping people at their most vulnerable moments, and you have the determination and confidence to build this and drive it relentlessly. You welcome tough feedback and come back with something better, and when something stalls, you find another way to make the work succeed

Nice-to-have experience (but not required!):

• Familiarity with public safety, 911, emergency response, government technology or enterprise technology

• Experience running a newsletter, podcast or creator program

What we offer:

• The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally

• Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation

• A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team

If you're curious to learn more about RapidSOS, you can check out https://rapidsos.com/blog/

US based roles only

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

We're looking for a Research Engineer to make Claude better at the real-world work that matters most to Beneficial Deployments. You'll identify where our models fall short, build the environments and reward signals used to train them, run experiments, and measure whether new capabilities generalize beyond the training data. You'll also work closely with the Beneficial Deployments team, helping shape its roadmap based on where AI capabilities are heading.

Key responsibilities

• Identify capability gaps in our models and turn them into a research agenda

• Own the end-to-end process of creating RL environments, from task sourcing and reward design through training, using both real-world and synthetic data

• Collaborate with domain experts to design data pipelines

• Develop and improve QA frameworks to catch reward hacking and ensure env quality

• Run generalization experiments to measure how data strategy changes improve model capabilities

• Partner with other RL research teams and product teams to align on capability goals

Minimum qualifications

• Have experience with fine-tuning large language models for specific domains or real-world use cases

• Have experience with reinforcement learning, reward design, or training data curation for LLMs

• Have a track record of setting your own direction and delivering on ambiguous, high-stakes work with little oversight, such as by running your own team, research program, or company

• Can turn deep technical understanding into clear strategic recommendations that influence senior, non-technical leaders

• Think rigorously about how quickly AI capabilities are advancing and are ready to plan around the possibility that transformative AI arrives soon

• Find value in reading through datasets to understand them and spot issues

• Are excited about a role that combines hands-on applied research with strategy and influence

Preferred qualifications

• Have experience training production ML systems

• Have experience designing evals or benchmarks for LLMs

• Have domain expertise in healthcare, global health, or philanthropy

• Have experience with multilingual models or low-resource languages

• Have worked with NGOs, ministries of health, funders, or other partners in low- and middle-income countries

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, OpenRouter (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

To help support that mission, in August we announced that Stripe had agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a leading AI model gateway and routing platform. While that acquisition is under regulatory review and has not yet closed, our intent is that this role will support the OpenRouter team following the closing of the acquisition.

About the team

OpenRouter helps developers and businesses access and use a broad range of AI models through a unified platform. This role sits at the intersection of OpenRouter and Stripe, supporting hiring across Tech, GTM, and Core teams. You’ll serve as a bridge between the 2 organizations, bringing Stripe’s recruiting standards, talent networks, and resources to OpenRouter while protecting its speed and minimizing operational overhead.

You’ll align to Tech, GTM, or Core, but you won’t be dedicated to a single job profile within that function. For example, a GTM Recruiter may support Sales, Solutions Architecture, Marketing, or other GTM roles as priorities shift. The same model applies across Tech and Core.

What you’ll do

Own full-cycle recruiting for your aligned function, moving across job profiles based on business priority, from intake and market mapping through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff. You’ll combine direct execution with consultative partnership, working closely with hiring managers to clarify needs, advise on talent markets, build and engage qualified pipelines, and move candidates through structured, timely processes.

You’ll operate with startup speed while leveraging Stripe’s infrastructure and reach. You’ll use metrics to identify risk and guide action, while keeping recruiting outcomes, not reporting or process for its own sake, at the center of the work.

Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting across the full range of roles within your aligned function, Tech, GTM, or Core, moving between job profiles as business priorities shift

• Build qualified and inclusive pipelines through hands-on sourcing across communities, referrals, events, market mapping, relationship-based outreach, and other creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach

• Partner consultatively with hiring managers to translate business priorities into clear role requirements, search strategies, structured assessments, and timely decisions

• Use funnel metrics, market evidence, and candidate feedback to identify risks, recommend actions, and communicate progress without allowing reporting or process to substitute for recruiting

• Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience and maintain relationships with prospective candidates for immediate and future needs

• Serve as an operational bridge between OpenRouter and Stripe by absorbing coordination where possible, maintaining continuity, and reducing the time OpenRouter leaders spend navigating recruiting processes

• Flex across job profiles within your aligned function when priorities shift or additional coverage is needed

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including direct ownership of sourcing, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing

• Experience recruiting in a high-growth technology startup, preferably during a stage below 200 employees

• Demonstrated recruiting depth in at least 1 of the following areas: Tech, GTM, or Core, with experience recruiting across multiple job profiles or clear evidence you can move between profiles as business priorities shift.

• Demonstrated interest in and ability to personally conduct hands-on sourcing and build qualified pipelines through creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach

• Experience partnering consultatively with hiring managers, managing multiple searches, and using recruiting metrics and market evidence to identify risk and guide action

• Ability to work through ambiguity, adapt quickly as priorities change, and balance direct execution with longer-term pipeline building

Preferred qualifications

• Experience recruiting across both startup and larger-company environments and helping teams work effectively across different operating models

• Experience supporting structured, competency-based hiring processes

• Experience recruiting across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy

• Practical experience using recruiting technology, talent intelligence, or AI tools to improve sourcing and candidate experience

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

HARDWARE RELIABILITY ENGINEER (STARLINK)

SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.

The Hardware Reliability Team at Starlink is an interdisciplinary team that is committed to the reliability of the mechanical and electrical hardware required to connect our customers to our satellites. Your breadth of exposure will span across dozens of areas (mechanical, electrical, RF, software, test, etc.) as you collaborate with core groups at SpaceX to bring hardware from initial concept development to full-scale high-volume production.

You will use data to understand the factors that drive process and product reliability in design and manufacturing. You will dive deep into the details to identify, understand, and solve difficult technical problems to influence product design and manufacturing processes. You will be exposed to a hands-on environment that will enable you to spend time on the factory floor and in the test lab to improve the reliability of hardware and, ultimately, the user experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and implement reliability test strategies for new products and their subcomponents to maximize field life and minimize early life failures

• Develop, implement, and validate test and inspection processes for new and existing products and production processes, ensuring that criteria are objective and that reliability goals are consistently met

• Design and execute novel environmental, RF, mechanical, and electrical testing techniques tailored to the product and its functions

• Write test programs to exercise the functionality of the product over various conditions and environments

• Automate reliability test initiatives and reporting using proper data visualization techniques and thorough knowledge of the product and its functions

• Define the ongoing reliability testing strategy to monitor the manufacturing process and screen for long-term reliability defects caused by process and component variability

• Monitor product and process quality through production ramp-up using a suite of analysis tools, and drive improvements to areas that are under-performing in terms of key quality metrics

• ⁠Investigate failures in production and test, identifying and mitigating the immediate and underlying root causes in order to reduce risk and improve reliability of designs and processes

• ⁠Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to production representatives and engineers to assist in quarantining and rework activities

• Work closely with hardware, software, manufacturing, and network engineering teams to maximize reliability across all disciplines

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or other engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience in test, analysis, manufacturing, or hardware development (internship and project experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with both electronics and mechanical design and analysis including knowledge of RF principles

• Programming experience in Python, C, and SQL with an emphasis on data analysis and automation

• Demonstrated capability to think creatively and solve complex problems with little to no supervision and on schedule, both as an individual or as a member of an integrated team

• Experience in a fast-paced, iterative design environment within the consumer electronics, mobile handset, medical devices, aerospace, marine, or automotive industries

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and offsite as needed

• Must be willing to travel up to 30% for work

• Must be willing to relocate to Bastrop, TX (Austin area) if not already local – remote or hybrid work not considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Bridge Inspection Project Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Bridge Inspection Project Manager to help develop and grow our bridge inspection capabilities within our Construction Management team in Texas. This is an exciting opportunity for an established bridge inspection professional to take a leadership role in positioning AECOM for future bridge inspection, assessment, and preservation opportunities throughout Texas and surrounding states. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with project management, client relationship development, and business development capabilities to help expand AECOM's presence in this specialized area of transportation infrastructure.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and support a variety of anticipated inspection programs, potentially including routine and complex bridge inspections, tunnel inspections, and underwater bridge inspection assignments. You will bring technical knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, and specialized inspection procedures. As opportunities develop, you may also oversee underwater inspection activities, including coordinating inspection divers, planning inspection operations, and ensuring appropriate technical and safety protocols are followed.

Beyond technical delivery, this position offers the opportunity to help establish and grow AECOM's bridge inspection team in Texas and surrounding states. Initially managing a small group of inspection and technical professionals, you will help identify future staffing needs, recruit and develop additional talent, and build the capabilities necessary to support anticipated business growth. You will engage with TxDOT and other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation clients, serving as a technical resource while identifying opportunities to strengthen existing relationships and develop new business. This may include partnering with other engineering consultancies, supporting strategic pursuits, participating in marketing initiatives, and representing AECOM at industry conferences, trade shows, and professional events.

This is an opportunity for a technically accomplished bridge inspection professional who enjoys being involved in the field, developing people, building client relationships, and helping grow a business. You will have the support and resources of AECOM's established transportation and construction management organization while helping shape the future direction of its bridge inspection capabilities across the region.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs as opportunities develop, ensuring inspections are performed in accordance with applicable federal requirements, state DOT standards, and client expectations.
• Provide technical leadership for specialized inspection opportunities, potentially including fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, underwater bridge inspections, tunnel inspections, and other complex structural assessments.
• Plan and coordinate potential underwater bridge inspection assignments, including overseeing inspection divers, developing inspection plans, coordinating field resources, and ensuring appropriate safety procedures and technical requirements are followed.
• Provide technical oversight of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and specialized inspection procedures used to evaluate structural conditions, identify deterioration, and assess the integrity of bridge components.
• Support bridge condition assessments and preservation efforts, evaluating inspection findings, identifying critical deficiencies, managing Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and developing recommendations for maintenance, rehabilitation, and repair.
• Manage project budgets, schedules, staffing, subcontractors, deliverables, and quality control activities for awarded bridge inspection and assessment projects.
• Serve as a primary client contact as projects develop, building relationships with TxDOT, other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation agencies while communicating technical findings, project progress, and recommended solutions.
• Review and oversee the preparation of bridge inspection reports, condition assessments, technical evaluations, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable NBIS and agency requirements.
• Initially manage a small team of bridge inspection professionals, with the opportunity to recruit, develop, and expand the team as business needs and project opportunities increase.
• Identify and pursue opportunities to expand AECOM's bridge inspection services through client engagement, relationship development, strategic marketing, and participation in transportation infrastructure pursuits.
• Develop teaming relationships and partner with other engineering consultancies and industry firms to pursue potential inspection and preservation opportunities and strengthen AECOM's position in the regional bridge inspection market.
• Represent AECOM at industry conferences, technical meetings, trade shows, and professional association events, helping promote the firm's bridge inspection capabilities and develop new client relationships.
• Maintain a strong commitment to safety, ensuring field personnel follow established safety protocols, applicable OSHA standards, proper equipment setup procedures, and safe working practices during inspection activities.
• Travel throughout Texas and surrounding states to support inspection programs, client meetings, business development activities, and project assignments, including overnight travel as opportunities require.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS + 8 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of Texas or the ability to obtain Texas PE licensure through reciprocity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience managing routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs, including hands-on experience with fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, procedures, and specialized structural assessments.
• TxDOT Precertification 6.1.1 – Bridge Inspection Team Leader, along with completion of the NHI Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges national training course.
• Additional TxDOT pre-certifications, including 6.1.2, 6.2.1, 6.2.2, 6.3.1, 6.3.2, 6.4.1, 6.5.1, 6.5.2, 6.6.1, and 6.6.2.
• Experience with underwater bridge inspection programs, including planning inspection operations, overseeing inspection divers, coordinating specialized equipment, and ensuring compliance with applicable safety and inspection requirements. Rope access training and certifications, including SPRAT, are a plus.
• Demonstrated experience with tunnel inspections, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, bridge condition assessments, and preservation programs, including identifying deterioration, managing critical findings and Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and recommending appropriate repair and rehabilitation strategies.
• Experience working directly with TxDOT and other state DOTs, transportation agencies, and municipal clients, with the ability to develop client relationships, communicate complex technical findings, and support the development of long-term inspection programs.
• Proven experience building and managing technical teams, including recruiting, mentoring, developing staff, and expanding inspection capabilities. Experience with movable bridge inspections and assessments is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated business development and marketing experience, including developing client relationships, partnering with other engineering consultancies, supporting proposals and strategic pursuits, and representing an organization at industry conferences, trade shows, and professional events.

• This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter, OpenRouter (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

To help support that mission, in August we announced that Stripe had agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a leading AI model gateway and routing platform. While that acquisition is under regulatory review and has not yet closed, our intent is that this role will support the OpenRouter team following the closing of the acquisition.

About the team

OpenRouter helps developers and businesses access and use a broad range of AI models through a unified platform. This role sits at the intersection of OpenRouter and Stripe, supporting hiring across Tech, GTM, and Core teams. You’ll serve as a bridge between the 2 organizations, bringing Stripe’s recruiting standards, talent networks, and resources to OpenRouter while protecting its speed and minimizing operational overhead.

You’ll align to Tech, GTM, or Core, but you won’t be dedicated to a single job profile within that function. For example, a GTM Recruiter may support Sales, Solutions Architecture, Marketing, or other GTM roles as priorities shift. The same model applies across Tech and Core.

What you’ll do

Own full-cycle recruiting for your aligned function, moving across job profiles based on business priority, from intake and market mapping through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff. You’ll combine direct execution with consultative partnership, working closely with hiring managers to clarify needs, advise on talent markets, build and engage qualified pipelines, and move candidates through structured, timely processes.

You’ll operate with startup speed while leveraging Stripe’s infrastructure and reach. You’ll use metrics to identify risk and guide action, while keeping recruiting outcomes, not reporting or process for its own sake, at the center of the work.

Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting across the full range of roles within your aligned function, Tech, GTM, or Core, moving between job profiles as business priorities shift

• Build qualified and inclusive pipelines through hands-on sourcing across communities, referrals, events, market mapping, relationship-based outreach, and other creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach

• Partner consultatively with hiring managers to translate business priorities into clear role requirements, search strategies, structured assessments, and timely decisions

• Use funnel metrics, market evidence, and candidate feedback to identify risks, recommend actions, and communicate progress without allowing reporting or process to substitute for recruiting

• Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience and maintain relationships with prospective candidates for immediate and future needs

• Serve as an operational bridge between OpenRouter and Stripe by absorbing coordination where possible, maintaining continuity, and reducing the time OpenRouter leaders spend navigating recruiting processes

• Flex across job profiles within your aligned function when priorities shift or additional coverage is needed

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including direct ownership of sourcing, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing

• Experience recruiting in a high-growth technology startup, preferably during a stage below 200 employees

• Demonstrated recruiting depth in at least 1 of the following areas: Tech, GTM, or Core, with experience recruiting across multiple job profiles or clear evidence you can move between profiles as business priorities shift.

• Demonstrated interest in and ability to personally conduct hands-on sourcing and build qualified pipelines through creative channels beyond inbound applications and standard LinkedIn outreach

• Experience partnering consultatively with hiring managers, managing multiple searches, and using recruiting metrics and market evidence to identify risk and guide action

• Ability to work through ambiguity, adapt quickly as priorities change, and balance direct execution with longer-term pipeline building

Preferred qualifications

• Experience recruiting across both startup and larger-company environments and helping teams work effectively across different operating models

• Experience supporting structured, competency-based hiring processes

• Experience recruiting across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy

• Practical experience using recruiting technology, talent intelligence, or AI tools to improve sourcing and candidate experience

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Business Development Representative is the front door to Protege’s commercial and go-to-market motion. You’ll gain rapid exposure to the pain points, challenges, and opportunities of the world’s leading labs and healthcare AI builders. You’ll be responsible for building high-quality pipeline through a combination of disciplined, insight-led outbound prospecting via targeted sequences, fast qualification for both inbound and outbound, and strategic approaches such as events, conferences, and other indirect channels. You’ll also help test and validate new outreach hypotheses for new customer personas in close coordination with the sales and marketing team.

We are a small and focused team, and while we are focused on growing new logos and pipeline, this is not a “run an existing playbook” or “hit the phones with the same script 100x a day” sort of role. This role is highly strategic and requires both grit and brains — we do not expend energy for the sake of hitting arbitrary activity numbers.

The compensation reflects this opportunity - this is not a pure volume-based BDR position. The role calls for high agency, early-career individuals who want to drive business outcomes from the get-go. The ideal candidate may not know exactly what’s next after starting as a BDR - but wants to discover where they fit in a scaling go-to-market motion.

Prior BDR, sales, or partnerships experience is preferred, but not required. Backgrounds such as management/strategy consulting, PE, VC, and finance are strongly encouraged to apply.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and maintain a focused ICP target list for your assigned focus area(s). Avoid random outreach.

 - Develop, test, and run daily outbound sequences (email, LinkedIn, calls) to generate qualified meetings.

 - Prospect into Protege’s core wedge in each customer type: high-value real-world data that enables AI model development, not generic vertical SaaS.

 - Qualify fast (use case, data needed, timeline, stakeholders, success criteria) and disqualify quickly.

 - Deliver clean handoffs with crisp notes that accelerate next steps.

 - Partner with Marketing to iterate messaging and turn winning plays into a repeatable outbound engine, as well as drive connections to events and activations.

 - Keep pipeline hygiene tight and report what’s working weekly.

 - Build fluency in each vertical’s specific data landscape and AI constraints (ie. licensing, privacy, de-identification expectations, provenance, evaluation requirements) to speak credibly with technical and business buyers.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

30 days: Learn the Healthcare motion + start producing

Learn Protege’s positioning across verticals, core use cases, and target personas. Build a clean outbound workflow (target account list, sequences, call talk tracks, and daily activity targets). Begin consistent outbound execution and start booking initial qualified meetings.

60 days: Run repeatable outbound plays + tighten conversion

Operate as a quota-bearing BDR with steady weekly output across verticals. Refine ICP targeting and messaging based on results and feedback from Sales and GMs. Lock qualification criteria and handoff rules, and document 1–2 outbound plays (targeting, messaging, sequence, talk track) that can be reused.

90 days: Scale what works + make pipeline predictable

Scale the highest-performing outbound plays while improving meeting quality (fewer bad-fit meetings). Improve conversion (meeting → opportunity) and show rates. Deliver a simple 90-day retro with what worked, what did not, and the next 1–2 experiments to run, plus any enablement/tooling gaps needed to hit pipeline goals.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - High-agency, self-motivated, and outgoing — and eager to drive business outcomes early in your career.

 - Excited to help shape a growing, still-nascent go-to-market motion and discover where you can have the greatest impact — and where that impact leads you next

 - Ready to learn from leaders who have built startups before and helped scale Protege’s revenue more than 200x in two years.

 - Generate net-new pipeline through high-volume, high-quality outbound prospecting, and consistently convert outreach into qualified meetings.

 - Track record of building and executing a focused account plan, including tight ICP targeting, crisp prioritization, and disciplined follow-through.

 - Demonstrated or equivalent skill qualifying complex B2B opportunities, including mapping stakeholders, clarifying use cases, and identifying clear next steps and disqualifiers early.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical or nuanced offerings into simple, compelling outreach that resonates with busy buyers.

 - Operational rigor in CRM and pipeline management, including clean activity logging, accurate stage hygiene, and weekly reporting on what is working and what is not.

 - Prior experience in BDR, sales, or partnerships is a plus, but not required.

 - You may bring experience in management or strategy consulting, private equity, venture capital, or finance—and a willingness to bet on yourself and grow alongside a rapidly scaling business.


PROTEGE VALUES

Pass the Loved Ones’ Test

We act with integrity and do the right thing — especially when it’s hard and no one is watching.

Always Find a Way

We are resourceful, resilient builders who solve hard problems and push through obstacles.

Go Fast and Grow Fast

Velocity matters. We move with urgency, learn quickly, and continuously improve as individuals and as a company.

Practice Kindness and Candor

We communicate directly and respectfully, building trust through honest feedback and genuine care for one another.

Deliver Together

We win as one team. Collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership drive our success.

Own the Outcome. Hone the Craft.

We take pride in our work, sweat the details, and continuously raise the bar for excellence.

jobs.title: Bridge Inspector
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an experienced Bridge Inspector to support our growing Construction Management team in Texas. This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned bridge inspection professional to play an important role in maintaining the safety, reliability, and long-term performance of transportation infrastructure throughout Texas and other states in the area. The successful candidate will support bridge and bridge-class culvert inspection programs, working with TxDOT and other state and local transportation agencies to evaluate structural conditions, identify deterioration, document deficiencies, and recommend appropriate preservation and repair strategies.

In this role, you will perform routine National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS) inspections, assess bridge conditions, identify and communicate critical findings, and support the development of follow-up actions (FUAs) to address deficiencies and potential safety concerns. You will be responsible for evaluating inspection results, reviewing technical reports, checking as-built documentation, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions regarding bridge maintenance, rehabilitation, and preservation. Your ability to recognize structural deterioration, evaluate bridge condition scores, and track changes in asset conditions over time will be essential to helping our clients prioritize maintenance needs and extend the service life of their infrastructure.

Safety is a critical component of this position. You will be expected to follow established safety protocols, comply with applicable OSHA standards, properly set up and utilize inspection equipment, and maintain safe working conditions while performing field inspections. This is a field-oriented position offering the opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of bridge infrastructure projects throughout Texas and surrounding states. The role requires regular travel to project sites, including overnight travel, and provides an opportunity to collaborate with experienced bridge engineers, inspectors, and construction management professionals while supporting critical transportation infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform routine NBIS inspections of highway bridges and bridge-class culverts in accordance with applicable federal, state, and agency inspection requirements.
• Conduct detailed field assessments to evaluate structural conditions, identify deficiencies, document bridge deterioration, and determine the overall condition and performance of bridge components.
• Identify, document, and communicate critical findings, including developing and tracking Follow-Up Actions (FUAs) to ensure identified deficiencies receive appropriate attention and resolution.
• Support bridge condition assessments and preservation programs by evaluating inspection results, monitoring bridge condition scores, and tracking changes in structural conditions over time.
• Review bridge inspection reports for technical accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with NBIS, TxDOT, and other applicable DOT standards and procedures.
• Evaluate existing bridge documentation, construction plans, and as-built drawings to verify structural details, identify discrepancies, and support accurate bridge assessments.
• Recommend appropriate maintenance, preservation, rehabilitation, and repair strategies based on observed conditions, inspection findings, and anticipated deterioration.
• Monitor and document deterioration trends, identifying bridges and bridge-class culverts that may require additional evaluation, maintenance, or corrective action.
• Coordinate with TxDOT personnel, other DOT representatives, local agencies, and project teams to communicate inspection findings, discuss critical deficiencies, and support bridge maintenance and preservation decisions.
• Assist with bridge assessment activities, including reviewing available structural information, evaluating inspection histories, and supporting recommendations for continued service or additional investigation.
• Maintain accurate inspection records, photographs, field notes, condition assessments, and supporting documentation in accordance with applicable agency requirements.
• Follow established safety protocols and OSHA standards while performing field inspections, including proper equipment setup, use of required personal protective equipment (PPE), and maintaining safe working conditions for inspection personnel and the public.
• Travel throughout Texas and surrounding states to perform bridge inspections and field assessments, including overnight travel as required by project assignments.

Minimum Requirements

• High School + 6 Years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.

Preferred Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience performing routine NBIS inspections of highway bridges and bridge-class culverts, including evaluating structural components, identifying deficiencies, documenting deterioration, and assigning condition assessments.
• TxDOT Precertification 6.1.1 – Bridge Inspection Team Leader.
• Completion of the NHI Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges national training course.
• Experience identifying, documenting, and managing critical findings and Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), including coordinating with transportation agencies to ensure deficiencies are appropriately addressed and tracked.
• Working knowledge of TxDOT bridge inspection procedures, standards, and reporting requirements, with additional experience supporting other state DOTs, local transportation agencies, or municipal bridge inspection programs.
• Experience with bridge preservation, condition assessment, and asset management activities, including monitoring and tracking bridge condition scores, evaluating deterioration trends, and recommending maintenance, rehabilitation, and repair strategies.
• Demonstrated ability to review bridge inspection reports, construction plans, and as-built drawings for accuracy and completeness, identifying discrepancies and potential concerns that may affect structural condition or long-term performance.
• Ability and willingness to travel regularly throughout Texas and other surrounding states, including overnight travel, to support bridge inspection assignments, field assessments, and client project requirements.

• This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship

jobs.title: RICE Object Developer/Oracle Database Administrator (System Programmer)
jobs.description:
Coho Technology Solutions is seeking a highly skilled remote RICE Object Developer / Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to support the maintenance, sustainment, enhancement, and database administration of the Commercial Asset Visibility Air Force (CAV AF) system. This position combines Oracle application development and database administration responsibilities, supporting mission-critical Air Force logistics operations.

The successful candidate will develop, modify, and maintain Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, and Extensions (RICE) objects while also performing Oracle database administration, performance tuning, data management, and database security activities. This role requires expertise in Oracle technologies, software development, database administration, systems integration, and production support.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to)

• Application Development & Sustainment Maintain, update, and enhance legacy system application code, software, and release documentation. Develop and modify RICE objects to implement system updates, enhancements, interfaces, reports, and fixes. Resolve Discrepancy Reports (DRs) and System Change Requests (SCRs) to improve system performance and functionality. Deliver Technical Solutions and Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimates for system modifications. Conduct and support Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), and Test Readiness Reviews (TRR). Monitor application logs, identify system issues, and perform ongoing reviews to ensure system stability. Support the integration of system changes provided by external organizations. Ensure compliance with security, configuration management, and software development best practices. Work collaboratively with business analysts, testers, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and government stakeholders. Provide technical documentation, user guides, training materials, and end-user support as required. Develop, maintain, and optimize Oracle database objects including tables, views, indexes, stored procedures, packages, triggers, and PL/SQL code. Design and maintain logical and physical data models supporting application enhancements and business requirements. Configure, administer, and maintain Oracle database environments supporting development, test, staging, and production systems. Monitor database performance and conduct tuning activities to optimize system efficiency and reliability. Analyze and resolve database bottlenecks, locking issues, deadlocks, and performance degradation. Develop and implement indexing strategies, query optimization techniques, and database performance improvements. Support database upgrades, patching, configuration management, and software installations. Coordinate and support database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery activities. Manage database imports, exports, migrations, and data transformation efforts. Maintain database integrity, availability, and security in accordance with government requirements. Implement and maintain database security controls, user account administration, role-based access controls, and auditing mechanisms. Support interface development and integration activities involving Oracle databases and external systems.

• Security & Compliance Ensure compliance with cybersecurity requirements, security controls, and configuration management processes. Support vulnerability remediation, security patching, and compliance activities. Participate in system accreditation, audits, and Authority to Operate (ATO) support activities. Assist with implementation of secure coding and database administration best practices.

Essential Job Qualifications:

• Clearance:

• Requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

• Education and Certifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, or related technical discipline

• Equivalent combination of education, technical certifications, and relevant experience may be considered

• Security + certification or equivalent required

• Experience: 3+ years of software development experience with a focus on Oracle application development and RICE object development Strong proficiency in Oracle PL/SQL, Forms, Reports, Workflow, Packages, Procedures, and Triggers Experience designing, developing, testing, and implementing Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, and Extensions (RICE) Strong understanding of Oracle relational database architecture and administration Experience developing and maintaining logical and physical data models Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and database scripting Experience with Oracle Database 12c, 19c, or newer versions Experience supporting multiple software releases annually, including testing, deployment, and sustainment activities Experience with database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis Experience with database import/export processes, data migration, and change management activities Knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery methodologies including RMAN and Oracle Data Guard. Experience with Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) and database monitoring tools Strong understanding of software versioning, configuration management, and release management processes Knowledge of solutions integration methodologies and system interfaces Experience implementing database security controls, user administration, and role-based access controls Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• Desired Skills / Qualifications Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), Air Force, or federal government systems. Experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) environments Knowledge of Air Force logistics, supply chain, maintenance, or asset visibility systems Experience with ETL processes, database replication, and enterprise data migrations Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, or CI/CD methodologies Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) requirements and cybersecurity compliance initiatives Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), Oracle DBA, or Oracle Developer certifications preferred Experience supporting mission-critical production environments with high availability requirements

jobs.title: Director of Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Director of Supply Chain, Heavy Metal (VCS) to join our leadership team in Baltimore, MD. In this role, you will be the end-to-end supply chain owner for the Virginia-class submarine supermodule program, architecting and executing the procurement, sourcing, and material flow strategies required to fuel the Baltimore shipyard. You will build and lead a high-performing team across strategic sourcing, subcontracts, procurement, material planning, and supplier quality, while working in lockstep with VCS Program Operations, Shipyard Construction, and Manufacturing Engineering. This role requires deep commercial acumen, command of heavy industrial and defense manufacturing supply bases, fluency in FAR/DFARS and EVMS-driven program controls, and a relentless bias for operational de-risking. If you are an aggressive, mission-focused operator who thrives in the yard as much as the boardroom and wants to fundamentally transform how naval vessels are built for the U.S. Navy, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Architect and execute the overarching supply chain and industrial base strategy for VCS supermodule construction, scaling the operation into a multi-billion-dollar annual production engine.

• Recruit, build, and lead an elite, yard-integrated supply chain organization spanning strategic sourcing, subcontracts management, procurement, and supplier quality engineering.

• Establish and secure resilient supply pipelines for specialized heavy naval commodities, including structural steels, heavy forgings, precision castings, complex piping systems, and submarine-grade electro-mechanical hardware.

• Partner closely with VCS Program Operations to integrate procurement commitments directly into the program master schedule and Earned Value Management System (EVMS) baselines.

• Drive aggressive risk-mitigation initiatives to eliminate single-source dependencies, secure critical long-lead raw materials, and resolve supplier capacity bottlenecks before they impact shipyard throughput.

• Lead the negotiation of high-value subcontracts, master service agreements (MSAs), and strategic partnership frameworks in strict compliance with U.S. Government procurement regulations.

• Collaborate with Heavy Metal Digital and Manufacturing Technology teams to establish real-time, digital material tracking from supplier facilities all the way into supermodule production bays.

• Maintain active, high-level interfaces with key external stakeholders—including the U.S. Navy, prime shipyard partners, and defense industrial base suppliers—to ensure programmatic alignment and transparent execution.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of progressive supply chain, subcontracts, or strategic sourcing experience within heavy industrial manufacturing, defense shipbuilding, or aerospace programs.

• 5+ years of direct people-management experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing supply chain teams in demanding, high-growth environments.

• Demonstrated track record of negotiating and managing high-dollar defense subcontracts and complex agreements under FAR/DFARS regulations.

• Extensive experience managing long-lead raw materials, structural hardware, and heavy component manufacturing pipelines.

• Strong practical understanding of Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS) and how supply chain performance impacts schedule and cost variances (SV/CV).

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• Willing and able to be based full-time on-site in Baltimore, MD, with regular travel to Costa Mesa, CA, and key vendor sites.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Direct experience supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding programs (e.g., Virginia-class, Columbia-class, or surface combatants) and familiarity with NAVSEA technical requirements and quality standards.

• Experience standing up greenfield supply chain operations or leading the transition from facility standup into full-rate serial production.

• Familiarity with nuclear/subsea defense supply networks and rigorous quality frameworks (e.g., SUBSAFE-adjacent quality control standards).

• Advanced degree (MS, MBA) or industry credentials (e.g., APICS CSCP, CPIM, CPSM).

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director of Services Operations
jobs.description:
About Apollo

Apollo Information Systems is a cybersecurity services company delivering comprehensive security and compliance programs to organizations that need measurable protection without the burden of building it alone. Backed by a Series A investment led by Syn Ventures, Apollo is pioneering a cybersecurity-as-a-service model that replaces fragmented tools and episodic engagements with unified, outcome-driven security programs.

Through Apollo Aegis - a subscription-based cybersecurity and compliance platform - and a full portfolio of managed security, advisory, assessment, incident response, and offensive security services, Apollo helps organizations reduce risk, simplify operations, and maintain continuous compliance. Apollo's primary markets include state and local government, K-12 and higher education, and mid-market enterprises, with deep specialization in election security.



Our Culture

We are growing rapidly and have significant expansion plans and growth capital. We foster a collaborative environment where deep cybersecurity expertise meets business acumen, enabling our professionals to solve complex security challenges while building lasting client partnerships. We pride ourselves on our integrity and ethics. You’ll find smart, professional, mission-driven, hardworking, genuinely kind and good colleagues here. We primarily work remotely but have a hub in Denver.

Position Overview:

The Director of Services Operations is the operational leader supporting Apollo’s Services Delivery organization. This role turns strategic priorities into practical operating systems, scalable processes, trusted reporting, and measurable improvements across the Services department. The Director partners closely with the VP, Services Delivery to improve delivery consistency, visibility, capacity planning, and commercial execution.

This leader owns a portfolio of operational initiatives and a recurring monthly and quarterly reporting cadence. They will establish clear metric definitions, strengthen project-level financial and resource visibility, streamline the path from scoping to delivery kickoff, and lead responsible adoption of AI-enabled workflows. Success requires strong cross-functional influence and the ability to make complex operational data clear, actionable, and useful to executives and delivery leaders.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead cross-functional services operations projects from scope through implementation; communicate progress, risks, and outcomes to the VP, Services Delivery.

 - Develop repeatable service offerings, including standard scopes, deliverables, staffing models, templates, and delivery playbooks.

 - Improve processes and systems that support services delivery, including PSA, time tracking, CRM, project management, reporting, and handoffs.

 - Establish operating standards, templates, and quality checkpoints that improve delivery consistency across service lines.

 - Build and maintain capacity, utilization, and forward-allocation models by role and service line; identify staffing risks and inform workforce planning.

 - Implement and manage project-level reporting for budget-to-actual performance, delivery costs, margin, milestones, backlog, and forecasted services income.

 - Produce monthly and quarterly operating reviews covering utilization, margin, revenue forecast, delivery health, backlog-to-capacity fit, and key operational risks.

 - Streamline SOW and change-order workflows by providing templates, effort models, approval processes, and tools that reduce cycle time and rework.

 - Partner with Finance to align time capture, billing milestones, margin reporting, and delivery-based revenue forecasting; Finance retains ownership of revenue recognition.

 - Identify, pilot, and scale AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency, and knowledge reuse in services operations.

 - Identify and implement AI use cases that improve speed, consistency, and knowledge reuse.

 - Partner with IT to establish appropriate AI tooling, client-data handling practices, governance, and adoption measures.

 - Maintain a single, trusted set of operating metrics and definitions for Services Delivery leadership and executive reporting.



Qualifications

 - Required
   
   - Seven or more years of experience in services operations, delivery operations, PMO, practice management, or related functions.
   
   - Five or more years leading cross-functional programs, operational initiatives, or process-improvement efforts.
   
   - Experience supporting a technology services, cybersecurity services, managed services, consulting, or advisory organization.
   
   - Working knowledge of professional services, advisory, PMO, engineering, managed services, or SOC operating models.
   
   - Demonstrated experience with project-based accounting, utilization reporting, resource management, capacity planning, forecasting, and margin analysis.
   
   - Experience developing executive-level operating reports and translating data into clear recommendations.
   
   - Experience improving SOW, proposal, scoping, intake, or delivery-kickoff processes in partnership with Sales, Finance, and Delivery teams.
   
   - Practical experience using AI tools to improve workflows, reporting, documentation, automation, or operational consistency.
   
   - Strong analytical skills and proficiency with spreadsheets, business-intelligence tools, CRM, project-management, and reporting systems.

 - Preferred
   
   - Experience in cybersecurity managed services, including work with state, local, education, or other public-sector customers.
   
   - Experience productizing professional or managed services into defined offerings and delivery playbooks.
   
   - Familiarity with AI workflow automation, prompt design, agents, or AI-enabled operational tooling.
   
   - Experience with services pricing, rate cards, and fixed-fee and time-and-materials delivery models.
   
   - Experience with systems such as Salesforce, CloudCoach, Power BI, PSA platforms, or comparable services-operations tools.

Expectations:

 - At 30 days:
   
   - Build relationships with Services Delivery leaders, Finance, IT, and executive stakeholders.
   
   - Assess current systems, reports, workflows, data sources, and operational pain points.
   
   - Document the existing SOW-to-delivery process and baseline utilization, capacity, margin, and reporting practices.
   
   - Align with the VP, Services Delivery on initial priorities and core metric definitions.

 - Within 60 days:
   
   - Deliver an initial monthly operating review covering utilization, project margin, and services revenue forecast.
   
   - Establish a maintained capacity model and forward-allocation view.
   
   - Prioritize SOW improvements, service-productization opportunities, data-governance needs, and initial AI use cases.
   
   - Define an operations roadmap with measurable milestones.

 - By 90 days:
   
   - Operate a reliable monthly reporting cadence using agreed metric definitions and a trusted source of truth.
   
   - Deliver the first quarterly operating review, including workforce-planning and capacity recommendations.
   
   - Launch an initial SOW workflow or automation improvement and pilot at least one AI use case.
   
   - Present a 12-month services-operations improvement roadmap to the VP, Services Delivery.



Company Values

We have created a fantastic corporate culture – our values drive our behaviors. Here are the expectations:

 - Passion for cybersecurity and a commitment to maintaining the highest standards of security.

 - Customer Outcomes: Their success is our success, we are business partners

 - Entrepreneurial Approach: fast decision making, empowerment, focus on results, test and learn

 - Win Together: Intense Collaboration, no silos

 - Integrity is paramount

Why You'll Love Working Here

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, the company covers 100% of employee premiums and 90% of dependent premiums on base plans

 - Unlimited PTO, 7 paid sick days, and 11 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with 4% company match after 90 days, immediately vested

 - Company‑paid life insurance at 1x annual salary

 - Company‑paid Short‑Term Disability (STD) and Long‑Term Disability (LTD) coverage

 - $125 monthly home‑office tech stipend for internet, equipment, and other technology needs

 - Amazing colleagues, a collaborative environment, and a supportive, growth‑focused culture



Apollo-IS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Apollo-IS provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
