jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

As our Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you'll build and run Savvy's deployment bench: a team of forward deployed engineers who go into the firms and advisor teams we partner with and make Savvy work inside their world.

You'll lead a bench of engineers with different strengths, from moving large datasets with AI to building integrations using Savvy’s harness to solving deep technical problems that only a single customer has. As new customers come on, you'll match the right people to the work, keep deployments moving, and make sure what we deliver holds up. You'll be a hands-on leader who grows engineers quickly and sets the standard for how we show up for customers.

Because this is a new function, you'll also help shape how it runs: how the team is structured, how work gets staffed, and how we handle the moments when something goes wrong.

This role is part engineering manager and part solutions engineering manager. It's different from our product EM roles: your success is measured by how quickly and reliably customers get value from Savvy, and by the strength of the bench you build.

All of this is only possible at scale with intense use of AI through your own work, and by extension, the team you build.




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

 - Build the bench
   
   - Hire and develop an early-career-leaning team of forward deployed engineers with complementary strengths.
   
   - Coach scrappy, curious engineers through stretch assignments, direct feedback, and a high bar for technical and customer excellence.

 - Deploy the bench
   
   - Partner with Forward Deployed PMs on customer intake, then staff each engagement with the right engineers.
   
   - Own delivery across concurrent deployments, staying hands-on enough to review code and debug the hard problems.

 - Own escalations
   
   - Build the guardrails (testing, reviews, approval checks) that keep customer data and accounts safe.

 - Scale the function
   
   - Build the playbooks, templates, and tooling that make each deployment faster than the last.
   
   - Feed field learnings back to Product and Engineering so repeated customer needs become product capabilities.





MUST HAVE:

 - You have 6+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions or sales engineering, or technical consulting (including meaningful customer-facing delivery work)

 - You have 2+ years managing or leading engineers, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining a strong team.

 - You use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) day to day and are excited to build a team that does the same; bonus if you’ve built your own software factory.

 - You've been a strong IC in this kind of work yourself, such as an FDE, solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or customer-facing product engineer, and you can still go deep technically.

 - You've owned end-to-end delivery across several customer engagements at once.

 - You have hands-on experience with data migrations and system integrations (AI now writes all of this, but you need to be familiar with the concepts).

 - You stay calm under pressure, own mistakes openly, and communicate clearly with everyone from junior engineers to frustrated customer stakeholders.

 - You thrive in ambiguity and have helped build a team, process, or function that didn't exist before.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in fintech, wealth management, or another regulated, high-trust industry, such as custodial integrations, account transfers, or financial data.

 - Experience building playbooks, internal tooling, or onboarding systems that outlasted your time on the team.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

jobs.title: Director, Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy Wealth is seeking its first dedicated revenue accounting leader. In this position, you will drive revenue accounting operations, accounts receivable accounting, and financial reporting processes for a high growth fintech company ,Registered Investment Advisor (“RIA”) and broker-dealer.

You will design processes and policies, build the Campfire revenue module ensuring accurate revenue recognition, managing complex A/R processes and revenue share payments, and enhancing month-end close operations. The ideal candidate brings deep technical accounting expertise, leadership capabilities, and thrives in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment.



HOW WE WORK: AN AI-NATIVE FINANCE TEAM

Our Finance team is small, and we run like a much bigger one because of how we use AI.



We build most of our own tools. Payout engines, reconciliation workflows, reporting, and agents that handle recurring analysis were built by people on this team. When we do buy software, we choose finance platforms built around AI and automation, not legacy systems with AI added on.

We expect everyone to work this way. When a problem shows up, your first move should be asking how AI can solve it, and you should know when the output needs a human check before money moves.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Manage daily revenue accounting operations, including high-volume transaction processing, and ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC 606 for a RIA and broker-dealer

 - Own the month-end revenue close process by preparing revenue journal entries and revenue account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables

 - Manage comprehensive accounts receivable accounting functions, including custodian cash application, A/R reconciliations, and aging analysis

 - Ensure accurate commission calculations and recognition under US GAAP

 - Lead quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326

 - Ensure compliance with SEC and FINRA rules and reporting

 - Perform regular month-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue, commissions, and accounts receivable balances to ensure financial integrity and provide insights for management decision-making

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, RevOps, Sales, Legal, and other business partners on strategic processes and programs

 - Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including design, implementation, testing, and optimization

 - Serve as subject matter expert for revenue and A/R accounting questions across the organization

 - Lead audit coordination and serve as primary contact for external auditors during year-end audit

 - Maintain comprehensive documentation for all revenue, commissions and A/R processes




MUST HAVE:

 - CPA with a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance (or equivalent experience)

 - 8+ years of accounting experience, with at least 3 years in financial services industry

 - Direct experience at a wealth management firm, RIA or broker-dealer

 - You understand AUM fee billing, custodian cash flows and revenue share payout models

 - Strong knowledge of ASC 606 Revenue from Contracts with Customers & ASC 326 Credit Impairment

 - Experience with custodian cash application, accounts receivable accounting and financial reporting

 - Proficiency with mainstream ERP systems and revenue engines such as Netsuite, Campfire, Orion, AdvicePay, etc.

 - Experience in collaborating across departments to influence change

 - Attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and strong sense of teamwork

 - Ability to work independently and prioritize in a fast-paced environment

 - Strong sense of ownership and independence, with proven ability to identify issues, propose solutions, and drive initiatives to completion with minimal supervision
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in a growing fintech business, preferably in startup or high-growth environments

 - Experience with SEC/FINRA regulated entities

 - Passion for data integrity, comfort with large datasets, and enjoyment of solving complex problems

 - Exceptional business acumen with ability to translate complex financial concepts into actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

THE ROLE:

Savvy is looking for a Director of Advisor Onboarding to own and scale how wealth management practices move their businesses onto Savvy. When an advisor joins us, they're moving everything: their team, their clients, their systems, and the way they've run their practice for years. This leader makes that move fast, predictable, and something advisors feel great about.

Advisor Onboarding owns the advisor's journey from signature until they’ve established their practice at Savvy. The Director leads the team that runs this end to end: managing every workstream of the move, keeping the advisor confident and bought in, and enabling them and their team to work the Savvy way. For enterprise teams, the work looks a lot like a consulting deployment: learn how the business ran before, then map it onto Savvy.

This role reports to the Head of Advisor Success and partners closely with Growth, Product, Operations, Compliance,Client Experience, and IT. It's ideal for a senior operator who has run onboarding or deployment through hypergrowth, brings a consultative and commercial mindset, and has a strong executive presence with demanding customers.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own and lead the Advisor Onboarding function, including hiring, training, performance management, and org design for a rapidly scaling team.

 - Build and run distinct onboarding motions for enterprise teams and emerging advisors, with clear segmentation, staffing models, and playbooks for each.

 - Build an enterprise deployment playbook: discovery of how each team runs today, mapping their workflows and roles onto Savvy, and a tailored plan to get them live.

 - Own advisor enablement so advisors and their teams are confident in Savvy's tools and ways of working by the time they hand off to Client Experience.

 - Act as program lead across every workstream of a transition, coordinating Client Transition Specialists, Operations, Compliance, and IT to hit one plan and one date.

 - Own onboarding KPIs and OKRs, including time to start date, time to assets transitioned, onboarding CSAT, signed-not-started rate, and enablement completion.

 - Build a capacity model tied to the Growth forecast so the team is staffed ahead of volume.

 - Partner with Growth on late-stage enterprise deals: join recruiting meetings, scope deployment complexity before signing, and set expectations the team can deliver.

 - Design and own the handoffs from Growth into Onboarding and from Onboarding into Client Experience.

 - Own the team’s AI and automation stack: build the workflows, agents, and tools that cut manual work from onboarding.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for high-stakes onboardings and fix the underlying process behind each one.
   


MUST HAVE:

 - 8 to 12+ years in onboarding, implementation, deployment, consulting, or business operations, with 4+ years leading teams in a high-growth environment.

 - Proven experience building and scaling an onboarding or deployment program through rapid growth (2x+ volume), including managing managers.

 - Experience moving customers' whole operations onto a new platform: learning how their business runs, redesigning their workflows, and driving adoption.

 - Experience running both enterprise (high-touch, complex) and mid-market (repeatable, volume) motions.

 - Strong program management across many parallel workstreams and teams you don't directly manage.

 - Sales acumen: has partnered with Sales on late-stage deals and is comfortable presenting to and managing senior, demanding customers.

 - Track record designing enablement and change management for experienced professionals.

 - Tech-forward operator with a track record of using automation and AI to improve speed and quality.

 - Excellent communication, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Wealth management experience, especially advisor transitions (RIA, broker-dealer, wirehouse).

 - Experience at a recruiting-driven platform (wealth, real estate brokerage, healthcare practice platforms, PE-backed rollups).

 - Management consulting or implementation consulting background.

 - Experience leading or partnering on AI-enabled onboarding or service transformations.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Savvy Wealth is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.

#LI-CM1

Responsible for both the design, development and implementation of short- and long-term solutions to information technology (IT) needs through new and existing applications, systems architecture, network systems and applications infrastructure and the management of the IT infrastructure within an organization.

Conducts a wide range of quality control tests and analyses to ensure that software meets or exceeds specified standards and end user requirements | Performs quality assurance and testing in an environment that typically uses state-of-the-art software applications testing processes (i.e., testing "clean room") but may also include manual QA/Testing | Drafts, revises and approves test plans and scripts to ensure alignment with standards and IT strategy | Creates test data files with valid and invalid records to thoroughly test program logic and verify system flow | Collaborates with users to plan user acceptance testing, alpha and beta testing | Ensures that system tests are successfully completed and documented and all problems are resolved | May develop, revise and approve quality assurance and testing policies, standards and procedure

jobs.title: Channel Sales Director, Farm & Fleet
jobs.description:
We’re leading the way in redefining the workwear category. Our mission is to engineer better boots and apparel for our country’s tradesmen and women by working directly with real workers to learn what they actually need to execute their jobs.

The BRUNT team is not only devoted to improving on the old workwear standards, but we’re also creating a community that tradesmen and women can call their own. From our weekly hangouts at the BRUNT Garage, to hosting events across the country, we’re all about getting boots on the ground and building something real with the BRUNT crew.

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for a sharp, commercial leader to own and grow BRUNT Workwear’s business within our Farm & Fleet accounts. This role is for a strategic, forward-thinking builder who pairs deep wholesale acumen with a relational approach moving seamlessly from high-level channel strategy to building trusted partnerships with buyers and retail executives alike in this unique retail landscape.

Serving as the face of the brand to our largest partners, you will be a key internal partner to our Product, Supply Chain, and Marketing teams, ensuring the voice of the retailer is integrated into critical business decisions. You will own the strategic direction of this vital segment from roadmap to execution, leveraging a disciplined forecasting model to drive profitable, sustainable revenue. The ideal candidate is equal parts visionary strategist and hands-on leader who knows how apparel and footwear move through retail, managing seasonal buying cycles with precision while mentoring a high-performing team of Key Account Managers.

How You’ll Do It:

Execution & Delivery

• Deliver annual revenue, gross margin, and market share targets for the Independent Channel with an accurate, disciplined forecast.

• Build and run joint business plans with top accounts covering assortment, pricing, promotional calendars, inventory commitments, and growth initiatives.

• Lead annual line reviews, program agreements, and vendor compliance requirements.

• Lead, coach, and develop Key Account Managers on your team

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as executive sponsor for our key partners, building relationships at the buyer, merchant, DMM/GMM, and C-suite levels.

• Work with Product and Merchandising to shape seasonal line plans around customer feedback and sell-through.

• Partner with Supply Chain, Partner Services, and Logistics on on-time, in-full delivery, fill rates, and EDI and routing guide compliance.

• Align with Marketing on retail programs, in-store merchandising, sell-in tools, and co-branded campaigns.

• Partner with Finance on pricing, margin analysis, and credit terms.

Strategy Insights & Innovation

• Develop a multi-year channel strategy for both segments, including account prioritization and white-space analysis.

• Use POS, sell-through, inventory, and margin data to uncover growth opportunities and fix underperforming accounts.

• Bring customer and market insights back to product teams.

Measurement & Accountability

• Own year-over-year net revenue growth, gross margin, and forecast accuracy against plan.

• Track sell-through and inventory turn within all accounts.

• Hold forecast accuracy, customer fill rate, and compliance scores to defined standards.

• Report out performance and insights to Senior Leadership on a regular cadence.

• Measure team retention, engagement, and development.

What You Need to Succeed:

• 10+ years of wholesale or channel sales experience in workwear, apparel, footwear, outdoor, or a related consumer goods category.

• 5+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing a team.

• Proven track record of growing Farm & Fleet accounts, with measurable revenue and margin results.

• Established relationships with buyers within Independent Work Retailers

• Strong negotiation skills and experience structuring wholesale programs, trade terms, and joint business plans.

• Financial acumen across margin, trade spend, and P&L management.

• Proficiency with CRM, ERP, and analytics tools, and comfort working with POS and sell-through data.

• Executive presence, with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to lead and develop teams, collaborate across functions, and stay accountable in a seasonal, fast-moving business.

• Willingness to travel approximately 50%

In accordance with applicable salary transparency laws, we are providing the good-faith salary range for this position. This range reflects the base salary that we reasonably expect to pay for this position at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will depend on factors such as qualifications, experience, skills, and budget.

Benefits & Perks:

• Healthcare: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

• Retirement: 401(k) plan with Company Match.

• Paid Time Off: 15 days of PTO, plus 11 paid holidays and sick leave.

• Incentives: Performance-based bonus eligibility and Equity if applicable.

The anticipated salary range for this role is:

Compensation

$150,000—$180,000 USD

No matter what experience you have within our industry we encourage you to apply. At BRUNT, we believe that a strong crew is assembled with people from different backgrounds.

We look for individuals who thrive on challenges, will be passionate about our brand, and believe that teamwork is necessary for success. Show us how your experiences have shaped you and how you can contribute to BRUNT. We can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Paralegal, Global Employment & Immigration Legal
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. For more than 25 years, our development teams have created some of the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful entertainment experiences, captivating and engaging audiences around the world. We are incredibly proud of our ability to deliver consistently the highest-quality titles, as well as our colleagues who help to create our unique culture and work environment that is inclusive, diverse, and dynamic.

While our offices are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge:

The selected candidate will serve as a Senior Paralegal for the Global Employment & Immigration Legal team in the Take-Two offices in New York City supporting Take-Two and its publishing labels.  Candidate must possess critical thinking skills and strong business acumen, and be extremely organized, great at independently managing projects, proactive in driving projects forward, and able to engage in complex work, including drafting and reviewing legal documents and managing various employment-related matters in partnership with counsel. The selected candidate will also provide day-to-day administrative and paralegal services to the Global Employment & Immigration Legal team at a dynamic entertainment company.  The role provides broad exposure to Take-Two’s activities and offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, collegial, and engaging environment.

This role will serve as a critical member of the Global Employment & Immigration Legal team, providing strategic paralegal support for substantive and complex legal matters, including threatened and actual litigation, employee relations investigations and follow-up, and restructurings, and will be primarily responsible for organizing and maintaining key records, filings, templates, and other materials for such matters as well as any pending immigration cases.  Candidate will at times work collaboratively with the larger Take-Two Legal team and other stakeholders, and will also work in a fast-paced, autonomous environment with the ability to implement efficient processes and procedures.  Candidate will strive to utilize technology and workflows in order to increase efficiency.

What You’ll Take On:

• Organize, prepare, and track separation agreements based on contract templates and update such templates when needed.

• Build and maintain comprehensive database for employment- and immigration-related templates, such as offer letters, non-disclosure agreements, and various other employee notices.

• Analyze employee outside activities/employment disclosures and liaise with business partners for conflicts assessment.

• Own the process for updating and distributing revised employee handbooks on an annual basis.

• Analyze data for restructuring actions and prepare legal notices and related paperwork / communications.

• Draft and finalize litigation hold memos in connection with threatened or actual litigation.

• Summarize case documents and prepare chronologies and related work product for threatened or actual litigation.

• Support the maintenance of accurate immigration data and tracking and planning systems.

• Participate in the planning, selection, implementation and training of key technology resources for the Employment Legal team, including enhancements and upgrades to such systems.

• Prepare materials for and assist with Global Employment & Immigration Legal training initiatives and programs.

• Identify, and collaborate with the wider team to implement processes and procedures for document management, litigation hold tracking, outside interest disclosures, and other tasks to bring about more efficiency and innovation within the Global Employment & Immigration Legal team.

What You Bring:

• Six or more years of experience as a paralegal or similar role in relevant field (Employment, Employee Relations, Human Resources, etc.).

• Ability to work with document management software, such as iManage, Google Drive, or similar systems.

• Must be tech-savvy, with a grasp of AI legal offerings or a proven ability to quickly learn new software applications, including AI software such as Gemini, Harvey, and similar tools.

• Demonstrated ability over your career to handle progressively more complex tasks, with a commensurate demonstrated rise in business judgment.

• High energy, positive attitude, and urgency to “get stuff done”.

• College degree.

• Strong academic background and excellent critical thinking skills.

• Must possess common sense, patience, good humor, and a commitment to teamwork.

• Strong administrative problem-solving skills and time management skills.

• Excellent attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills and thorough follow-up.

• Takes ownership of projects, shows initiative and commitment to drive matters to completion.

• Team-player who can multi-task and work well under pressure, with constantly changing priorities.

• Professionally interface with all levels of the organization, clients and vendors.

• Knowledge of and enthusiasm for the videogame industry.

• Proficient with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

(“T2”) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization.  Employment at T2 is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Advisor Experience Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an operationally strong, customer-obsessed professional to join our Advisor Experience team. As an Advisor Experience Manager, you’ll partner closely with financial advisors and cross-functional teams to ensure advisors have the support, training, and tools they need to succeed on Savvy’s platform. You’ll be a key contributor in driving advisor satisfaction, product adoption, and long-term retention and expansion, while shaping how Savvy scales its advisor-facing experience.

This role offers significant exposure to cross-functional teams including Product, Operations, Growth, and Marketing, and provides an opportunity to influence strategic priorities based on advisor insights.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of Savvy advisors, ensuring they feel supported and successful on the platform

 - Partner with the Head of Advisor Experience to drive advisor engagement, retention, and satisfaction

 - Champion Savvy’s value proposition and clearly communicate the impact of our software, services, and financial products

 - Drive key advisor-facing KPIs, including platform adoption, product utilization, retention and expansion

 - Identify churn risk and proactively develop plans to mitigate it

 - Build and maintain a strong feedback loop with advisors; serve as the voice of the advisor to internal teams

 - Collaborate with Sales to ensure smooth handoffs and a high-impact onboarding experience

 - Design and deliver ongoing training, programming, and enablement to help advisors become power users

 - Balance multiple initiatives while adapting quickly as priorities evolve

 - Continuously improve processes and workflows to support scale without sacrificing quality




MUST HAVE:

 - 3–5+ years of experience in customer experience, advisor experience, account management, client engagement, or sales enablement

 - Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior advisors confidently and empathetically

 - Experience onboarding, training, or enabling customers to adopt software or services

 - A customer-first mindset with strong ownership and follow-through

 - Proficiency using AI tools to scale advisor engagement and synthesize feedback

 - Ability to prioritize, multitask, and operate effectively in a fast-growing environment

 - Comfort learning and adopting new tools and technologies quickly




NICE TO HAVE:

jobs.description:
Title: Customer Service Representative

Job Description:

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world? And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality, hustle and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team are valued for their differences, and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be apart of, what are you waiting for? Apply!

​

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Customer Service Representative (CSR) you are often the first person to welcome and interface with Domino’s customers. You must be at least 16 years of age

Must pass a Criminal Background Check

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer – Structural Simulation & Analysis
jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

Apptronik is seeking a Mechanical Engineer – Structural Simulation to support the structural integrity, mass optimization, and dynamic performance of our humanoid robot, Apollo. In this role, you will contribute to simulation efforts that help move designs from concept to validated hardware while reducing the need for extensive physical prototyping.

You will use FEA and related tools to support analysis of physics challenges such as impact dynamics, fatigue in high-DOF joints, and multi-body dynamics. You’ll work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams, learning how system-level behaviors connect to the physical capabilities of the robot’s structure.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

• Simulation Workflows: Contribute to the development and documentation of simulation workflows and methodologies across the team.

• Early-Stage Analysis: Support the integration of simulation into early design decisions by running studies and sharing results with design engineers.

• Modeling Standards: Follow and help refine team standards for modeling (materials, boundary conditions, safety factors).

• Non-Linear & Dynamic FEA: Assist with non-linear and dynamic simulations (e.g., robot falls, extreme events) under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Fatigue & Life Prediction: Support fatigue life analyses and contribute to the evaluation of life prediction methods.

• Mass Optimization: Contribute to mass optimization efforts by running design studies that balance stiffness, durability, and weight targets.

• Test/Sim Correlation: Participate in test and simulation correlation activities, helping compare results to test data so models become more predictive over time.

• Material Characterization: Assist with material characterization efforts, including data collection and model inputs for advanced materials.

• Collaboration & Learning: Work with senior engineers to grow your technical depth, and participate in technical design reviews.

• Cross-Disciplinary Support: Collaborate with mechanical, controls, and test teams to help identify and resolve physics-related design issues, and contribute simulation inputs to trade studies.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

• Software: Working knowledge of industry-standard simulation tools (e.g., Ansys, Abaqus, SimCenter).

• Physics Fundamentals: Strong grounding in solid mechanics, with exposure to vibration (shock and modal analysis), heat transfer, and multi-body dynamics.

• Humanoid Context (preferred): Exposure to high-speed moving mechanisms or lightweight structures for mobile platforms.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

• Experience: 4-6 years of experience in structural simulation and/or mechanical design, preferably on electromechanical products (robotics, aerospace, or automotive). Internship, co-op, or graduate research experience will be considered.

• Education: BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Coursework or research in computational mechanics is a plus.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

• Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

• Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen

• Hearing and speech to communicate

*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer

LiteLLM is the world’s most popular open-source AI Gateway, used by Adobe, Netflix, NASA, NVIDIA and much of the Fortune 500. Every LLM call these companies make runs through our code, so when we break, they break. We’re a team of about 20, and we’re hiring senior and staff backend engineers to own the core of the gateway and keep it fast and reliable as traffic grows.

About the role

You’ll own critical parts of the LiteLLM proxy: routing, auth, caching, spend tracking, guardrails and observability. The job is to make these systems correct, fast and dependable at 1B+ requests a month. That means hunting down silent failures, fixing the root cause in code rather than adding another dashboard, and refactoring components that keep breaking without changing how they behave. You’ll set the bar for how our mostly early-career team writes, tests and ships backend code.

What you’ll do

 - Own core proxy components end to end, from design through production, including the incidents

 - Find and remove whole classes of bugs, like race conditions, stale cache state across replicas, and errors that get silently swallowed instead of shown to users

 - Make sure every guardrail and policy check (e.g. apply_guardrail) is logged, traceable and fails loudly when it should

 - Build guardrails that run inside the gateway and block common attacks on LLM APIs, MCP servers and agents

 - Keep our observability integrations (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) accurate at 1B+ requests a month, with minimal latency overhead and no memory leaks (e.g. from Prometheus metric cardinality)

 - Help migrate performance-critical paths from Python to Rust without breaking behavior

 - Raise the bar for the team on code review, testing and debugging

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years building backend systems in production, with real ownership of something mission-critical: payments, gateways, core APIs, data stores, or anything else where downtime hurts customers

 - Strong Python, and experience with async or high-throughput services (asyncio, FastAPI or similar)

 - A track record of making production systems more reliable through code: refactors, re-architectures, migrations, or fixing a root cause for good

 - An excellent debugger across services, databases (Postgres, Redis) and distributed systems

 - High ownership, meaning you take responsibility for the customer impact of what you ship

 - BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent proof you’re exceptional

Nice to have

 - Rust, Go or C++ in production

 - Time at a fast-growing startup with a large, real codebase

 - Experience with LLM APIs, proxies or API gateways

 - Open-source contributions

Why LiteLLM

 - Your code runs in the critical path for some of the biggest companies in the world

 - Real ownership of core systems on a small, senior-leaning team

 - Profitable, growing fast, backed by Kleiner Perkins

 - $250-$350k base + equity, health, dental and vision. Onsite in San Francisco.

About LiteLLM

LiteLLM https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm is a Python SDK and proxy server for calling 100+ LLM APIs in the OpenAI format, with 60K+ GitHub stars.

jobs.title: Agent Engineer, Pre-sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.



About the Role: 

Designs, builds and improves what the GTM Agent does to create pipeline, from the first signal about a prospect to a booked meeting. Owns the software and agents behind outbound on every channel: inbound lead follow-up, prospecting, multi-channel sequences, email deliverability, calling and the quality of every message the agent writes, with people deciding what goes out. Serves Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), Account Executives (AEs), their managers and Marketing.

The goal of the role is business impact for those teams: more positive replies, more meetings booked and more qualified pipeline for every dollar spent. Additionally, this role has a communication and evangelizing component: showing the teams it serves what works, and sharing content and open source projects with our developer community.

This role suits an engineer who has already built agents or software for outbound and prospecting, such as sequencing, email deliverability, dialing or AI-written outreach.




YOU WILL:

 - Spends time with SDRs, AEs and their managers to find the prospecting work they repeat that the agent can take over.

 - Designs, builds and improves the agent's outbound workflows: what starts each run, what the agent reads and decides, what it drafts, and what waits for a rep's approval.

 - Builds the agentic system that follows up every inbound lead within minutes: it qualifies the lead, researches the person and the account, and drafts a first touch for the owner the routing rules assign.

 - Builds and improves the system that runs Marketing's outbound plays and campaigns for every rep, from the target list to the first touch.

 - Builds the software and agentic system behind multi-channel sequences, which combine email, LinkedIn and calls, choose each next touch from what the prospect did, and stop when the prospect replies on any channel.

 - Builds the email sending and deliverability system: sending domains and mailboxes, warm-up, daily limits, address checks, bounces, opt-outs and inbox placement across mail providers.

 - Builds the calling software reps use: call lists, dialing and the research a rep reads before each call.

 - Owns the quality of what the agent writes, so every message fits the prospect's signal, their history with us and the right product, and uses how much reps edit each message and the replies it gets to find what to fix.

 - Builds the safeguards that keep prospects from getting duplicate or overlapping outreach, and the sync that logs every email, LinkedIn action and call in Salesforce.

 - Builds experiments that test messages, channels, timing and sequences against held-out groups, measures which ones book meetings, and fixes or removes what doesn't.

 - Writes evals for every feature shipped, and ships each feature with its scorecard row.

 - Shows reps and their managers what works, and shares it through blog posts, webinars and open source.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 - AI-Native Developer: You have a deep understanding of the LLM stack: prompting, retrieval (RAG), cognitive architectures, and agentic loops. You have likely already built with LangChain or LangGraph.

 - Engineering Foundation: You are a strong software engineer (typically 3+ years) with at least 1 year of experience specifically shipping LLM systems in production.

 - Self-Directed "Founder" Mentality: You don't need a ticket to tell you what to fix. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying high-impact problems, and driving them to completion autonomously.

 - Full-Stack Capability: Strong coding skills in Python or TypeScript (ideally both) and the ability to build end-to-end applications.

 - Customer-Centric: You enjoy the intersection of high-level engineering and direct customer impact. You can translate a customer's technical pain point into a scalable system architecture.

Nice to Haves:

 - Expertise with LangSmith for evaluation and monitoring.

 - Experience building or maintaining open-source projects.

 - A background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or high-growth GTM teams.

Compensation:

 - Salary: $160K - $180K




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD SUPPLIER QUALITY SPECIALIST (SPACEXSI)

SpaceX is seeking a Lead Supplier Quality Specialist for the Superintelligence program. You will lead supplier quality for process gas, power plant consumables, electrical spares, and cooling spares. You will decide which suppliers are fit to ship, what gets inspected, and how nonconformances are closed so bad material does not reach the plant.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead supplier quality for process gas, power plant consumables, electrical spares, and cooling spares used by Superintelligence operations

• Build and develop supplier quality specialists and set the standard for source inspection, receiving inspection, and supplier corrective action

• Qualify and audit suppliers of industrial gas, turbine and plant consumables, electrical equipment, and cooling equipment before they are on the approved list

• Define inspection plans, certificates, and hold points for critical spares, including electrical equipment and pressure-boundary or rotating-equipment parts

• Own supplier nonconformances from containment through root cause and verified corrective action

• Review mill certs, certificates of conformance, gas analyses, and test reports and reject paperwork that does not match the purchase order

• Place source inspection where the risk is at the supplier, and dock or receiving inspection where the risk is at the site

• Partner with sourcing on supplier selection and with planning so quality holds are visible before maintenance counts on the part

• Trend supplier escapes, receiving rejects, and repeat issues, and remove suppliers who do not improve

• Support operations when installed material is suspect, including quarantine, field inspection, and supplier containment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience in engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, or quality; or 5+ years of experience in engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, or quality

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 10+ years in supplier quality for power generation, electrical equipment, industrial gas, or HVAC and process cooling

• Experience with gas certificates of analysis, lubricant and chemical specifications, or high-voltage and medium-voltage equipment test reports

• Experience with first-article or source inspection of pumps, valves, heat exchangers, switchgear, breakers, or turbine parts

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and of common power-industry quality requirements, including material traceability and certificate review

• Experience with 8D, 5-Why, or equivalent structured root-cause methods

• Experience in an SAP, Oracle, or other quality and nonconformance system

• Willingness to stop a shipment or a receipt when the objective evidence is not there

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work onsite

• Must be available for extended hours and weekends when a quality escape or a receipt hold is blocking operations

• 50% travel to supplier facilities to audit and to witness inspection and test

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Leesburg, VA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match: $165000-$220000

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 10 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Accounting & Payroll
jobs.description:
The role / impact

At Xero, our purpose is to supercharge small businesses by making them more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology, and empowering a community behind them. As a Senior Solutions Consultant, you will act as a trusted technical expert and strategic advisor on Xero's most complex, high-impact opportunities. Partnering closely with Sales and our accounting and bookkeeping partners, you will translate ambiguous, competing business needs into scalable, future-proof solution architectures and implementation roadmaps. By uncovering root causes rather than surface symptoms, you will shape deal strategies, evaluate technical and workflow trade-offs, and build compelling value cases that help partners adopt better ways of working.

You will guide strategic partners across the full lifecycle—from pre-sales discovery and tailored demonstrations through to data migration strategy, implementation governance, and change enablement. Beyond delivering durable business value and smooth transitions into ongoing customer success, you will help lift the capability of the wider Solutions Consulting team. By coaching peers through intricate engagements and contributing reusable frameworks, playbooks, and best practices, you will turn complex partner implementations into long-term advocacy for the Xero platform.

The team / how they connect

Our Solutions Consulting team bridges technical expertise and commercial strategy to help accounting and bookkeeping practices get the most out of the Xero platform and its wider app ecosystem. Working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, we design integrated solutions and share market insights that shape future product roadmaps. Together, we foster a culture of continuous learning by openly sharing reusable tools, technical standards, and peer mentorship across regions.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

 - Designing integrated, end-to-end solution blueprints across the Xero product suite, practice tools, and key ecosystem applications.

 - Running complex pre-sales discovery workshops and delivering tailored demonstrations that validate future-state workflows for strategic accounting partners.

 - Advising on legacy data migration strategies, risk management, and governance frameworks for multi-phase implementations.

 - Developing reusable technical playbooks and change enablement programmes while sharing structured partner feedback with Product and Engineering teams to inform future roadmap priorities.

Where and how you can work

We embrace a flexible, hybrid way of working that balances remote focus time with purposeful in-person connection. Depending on your location, you will have access to our modern office spaces for team collaboration and regular boost days, alongside the flexibility to work from home and engage with partners virtually.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - Deep domain knowledge of accounting and bookkeeping practice workflows, paired with hands-on familiarity across the Xero product suite, practice tools, and wider app ecosystem.

 - A background in pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical advisory roles where you have designed scalable solution architectures and implementation roadmaps for complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.

 - Practical experience guiding legacy data migrations, assessing technical risks, and establishing clear governance and change enablement plans across multi-phase rollouts.

 - Strong consultative and communication skills, with the confidence to uncover root causes, translate technical concepts into tangible business value, and engage senior stakeholders through workshops and executive presentations.

 - A collaborative mindset with enthusiasm for mentoring colleagues, sharing reusable frameworks, and contributing to team-wide enablement and continuous improvement.

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheck. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role in:

 - $81,000 to $90,000 + commission USD

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ page.

Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.title: Lead Supplier Development Engineer (SpaceXSI)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (SPACEXSI)

SpaceX is seeking a Lead Supplier Development Engineer for the Superintelligence program. You will lead supplier development for one commodity on the supercomputer and data center build: infrastructure (switchgear, busway, power distribution, and rack power), cable and harness, or cooling. You will decide which suppliers are fit to ship, which processes are ready for rate, and how nonconformances get closed.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Build and lead the supplier development engineers for the assigned commodity on SpaceXSI supercomputer and data center hardware

• Set one standard for supplier qualification, first article, production part approval, process control, and corrective action, and hold the team to it

• Work with supply chain, design, reliability, operations, and production so the policy on your commodity is the same from the supplier floor to the site

• Own supplier qualification. Audit the process, the quality system, and the capacity before a supplier is released to ship

• Implement the production part approval process for hardware qualification and approve the pack only when the objective evidence is there

• Read supplier quality and delivery data, find the systemic gap, and put an engineer on the improvement until it is verified

• Run material review, root cause, and 8D with receiving, supplier quality, and the supplier. Contain suspect material in the warehouse and in the hall

• Know how the purchased part goes into the next assembly. Give design for manufacturing feedback while the drawing can still change

• Find the bottleneck, the yield loss, and the rate limiter in the supplier process and remove them

• Set the schedule to bring up a new part or a design change, and track the supplier against that schedule

• Keep receiving inspection, nonconforming material, and traceability tight enough that a rejected part cannot be issued to the build

• Hire, train, and mentor the supplier development engineers on your commodity

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in an engineering, supply chain, or quality role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience in the assigned commodity: data center power and infrastructure, copper or fiber cable and harness, or data center cooling equipment

• Experience leading engineers or owning a supplier commodity through qualification and rate

• Experience with the production part approval process, first article inspection, and structured root cause

• Master's degree in engineering or business

• Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or equivalent process-improvement training

• Experience with capacity modeling, process mapping, and yield or fault analysis

• Hands-on experience with electromechanical manufacturing, including harness build, power equipment, or cooling skids

• For cable and harness: working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 or an equivalent workmanship standard

• For cooling: working knowledge of pumped liquid cooling, heat exchangers, and cleanliness or fluid specifications

• For infrastructure: working knowledge of data center power distribution, from switchgear and busway to rack power

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Position is based in Bastrop, TX, or Memphis, TN, and requires being onsite. Remote work is not considered

• Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends when a supplier, a receipt, or a site install is on the critical path

• Ability to travel 50% to supplier facilities

• Valid driver's license

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Join Vultr

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Part Time) - Leesburg, VA
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®..

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a part-time Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation $20-$49

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.
