jobs.title: Platform Integrity Manager (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PLATFORM INTEGRITY MANAGER (STARLINK)

At SpaceX, we are committed to ensuring the service remains a force for good and sustains trust worldwide: both connecting the unconnected and executing thorough processes to detect and prevent misuse by illicit operators. We are looking for an experienced Platform Integrity Manager, known internally as Customer Integrity & Threat Detection Manager, to detect, disrupt, and investigate potential misuse of the service—including proactively combating and deterring illicit operators. This person must strike the careful balance of safeguarding customer information and privacy while applying enforcement measures and executing with an even-handed approach, avoiding overreach and disproportionate collateral impacts.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Proactively identify and assess platform integrity and abuse risks

• Design and develop solutions to priority risks. Own their deployment and effectiveness in concert with a wide range of stakeholders

• Represent the team in cross-functional groups and in appropriate areas of expertise

• Establish yourself as an expert in 2+ relevant investigative techniques, technologies or abuse prevention strategies

• Reactively investigate potential issues such as scams, fraud, and illicit goods and activities

• Conduct periodic reviews to support legal and compliance obligations

• Execute with consideration for customer privacy, targeting activities of indisputable harm and avoiding overreach

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations; OR 8+ years of professional experience in global affairs, intelligence, or investigations in lieu of a degree

• 6+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), geospatial tools (e.g., ArcGIS), and/or statistical software (e.g., R)

• 6+ years of experience investigating, mitigating, or dealing with illicit operators (e.g., fraud, abuse, cybersecurity, or other illicit activities)

• 3+ years owning and driving improvements in processes, technology, or other business areas to improve customer integrity or related capabilities

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience enabling others, influencing organizational decisions, and building consensus around solutions to challenging problems

• Strong analytical research and communication skills, including excellent written and oral communication skills

• International professional exposure (e.g., working abroad or on global initiatives/businesses)

• Experience in cybersecurity operations, threat detection, or vulnerability assessment in high-stakes environments

• Experience with research and intelligence analytic techniques, including open-source intelligence (OSINT) data techniques

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment in a fast-paced, high-tech environment

• Highly organized with a strong attention to detail

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Familiarity with U.S. and international economic sanctions and export control laws and regulations

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel as needed for business (15%)

• This position is based in Redmond, WA and requires being onsite—remote work not considered

• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: R&D Research Associate
jobs.description:
About Plasmidsaurus

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.



We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.



Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.



Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Plasmidsaurus is hiring a Research Associate to join our R&D team in South San Francisco. You’ll run the experiments that make our RNA-seq products faster to improve and more robust, turning open questions about our workflows into changes our production labs adopt.

You’ll start by running experiments designed by our Scientists and soon be proposing and planning your own. This role is ideal for someone who loves the bench, wants to understand why a protocol works, and wants to see their results show up in products customers use every day.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run the experiments. Execute wet-lab experiments on our RNA-seq workflows, from sample prep through library prep and sequencing.

 - Learn the molecular biology. Build a deep understanding of our RNA-seq protocols and the molecular reactions behind each step. You should be able to think in molecular interactions.

 - Read the data. Analyze results from your experiments and draw clear conclusions about what worked, what didn't and why.

 - Propose what's next. Use those results to suggest and plan new experiments that solve real problems in our workflows.

 - Keep a clean record. Document every experiment in a lab notebook so it can be reproduced, then communicate and present results clearly to the team.

 - Get it into production. Help carry successful results into changes our production labs can adopt.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role means our RNA-seq products get better, faster and more reliable because of the experiments you run.


YOUR FIRST FEW MONTHS

 - You're contributing right away. You efficiently complete several planned experiments, document them in your lab notebook and share clear updates on the results.

 - You know our workflow. You quickly get up to speed and can walk a new teammate through our full RNA-seq protocol and explain the molecular biology behind each step.

 - You're thinking ahead. You analyze your own results and propose new experiments to solve problems in our workflows.

 - You're already making a difference. At least one of your results comes with a recommendation that production has adopted or is evaluating.


YOUR FIRST YEAR

 - We make decisions based on solid data. You own a line of investigation, and you design, run and interpret the experiments behind it.

 - Customers depend on more robust products. Improvements you've helped prove out have been adopted by our production labs.

 - The team understands the chemistry. You're a go-to person for how each step of our protocol works, and you help bring new hires up to speed.

 - We're moving faster. Open questions become tested answers sooner because you run experiments independently and propose your own.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in biology, biochemistry or a related field

 - 1 or 2 years of post-graduate, hands-on wet-lab experience in molecular biology (academic research or industry)

 - Demonstrated research experience, supervised or independent, such as a senior thesis, internship or independent lab project


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working with nucleic acids

 - Experience analyzing experimental data

 - Experience with NGS library prep or sequencing

 - Experience with lab automation or liquid-handling robots




WAYS OF WORKING

 - Build. You're scientifically curious and think in molecular interactions. You want to understand why a protocol works, not just run it.

 - Own. You take responsibility for your experiments from plan to result. Your work is tidy and organized, your lab notebook is reproducible, and your results are visible to the team.

 - Move. You have a bias to action. You plan and follow complex workflows with care, and keep experiments moving so improvements reach production sooner.

 - Participate. You communicate clearly and work closely with the team. You share results early and speak up with ideas for new experiments.

 - Inspire. You raise the bar for the people around you, and you help bring new teammates up to speed on our workflows.

We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly align with the job description as we seek out diverse and creative perspectives. Team members who love to learn and collaborate in an inclusive environment will thrive with us. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please let us know at careers@plasmidsaurus.com. careers@plasmidsaurus.com

jobs.title: Senior EPC Structural Engineer

About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Position Summary:

The Staff EPC Structural Engineer is an advanced-level role within the Engineering, Procurement, & Construction (EPC) function. The role is responsible for structural design of industrial facilities, equipment foundations, and battery energy storage system (BESS) sites. The role independently owns assigned structural scopes from concept design through construction support. Designs are checked through peer review, and the role also checks the work of other engineers and designers. The role determines methods and procedures on new assignments and advises others on complex structural matters. The position coordinates with civil, electrical, mechanical, and process engineers, designers, construction teams, and outside consultants to deliver designs that are code-compliant and constructible. This is a hybrid role with three days per week on-site at Battery Materials Campus (McCarran, NV), Lockheed 2 (Carson City, NV) or SFO campus.

Responsibilities will Include:

• Leads structural design of industrial facilities, equipment foundations, and BESS site structures from concept through issued-for-construction documents, and serves as engineer of record on assigned projects

• Performs structural analysis and calculations for concrete, steel, and other building materials, including equipment anchorage, per IBC, ASCE 7, and applicable material standards

• Prepares and checks structural drawings, specifications, and general notes, and mentors and provides technical direction to engineers and designers

• Resolves construction-phase issues through RFI responses, submittal reviews, and field observations

• Coordinates structural requirements with civil, electrical, mechanical, and process disciplines, geotechnical consultants, and equipment vendors, and influences design decisions across disciplines

• Reviews and directs external design consultants and vendor structural submittals for code compliance, constructability, and schedule

• Develops structural design standards, templates, and procedures, and provides quantities and cost inputs to support estimates

Desired Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering; Master's degree a plus

• 8+ years of structural engineering experience, or 6+ years with a Master's degree

• Professional Engineer (PE) license in any US state, with willingness to apply for Nevada licensure by comity; Structural Engineer (SE) license a plus

• Working knowledge of IBC, ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC 360, AISC 341, and other material standards such as TMS 402 (masonry) and AISI S100 (cold-formed steel)

• Proficiency with RISA or equivalent analysis software, and with Enercalc and Hilti PROFIS for calculations and anchor design

• Working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, and Bluebeam for model review, coordination, and markups · Ability to travel up to 15% of time to project site

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

• Seek Excellence.

• Be Selective To Be Effective.

• Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.

• Disagree Transparently.

• Encourage Independent Decision-Making.

• Build Dream Teams.

About the Galaxy Summer Internship Program

The Galaxy NYC Summer Internship Program is an immersive, nine-week experience taking place on-site in our New York HQ office. During the nine weeks, you will gain hands-on, practical work experience on our the FP&A Team, working on real products and problems alongside the people building them. In addition to learning on the job, Galaxy interns participate in professional development programming, social events, and networking opportunities with senior leaders.

The FP&A team coverage spans all Galaxy segments, including Global Markets, Asset Management & Digital Infrastructure, and Data Centers. We track how each desk is performing, figure out what’s driving the results, and turn the numbers into clear takeaways for business leaders and senior management. As our FP&A intern, you’ll work with the team to analyze the drivers of business performance. You’ll look for trends, explain what’s moving the P&L (profit and loss) and help build the reports and dashboards leadership uses. You’ll learn about a diverse business and how to explain the story behind the numbers.

Program Dates: June 7th – August 6th, 2027

What You'll Do:

• Performance analysis: Analyze business performance by month, quarter and year-to-date. Find the key trends and explain what’s behind them, such as client activity, product mix, or expense changes.

• P&L driver analysis: Help review the daily and month-to-date P&L. Point out the biggest moves and link them to the products, clients, or crypto price changes behind them, such as BTC or ETH.

• KPI trends: Track trading volumes, client activity and how revenue is split across products and regions. Point out what’s growing, what’s slowing and what stands out.

• G&A expense process: Support the monthly G&A expense process by comparing actuals to budget and forecast, following up with cost owners on variances, and summarizing what’s driving changes in spend.

• Dashboards and reporting: Help maintain dashboards and prepare charts and short commentary for management reviews, tying every number back to its source.

• Data quality and automation: Check and clean the data, for example client and region mappings. Find manual steps that could be made faster with Excel, Python, SQL or AI tools.

• Summer project: Own one performance analysis from start to finish, such as a deep dive on one desk or a trend across products. Present your findings to the team at the end of the summer.

What We're Looking For:

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills, strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and comfort working with large datasets.; familiarity with SQL, Python, or BI tools is a plus.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial insights clearly.

• Self-starter attitude with the curiosity to learn and the initiative to take on new challenges.

• Available to work in-person in our New York office during the internship term.

• Curiosity about what drives the numbers, not just what they are, and the ability to sum up a finding in two or three sentences.

• Interest in Digital Assets, Digital Infrastructure, Data Centers, etc.

• Eligible master’s students must have fewer than two years of relevant, full-time work experience

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the department

Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.

About the team

Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.

We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.

About the role

This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:

• AI tools for engineers. Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.
• Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them. Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.

You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems.

You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it.

We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.

You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.

What you'll do

• Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.
• Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.
• Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.
• Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.
• Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.
• Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.

What we're looking for

• 3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.
• 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.
• Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role.
• Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems.
• Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.
• A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.
• Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.

Bonus points

• You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.
• Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.
• Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.
• You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.
• Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

You are interested in…

• Daily Lab Operations: Maintain clean, safe, and functional labs, including shared spaces and tissue culture areas. Perform routine tasks such as autoclaving, freezer defrosting, gas cylinder replacement, incubator maintenance, and servicing Milli-Q water systems and instrument UPS batteries.

• Lab Support: Anticipate scientists' needs, respond to requests, maintain supplies, coordinate pest control, and troubleshoot day-to-day operational issues.

About you:

This role requires someone who works independently, anticipates needs, solves problems, and takes ownership of day-to-day lab operations with minimal supervision.

Meet your Manager:

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join our Core Network Engineering team. You will be joining an established, collaborative group of four engineers (1 Staff Engineer, 1 Senior Network Engineer, 1 Dedicated Wireless/RF Engineer, and 1 Network Engineer).

In this role, you will be a pillar for our core routing, switching, WAN/backbone transport, multi-cloud interconnects, and edge security systems. Rather than building automation frameworks from scratch, you will partner closely with our dedicated Senior Network Automation Engineer to identify programmatic bottlenecks, standardize configurations, and integrate our multi-vendor ecosystem into our automation pipelines.

You will be instrumental in consulting directly with internal business lines—spanning hardware engineering, software development, advanced manufacturing, and flight-test operations—to translate unconventional technical constraints into robust, secure, and multi-tenant network designs. Additionally, you will own the delivery of high-capacity carrier transport (wave circuits, dark fiber), provision multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP), elevate operational observability, mentor junior engineers, and serve as an escalation point for complex Tier-3 network issues.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Design, scale, and maintain resilient campus, datacenter, and field-test networks utilizing both traditional three-tier and EVPN-VXLAN fabric designs across Arista (EOS) and Cisco (Catalyst/Nexus) platforms.

• Architect, scale, and maintain our corporate and datacenter WAN backbone—owning carrier circuit delivery, capacity planning, and turn-up for optical waves, dark fiber, and DIA across colocation and telecom providers.

• Design, provision, and maintain resilient hybrid-cloud transit networks across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Implement and manage dedicated interconnects (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, Google Cloud Interconnect), Transit Gateways/VNet Hubs, dynamic BGP peering, and cloud-native routing architectures.

• Develop scalable network standards, reference architectures, and implementation patterns.

• Participate in architecture reviews and provide technical direction for complex network initiatives.

• Partner with our Senior Network Automation Engineer to drive Network-as-Code workflows—leveraging your foundational knowledge of Python, Nornir, and Jinja2 to define data models, draft templates, and shape API integrations.

• Partner with our dedicated Wireless/RF Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain robust campus-wide and field Wi-Fi deployments leveraging Aruba and Juniper Mist platforms, focusing on enterprise 802.1X/EAP-TLS authentication and client performance optimization.

• Implement, audit, and manage Layer 3–7 security policies, microsegmentation strategies, and site-to-site IPsec tunnels utilizing Palo Alto Networks NGFWs managed globally via Panorama.

• Elevate our telemetry stack beyond traditional SNMP polling. Implement deep-visibility tooling, flow analysis, and streaming telemetry dashboards (Grafana, Prometheus, Syslog) to proactively detect degradation, reduce MTTR, and improve alerting fidelity.

• Act as a final point of technical escalation for critical, intermittent, or high-blast-radius network anomalies. Lead rigorous post-mortem reviews and participate in a shared, multi-engineer Tier-3 on-call rotation.

• Actively support, coach, and level-up junior systems administrators and network engineers across the broader IT and Infrastructure organizations through runbook authoring, architectural reviews, and pairing sessions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, scaling, and maintaining complex multi-vendor enterprise, backbone, and campus production networks.

• Advanced Routing, Switching & Multi-Tenancy:

• Deep operational mastery of BGP (path selection, community manipulation, convergence optimization) and OSPF.

• Demonstrated production experience deploying and troubleshooting EVPN-VXLAN fabrics.

• Proven experience designing multi-tenant network architectures (VRFs, dynamic segmentation, macro- and micro-segmentation).

• Expert-level packet analysis skills (tcpdump, Wireshark) for diagnosing subtle transit failures, MTU/fragmentation mismatches, and asymmetric routing.

• Experience working directly with carriers and telecom providers to scope, order, cross-connect, turn up, and test high-bandwidth transport circuits (10G/100G Waves, dark fiber, DIAs).

• Proven track record provisioning and troubleshooting cloud-native networking components and dedicated connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, GCP Cloud Interconnect, VPC/VNet peering, Transit Gateways).

• Automation Fluency & Collaboration:

• A strong programmatic mindset with the ability to read, review, and write foundational Python.

• Working familiarity with automation ecosystems (Nornir, Jinja2, Netmiko) and REST APIs sufficient to collaborate effectively with dedicated automation software engineers.

• Comfort with Git workflows for managing configuration versions and operational changes.

• Multi-Vendor Hardware Mastery: Expert-level configuration, architecture, and troubleshooting experience across:

• Arista Networks: EOS, CloudVision (CVP), modern spine-and-leaf designs.

• Cisco Systems: Catalyst 9k series (IOS-XE) and Nexus switches (NX-OS).

• Palo Alto Networks: NGFW appliances, Panorama, App-ID, User-ID, and GlobalProtect.

• Enterprise Wireless: (Juniper Mist & Aruba) Mist Cloud, Aruba AirWave/Conductor, ClearPass/RADIUS integration, dynamic packet captures, and high-density 802.1X designs.

• High-Touch Cross-Functional Communication: Exceptional ability to translate non-standard business and physical engineering requirements into pragmatic, resilient network architectures.

• Operational Excellence: Willingness to support a weekly Tier-3 on-call rotation and travel periodically to remote field sites, test facilities, or manufacturing sites when hands-on senior engineering is required.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Senior or Expert-level industry certifications (CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, PCNSE, or Arista ACE).

• Certifications in public cloud networking (e.g., AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty, Azure Network Engineer Associate).

• Experience operating within regulated or compliance-driven environments (e.g., ITAR, EAR, NIST 800-171, CMMC).

• Experience with Network Source-of-Truth platforms (NetBox, Nautobot).

• Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms (Telegraf, InfluxDB, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenConfig/gNMI).

US Salary Range

$127,000—$170,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Collaborate with related engineering teams to investigate data, annotation, infrastructure, and cross-component integration issues.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Mathematics, Informatics, or a closely related field. A foreign equivalent degree is accepted.  Position requires 36 months of experience as a research engineer, machine-learning engineer, or position in a related field of computer vision or machine-learning model development.

At least one year of that experience must have involved developing camera-based perception systems for autonomous vehicles or advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS).

Two years of the required professional experience must have involved developing and evaluating deep-learning-based computer-vision models.

Two years of the required professional experience must have involved designing or conducting machine-learning experiments and evaluating model performance.

Experience with classical computer vision, image processing, object detection, segmentation, and tracking.

Experience developing data-processing, annotation, dataset-generation, training, or validation pipelines for machine learning.

Professional software-development experience in Python and C++.

Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Experience with distributed or large-scale data processing using PySpark or a comparable framework.

Experience with workflow orchestration for data-processing or model-training pipelines using Argo Workflows or a comparable system.

Experience developing in containerized environments using Docker or a comparable technology.

Experience using SQL to query and prepare data for analysis, model training, or evaluation.

Experience with distributed version control using Git or a comparable system.

jobs.title: Events Marketing Manager
jobs.location: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood is hiring an Events Marketing Manager to own the cohesive marketing plans for its growing roster of events. This is an amplification role. You'll take the approved event strategy and build the marketing plan and messaging for each workstream (RSVP, livestream, and post-event) to get people to register or buy tickets, tune in to the livestream, and keep them talking after the event ends. Your plans will cover all the major channels (paid and organic social, email and lifecycle marketing, PR), and you’ll also shape how the brand shows up on-site. This is not an event production or logistics role. Venue, travel, F&B, and on-site operations sit with other members of the Events team. We are looking for someone who thinks in funnels, channels, audiences, and reach, and who is just as comfortable owning a brief as running a daily performance check-in.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

Event Marketing Strategy

• Build the event marketing and amplification plan across 3 core workstreams (RSVP/ticket sales, livestream, and post-event), including goals, audience targeting, messaging hierarchy, asset needs, and channel mix.

• Drive cross-functional alignment on the amplification plan with Channel Leads (Social, Lifecycle Marketing, Comms) and Marketing Leadership); own briefing to Creative team for assets.

• Align with Product Managers on event-related product announcements and promotions, and incorporate into the event marketing plan and keynote.

• Partner with Senior Brand Manager on ticketing/RSVP and pricing approach, and manage the registration types, flows and nurture strategy.

• Collaborate with the Sponsorship Lead to define and execute the sponsor marketing strategy and deliverables included in each sponsor package (social, email, comms, etc).

• Support Program Manager on Legal & Compliance review of marketing assets.

Promotional Plan Execution & Optimization

• Execute the approved marketing plan across all channels with one promotional calendar that covers the full event arc (3 workstreams); ensures all assets go live on schedule and are on message.

• Manage paid social planning and optimization, including budget tracking, platform partner relationships, and in-flight optimization against RSVP, ticket, and livestream tune-in goals.

• Partner with the organic social team and Creative on teaser sequencing, social-first creative, and posting cadence to build momentum and reach.

On-Site Branding & Marketing

• Own the on-site branding strategy along the attendee journey (e.g., signage, branded environments, swag); includes brief creation.

• Build marketing plans for cross-functional on-site activations, such as CX and Research, in partnership with their teams.

Content Capture & Post-Event Promotion

• Build the content pipeline to drive post-event momentum and reach: determine the post-event promotion plan that turns keynotes, sessions, and on-site moments into clips, highlights, and recap content that extends the moment and drives reach after the event ends.

• Partner with the content capture and social teams for the on-site content capture, reviews, and go-live process.

Reporting & Measurement

• Set goals for each workstream and channel (RSVPs and attendance, livestream views and CPV, engagement), benchmarked against prior events.

• Track daily registration counts, cohort conversion, and channel performance to forecast attendance and optimize in flight.

• Own the post-event program report: consolidate channel results against goals and prior events, with key learnings per work stream and attendee survey results (in partnership with Research).

• Lead the marketing retro with channel partners and turn the learnings into recommendations for the next event.

What you bring

• 5+ years of experience in marketing (events, brand, social, or content marketing) within a consumer-facing company; financial services a plus.

• Proven track record of building and executing integrated marketing plans across paid, owned, and earned channels (e.g., paid social, email and lifecycle, PR), with strong organic social expertise and a record of optimizing against performance goals.

• Hands-on experience driving ticket sales, registration, or attendance for events, including promotions, audience targeting, and conversion optimization.

• Proven track record driving awareness and large-scale reach for events or campaigns (e.g., livestream viewership, social and earned reach), with metrics to back it up.

• Experience driving on-site branding and brand activations at events a plus.

• Comfort using data (e.g., registration, campaign performance, and audience insights) to forecast, optimize, and report on results.

• Clear, confident communicator with experience writing briefs and managing creative and agency partners through execution.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives, aligning channel leads and stakeholders around a shared plan, including Legal & Compliance review processes (ideally in a regulated industry).

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong project management skills and the ability to manage complex workflows in a fast-paced environment.

• Self-starter and problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity and adapts quickly as priorities evolve.

• Based in the U.S. (NYC or SF preferred), with travel required for key events throughout the year.

What we offer

• Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.

• Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

• Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.

• Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.

• Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.

• Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.

• Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

• Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. About Procare

For over 30 years, Procare Solutions has been dedicated to empowering early childhood educators by providing products and services that enable them to focus on the care, safety and education of children.  We recognize the responsibility that comes with nurturing and educating children, which is why our child care management solutions are designed to automate business processes, help ensure safety and compliance, communicate with families and provide educational resources and training to help teachers and children thrive.

Over 40,000 satisfied customers have chosen Procare Solutions as their trusted partner in providing exceptional care for young minds.

A Little About the Role

The Associate Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a professional who proactively manages a dedicated portfolio of customers. This role focuses on building strong, long-term relationships with customers by ensuring they achieve maximum value from our solutions. The CSM proactively drives product adoption, increases software and payment processing usage, and ultimately improves key financial metrics like GRR and NRR within their portfolio.

What you’ll do:

• Dynamic Account Management: Proactively engage with a diverse set of customers assigned to you based on their health status or specific needs. You will be the primary point of contact for these accounts until their health improves and they are successfully transitioned.

• Value Realization: Create and execute tailored Customer Success Plans (CSPs) for each account. These plans will outline specific goals, milestones, and metrics for driving product adoption, increasing payment processing, and demonstrating ROI.

• Performance & Health Monitoring: Regularly monitor account health and usage data to identify at-risk customers and opportunities for growth. Take proactive measures to mitigate risks and ensure customer satisfaction.

• Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs): Prepare and deliver impactful QBRs that highlight customer achievements, review key performance indicators (KPIs), and present new opportunities for maximizing value.

• Collaboration & Strategy: Partner with the sales team to ensure a cohesive account strategy. Effectively pass on qualified upsell and cross-sell opportunities to your sales counterpart.

• Product Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of our product suite, new features, and best practices to serve as a trusted advisor to customers.

• Internal Collaboration: Partner with other teams, including Sales, Support, and Product, to address customer requests and ensure a seamless customer journey.

• Case & Inbound Request Management: Efficiently manage and resolve inbound customer inquiries and requests from other teams. You will act as a key resource for the company, addressing a variety of customer needs to ensure a smooth and positive experience.

• Proactive Adoption & Value Realization: Actively work with customers to understand their business goals and pain points. Your focus will be on increasing product adoption and usage, especially for our payment processing solutions, to demonstrate the full value of Procare Solutions.

• Continuous Improvement: Understand how Procare Solutions competes in the marketplace and consistently apply new best practices to help our customers. You will also build an awareness of market trends and competitor activities to better assist your customers.

Our ideal candidate will have:

• Application Knowledge: Proficient in the use of our solutions and able to provide recommendations to customers on optimal use of our products.

• Problem-Solving: Capable of diagnosing customer issues, evaluating solutions, and making well-informed decisions for the benefit of both the customer and Procare Solutions.

• Communication: Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with a customer-centric approach.

• Adaptability: A proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

• Typically requires 1-5 years’ of experience in a customer-facing role, preferably within the SaaS industry.

Physical Requirements:

• This position works most of the time in a fixed office location and may involve sitting and/or standing for prolonged periods

• Frequently required to communicate verbally and in writing (mostly email) with customers, prospects, and other employees

• Use of computer, telephone, and other office equipment for the greater part of the workday

Why Procare?

• HSA option with employer contributions

• 401K Plan with employer match and immediate vesting

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Channel Sales Director, Regional/Specialty Work
jobs.description:
We’re leading the way in redefining the workwear category. Our mission is to engineer better boots and apparel for our country’s tradesmen and women by working directly with real workers to learn what they actually need to execute their jobs.

The BRUNT team is not only devoted to improving on the old workwear standards, but we’re also creating a community that tradesmen and women can call their own. From our weekly hangouts at the BRUNT Garage, to hosting events across the country, we’re all about getting boots on the ground and building something real with the BRUNT crew.

What You’ll Do:

We are looking for a sharp, commercial leader to own and grow BRUNT Workwear’s business within our Regional and Specialty Work accounts. This role is for a strategic, forward-thinking builder who pairs deep wholesale acumen with a relational approach moving seamlessly from high-level channel strategy to building trusted partnerships with buyers and retail executives alike in this highly targeted retail landscape.

Serving as the face of the brand to our largest partners in this segment, you will be a key internal partner to our Product, Supply Chain, and Marketing teams, ensuring the voice of the retailer is integrated into critical business decisions. You will own the strategic direction of this vital segment from roadmap to execution, leveraging a disciplined forecasting model to drive profitable, sustainable revenue. The ideal candidate is equal parts visionary strategist and hands-on leader who knows how apparel and footwear move through retail, managing seasonal buying cycles with precision while mentoring a high-performing team of Key Account Managers.

How You’ll Do It:

Execution & Delivery

• Deliver annual revenue, gross margin, and market share targets for the Independent Channel with an accurate, disciplined forecast.

• Build and run joint business plans with top accounts covering assortment, pricing, promotional calendars, inventory commitments, and growth initiatives.

• Lead annual line reviews, program agreements, and vendor compliance requirements.

• Lead, coach, and develop Key Account Managers on your team

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as executive sponsor for our key partners, building relationships at the buyer, merchant, DMM/GMM, and C-suite levels.

• Work with Product and Merchandising to shape seasonal line plans around customer feedback and sell-through.

• Partner with Supply Chain, Partner Services, and Logistics on on-time, in-full delivery, fill rates, and EDI and routing guide compliance.

• Align with Marketing on retail programs, in-store merchandising, sell-in tools, and co-branded campaigns.

• Partner with Finance on pricing, margin analysis, and credit terms.

Strategy Insights & Innovation

• Develop a multi-year channel strategy for both segments, including account prioritization and white-space analysis.

• Use POS, sell-through, inventory, and margin data to uncover growth opportunities and fix underperforming accounts.

• Bring customer and market insights back to product teams.

Measurement & Accountability

• Own year-over-year net revenue growth, gross margin, and forecast accuracy against plan.

• Track sell-through and inventory turn within all accounts.

• Hold forecast accuracy, customer fill rate, and compliance scores to defined standards.

• Report out performance and insights to Senior Leadership on a regular cadence.

• Measure team retention, engagement, and development.

What You Need to Succeed:

• 10+ years of wholesale or channel sales experience in workwear, apparel, footwear, outdoor, or a related consumer goods category.

• 5+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing a team.

• Proven track record of growing Regional/Specialty Work accounts, with measurable revenue and margin results.

• Established relationships with buyers within Independent Work Retailers

• Strong negotiation skills and experience structuring wholesale programs, trade terms, and joint business plans.

• Financial acumen across margin, trade spend, and P&L management.

• Proficiency with CRM, ERP, and analytics tools, and comfort working with POS and sell-through data.

• Executive presence, with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to lead and develop teams, collaborate across functions, and stay accountable in a seasonal, fast-moving business.

jobs.title: Associate Counsel, Commercial & Legal Operations
jobs.description:
Laurel is on a mission to return time. As the leading AI Time platform for professional services firms, we’re transforming how organizations capture, analyze, and optimize their most valuable resource: time. Our proprietary machine learning technology automates work time capture and connects time data to business outcomes, enabling firms to increase profitability, improve client delivery, and make data-driven strategic decisions. We serve many of the world's largest accounting and law firms, including EY, Aprio, Crowell & Moring, and Frost Brown Todd, and process over 1 billion work activities annually that have never been collected and aggregated before Laurel’s AI Time platform. 



Our team comprises top talent in AI, product development, and engineering—innovative, humble, and forward-thinking professionals committed to redefining productivity in the knowledge economy. We're building solutions that empower workers to deliver twice the value in half the time, giving people more time to be creative and impactful. If you're passionate about transforming how people work and building a lasting company that explores the essence of time itself, we'd love to meet you.




THE OPPORTUNITY



This role starts with legal operations. You will own the function: the templates, playbooks, workflows, tooling, and metrics that let Laurel's legal team support a company that is growing fast, and the steady stream of improvements that make legal easier for the rest of the organization to work with. Laurel already runs on Ironclad, integrated with Salesforce. What we do not yet have is the full build-out for the legal function. That build-out is yours.

If you own how legal work gets done, it follows that you will have a meaningful understanding of the day-to-day. You will work on Laurel's high-volume commercial work: order forms, standard customer edits, NDAs, and the questions that come with them from Go To Market. This is not a role built around marquee negotiations. It is built around the hundred small things that come across a legal team's desk every week, most of which look a lot like the last hundred. You will be the person who handles them quickly, consistently, and well, and who recognizes when something is not routine and brings in the right people rather than forcing it through.

Here is the part that matters most. Most people who work on legal automation will tell you that 80 percent of what a legal team does can be made repeatable and the other 20 percent needs a lawyer every time. We think 80/20 is a starting point, not a ceiling. The 20 percent is not a pile of one-off questions. It is a set of patterns. Your job is to find the pattern, get one clear answer, turn that answer into a rule, and build the rule into the playbook and the tooling so the same question never needs manual intervention again. Do that over and over and 80/20 becomes 90/10, then 95/5. If you are the kind of person who gets a little annoyed every time you have to do the same thing twice, this role was written for you.

Most legal operations roles are built for people who do not practice law. Most junior counsel roles keep you inside the four corners of the contract. This role is intentionally a blend of both. We want someone with legal chops who wants to get into the legal issues, not someone who wants to stay on the operations side of the line, whether you come to this from a law firm, an in-house team, or a legal operations seat. We believe the people who will lead legal functions in five years are the ones who understand the work well enough to do it and well enough to redesign it.

This role reports to Laurel's Associate General Counsel, Commercial and Revenue, and works in close partnership cross-functionally day to day. The legal side of the role is designed to grow: you will start with the repeatable work, and as you demonstrate judgment you will take on more of the substantive questions sitting behind it.



We are looking for someone who wants to help us answer questions such as:

 - What does a commercial contracting process look like when the standard case never touches a lawyer?

 - How do you take a legal process from 80 percent repeatable to 95, and what has to be true to get there?

 - How does a small legal team support a company that is quickly growing in size?



We are not hiring you because you already know how to do all of this. We are hiring you because you are excited enough to learn, work hard, and make a meaningful impact.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



Legal Operations & Systems

This is where you build, and it is the priority. You will own the systems that let a small legal team support a growing company:

 - Owning Ironclad administration: workflow design, templates, approval routing, conditional logic, and reporting, and partnering with Revenue on the Salesforce integration

 - Building and maintaining the commercial playbook, template library, fallback positions, and clause bank, and encoding them into the tooling so the business can self-serve

 - Developing AI-enabled workflows for first-pass review of customer edits, redline summaries, obligation extraction, and knowledge retrieval

 - Working the exceptions: tracking what still escalates to an attorney, finding the patterns in it, getting the legal call made once, and operationalizing that answer as a playbook rule, a template change, or a workflow so it stops escalating

 - Defining and tracking legal team metrics: turnaround time, volume, where deals stall, and where legal time actually goes

 - Building and maintaining the legal knowledge base, FAQs, and training materials so routine questions get answered without a lawyer

 - Evaluating emerging legal technology and AI tools and recommending what Laurel should adopt next
   
   

Commercial & Transactional

You will work on the repeatable commercial work that keeps deals moving, and you will be the one making it more repeatable. Responsibilities include:

 - Owning the order form process end to end: preparing, reviewing, routing for approval, and getting to signature

 - Handling common customer-requested edits to Laurel's standard terms against the playbook, and escalating anything outside it with a recommendation

 - Running the NDA pipeline

 - Serving as the first point of contact for commercial legal questions from Sales and Finance

 - Keeping executed agreements, obligations, and renewals organized, accurate, and findable in Ironclad

 - Supporting the legal team on larger negotiations as needed
   
   

Strategic Projects

You will regularly work on projects beyond a traditional contracts desk. Examples may include:

 - Cross-functional projects where Legal can serve as a model for AI adoption across the company

 - Internal operational improvements for Sales, Finance, and Legal handoffs

 - Projects that put Laurel's own product to work inside the legal function



At Laurel, Legal is expected to be a force multiplier for the business, not only a review function.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You may currently be:

 - An early-career in-house attorney at a SaaS company who has lived inside a CLM and knows what it could be

 - A first- to third-year associate in a commercial, technology transactions, or corporate practice

 - A J.D. who has been working in legal operations, contracts management, or CLM administration and wants a seat closer to the legal work

 - More important than your current title is your trajectory.



You likely possess:

 - 1 to 3 years of experience with commercial contracts, whether at a law firm, in-house, or in a legal operations or contracts seat

 - Admitted to practice in a U.S. jurisdiction

 - Strong drafting fundamentals, the judgment to know what matters in a deal and what does not, and a real appetite for the legal issues behind the contracts

 - A systems mindset: you notice when the same problem keeps showing up and want to fix the process, not just the instance

 - Comfort with technology and a demonstrated interest in AI tools, whether or not you have formal technical training

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, especially with non-lawyers

 - Strong project management and organizational habits

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and a bias toward action

 - High ownership and personal accountability



Bonus points for:

 - Ironclad administration experience, or hands-on experience with another CLM

 - Familiarity with Salesforce and how contracts flow from quote to signature to invoice

 - Experience building prompts, workflows, or automations, in any context

 - Experience with SaaS order forms and standard customer edit requests

 - Experience working with or selling to law firms or accounting firms

 - Familiarity with information security and privacy as they come up in contracting, such as security questionnaires and DPAs

 - An IAPP certification (CIPP or similar) or another privacy or security credential

 - Startup or founder-led company experience




HOW YOU WORK

You are a builder. You enjoy figuring things out before someone hands you a playbook, and then you write the playbook so the next person does not have to.

You think like a lawyer. You take the contract seriously, you know the difference between a real risk and a theoretical one, and you protect the company without slowing it down.

You prefer creating systems over repeatedly solving the same problem.

You learn quickly and seek responsibility. You are energized by difficult problems and comfortable being uncomfortable.

You are willing to question assumptions, including your own.

You care more about learning velocity than credentials.

You believe technology will fundamentally reshape legal work and want to help lead that transformation.

You are excited about learning through proximity, feedback, and direct collaboration. You see working closely with experienced operators as an accelerant to your own development.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER 12 MONTHS

By the end of your first year, you will have:

 - Taken ownership of Laurel's commercial playbook, templates, and fallback positions, and encoded them into Ironclad so the standard case never waits on a lawyer

 - Rebuilt Laurel's Ironclad workflows so that the business can self-serve the majority of order forms and NDAs

 - Built and deployed AI-enabled workflows that measurably cut turnaround time and legal hours per deal

 - Moved the needle on the 20 percent: measurably reduced the share of order forms and customer edits that need an individual attorney, by turning recurring exceptions into playbook rules and automation

 - Established a set of legal metrics that leadership looks at and that drive decisions

 - Helped establish Laurel as a model for what an AI-native legal function can look like

Most importantly, you will have developed capabilities that very few legal professionals possess today: the ability to do the legal work well, to design the systems that work gets done in, and to use AI to do both.




WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

This role is probably not the right fit if:

 - You are primarily seeking a traditional in-house commercial role built around negotiations

 - You want to do legal operations without touching the legal work, or the legal work without touching operations

 - You think "that part is just manual" is an acceptable final answer

 - You prefer highly structured environments with clearly defined responsibilities

 - You are uncomfortable experimenting with new technologies

 - You view AI as a threat rather than an opportunity

 - You are looking for predictable work and limited ambiguity
   
   


WHY LAUREL

Most companies are trying to figure out how AI fits into their workflows. We are trying to redesign the workflows themselves. We believe the legal function should be one of the first places that transformation happens, and we sell to the law firms and accounting firms who are asking the same questions.

If you are excited by the idea of doing the legal work and building the function at the same time, while developing into a highly leveraged, business-minded legal professional, we might have a spot for you.


WHAT LAUREL IS

Laurel is building the system of record for human and agentic work.

The trust Laurel has built with regulated enterprises—and, even more importantly, their end-users— has enabled it to be the first company ever to deploy a multimodal desktop agent at scale (45K+ professionals and 70+ countries). This enables Laurel to collect work that no one else has.

 

Half of enterprise work happens in systems with no API or OS-level access which no tech—other than a multimodal desktop agent—can capture.

Laurel collects more than just metadata; it captures the work itself. And to make the data useful, Laurel builds workflows that requires the professional who did the work to label it accurately, creating a reinforcement learning flywheel that nobody else in the world has.

The result is +2B (and counting) of human-verified labels, creating what is becoming the world’s largest repository of last-mile enterprise data and workflows.

 


HOW LAUREL DID IT

Laurel developed its data infrastructure by creating the AI Billing category in professional services (legal, accounting, consulting). Laurel earned the trust of the enterprise (in the form of +$1B in profit returned) and end-users (in the form of 1.53M work hours returned) to collect all digital work, even work happening in digital systems that were previously invisible to AI.

 

Laurel is now re-running the same playbook in financial services (insurance, banks, private equity, etc). Same data infrastructure. But instead of billing, it is creating the Work Observability category to expand its feedback loop.

 


WHAT’S NEXT

Packaging its last-mile data in the form of:

 - Post-training: an open-source model on Laurel’s data improved performance by 33%, matching the frontier, at 1% of the cost.

 - Context: Feeding this data into a frontier model’s context window improves task automation by 21%.

 - This is how Laurel accelerates its growth from 4x YoY (current) to +10x YoY).
