jobs.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs.description:
Quality Assurance Analyst – Dallas

Location: Dallas, Texas, US | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent (Full-Time)

Shape the future of financial services through quality-driven technology solutions that deliver real impact.

The Role

At Capco, we are a global management and technology consultancy specializing in financial services, energy, and insurance. We partner with clients to deliver innovative solutions, drive digital transformation, and navigate complex business and technology challenges.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst to join our Technology & Engineering practice in Dallas, Texas.

In this role, you will work closely with clients and delivery teams to ensure technology solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and end-user expectations. You will contribute throughout the testing lifecycle, from defining test strategies and developing test cases to executing tests, managing defects, and supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

You will have the opportunity to work on complex technology implementations, collaborate with subject matter experts, and help deliver reliable, high-quality solutions for leading financial institutions.

What You’ll Do

• Develop Test Strategies: Document testing approaches, translate functional requirements into comprehensive test cases, and define scenarios and data variations to validate solution functionality.

• Execute Quality Assurance Testing: Perform smoke, functional, regression, interface, negative, and user acceptance testing across vendor-developed and internally developed applications.

• Manage Defects and Quality: Identify, document, track, and support the resolution of software defects, ensuring alignment with business requirements and end-user expectations.

• Collaborate with Stakeholders: Partner with business analysts, developers, subject matter experts, and clients to refine testing requirements, identify gaps, and coordinate UAT activities.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate testing processes, recommend enhancements, and produce clear documentation, reports, and presentations to communicate findings and improve delivery outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

• Quality Assurance Experience: At least 2 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and requirements validation.

• Testing Methodologies: Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and defect management processes, with experience across multiple testing techniques.

• Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, evaluate requirements, and recommend practical solutions to improve software quality.

• Communication and Collaboration: Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams, manage priorities, and communicate testing outcomes.

• Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points For

• Experience supporting large-scale system implementations, technology transformations, or enterprise application deployments.

• Previous experience working within a management consulting or technology consulting environment.

• Exposure to financial services, banking, insurance, or other regulated industries.

• Experience preparing and facilitating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.

• Familiarity with defect management and test management tools, alongside opportunities to improve existing QA processes.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact technology solutions for leading financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, professional development, and opportunities to build your consulting and technology expertise.

• Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

• Help drive meaningful digital transformation across Financial Services and Energy.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.

AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

• Healthcare Coverage: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance options to support your health and wellbeing.

• Retirement Planning: 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions.

• Family-Friendly Benefits: Maternity and paternity leave, alongside dependent care benefits to support you and your family.

• Financial Wellness: Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options to help manage eligible healthcare and dependent care expenses.

• Continuous Learning: Tuition reimbursement to support ongoing education, professional development, and career growth.

• Wellness Support: Wellness reimbursement to encourage a healthy and balanced lifestyle.

• Commuter Benefits: Commuter benefit options to help manage eligible transportation expenses.

• Employee Discounts: Access to Working Advantage, offering discounts on shopping, entertainment, travel, and other lifestyle experiences.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help.

We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate II
jobs.description:
At Lyell, our vision is to develop curative cell-based immunotherapies for solid tumor cancers. We have innovative science originating from our founder’s world class labs and a unique and disruptive approach to research and development. Our company is first and foremost focused on understanding the science. We are a learning organization, dependent on deep collaborative relationships between all of our colleagues, partners and founders. Our culture is based on Science, Respect, Courage and Collaboration and it reflects who we are and the environment we are creating.

We are recruiting Manufacturing Associates to help operate our cGMP clinical manufacturing site producing plasmids, viral vectors, and autologous cell therapies.  These individuals will work closely with the Process Sciences, Vector Sciences, and Manufacturing Sciences and Technology (MSAT) teams to transfer and execute clinical manufacturing processes, and establish procedures for equipment and manufacturing operations.  The successful candidates will have experience in manufacturing autologous cell therapies, lentiviral vector manufacturing, and/or plasmid production, and have a thorough understanding of the technologies used in these manufacturing operations.

Essential Functions:

• Startup Facility and Operations Work collaboratively with the MSAT, Quality, Process Sciences and Vector Sciences on all aspects of facility qualification and start-up. Support the development of the operating paradigm for GMP cell therapy and viral vector manufacturing operations.

• Execute the Day-to-Day Manufacturing Processing Assist in development and implementation of GMP procedures and policies related to Manufacturing Operations. Execute manufacturing operations safely, as scheduled, and right the first time for delivery of treatment to patients. Maintain production facilities at a high standard of cleanliness and organization, perform equipment maintenance and calibrations as required, and complete and review GMP documentation in a timely manner. Maintain appropriate level of training for assigned responsibilities. Work with TechOps teams to execute technology transfers and capacity building projects. Identify and mitigate risks in the manufacturing areas that could negatively impact the quality of patient therapies.

• Provide Leadership Use strong communication and teamwork skills to build relationships across the manufacturing site. Demonstrate technical acumen, operational understanding, and GMP compliance in managing the manufacturing operations. Support operational excellence initiatives, and the implementation of new technologies and systems. Ensure a strong culture in safety and GMP compliance.

Preferred Experience:

• Years of experience in cGMP biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations, preferably with experience in cell therapy, mammalian cell culture, and/or microbial fermentation:

Associate I: 0-2

Associate II: 2-4

Senior Associate: 4-8

Lead Associate: 8+

• Familiar with regulations for GMP manufacturing of drug substance, drug products, cellular and gene therapies, and viral vectors for clinical phase therapies.

• Experience with quality management systems (e.g. Deviations, CAPAs, Change Management).

Preferred Education:

• A bachelor's degree in biology, biochemistry, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or related scientific field.

Preferred Additional Skills:

• Proven track record in cGMP manufacturing operations, including producing therapies safely and right the first time.

• Fast learner, adaptable, and excellent cross-collaboration and inter-personal skills.

• The desire and ability to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

Physical Requirements

• The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. During higher times of processing these activities may increase up to 4 hours at a time (except for a 15-minute break). Generally, these activities may last for 1-2 hours at a time. While performing their duties, the employee must be able to do the following:

• Repetitive use of arms, wrists, and hands; use of fine motor skills and manipulations both in and out of a BioSafety Cabinet.

• Frequently stand, walk, sit, bend, stretch, and reach with hands and arms. Some overhead reaching and stretching will be required.

• Lift, push, or pull up to 10 lbs; carry materials, tools, products, and samples throughout the cleanroom. Standard lifting, pushing, and pulling would range from ground level to bench height.

• Confirm visual information in the environment such as; batch record and SOP steps were completed properly, parameters on equipment and computer screens, status of materials and equipment, and perform visual inspection of materials and product. A vision test may be required. Use of corrective lenses is acceptable.

• Stand and step over a gowning bench (12-24”) and aseptically don head-to-toe non-sterile and sterile gowns.

Shift Work, Weekend Work, and Holiday Coverage

• Due to the nature of our autologous cell therapies and the need to deliver life-saving treatments to our patients as timely as possible, shift work, weekend work, and holiday work will be required.

• We are looking for passionate team members to join our team that are willing to learn, grow, and evolve with us. Part of this evolution will be to work together to continually assess and modify our shift structure to best support delivering these critical products to our patients.

At Lyell, we believe that highest performing teams include people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences who respectfully challenge each other. We are committed to building an open, diverse and inclusive culture for all employees.
Lyell is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, citizenship status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, age, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristics protected under applicable federal, state and local laws.

We’ve learned from experience that some of the best people don’t always match our requirements perfectly - if you’re interested and think you could fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We’re growing quickly and looking for an experienced, results-driven Mid-Market Account Executive to win new customers for Muck Rack.

This is a dedicated new-business role. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting into new accounts and leading discovery to delivering product demonstrations, navigating buying processes, and closing new business.

We’re looking for a proven B2B SaaS seller with 4–5 years of recent experience as a quota-carrying, new-logo Account Executive. The strongest candidates will have sold sophisticated SaaS products comparable to Muck Rack and will show consistent results, self-sourced pipeline, and sustained tenure in their recent roles.

What we’re looking for

• 4–5 years of recent, quota-carrying Account Executive experience in B2B SaaS, primarily focused on new-logo acquisition

• Recent experience owning the new-business sales cycle, from self-sourced prospecting through contract close; account management, renewals, and expansion should not make up the primary focus of the role

• A record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota, supported by specific performance results

• Experience selling sophisticated, consultative SaaS products comparable to Muck Rack’s media intelligence platform

• Strong self-sourced pipeline generation through outbound prospecting, including cold calling, personalized email, social selling, and strategic account development

• Experience selling to mid-market organizations and navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes

• Strong discovery and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex product capabilities in clear business terms

• Experience engaging Directors, VPs, C-suite executives, and other decision-makers

• Strong pipeline management, territory planning, and forecasting discipline

• Experience using Salesforce and modern sales engagement or prospecting tools

• Interest in using AI and automation to improve sales productivity

Particularly relevant experience

We’re especially interested in candidates who have sold B2B SaaS in areas such as:

• Media intelligence, media monitoring, PR technology, or communications software

• Marketing technology, digital analytics, or brand intelligence

• Social listening, reputation management, or customer intelligence

• Business intelligence, data analytics, or research platforms

• Other sophisticated SaaS platforms with consultative sales cycles and multiple stakeholders

Direct PR industry experience is a plus. Experience with a comparable SaaS product and a clear record of recent new-logo sales is the priority.

Interview Overview

Our anticipated interview process includes:

• 30-minute recruiter screen with our Talent Team

• 60-minute interview with the hiring manager

• Peer interviews with members of our sales organization

• Executive interview

• 30-minute cross-functional Bar-Raiser interview

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

In the US, the starting base salary for this role is $88,000, with on-target earnings of $176,000+.

We typically build 1–3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and corresponding lower commission earnings. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning we pay based on job function and level rather than location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

• Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup

• Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

• Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

• Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.

• Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment

• Standardized bonus or commission structure

• 401(k) with employer contributions

• Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents

• 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans

• 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program

• Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits

• Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

• 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

• 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days

• Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

• Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

• Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

• Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly

• 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

• Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives

• Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

• Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

While we are a fully distributed team, we do have limitations on where we can hire and maintain a list of acceptable working locations based on job function. If we are unable to hire in your current location for the role for which you applied, you will be notified via email. While we enjoy many benefits as a permanently distributed and remote company, we cannot always support relocation or extended travel and have guidelines in place to ensure compliant work away from your designated permanent residence.

Please note: For detailed information regarding our GDPR and/or CCPA compliance policies, including how we handle personal data and privacy rights, kindly refer to the email correspondence accompanying this application.

Muck Rack does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or any other third parties. Any unsolicited resume sent to Muck Rack will be considered Muck Rack property, and Muck Rack will not pay a fee should it hire the subject of any unsolicited resume.

Muck Rack considers applicants for all positions on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs, and without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, alienage or citizenship status, ancestry, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (acquiring, high-risk, russian speaking)
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager (acquiring, high-risk)



Удалённо

Формат:  part-time / full-time
Языки: русский (свободно), английский (B2+)

О компании

Канадский MSB (FINTRAC) развивает международную платёжную инфраструктуру для B2B: payment processing и оркестрация, эквайринг (~30 APM), cross-border payments и payouts, BaaS-интеграции с банками, EMI и PSP, fiat on/off-ramp, OTC и расчёты в стейблкоинах. Рынки: Европа, LatAm, Азия, Канада. Работа строится через банки, платёжные учреждения, крипто-провайдеров и поставщиков ликвидности.

Фокус по клиентам: high-risk, прежде всего licensed iGaming. Компания в составе группы финтех-компаний с действующей инфраструктурой и пилотным портфелем клиентов. Ищем BDM, который будет вести портфель и развивать направление эквайринга самостоятельно.

Обязанности

 - Вести пилотный портфель клиентов как единая точка контакта: объяснять возможности и стоимость продукта, сопровождать онбординг от заявки до запуска.

 - Привлекать новых мерчантов в эквайринг, прежде всего high-risk и iGaming: переговоры, ставки, закрытие сделок.

 - Координировать запросы клиентов с саппортом, комплаенсом и операционной командой: платежи, открытие новых юрлиц, операционные вопросы.

 - Представлять компанию на отраслевых мероприятиях.

 - По мере роста: строить команду продаж и принимать решения по риск-аппетиту клиентов.

Требования

 - Опыт BizDev или продаж в эквайринговой компании или PSP, которая принимает платежи для мерчантов. Опыт в компаниях, выдающих только счета, не подходит.

 - Опыт работы с high-risk мерчантами: iGaming, betting.

 - Понимание экономики эквайринга: MDR, rolling reserve, chargebacks, settlement, платёжные методы и APM.

 - Опыт ведения клиента от первого контакта до запуска и дальнейшего сопровождения.

 - Умение координировать внутренних исполнителей (саппорт, операции, комплаенс).

 - Русский язык, свободно; английский B2+.

 - Готовность перейти на full-time примерно с 4-го месяца, нет конфликта интересов с текущей работой.

Будет плюсом

 - Собственные контакты и опыт в iGaming и high-risk.

 - Опыт с APM в LatAm, Европе, Центральной Азии.

 - Опыт управления небольшой командой.

 - Базовое понимание крипто: стейблкоины, кастодиальные и некастодиальные кошельки, on/off-ramp.

 - Опыт участия в отраслевых конференциях.

Что вы получите

 - Пилотный портфель клиентов и действующая инфраструктура: вы вовлечены в работу с клиентами с первого дня.

 - Самостоятельность: контроль раз в две недели, остальные решения принимаете вы.

 - Revenue share по KPI после испытательного срока.

 - Рост до руководителя направления с ответственностью за продажи и операционку.

 - Гибкий старт: можно начать part-time и совмещать с текущей работой при отсутствии конфликта интересов.



Growth Opportunity



В перспективе роль предполагает переход от Business Development к управлению бизнес-направлением: формирование собственной команды, развитие операционных процессов и принятие стратегических решений.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II, RF Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As an RF Test Engineer, your work will be essential in ensuring that the wireless technologies in Axon's advanced products meet the highest performance, reliability, and compliance standards. Your hands-on expertise will drive the rigorous testing and optimization of RF systems that enable our cutting-edge body-worn cameras, vehicular systems, and connected devices. By leveraging your technical acumen and problem-solving skills, you will be instrumental in identifying and overcoming RF challenges, ensuring robust designs that operate seamlessly in diverse and demanding environments.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and global partners to verify and refine wireless designs, using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. Your work will directly contribute to the development of reliable, high-performance solutions that serve Law Enforcement, Public Safety, and the communities they protect. Through your efforts, you will help deliver transformative technologies that empower public safety professionals and redefine industry standards.

What You’ll Do

• Design and implement test plans to evaluate the performance of wirelessly connected devices, ensuring they meet stringent product and regulatory requirements.

• Record RF test data and organize results, creating clear, actionable reports.

• Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams, enabling swift resolution of design challenges.

• Evaluate RF performance characteristics such as Total Radiated Power (TRP), Total Isotropic Sensitivity (TIS), and other over-the-air (OTA) metrics for cellular-enabled wireless devices using advanced equipment. (CMX500 and CMW500 in controlled chamber environments).

• Use instruments like spectrum analyzers and radio communication testers to assess conducted performance of wireless technologies, including LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GNSS.

• Support product field evaluations to validate RF performance under diverse real-world conditions, such as urban or rural environments

• As part of a collaborative team, investigate and debug issues such as poor sensitivity, low transmit power, or signal interference in wireless devices.

• Assist in the regulatory pre-certification and formal certification test efforts for hardware by preparing test samples, working closely with external test labs, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring successful completion of certification activities.

• Expand your knowledge of RF systems, testing methodologies, and certification standards while working closely with experienced engineers to develop your technical expertise and contribute to innovative designs.

What Your Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering or similar discipline.

• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on embedded RF and wireless device testing experience

• Minimum of 3 years of wireless device test plan development for evaluating performance of various wireless interfaces against system and product requirements

• Solid understanding of basic RF principles and theory, familiar with basic RF technology circuitry stages and topologies.

• Experience characterizing RF components such as filters, switches, passives and signal paths.

• Experience testing modern RF hardware including multiband Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular (LTE, 5G FR1), and multi-constellation GNSS at the circuit, subsystem and device levels. Cellular experience is a must-have.

• High level of familiarity of cellular certification processes, test requirements, and test methods (PTCRB, CTIA, GCF, Carrier testing, etc), with hands on experience with device pretesting

• Familiarity of worldwide EMC and intentional radiator regulatory standards and test methods (FCC, CE, ETSI, etc). Hands on experience a plus.

• Proficient with hands-on operation of RF equipment such as RF communication testers (CMW, CMX, Litepoint), Network Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters, Signal Generators, RF Test chambers

• Experience with collaborative RF debug at device and circuit level

• Familiarity reading electronics schematics, layout and mechanical drawings.

• Strong documentation and communication capabilities to effectively report test procedures, test results, and recommendations to the design team

• Motivated to operate independently, within cross-functional in-house design teams, and with external resources and test facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiar with Linux command line

• Experience with CMWrun test scripting tool

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• And more...

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: Scientist/Senior Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology & DMPK
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA or Remote or Hybrid
jobs.description:
About us:

Braveheart Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) and other serious cardiovascular diseases. Our lead product candidate, BHB-1893, is a next-generation oral small-molecule cardiac myosin inhibitor (CMI) being developed for the treatment of obstructive HCM (oHCM) and non-obstructive HCM (nHCM). Braveheart’s goal is to improve the treatment options for these patients by enhancing speed of onset, depth of gradient response, systolic safety, reversibility and reducing prescribing complexity.

With a proven leadership team, a strong financial foundation, and a high-value late-stage asset, Braveheart Bio represents an outstanding opportunity for ambitious, mission-driven professionals to make a tangible impact in a high-profile and rapidly evolving therapeutic area.

The role:

The Scientist/Senior Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology & DMPK will be the hands-on scientific and operational engine of the clinical pharmacology group, reporting to the Vice President, Clinical Pharmacology & DMPK. You will support Phase 1 clinical pharmacology studies, model-informed dose optimization, and the clinical pharmacology content of global regulatory filings as assets move through clinical development towards registration. You will be a member of a lean, cross-functional development team comprised of representatives from Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Regulatory, CMC and external CROs, and your work will directly shape program strategy and decisions. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to support the nonclinical DMPK-related activities of our drug discovery programs.

Key responsibilities:

Clinical Pharmacology Support

• Collaboratively plan and execute clinical pharmacology or DMPK workstreams to support clinical assets, including the design and execution of Phase 1 clinical pharmacology studies (e.g., SAD/MAD, drug interaction, food effect, QTc, and hepatic/renal impairment studies)

• Provide oversight and guidance for noncompartmental analyses (NCA), population PK, exposure–response, and PK/PD analyses (including relationships with clinically relevant endpoints), working with external modeling and simulation vendors

DMPK and nonclinical support

• Perform NCA PK analyses, interpretation and reporting using Phoenix WinNonlin or equivalent tools

• Integrate nonclinical ADME, toxicokinetic and translational data to inform DDI risk assessment and clinical study design

• Participate in the oversight of bioanalytical CROs for method development, validation, and sample analysis under GLP/GCP

• Review bioanalytical plans, validation reports and sample analysis data for quality and data integrity

Additional Support

• Contribute to building fit-for-purpose processes, SOPs, and templates as the company scales toward registration

• Contribute to abstracts, posters and publications; present at external meetings

• Mentor junior staff or contractors as the team grows

Required experience & skills:

• A PhD or PharmD degree in pharmacokinetics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacology, bioanalytical chemistry, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; or MS degree with 8+ years of relevant industry experience

• Hands-on NCA experience with Phoenix WinNonlin or equivalent software

• Solid understanding of PK/PD, ADME and DDI principles, and how nonclinical data translate to clinical study design

• Working knowledge of ICH, FDA and EMA guidance for clinical pharmacology and bioanalytical method validation, and of GLP/GCP

• Experience working with CROs or external vendors

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several studies at once

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and remain comfortable with change and ambiguity

jobs.title: Lead Cyber AI Engineer
jobs.description:
STR is hiring a Lead Cyber AI Engineer to apply modern AI capabilities—including Large Language Models (LLMs), agents, tool harnesses, and automation—to accelerate reverse engineering, vulnerability research, digital modeling, embedded software development, and cybersecurity analysis of cyber-physical systems.

This role is for an engineer with hands-on low-level cyber experience who can build practical AI-enabled workflows for software, firmware, binaries, embedded systems, and cyber-physical targets. You will join a multidisciplinary team of researchers and engineers developing cutting-edge technologies with significant and immediate impact on national security.

This is not a general AI-product, chatbot, or data-science position. Candidates must have practical experience in one or more cyber disciplines—such as reverse engineering, vulnerability research, firmware analysis, fuzzing, emulation, digital modeling, or embedded software development—and use AI to improve those workflows.

We welcome candidates whose expertise was developed through industry experience, advanced academic research, or a combination of both.

Work must be performed onsite. An Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance is required.

What You’ll Do:

• Develop and apply AI-enabled workflows that accelerate reverse engineering, vulnerability research, firmware analysis, digital modeling, embedded software development, and cyber-physical-system analysis.

• Design and build LLM-based agents, tool harnesses, and research automation for tasks such as binary triage, code and data-flow analysis, protocol reconstruction, documentation, and vulnerability investigation.

• Integrate AI-enabled tooling with disassemblers, decompilers, debuggers, fuzzers, emulators, databases, and custom research platforms.

• Build scripts, plugins, APIs, and automation tools that allow AI workflows to retrieve approved research artifacts, invoke analysis tools, preserve workflow state, and present findings for researcher review.

• Develop skills, tool interfaces, structured outputs, tests, and benchmark datasets that improve the reliability and technical accuracy of AI-assisted workflows.

• Implement safeguards for AI-enabled systems in sensitive environments, including human review, controlled tool execution, audit logging, access control, and reproducible workflows.

• Conduct hands-on reverse engineering, vulnerability research, debugging, firmware analysis, digital modeling, or low-level software development to ensure that AI-enabled capabilities solve real researcher problems.

• Work with cyber researchers, engineers, program leadership, and customers to develop, demonstrate, document, and transition innovative cybersecurity capabilities.

Who You Are:

• This position requires an Active Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is needed by the U.S. Government.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical field, plus 7+ years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. Candidates with a relevant MS or PhD and demonstrated hands-on experience in cyber research, reverse engineering, vulnerability research, embedded systems, digital modeling, or AI-enabled technical tooling are strongly encouraged to apply.

• Hands-on experience in one or more of the following: reverse engineering, binary analysis, vulnerability research, embedded or firmware development, fuzzing, emulation, dynamic analysis, digital modeling, simulation, or cyber-physical-system analysis.

• Proficiency in Python and one or more systems programming languages, such as C or C++.

• Experience using or developing low-level analysis tools, such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, GDB, QEMU, Frida, AFL++, libFuzzer, or equivalent custom tooling.

• Working knowledge of low-level systems and reverse-engineering concepts, including binary formats, memory layout, calling conventions, control flow, data flow, and debugging without source code.

• Experience applying LLMs, agents, AI-assisted automation, or equivalent modern AI capabilities to technical workflows.

• Experience integrating software tools through APIs, command-line interfaces, plugins, scripting interfaces, or custom tool harnesses.

• Strong technical judgment, including an understanding that AI-generated output requires validation, controlled execution, repeatability, and human oversight.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have:

• Experience applying AI to reverse engineering, vulnerability research, malware or firmware analysis, fuzzing, exploitability assessment, or cyber-physical-system security.

• Experience building custom agent harnesses, multi-agent workflows, MCP servers, tool-calling interfaces, or AI integrations with reverse-engineering platforms.

• Experience with LLM structured outputs, function calling, tool use, evaluation, context management, or failure analysis.

• Experience developing custom emulation tools, fuzzing harnesses, reverse-engineering plugins, automated analysis pipelines, or digital models.

• Experience with embedded systems, firmware, IoT devices, industrial-control systems, DSP architectures, or nontraditional processor architectures and operating systems.

• Knowledge of exploit mitigations, operating-system internals, binary emulation, symbolic execution, or dynamic analysis.

• Experience creating evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, observability tools, or tracing systems for AI-enabled workflows.

• Experience with technical proposals, customer demonstrations, CTFs, open-source security tooling, or technical publications.

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $157,000 - $224,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

jobs.description:
Join AIR as a Principal Researcher and use your experience and knowledge to help us deliver on our mission: to generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all. The Principal Researcher will provide senior intellectual and strategic leadership for AIR’s work in career and technical education (CTE) and career pathways, bringing deep subject matter expertise to a growing portfolio of research and evaluation work.

The Principal Researcher will provide leadership across projects, cultivate relationships with clients and partners, and help shape and develop new opportunities in the CTE and career pathways field. Serving as a trusted advisor to clients, collaborators, and multidisciplinary teams, the Principal Researcher will contribute thought leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction while helping strengthen and grow AIR’s CTE and career pathways portfolio.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as a senior subject matter expert on CTE and career pathways, including programs of study, career exploration and navigation, work-based learning, dual enrollment, industry-recognized credentials, career advising, employer engagement, secondary-postsecondary alignment, and transitions into postsecondary education and the workforce.

• Provide strategic direction for AIR’s CTE and career pathways portfolio, helping to identify and shape emerging policy, research, and funding opportunities.

• Provide intellectual and methodological leadership as principal investigator, project director, or senior technical advisor for studies using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, student-level longitudinal administrative data, state longitudinal data systems, and linked education and workforce data.

• Advise clients and project teams on the design, implementation, continuous improvement, and evaluation of CTE and career pathways initiatives.

• Lead business development and capture efforts, including opportunity identification and shaping, development of technical approaches and research designs, partnership and staffing strategies, proposal writing, and client engagement.

• Cultivate and maintain strategic relationships with federal and state agencies, foundations, policymakers, research partners, practitioners, intermediaries, and other leaders in the CTE and career pathways field.

• Represent AIR through conferences, professional networks, publications, webinars, and other thought-leadership activities.

• Recruit, mentor, and develop researchers and project leaders and help build AIR’s organizational capacity in CTE, career pathways, and related research methods.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

• Master’s degree in education, economics, public policy, sociology, statistics, or another relevant social science field, and a minimum of 11 years of relevant applied research experience; PhD preferred.

• Deep professional expertise in CTE and career pathways research, policy, or program implementation.

• Strong expertise in research and evaluation methods and demonstrated ability to provide intellectual and technical leadership for rigorous studies of education policies and programs.

• Proven track record of developing new research opportunities, securing funding, and leading successful proposals or grants.

• Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining senior relationships with government, foundation, research, or practitioner clients and partners.

Skills

• Ability to think strategically, connect CTE research to policy and practice needs, and contribute to the development of a sustainable portfolio of work.

• Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior policymakers, practitioners, researchers, clients, and partners.

• Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, including experience developing researchers and project leaders.

• Commitment to equity, rigor, and innovation in research.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher, Secondary and Postsecondary Pathways
jobs.description:
AIR’s Education Systems and Policy program area is seeking a Quantitative Researcher to contribute to our growing portfolio focused on secondary and postsecondary pathways. The ideal candidate will bring rigorous quantitative skills and knowledge of policies and programs designed to improve students’ transitions from secondary education to college and careers. Areas of particular interest include career and technical education (CTE), work-based learning, dual enrollment and early college, college and career readiness, advanced coursework, postsecondary access and success, and career pathways.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

• Develop research designs and analytic approaches using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, including regression discontinuity, difference-in-differences, comparative interrupted time series, fixed-effects models, and other approaches for causal and descriptive inference.

• Lead analyses of large-scale longitudinal administrative data, including student-, school-, district-, and state-level data.

• Develop analysis plans, data specifications, analytic code, technical documentation, and quality-assurance processes.

• Apply appropriate qualitative and/or quantitative methods to collect, manage, analyze, and interpret data.

• Manage day-to-day project operations and small to mid-sized tasks or project components in roles such as quantitative lead or task lead, including planning timelines, tracking deliverables, and liaising with clients while maintaining positive and collaborative relationships.

• Provide technical guidance, quality review, supervision, and mentorship to researchers and analysts through regular feedback, training, and modeling of research best practices.

• Apply knowledge of state and local education policy, administrative data systems, and implementation contexts to strengthen study design, analysis, and interpretation.

• Contribute to research proposals for federal, state, foundation, and other clients, including capture strategy, technical writing, research design, and partnership development.

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with clients, partners, policymakers, practitioners, and other stakeholders.

• Communicate study progress and findings clearly and effectively through reports, briefs, presentations, visualizations, and other products for technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Contribute to the identification and shaping of new research opportunities related to secondary and postsecondary pathways.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

• PhD in a related field, such as economics, statistics, public policy, public health, human development, political science, psychology, or sociology; or a master’s degree in a related field with a minimum of 4 years of relevant applied research experience.

• Experience working on research or evaluation projects for federal, state, or local agencies or other public or nonprofit entities.

• Demonstrated experience with quantitative research design, data analysis, and reporting.

• Experience applying qualitative and/or mixed methods to support research and evaluation studies, including data collection, analysis, and interpretation.

• Demonstrated knowledge of or experience with secondary and postsecondary education policy.

Skills

• Advanced statistical programming skills using R, Stata, SAS, Python, or comparable software.

• Strong knowledge of experimental and contemporary causal-inference methods.

• Ability to translate technically complex analyses into clear, actionable information for policymakers, practitioners, and other audiences.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in data analysis and report writing.

• Ability to collaborate effectively in a virtual work environment and manage multiple priorities.

• Proven ability to coach junior staff and foster inclusive team dynamics.

jobs.title: Sr Cyber Event Analyst (Shift: 1:45 PM PDT to 10 PM PDT)
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
• Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
• Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
• Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
• Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
• Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
• Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
• Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
• Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
• Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
• Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
• Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
• Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
• Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
• 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
• Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
• Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
• Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
• Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
• Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
• Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
• Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
• Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
• Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
• Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

• Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
• Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
• Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
• Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
• Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
• Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $95,000 - $120,000

We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

For LA County and City Residents Only:  NBCUniversal will consider for employment  qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner  consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive, Hedge Funds
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Strategic Account Executive (Hedge Funds) at Anthropic, you'll join our new Hedge Funds sales team within Enterprise FSI, bringing frontier AI to the world's leading hedge funds: multi-strategy platforms, quantitative and systematic firms, discretionary long/short equity, global macro, and credit funds. These are some of the most technically sophisticated and competitive organizations in financial services, rethinking how they generate ideas, conduct research, build and test strategies, manage risk, and run their operations. They're looking for a partner they trust to take frontier AI from promising experiments into production across research, engineering, and operations.

The ideal candidate is energized by building a new category in a highly competitive industry, identifying high-potential opportunities within each fund and running the strategies to win them. This is a rare opportunity to help shape how the hedge fund industry adopts frontier AI, at a company where safety, trust, and long-term customer outcomes are central to how we sell.

Key responsibilities

• Own a book of strategic, high-value hedge fund accounts, carrying and exceeding an individual revenue target

• Engage personally with founders, C-level, and senior technical stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Heads of Research), building business cases and value narratives, and navigating complex procurement, security, compliance, and legal review through to production deployment and expansion

• Identify and prioritize high-potential opportunities within your accounts, building and executing account plans that turn strategic relationships into committed revenue

• Drive evaluation, deployment, and adoption of Claude within your accounts across research, engineering, and operations, turning early wins into durable, scaled usage

• Run a disciplined pipeline and forecasting cadence: consistent pipeline generation, accurate deal inspection, clear next steps, and predictable, coachable execution across a high-value book of business

• Partner closely with Applied AI, Solutions Architecture, and Product to design solutions, prove value quickly, and represent client requirements on security, deployment, and performance to Product

• Codify winning use cases, proof points, and reference stories from your deals into repeatable, hedge-fund-specific plays, partnering with Marketing and Enablement to help scale them across the broader FSI motion

• Orchestrate cross-functional and partner motions with Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, and cloud partners to deliver a seamless customer experience, and represent Anthropic as a visible, trusted voice with customers and at industry events

Minimum qualifications

• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience, with demonstrated success selling into hedge funds

• A track record of carrying and exceeding quota in enterprise sales of technical, complex products (API-first platforms, cloud infrastructure, data/ML platforms, or enterprise SaaS)

• Experience winning and growing strategic enterprise accounts, including building C-suite relationships, in hedge funds

• Operational rigor across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, balancing velocity with deal quality and forecasting accurately in fast-changing environments

• Credibility with technical buyers and builders (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Heads of Research) and experience pairing effectively with solutions architects and applied AI teams

• A genuine interest in deploying AI responsibly and motivation to advance Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI

Preferred qualifications

• Experience bringing generative AI or LLM-based products, or other emerging platform technologies, to hedge funds

• Deep familiarity with regulated-industry selling: model-risk management, regulatory and compliance-driven procurement, security review, and the governance expectations of financial institutions

• Experience selling with IP protection, security, and vendor risk in mind, including the protection of proprietary strategies and data

• Experience selling with and through cloud and ecosystem partners such as AWS, Google Cloud, and global systems integrators

• Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based commercial models and value-based pricing conversations

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$380,000—$450,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Insurtech Specialty Sales
jobs.description:
About Storable

At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. Powered by AI and three decades of industry data, Storable empowers over 33,000 self-storage facilities with the industry's only fully integrated technology platform. Our end-to-end solutions—from management software and demand generation to CRM tools and delinquency solutions—help storage operators streamline workflows, attract tenants, and grow revenue. Dedicated to empowering self-storage owners and operators, Storable helps you Win More every day. Explore our platform solutions at storable.com.

Overview

Storable is building a quota-bearing Specialist Sales organization to capture growth across all customer segments, with insurance as a core part of that strategy. As Sales Manager, Insurtech Specialty Sales, you'll lead a team of Tenant Insurance and Tenant Protection Plan (TPP) sellers who co-sell alongside SaaS Account Executives across Top 100, Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB operators.

You'll own new insurance revenue, expansion revenue, and your team's forecast. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll coach sellers in active deals, help structure compelling programs, and build a repeatable sales motion that scales. The role is remote and US-based, reports to the VP, Specialist Sales, and partners closely with SaaS Sales, Customer Success, Insurance Implementation, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Enablement.

Success means building a high-performing team that delivers against quota, maintains accurate forecasts, expands insurance adoption within existing accounts, and launches customer programs smoothly.

What you'll do every day

• Own team bookings, quota attainment, and forecast accuracy; call the business within ±10% at the start of each month and within 2% as the month matures.

• Build and coach a new-logo motion for operators that are not yet using a Storable insurance program, including accounts using a competing tenant insurance or protection provider.

• Grow existing insurance revenue by adding facilities, increasing tenant participation, and attaching insurance as customers expand their Storable software footprint.

• Partner with SaaS Account Executives and Sales Managers on joint account plans, clear rules of engagement, and consistent insurance positioning in relevant software opportunities.

• Lead from inside complex deals by joining discovery, presentations, and negotiations, especially with multi-facility and Enterprise operators; structure program economics and administrative-fee terms that work for both the operator and Storable.

• Coach sellers to recommend the right program—Tenant Insurance or TPP—based on the operator's licensing, lease structure, launch timeline, and revenue goals.

• Run a repeatable sales process with clear stage definitions, SPICED, MEDDIC, or equivalent qualification, weekly deal inspection, and clean Salesforce data, including at least 90% next-step coverage and no more than 10% stale opportunities.

• Build quarterly territory and whitespace plans for new logos and expansion, supported by at least 3x pipeline coverage.

• Recruit, ramp, coach, and develop high-performing sellers through regular 1:1s, role-plays, Gong call reviews, and deal clinics; ensure accurate quoting, contracting, and handoffs through implementation and Customer Success.

• Partner with Marketing, Product Marketing, BDR, Revenue Operations, and Enablement to improve pipeline generation, event attribution, reporting, and team productivity through AI and automation.

What you need to bring

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including 2+ years leading a quota-carrying team, or 2+ years leading teams at Storable.

• Experience selling insurance, InsurTech, or another variable-revenue product, with a working understanding of revenue-share or consumption models, program economics, and compliance basics.

• An active P&C producer license, or willingness to obtain one within an agreed timeframe after joining Storable.

• Experience leading specialist or overlay sellers who share accounts with core Account Executives, including experience establishing rules of engagement and shared crediting.

• A record of building teams that achieve at least 100% of quarterly quota and maintaining accurate forecasts.

• Strong SaaS business acumen and experience using Salesforce, Gong, AI tools, and pipeline-inspection practices to coach data-driven teams across SMB through Enterprise segments.

Bonus points

• Experience in self-storage, property management, or vertical SaaS.

• Familiarity with Storable's insurance programs, including Tenant Insurance, TPP, Auto-Protect, and P&C, as well as Storable Edge, SiteLink, or Storable Easy.

• Experience selling to multi-facility and Enterprise operators.

• Experience working in a private-equity-backed or high-growth transformation environment.

• Experience planning and executing trade shows or industry events with measurable pipeline attribution.

Work Authorization

All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Storable is a fully distributed company, but is currently only registered for employment in certain states. To be eligible for employment, you must reside in the following states:  AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.

About Us:

At Storable, we’re redefining property management for specialty real estate. Tailored for the self-storage, marine, and RV & camping industries, we seamlessly integrate management software with marketplace listings, websites, CRM, insurance, payments and more. Dedicated to empowering owners and operators, Storable helps you win more every day. Explore our platform solutions at www.storable.com.

At the heart of Storable is our “Win More” culture, which reflects our commitment to delivering exceptional value to our customers and fostering the personal and professional growth of our employees. We strive to empower our team and our customers to achieve and win more than ever before.

Benefits and Perks:

• Generous health coverage for you and your family, including fully paid short- and long-term disability coverage and two-times base salary life insurance.

• 401(k) match after 60 days, 100% vested after 1 year.

• Employer contribution to your HSA, plus an HRA to help offset your deductible.

• Instant access to flexible vacation. We trust you, so we have a ‘take what you need’ vacation policy.
