jobs.title: Automotive Technician - Post- (1st Shift) Mon. to Fri.  Bonus $8K (A-Level)  $4K (B-Level)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.

• Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

• Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer, FedRAMP
jobs.description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.


ROLE:

SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. We operate a modern, AWS-based environment and support security and compliance programs including FedRAMP, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own and improve the technical security implementation of SentiLink's AWS GovCloud environment. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building, maintaining, and operating security controls—not a compliance or audit-management position.

You'll work across AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, identity and access management, security tooling, vulnerability management, and monitoring. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security Engineering, IT, and our Security & Risk team to turn security and FedRAMP requirements into effective, maintainable implementations. You should be comfortable independently identifying gaps, designing pragmatic solutions, and following through on implementation and ongoing operation.

This is an individual contributor role with meaningful technical ownership and no people-management responsibilities.

This is a U.S.-based role. U.S. citizenship is required to meet applicable government customer and access requirements for the position. Candidates must also be able to satisfy applicable agency personnel-screening and system-access requirements.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Design, implement, maintain, and operate security controls within SentiLink's AWS GovCloud environment, including controls supporting FedRAMP Moderate requirements and continuous monitoring.

 - Engineer and improve cloud security across AWS accounts, IAM, networking, EKS/Kubernetes, Linux workloads, secrets management, logging, and encryption.

 - Define and implement role-based access control and least-privilege access patterns for teams, services, and administrators; partner with IT on identity lifecycle and access provisioning.

 - Develop, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure and security automation using Terraform and GitOps/CI/CD workflows.

 - Own or provide durable technical coverage for security services in GovCloud, including vulnerability scanning and management integrations, dynamic application security testing, security telemetry, and related tooling.

 - Investigate security findings, assess real-world risk, coordinate remediation with the engineering teams that own affected systems, and implement fixes directly for security-owned infrastructure and controls.

 - Improve vulnerability-management operations and technical evidence collection, ensuring findings can be accurately tracked, validated, and reported through FedRAMP processes.

 - Identify gaps in security visibility, monitoring, incident-response readiness, and operational processes; build and implement practical improvements rather than simply maintaining existing controls.

 - Support security incidents, response exercises, technical assessments, and remediation of audit or penetration-testing findings affecting the government environment.

 - Establish clear operational ownership, documentation, runbooks, and backup coverage for critical GovCloud security systems; participate in the security on-call rotation.

 - Collaborate with the Security & Risk team, which owns FedRAMP governance, audit coordination, and POA&M oversight, while Security Engineering owns technical implementation and operational effectiveness.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security engineering, infrastructure security, platform engineering, or a closely related technical role.

 - Strong practical experience designing and securing production systems on AWS, including IAM, VPC networking, logging/monitoring, and security services.

 - Experience deploying and operating cloud infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tools.

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes/container security, Linux security, CI/CD, and modern infrastructure operations.

 - Demonstrated ability to implement and operate technical security controls rather than only assess compliance or provide recommendations.

 - Experience with vulnerability assessment, remediation coordination, security findings, and continuous improvement of security operations.

 - Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and security issues, independently drive projects to completion, and produce clear technical documentation.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with Infrastructure, Engineering, IT, and security compliance stakeholders.

 - Understanding of security principles and frameworks such as NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, SOC 2, or comparable standards, with the ability to connect control requirements to real technical implementations.

 - U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy applicable government customer access and personnel-screening requirements.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Direct experience operating or securing AWS GovCloud systems within a FedRAMP Moderate or comparable government-authorized environment.

 - Experience implementing NIST SP 800-53 technical controls, supporting continuous monitoring, and producing technical evidence for assessors.

 - Experience with AWS Organizations, SCPs, IAM Identity Center, EKS, Kubernetes security tooling, and multi-account cloud environments.

 - Experience operating vulnerability scanners, DAST tooling, cloud posture management, and security logging/detection platforms.

 - Programming or scripting experience in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages to develop useful security automation.

 - Experience with government cloud access models, privileged access, just-in-time access, and identity lifecycle processes.

 - Experience in fintech, identity verification, financial services, or another highly regulated SaaS environment.
   
   


COMPENSATION:

 - $180,000/year - $230,000/year + equity + benefits




PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. As software development accelerates across the company, we're investing in engineers who can both build security capabilities and improve the security of the products we deliver to customers.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Product Security who combines strong software engineering skills with a security mindset. You'll build and operate custom security applications, automation, and integrations; investigate vulnerabilities in our applications and cloud infrastructure; and help engineering teams develop, test, and deliver more secure software.

This role spans software development and hands-on product security. You'll work closely with other product security engineers and the broader Engineering and Infrastructure teams to uncover difficult security problems, develop practical solutions, and drive them through implementation. We're looking for someone who is curious about how systems fail, can navigate complex codebases and architectures, and has the technical range to move between building security tooling and validating the security of customer-facing products.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Design, build, deploy, and maintain custom security applications and services that improve vulnerability discovery, attack-surface visibility, security testing, and remediation workflows.

 - Develop backend services, APIs, data-processing pipelines, integrations, and user interfaces that make security information useful and actionable for engineers.

 - Assess the security of SentiLink's customer-facing products and internal applications through code review, threat modeling, vulnerability research, and hands-on security testing.

 - Perform targeted penetration testing and validate potential vulnerabilities, including reproducing findings, assessing exploitability and impact, and verifying that fixes are effective.

 - Work directly with product engineering teams to investigate and remediate application vulnerabilities, strengthen security-sensitive designs, and implement durable fixes.

 - Develop and improve automated security testing within CI/CD and application delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency and container scanning, and security validation.

 - Build integrations with cloud services, source-control systems, scanners, and other engineering and security platforms; improve the quality and usefulness of vulnerability data and reduce manual operational work.

 - Use AI-assisted development and security analysis tools to accelerate delivery and expand testing coverage, while applying independent technical scrutiny to their output.

 - Take responsibility for the full lifecycle of the systems you build, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, reliability, and ongoing improvement.

 - Collaborate with Security Engineering, Infrastructure, and product teams on security architecture, technical investigations, incident response, and remediation of identified risks.

 - Participate in the security on-call rotation and help improve the effectiveness of the team's technical security capabilities.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering, product security engineering, or closely related experience, with substantial recent hands-on coding work.

 - Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript, with the ability to work effectively across unfamiliar codebases and technologies.

 - Demonstrated experience designing, shipping, and operating substantial software systems, including backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-intensive applications.

 - Ability to investigate application security weaknesses at the code and architecture levels, understand how vulnerabilities can be exploited, and work with developers to implement effective remediations.

 - Experience with practical application security testing, vulnerability assessment, or penetration testing, including validating findings beyond automated scanner output.

 - Strong understanding of common software security failures, authentication and authorization, web services and APIs, dependencies, and secure development practices.

 - Familiarity with cloud-native application environments, including AWS or comparable cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, investigate root causes, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and drive projects through delivery.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with engineers to explain vulnerabilities, evaluate fixes, and improve security without creating unnecessary friction.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience developing vulnerability-management, attack-surface management, security analytics, or security automation platforms.

 - Experience building security testing tools, exploit validation harnesses, fuzzers, or other offensive-security automation.

 - Hands-on red-team experience, advanced penetration testing, vulnerability research, or participation in responsible disclosure programs.

 - Experience with AWS IAM, EKS/Kubernetes, cloud networking, Terraform, and security-sensitive cloud architecture.

 - Experience integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, or software supply-chain security controls into developer workflows.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, FastAPI, React, or similar application technologies.

 - Experience building LLM-based agents or using AI-assisted tooling for software development, security testing, or vulnerability discovery.

 - Published security research, open-source tooling contributions, CVEs, or other evidence of hands-on security exploration.

 - Experience in fintech, identity verification, financial services, or highly regulated SaaS environments.

 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or comparable security and compliance obligations.

 - $180,000/year - $230,000/year + equity + benefits

jobs.title: Federal SOC Leader
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role
We are looking for a Federal SOC Leader to join our team. This is an On-site role (Crystal City, VA), reporting to the VP in the Federal Security Operations department. This role will build and lead the Security Operations Center (SOC) for Zscaler’s new, dedicated DoD IL6 environment, along with operating the SOC functions for the existing FedRAMP Moderate, High, and DoD IL5 environments. Working from a SCIF, you will manage the SOC’s analysts and incident response, own its playbooks and runbooks, and partner with detection engineering to implement SIEM monitoring.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Stand up a SCIF-based SOC for a new, dedicated DoD IL6 environment, defining its operating model, staffing and shift coverage, tooling, and performance metrics; deliver and mature all SOC functions for DoD IL5, DoD IL6, FedRAMP Moderate, and FedRAMP High environments, achieving and/or maintaining the associated DoD and FedRAMP compliance requirements

• Lead and develop a team of SOC analysts and incident responders, directing continuous monitoring, alert triage, investigations, and proactive threat hunting

• Lead incident response end to end, from triage and containment through eradication, recovery, and lessons learned, serving as incident commander for high-severity events (including classified spillage) and coordinating required reporting with stakeholders and partners

• Own all SOC playbooks, runbooks, and SOPs, keeping them aligned with DoD CC SRG, RMF, FedRAMP, and classified handling requirements and validated through tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews

• Partner with detection engineering to develop and tune detections in SIEMs, setting requirements, prioritizing coverage gaps, and feeding back analyst and hunt findings to keep alerts high-fidelity and actionable

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• Thriving in ambiguity, you feel comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic challenges as opportunities to create something meaningful.

• Operating with an owner's mindset, you navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution, driven by a strong bias for action and passion for the mission.

• Approaching complex issues as a dedicated problem-solver, you are energized by finding solutions to the hardest challenges to deliver the greatest impact.

• Championing the needs of both internal and external stakeholders, you are customer-obsessed and anchor your decisions in solving real-world security problems.

• Actively working as a pragmatic builder, you balance technical excellence with rapid value delivery, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves to build and iterate.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• This position requires an active US Government Top Secret/SCI security clearance. Maintenance of this clearance is a condition of continued employment

• Eight + years of experience leading security operations, incident response, and DFIR in DoD or classified environments, including managing SOC analyst teams and serving as incident commander in 24/7 operations

• Proven track record standing up a SOC or IR program in cloud-centric federal environments, including defining the operating model, staffing, playbooks, runbooks, and performance metrics

• Hands-on expertise with SIEM/SOAR (preferably Splunk Enterprise Security), including partnering with detection engineering to define detection requirements, improve signal quality, and reduce false positives

• Practical experience achieving and maintaining FedRAMP Moderate/High and DoD IL5/IL6 compliance for SOC operations, applying NIST 800-53, DoD CC SRG, RMF, and DISA STIGs

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

• Prior experience running security operations inside a SCIF, including classified information handling and cross-domain data transfer

• Experience operating in U.S. government cloud regions (AWS GovCloud/Secret; Azure Government/Azure DoD/Azure Secret) with DoD IL5/IL6 constraints and integration into SOC and IR workflows

• Proficiency automating enrichment and response actions and building analyst-facing dashboards, case management workflows, and SOC metrics reporting

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel is currently seeking a Specialist to lead the forecasting and planning for a top retailer.  This role will be a member of a dynamic team focused on collaborative sales forecasting and inventory management.  The S.P.A. Specialist will be instrumental in supporting both the Sales team and the customer inventory and planning teams in areas of forecasting, planning, and order fulfillment.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Serves as subject matter expert (SME) on assigned account and brands.
• Forecasting capabilities – Lead the analysis of sales trends to improve weekly item level POS projections. Own and align these plans with internal stake holders and retail partners to ensure we have a collaborative plan at retail.
• Determine appropriate model for evaluating item level forecasts and analysis, considering information such as total end consumer consumption forecasts, brand/product history, history of similar comparable brands/products, inventory levels and marketing programs.
• Consumption analysis – Determine a weekly shipping plan by item, by channel, to support POS plans, retailer in-stock and future order needs.
• Create product flow pattern based on criteria such as seasonality profiles, planned promotions, distribution and price point.
• Attend internal consensus meetings to present and share understanding of POS demand forecasts, provide key data findings to cross-functional S&OP teams to reach a consensus forecast on a month to month basis.
• Actively participate alongside Mattel sales team in key collaborative forecasting meetings with Buyers and Replenishment Managers. Present business findings and recommend action plan for the season.
• Deliver store in-stock metrics by influencing the end-to-end order process including order creation, reviewing daily orders, maintaining perfect PO’s, and optimizing fill rate.
• Direct the execution of our Direct Import business out of Asia, partnering closely with the Customer Service team in our Hong Kong office.

• Key CharacteristicsStrong Analytical Skills – ability to coordinate diverse information, identify relevant data, recommend and implement corrective actionsSolid Interpersonal and Communication Skills – ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels and all functional areas, ability to understand, assess and present the viewpoints of othersSound Business Judgment – ability to interpret issues and recommend actions to best support group, division and corporate goalsProcess Oriented - Ability to identify and address process improvements and share expertise with others
• Basic QualificationsProficient in MS Office, Excel Power UserDirect forecasting experience planning in a highly seasonal environment with long lead timesExtensive experience in analyzing large data sets, blending data from a variety of sources, conducting own analysis and compiling into an effective actionable summarized report to facilitate decision making & strategic planning.Knowledge of demand forecasting tools and cross functional forecasting processes (JDA, SAP, Demantra, Anaplan etc.)Have at least 5+ years relevant experience in sales analysis or merchandise buying/planning

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Rome, GA
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Medical Assistant plays a pivotal role in supporting dermatology physicians by delivering high-quality patient care. Responsibilities include patient rooming, updating medical histories, documenting visit details, and assisting with various dermatological procedures such as biopsies, surgeries, and skin treatments.

Required to work at multiple locations Rome/Cartersville

Essential Functions:

To perform effectively in this role, the candidate must fulfill the following duties with or without reasonable accommodations:

• Collaborate with a team to manage an average patient volume of up to 40 patients daily.

• Document patient histories, including history of present illness (HPI), medical, surgical, and family history, medications, and allergies.

• Prepare and assist with dermatological and cosmetic procedures, including ED&Cs, biopsies (shave and punch), ILK, I&D, Botox, laser treatments, excisions, and other surgical interventions.

• Administer local anesthesia and remove sutures as directed.

• Ensure strict adherence to sterile techniques and infection control practices.

• Perform scribing responsibilities, including inputting templates and chart notes as directed by physicians.

• Process prescription refills and manage prior authorizations.

• Log pathology samples and coordinate with appropriate laboratories.

• Operate specialized equipment such as Narrowband UVB and photodynamic therapy units.

• Maintain and replenish liquid nitrogen containers.

• Clean and stock examination rooms and supply areas.

• Ensure adherence to organizational infection control protocols.

• Maintain reliable and consistent attendance.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervising physician or department lead.

Knowledge, Skills, & Responsibilities:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• 0–3 years of medical assistant experience, preferably in dermatology.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate patient records.

• Effective communication and teamwork skills.

• Bilingual is Preferred.

This role requires a proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic healthcare environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to patient care and operational excellence.

Physical and Mental Demands:

The physical and mental demands described below are representative of those required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities:

• Physical Requirements:

• Occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.

• Use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms.

• Occasionally required to climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, or crawl.

• Occasionally lift, push, pull, or move up to 20 pounds.

• Vision Requirements:

• Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Note:
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the role. Additional responsibilities may be assigned, or duties modified by the department supervisor based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Associate Signal Processing Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team:

The Sensors Division at STR focuses on technology development for advanced sensor systems and platforms in support of national security requirements. Our particular focus areas include airborne/spaceborne/surface-based radar, electronic warfare, underwater acoustics, hyperspectral imaging, and EO/IR sensing. To support these missions, the Division’s efforts span multiple technical areas, including RF analog/digital hardware, acoustic hardware, signal processing algorithms, machine learning algorithms, systems analysis, and real-time embedded processor implementation.

The Algorithms, Processing and Experimentation (APEX) Group specializes in development of RF/radar modes, skills and applications, with particular emphasis on advanced signal processing chains and associated algorithm research. We mature these technologies with the objective of implementation, integration, and eventual utility in RF-based systems, typically tailoring our work for highly specific Defense (e.g., Air Force, Space Force, Navy, DARPA, etc.) and Intelligence Community needs.

About the Role:

As an Associate Algorithm and Signal Processing Engineer, you will develop, implement, test, and apply novel signal processing, optimization, and machine learning algorithms for advanced electronic warfare, radar, and remote sensing applications. You will work as part of multidisciplinary teams to research next-generation sensing concepts and transition advanced algorithms into integrated systems for laboratory and field demonstrations.

A successful candidate will have knowledge in one or more of the following areas: signal processing, adaptive radar signal processing, optimization, machine learning, electronic warfare, algorithm development, radar systems, communications systems, RF remote sensing, resource management, modeling and simulation, or related technical fields. This position requires strong analytical skills, scientific programming experience, and the ability to collaborate with researchers, engineers, and customers to solve challenging technical problems.

What You Will Do

• Apply advanced sensing concepts, signal processing algorithms, and machine learning techniques for radar, electronic warfare, and remote sensing applications

• Assist in researching, designing, implementing, and evaluating novel algorithms from concept through demonstration

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to architect, develop, integrate, and test advanced RF signal processing systems

• Support modeling and simulation activities to evaluate algorithm performance and inform system design

• Support laboratory and field testing to assess algorithm performance and transition research into operational prototypes

• Contribute to technical proposals, customer interactions, presentations, and technical briefings

• Survey emerging research and incorporate state-of-the-art techniques into practical algorithm solutions.

Who You Are

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance, for which U.S. citizenship is required by the U.S. government

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline or equivalent work experience

• Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or similar scientific computing languages

• Strong mathematical, analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills

• Ability to develop, implement, test, or analyze signal processing, optimization, or machine learning algorithms

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Ability to translate research objectives and customer needs into practical technical solutions

Even Better

• Active Top Secret security clearance

• Experience with radar systems, RF remote sensing, electronic warfare, or communications systems

• Experience with adaptive signal processing, waveform design, multidimensional signal processing, resource management, or system optimization

• Experience developing algorithms for real-time or embedded systems

• Experience with modeling and simulation, algorithm integration, and system test and evaluation

• Experience with software development and scientific computing workflows

• Ability to survey technical literature, identify emerging approaches, and transition research into integrated, tested solutions

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $110,000 - $115,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
Procurement Manager

Job type: Full-time

Location: United States (remote)

Reporting to: Chief Operating Officer

About Atari

Atari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises.

The Atari group of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studio, Stormteller Games, Hipster Whale, and Implicit Conversions spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.

Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, France, Germany, Sweden, India, and Australia.

Role Overview

Atari is establishing a dedicated procurement function, and you will lead its development and day-to-day operation. In this hands-on role, you will own how Atari buys across its entities, from sourcing and negotiation through contract management, vendor performance, risk assessment, and reporting.

In your first months, you will lead live negotiations and renewals while building the policies, controls, playbook, and reporting that make effective purchasing the standard across the business.

You will work closely with the executive leadership team, Finance, Legal, IT, HR, and studio and business-unit leaders to improve commercial outcomes, manage risk, and support disciplined growth.

What You’ll Do

• Own Atari’s procurement policy and vendor playbook, including intake processes, spend thresholds, competitive bidding requirements, minimum contract standards, and approval responsibilities.

• Build and maintain a single vendor and contract register across Atari’s entities, covering owners, terms, spend, renewal dates, and notice periods.

• Partner with Finance to enforce purchase-to-pay controls, including requiring an executed contract, statement of work, or purchase order before payment.

• Bring contractor and consultant engagements under consistent procurement standards with People and Finance, including a named owner, budget approval, executed agreement before work begins, and periodic review of extensions.

• Lead sourcing, RFPs, and negotiations for priority categories, including game engines and development tools, outsourced quality assurance and development services, software and cloud, IT hardware, travel, and professional services.

• Consolidate vendors where Atari buys similar products or services across entities, moving toward group agreements, rate cards, and master services agreements.

• Run a renewal calendar so contracts do not renew by default and each renewal begins early enough to renegotiate, re-tender, or exit.

• Negotiate commercial terms and prepare contracts with Legal, covering scope, service levels, pricing, renewal and termination, liability, data protection, and intellectual property.

• Set performance expectations for key vendors and run regular reviews with their internal owners.

• Assess new vendors for financial, operational, security, and data privacy risk with IT and Legal before onboarding.

• Work with Finance and Tax to ensure vendors bill the correct Atari entity and apply the correct tax treatment.

• Track savings against agreed baselines, validate savings with Finance, and report progress to the executive leadership team.

• Analyze spend by category, entity, and vendor to identify new opportunities, including categories growing faster than the business.

• Bring procurement data into the annual budgeting process, including reviews of significant vendor spend.

• Use automation and AI tools to keep the clerical side of procurement efficient, allowing more time for sourcing, negotiation, and vendor management.

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with end-to-end ownership of sourcing and negotiation for indirect spend.

• A track record of negotiating software, SaaS, and services contracts, with results that can be quantified.

• Experience building or substantially rebuilding procurement processes, policies, or controls, rather than only operating existing ones.

• Working knowledge of commercial contract terms, including MSAs, SOWs, service levels, renewal and termination provisions, and liability, together with experience partnering with legal counsel.

• Experience buying across multiple legal entities or countries, including managing multi-currency spend.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to build a spend analysis and savings model in a spreadsheet from imperfect data.

• The ability to influence senior leaders and budget owners without direct authority, and to communicate clearly when a request does not meet procurement standards.

• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, and alignment with Atari’s core values.

Preferred

• Experience in video games, entertainment, media, or technology.

• Category experience in game engines and development tools, outsourced quality assurance or development, cloud infrastructure, or IT hardware.

• Experience establishing contractor governance with People and Finance teams.

• Familiarity with spend, payables, and travel platforms such as Bill.com, Brex, or Navan.

• Experience implementing contract management or procurement software, or automating procurement work with AI tools.

• A procurement credential such as CIPS or CPSM.

If you meet most of the required qualifications and can show that you have built something similar before, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary: $110,000 to $135,000 USD. Final pay depends on experience and skills.

[This role may be eligible for a bonus based on company and individual performance.]

Benefits include medical insurance with multiple plan options, including an HSA-eligible plan with an Atari contribution; dental and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; 15 days of paid time off plus 16 paid holidays; and at least 5 days of paid sick leave per year, or more where state law requires.

EEO Statement

Atari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to equal employment regardless of race, religion or lack thereof, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, medical condition, veteran status, ancestry, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Manager, Supply Chain - New Supercomputer Deployment
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN - NEW SUPERCOMPUTER DEPLOYMENT

This individual will support the procurement of construction services and related capital equipment for the Supercomputer program, including power, cooling, electrical infrastructure, MEP/FP, civil, structural, architectural, and general construction scopes critical to supercomputer campus delivery and expansion.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute procurement strategies for construction services, including general contracting, MEP/FP, civil, structural, architectural, and specialty trades, as well as related capital equipment for Supercomputer sites.

• Lead the creation of bid packages and manage competitive bidding processes (RFIs, RFPs, RFQs), including contractor prequalification, pre-bid meetings, site visits, bid evaluations, and award recommendations for construction scopes.

• Review and validate engineering designs, construction drawings, scopes of work, and specifications to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, and constructability best practices.

• Perform market analysis and develop should-cost models to achieve the best-value purchasing deals for construction services, labor, materials, and equipment across Supercomputer projects.

• Create, negotiate, and administer construction contracts and purchase orders in collaboration with the legal department and project stakeholders; manage change orders, claims, and closeout documentation.

• Evaluate contractor proposals, bills of materials, and scopes of work for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with project requirements and budgets.

• Manage contractor and vendor relationships, ensuring clear communication, adherence to contracts, safety and quality standards, schedule performance, and timely resolution of any performance or delivery issues.

• Present value propositions to management, including those related to contract award, cost reviews, value engineering opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and critical supply issues.

• Identify and execute cost reduction and value engineering projects including planning, coordinating with stakeholders, estimating completion, and project updates for construction categories.

• Perform advanced quantitative and business process analyses to identify financial impacts of decisions, cost improvement, and performance for assigned categories.

• Create and implement management programs to develop, continuously improve, manage the performance of, and monitor KPIs of the construction supply base (safety, quality, schedule, cost).

• Lead and execute requests for proposal to fulfill requirements for defined construction categories or internal assigned areas.

• Place purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices related to assigned categories.

• Develop and lead efforts to reduce the number of transactions and streamline procurement processes for construction services.

• Take ownership of team effort to develop and implement sourcing and cost management strategies that support existing campuses and new Supercomputer capacity.

• Develop clear technology and commodity roadmaps for current commodities, products, and verticals as they relate to future Supercomputer construction and capital equipment needs.

• Manage the supply base from bid through project closeout and warranty to ensure continuity of supply with the right partners and on-time delivery.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 9+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Engineering Supply Chain Purchasing Contract negotiation Material or production planning Operations management Material cost control Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection technical background to speak the language of engineers, contractors, and field teams; strong business background to deal with contracts and negotiations.

• Experience working for or with a general contractor, MEP contractor, or construction services provider preferred.

• Experience sourcing or buying for data centers, supercomputer or high-performance computing campuses, power plants, or other mission-critical industrial facilities.

• Familiarity with construction industry standards and codes (ASHRAE, NFPA, NEC, IBC, OSHA) and project delivery methods (design-bid-build, CMAR, design-build).

• Industrial or mission-critical construction project management experience and/or relevant experience implementing or sourcing mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialty construction services.

• Hands-on experience with the full construction procurement cycle: competitive bidding, bid tabulation, contractor prequalification and evaluation, and contract administration.

• Familiarity with construction contract documents (AIA G-series, MSA) and processes including change orders, schedule of values, progress billing, retainage, and closeout.

• Construction equipment and services procurement experience in industrial, heavy civil, data center, or high-tech facility construction, including power and cooling infrastructure.

• Budget tracking, cost analytical skills, and demonstrated value engineering results on construction projects.

• Extensive project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple fast-track construction packages simultaneously.

• Experience managing an entire supply base from bid through turnover to ensure continuity of supply with the right partners, a plan in place, and on-time delivery.

• Ability to conduct all activities with the highest degree of integrity and safety focus.

• Strong contract negotiation and document management skills with construction-specific experience.

• Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed in a dynamic construction environment.

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment.

• Quick learner and ability to prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs.

• Excellent customer service and stakeholder management skills.

• Able to work effectively as a remote employee while keeping project teams, contractors, and suppliers aligned.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• This role requires 50% travel to Supercomputer project sites, suppliers, and related locations within the United States.

• Remote within the United States. The employee may live anywhere in the U.S. and is not required to relocate to a SpaceX site.

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Embedded Applications Engineer, TinyML Lab (Semiconductor Industry)
jobs.description:
Head Our Edge AI Prototyping Lab. Build Physical Rigs. Deploy TinyML on Silicon.

About the Role & The Reality AI Lab

The Renesas AIoT Center of Excellence in Columbia, MD (formerly Reality AI) is seeking a hands-on Senior Staff Edge AI Applications Engineer to lead our physical Edge AI Applications Lab.

In this role, you will head our physical lab facility, direct R&D and proof-of-concept (PoC) hardware builds, manage project scheduling, and mentor junior engineers. You will operate at the exact intersection of small-scale physical fabrication, digital signal processing (DSP), C/C++ embedded firmware, and microcontroller-level TinyML deployment.

You will lead the end-to-end execution of non-visual sensing solutions - instrumenting physical hardware setups (industrial motors, automotive systems, consumer devices), collecting high-frequency time-series sensor data, building custom DSP pipelines, and optimizing tiny machine learning models to run on Renesas silicon.

Are you a Senior Embedded Engineer or Applied Physicist who thrives in a physical lab environment building custom sensor rigs, soldering prototype boards, and squeezing machine learning models onto microcontrollers?

ATTENTION APPLICANTS: READ BEFORE APPLYING

• This is a physical lab leadership and embedded hardware role.
• DO NOT APPLY if your background is strictly in Cloud AI, Data Science, Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, or Web Backend APIs.
• DO APPLY if you have 7+ years of experience building physical prototype rigs, writing embedded C/C++, running FFTs on raw accelerometer/acoustic data, debugging SPI/I2C signals with an oscilloscope, and running TinyML on bare-metal silicon.

Key Responsibilities

• Lab Ownership & Technical Leadership: Manage physical lab facilities, equipment, part procurement, and project scheduling for customer PoCs, internal R&D, and cross-BU hardware integrations.
• Physical Prototyping & Fabrication: Lead hands-on assembly of prototype rigs, sensor arrays, 3D-printed mounts, and microelectronic setups to capture real-world physical data.
• High-Frequency Sensor Data Engineering: Instrument physical systems to capture, clean, and preprocess high-frequency time-series datasets (acoustic, vibration, electrical, motor current).
• DSP & TinyML Deployment: Design DSP feature extraction pipelines (FFTs, spectral analysis, filtering) and deploy optimized, quantized TinyML models onto microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, Renesas RA/RX/RL78) using TFLite Micro, CMSIS-NN, or eIQ.
• Customer & Cross-BU Collaboration: Work directly with customers and internal product teams to ingest raw hardware telemetry, debug edge firmware issues, and demonstrate live hardware solutions.
• Team Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and guide junior lab engineers in firmware debugging, signal processing, and physical prototype fabrication.

Why Join Renesas?

• No SCIF / No Clearance: Enjoy complex signal processing and hardware challenges without defense contractor bureaucracy or classified workspace restrictions.
• Commercial Product Impact: What you build in our lab gets integrated into Renesas silicon and deployed into millions of industrial, automotive, and consumer devices globally.
• Startup Autonomy + Global Backing: Small-team environment (under 50 people in Columbia) backed by one of the world's premier semiconductor manufacturers.

• Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline. (BSEE with extensive, demonstrable lab leadership experience will also be evaluated).
• Career Experience: 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in embedded software, physical hardware prototyping, digital signal processing, and real-time edge computing.
• Hardware & Lab Skills: Proven expertise in physical system fabrication, 3D printing, electrical assembly, PCB bring-up, and low-level debugging with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD.
• Embedded Firmware: Strong C/C++ programming for constrained microcontrollers, bare-metal or RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr), DMA buffer management, and low-level drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN).
• Signal Processing & On-Device ML: Deep understanding of digital signal processing (DSP) for time-series/audio data and practical experience deploying quantized ML models directly onto microcontrollers.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $139,500 - $185,000. This position is also eligible for   bonus opportunities and commission pay.  Please note that the final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

In addition to elective benefit options, benefited employees receive company-paid life insurance and AD&D, LTD, short term medical benefits as well as paid sick time, paid holidays, and accrued paid vacation. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Platform

Location: Hoboken, NJ (on site)

About Faropoint

Faropoint owns and operates last-mile, Class B, small-bay industrial properties across 20+ U.S. markets. Our in-house technology team builds the software and predictive models our investors and operators use to source deals, underwrite acquisitions, and manage assets, including tools powered by AI agents.

The Role

Faropoint is rebuilding how a real estate investment firm works around AI. Domain experts in investments, capital development, and finance build their own apps with AI coding agents, and agents answer questions over our leases, loans, due diligence files, and market data. Dozens of these apps are already in production.

As our Senior Software Engineer, Platform, you will own the platform all of this runs on: the path from a builder's idea to a secure production app, the infrastructure behind our AI agents and company knowledge layer, and the engineering standards that keep AI-generated code safe to ship. This is a hands-on seat for an experienced software engineer who uses agentic tools every day, with real autonomy over how the platform is built.

You will build within guardrails set by our IT team, who own the AWS accounts, environments, and permissions. You will work closely with our AI engineering, data engineering, and data science groups, with IT and security, and with the builders themselves.

What You'll Do

Build the platform for app building

• Own FaroMaker, our internal platform that lets non-engineers build, deploy, and run apps behind company SSO, and grow it to support more types of applications and services.

• Create "paved road" templates and tooling so a builder can go from idea to a secure, observable app without filing a ticket.

• Run the sandbox where builders and coding agents work, and own the path from sandbox to production.

Build the infrastructure for data and AI

• Give our MCP server, knowledge graphs, and vector search a reliable, secure, and scalable production home.

• Build the path for deploying AI agents to production, with the right access controls, usage budgets, and tracing.

• Deliver infrastructure changes and migrations end to end with IT, without disrupting the apps people rely on.

Set standards and build the delivery pipeline

• Define engineering standards across every repository, including environments, code review, and a clear definition of done.

• Build CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and quality gates that block bad releases while keeping delivery fast.

• Own QA automation and test strategy, so builders can ship with confidence.

Make AI-generated code safe to merge

• Introduce AI-assisted code review so routine changes ship quickly and risky changes get human attention.

• Own the evaluation and regression automation in CI, so changes to prompts, models, or tools can't quietly degrade results.

Run what we ship

• Make our applications observable, diagnose production issues from those signals, and take part in a sustainable on-call rotation.

• Automate manual deployments, workflows, and runbooks.

• Bring senior engineering judgment to key architecture decisions across our core platforms.

What You'll Bring

Must-haves

• 7+ years building and operating production software, including ownership of a codebase, its deployments, and its incident response.

• Hands-on experience shipping on AWS (containers, serverless, infrastructure as code) and with secure access practices such as secrets management and least privilege.

• Experience building an internal platform, developer tooling, or paved road that other engineers ship on.

• Strong production troubleshooting skills using logs, metrics, and tracing.

• CI/CD and test automation experience, including quality gates that block bad releases.

• Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar), with clear opinions on how to review, test, and safely deploy what they produce.

• A track record of introducing engineering standards that teams adopted, and the clear, direct communication it takes to get there.

Nice to have

• Experience with agent tooling (MCP servers, agent harnesses) on Amazon Bedrock or the Anthropic API.

• Experience running knowledge graph or vector search infrastructure in production.

• Experience evaluating LLM applications with eval frameworks, automated grading, and tracing.

• Experience supporting data and machine learning workloads.

• Experience migrating large codebases without production downtime.

• Experience in real estate, investment management, or fintech software.

What We Offer

This position offers a base salary in the $180,000-$225,000 range, plus discretionary bonus, competitive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO, and a 401k match.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Faropoint is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

No hiring or rejection decision will be made solely by automated means without meaningful human review by Company personnel, and any use of AI Tools will comply with applicable law, including anti-discrimination laws and laws governing automated employment decision tools and algorithmic decision-making. Personal information you submit will be kept confidential in accordance with our Privacy Policy and used for recruiting, hiring, and related legal, compliance, and recordkeeping purposes, including to evaluate you for employment opportunities with the Company and its affiliates.

We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.


ROLE:

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Product Security to lead and elevate security across SentiLink’s infrastructure, applications, and internal systems. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on building scalable security foundations while enabling the business to move quickly and safely.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to design secure systems, improve detection and response capabilities, strengthen cloud security posture, and reduce organizational risk. You’ll help shape long-term security strategy while remaining deeply involved in technical implementation and operational execution.

This role is best suited for someone who combines strong technical depth with practical judgment and thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Design and build internal security tooling from scratch, including agent-based security tooling, code analysis tooling, dynamic scanning, and security assessment tools

 - Identify vulnerabilities across SentiLink's AWS-based stack, including application code, cloud service configurations, and integrations between the two

 - Develop AI-assisted and agent-based tooling to scale offensive security testing beyond what a small team can do manually

 - Build and maintain security automation that improves detection, response, and remediation across the organization

 - Conduct hands-on penetration testing and vulnerability research against SentiLink's infrastructure and applications

 - Partner with engineering teams to remediate findings and embed security into the development process without slowing them down

 - Participate in the security on-call rotation, including incident response and regular response testing

 - Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for new systems, with a focus on cloud integrations and identity flows

 - Stay current on offensive security techniques, AI-assisted security tooling, and emerging attack patterns relevant to fintech and identity verification




REQUIREMENTS:

 - 8+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering with a security focus, or closely related roles

 - Proficient in at least one systems language (Go, Rust, C++) and at least one higher-level language (Python, TypeScript)

 - Proven ability to design and ship production software end-to-end

 - Deep AWS infrastructure expertise, including IAM, EKS, RDS, networking, and managed services

 - Proficiency with using an AI tool such as Claude Code, ChatGPT/Codex, Cursor or another similar tool

 - Demonstrated ability to identify security misconfigurations and vulnerabilities across cloud architectures, application code, and the integrations between them

 - Experience conducting or building tooling for penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, or red team activities

 - Track record of building security automation and tooling from scratch

 - Comfortable operating independently on ambiguous problems without heavy process or oversight

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to partner with engineers who are not security specialists
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience building or deploying LLM-based agents or AI-assisted security tooling

 - Prior experience at a security product company (Wiz, Snyk, Datadog, etc.) or other security-forward engineering org

 - Prior fintech, identity, or fraud detection experience

 - Industry certifications (OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, GXPN)

 - Experience with detection engineering or SIEM platforms

 - Published security research, CVEs, or open source security tooling contributions

 - Experience supporting compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, SOC 2, PCI DSS) without it being their primary focus
   
   


COMPENSATION:

$210k-260k/year + equity + benefits




PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role is based in either New York, Chicago, San Francisco, or Mountain View.

At LinkedIn, our vision is to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. And, this vision is powered by our innovative platform of trusted technology that connects our members and customers to opportunity and business growth. We’re looking for a Senior Communications Manager with experience and interest in telling B2B stories to join our Global Communications team. This individual will lead product communications in North America focused on our digital advertising portfolio and will focus on driving earned media to help our customers understand the value we’re delivering with our advertising products.

If you consider yourself a creative storyteller, are open to taking intelligent risks, and you have a love for media relations, product communications, and ad tech, this is the position for you!

In this role, you will work with cross-functional partners across product, marketing, engineering, sales and legal to help our customers love and understand LinkedIn and Microsoft’s advertising solutions. You will be responsible for developing a steady cadence of proactive communications strategies to drive product awareness for the business, while also managing reactive external communications. Strong media relations, writing, project management and organizational skills are required with deep experience in driving earned and owned media results.

If you have a zest for B2B media relations and you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and dive into a fast paced environment where you will have an opportunity to lead integrated product launches, drive an ongoing pipeline of product stories, and juggle multiple projects, we encourage you to apply for this role.

• Manage ongoing cadence of media conversations with product stories always in the pipeline
• Drive strategic and tactical communications plans corresponding with the launch of product news
• Strategically pitch stories and gain earned coverage tied to our advertising solutions and the value they are providing our customers
• Lead global proactive and reactive product storytelling and narrative building

• Remain current on ad tech industry trends, including competitive product news, to keep the our digital advertising business leaders informed about topics driving conversations with external audiences

• Partner with the Global Communications Team to execute on product launches
• Build relationships with your Global Communications Team counterparts across LinkedIn and Microsoft to identify opportunities to weave product narratives and customer value into larger advertising narratives
• Write and/or edit content, including, but not limited to articles, LinkedIn platform posts, bylines, etc.
• Help to connect the dots across lines of business to identify opportunities to collaborate on larger stories to drive a unified approach to marketing and communications
• Balance both the priorities for the digital advertising business with the extended communications teams’ priorities to ensure alignment
• Continuously consider how your priorities are supporting the sales organization as they work to open new doors and build and maintain existing relationships

• 10+ years’ experience in external communications – with a focus on media relations

• 5+ years’ experience working on product communications, ideally for advertising, ad tech, or media
• Strong results in dynamic, high-growth, fast paced environment with proven track record of delivering on projects with tight deadlines and cross-functional dependencies
• Excellent written and oral communications skills with the ability to critically think about how to position a story and weave in multiple messages to maximize opportunities
• Ideal candidate has experience managing issues that may impact reputation
• Experience developing scripts and video content for executive voices
• Organizational skills and an innate ability to stay on top of multiple projects at once
• Experience working across cross-functional teams towards a common goal or initiative
• Strong understanding of external communications and implementation process
• Strong media relations experience
• Must have very strong project management and decision-making skills
• Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external relationships at all levels
• Possess a high degree of integrity and sense of confidentiality

• Corporate Communications
• B2B Communications
• Complex Problem Solving
• Intellectual Curiosity
• Stakeholder Management

We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). • Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.

• Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

• Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site: Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination. Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.

• Assists practitioner with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as: Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing as directed by Provider.

• Provides high quality care by: Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments. Participates in environmental safety rounds. Maintains vaccine/medication inventory. Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines. Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items. Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.

• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner: Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner. Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)

• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum)

• Performs all other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Manager
