jobs.title: District Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Join the Mitsubishi Motors North America (MMNA) Team!

At Mitsubishi Motors NA, we are driving innovation, quality, and excellence in the automotive industry. Our commitment to delivering cutting-edge vehicles goes hand in hand with our dedication to fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment.

Our team members are the driving force behind our success, and we believe in empowering individuals to contribute their unique skills and perspectives. We are a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement.

At MMNA, your career is not just a job but a journey of growth. Benefit from ongoing employee development programs, contribute to our impactful Community Relations initiatives, and enjoy a range of employee benefits that make your experience with us exceptional.

Be part of a company proud of its heritage and excited about the future where together, we shape the future of mobility and drive success in every mile.

Summary of Role:

MMNA is seeking a District Sales Manager to join our South Regional Sales team. As a DSM, you will work in a business consultant capacity, assisting MMNA dealers to profitably sell Mitsubishi vehicles and accessories, while providing their customers with an excellent buying experience.

This position supports 10 dealers in Tennessee, Northern Mississippi, and Alabama. The ideal candidate must be located in Nashville, TN.

Responsibilities:

• Attain district wholesale and retail sales objectives.

• Contact dealerships, and coordinate wholesale, retail vehicle, and P.O.E. accessory sales activities with dealer principal, general manager and/or department managers.

• Develop and maintain an effective, professional long-term relationship with dealers within the assigned district.

• Communicate with dealerships and provide consistent direction of policies, procedures, etc.

• Monitor dealer’s adherence with policies and procedures, and participation in sales, marketing, and advertising programs.

• Advise Region management of non-compliance situations and recommend solutions.

• Analyze individual dealership sales, market penetration, and vehicle inventory.

• Develop and recommend marketing/promotional strategies to assists dealership in maximizing wholesale/retail sales volume, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

• Educate Dealers on the constant changes in marketing; the use of social media, electronic marketing tools, “customer” Dealer rating i.e. “Reputation”, Google Star, Cars.com etc.

• Enroll Dealers in the latest marketing Programs and Services.

• Work with Dealers on Mitsubishi logo and website compliance.

• Work with Dealers and their sales staff to assure they are properly trained using Mitsubishi’s Academy and MiShowroom and MiDelivery.

• Work with Dealers to research and resolve outstanding incentive payments.

• Work with Dealers in the utilization and claiming of their RDA and Co-op Funds.

• Coordinate, plan, and implement sales strategy with knowledge and cooperation of district counterparts.

• Other duties as assigned or required.

Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in automotive sales, dealer relations, field operations, or OEM/distributor roles.

• Direct experience working with franchised automotive dealerships, preferably in a district or regional capacity.

• Strong understanding of retail automotive sales processes, vehicle inventory management, and dealer profitability drivers.

• Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to influence dealer principals, general managers, and department leaders.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

• Comfortable working independently in a field-based role while collaborating closely with regional and district counterparts.

• Prefer Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Comfortable with extensive travel - potential for 4 overnights a month.

• Must maintain a valid unconditional driver’s license and a MMNA approved driving record.

Profile Differentiators:

• Experience representing an OEM or distributor (DSM / FOM / Territory Manager role).

Pay Transparency:

The base salary for this position ranges between $90,000 to $108,000. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes 401k with company match, Mitsubishi Lease Program, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

Perks and Benefits:

• Family First: Enjoy comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision plans.

• Be a Proud Mitsubishi Ambassador: Take advantage of our Discounted Employee Lease Car program, covering insurance, maintenance, and registration fees, with no down payment or credit check required.

• Drive with Perks: This position comes with an assigned vehicle, contingent upon a satisfactory driving record.

• Secure Your Future: Benefit from our 401(k) with Company match and annual contributions based on years of service.

• Fuel Your Growth: Access professional development opportunities, including training, tuition reimbursement, and employee resource groups.

• Take Time for Yourself: Enjoy up to 30 days of paid time off, including holidays, vacation, and other leave options.

• Thrive in an Open Environment: Experience our collaborative workspace where ideas flow freely.

The MMC Way:

Our values form the foundation of everything we do. At Mitsubishi Motors, we are committed to a set of core principles that guide our actions, decisions, and interactions. Our values reflect who we are as a company, how we collaborate, and the impact we aspire to make. These values are what we call the MMC Way:

• Think of Our Customers, Strengthen Trust

• Enrich Society

• Welcome All Facts, Share Difficult News First

• Conduct and Challenge Yourself Professionally

• Respect All, Work as a Broader Team

Diversity and How to Apply:

At MMNA, we embrace the strength that diverse perspectives and experiences bring to our team. Our application process is designed to champion inclusion and equity. We're on the lookout for the ideal fit for each role, valuing skills and experiences over traditional education or specific company backgrounds. Feel encouraged to apply, even if your profile doesn't precisely match the job description. We invite you to delve into a few thought-provoking questions in our application, offering you the opportunity to showcase your unique talents and insights right from the start.

Once you've submitted your application, expect to hear from us within 7 business days. We're committed to keeping you informed about the status of your application, ensuring transparency and open communication throughout the process. We understand that perfection is a journey, and if you ever have questions about your application or the process itself, don't hesitate to reach out to your recruiter.

Mitsubishi Motors is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, excited about collaborating with talented individuals of all identities. We do not discriminate based on identity, aligning with our commitment to fostering a diverse workplace. Our code of conduct serves as a guiding light for the company we aspire to be, celebrating our differences as the driving force behind a product that serves a global user base.

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities and is prepared to provide reasonable accommodations. If you require such accommodations for the job application or interview process, please email mmna-talent_acquisition@na.mitsubishi-motors.com.

We hope you will join us on this journey where your dedication aligns with our values, creating an environment that fosters growth, collaboration, and meaningful contributions.

Click here to learn more about what it's like at MMNA!

We value your privacy. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice to learn how your personal information is collected, used, and safeguarded throughout the application and hiring process.

jobs.title: Divison Operations, Business Associate
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Business Associate will own the analysis driving our facilities, capital investment, production capacity, and revenue forecasting. Partnering with RevOps, Finance, and Sales, you’ll keep production schedules honest against real demand and surface resource constraints before they become delivery problems. You will also lead the division’s annual planning cycle, support go/no-go product decisions, and deliver the ad hoc insights the General Manager and Head of Operations rely on daily. If you want ambiguous questions, direct access to data, and a short line between your analysis and the final decision, this is the seat for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the analytical arm of the business — This is the team that wakes up every day thinking about future planning. Own analysis related to business, real estate, and production planning for the Intelligence Systems business line.

• Drive facilities and capital planning — Manage planning and strategy for facilities (including office space, manufacturing, and testing), secured spaces, and capital investments.

• Inform go-to-market decisions — Support the Futures team on GTM decisions, using data to drive go/no-go calls on which products to pursue based on market demand.

• Partner on revenue forecasting — Partner with Revenue Operations and Finance on ACV and revenue forecasting. Work with Sales teams and RevOps to monitor pipeline health, identify material changes to forecast, and ensure production schedules are aligned with third-party and first-party product demand.

• Map staffing to the pipeline — Understand and communicate the planning and mapping of staffing to new and current projects, with the ability to develop plans to address resource constraints that would impact pipeline growth or international deployments.

• Lead annual planning — Drive annual planning for Intelligence Systems as part of the corporate planning cycle, and lead content development and planning to support other business reviews.

• Support the GM and Head of Operations — Deliver ad hoc analysis for the General Manager and the Head of Operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience in business analytics, strategic finance, revenue operations, corporate strategy, or a comparable analytical function.

• Strong analytical toolkit — Advanced financial and operational modeling, with fluency in excel and AI tools. You will work directly with data rather than waiting on a reporting team.

• Translates analysis into decisions — Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analysis, and to communicate findings clearly and simply to non-analytical audiences, including executives. Strong written and verbal communication.

• High ownership and capacity — Able to manage multiple large workstreams and priorities in parallel, at a rapid pace, and report out on progress regularly.

• Comfortable with cross-functional ambiguity — Experience working across Finance, Sales, Operations, and Engineering without formal authority over any of them.

• Ability to work onsite five days a week at either our Reston, VA or Costa Mesa, CA office.

• Possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance, at minimum.

• Ability to travel up to 25%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience in defense, aerospace, or another hardware manufacturing environment, particularly with production planning or capacity modeling.

• Experience working with Salesforce products.

• Experience supporting ACV, bookings, or revenue forecasting in partnership with RevOps or FP&A.

• Experience with facilities, real estate, or capital investment planning.

• Experience in the intelligence community or national security mission space.

• Experience working effectively in a matrix organization structure.

US Salary Range

$117,000—$154,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Product Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
WE'RE BUILDING A NEW HEALTHCARE CLEARINGHOUSE

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp https://ramp.com/data/top-saas-vendors-on-ramp-march-2026 as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.



Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.



To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MxyCUNAr9Y8. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IO6sR-i5rSs.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Every month, millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim statuses flow between healthcare providers and payers through our clearinghouse. Our Network Operations team is responsible for the health, growth, and operational efficiency of this system.

As a Product Analytics Engineer your job is to analyze the transactions flowing through our rails in order to improve eligibility check success rates, reduce claim rejections, and optimize our payer routes.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define business metrics to determine the “network health” of our clearinghouse

 - Instrument dashboards, reports, and alerts for both the network operations and engineering teams to take action on in order to continuously improve our payer routing and API logic

 - Work with product, engineering, and design to “productize” these metrics within the Stedi application for end-customer consumption

 - Ensure customer invoices, application reporting, internal reporting, and vendor invoices match with no manual reconciliation. When numbers differ, find the cause in the data pipeline and fix it there.

 - Build internal tools, scripts, and runbooks to help Stedi manage the network and make decisions quickly

 - Manage a well-defined backlog of issues in Linear


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have exceptional analytics and documentation skills: You’ve made a career in working with data to improve products and overall business operations. You know the tools, best practices, and playbooks necessary to stand up a high-performing and organized analytics function at the company.

 - You think like an architect. You anticipate bugs before they surface and design data models, pipelines, and schemas that hold up as volume grows. You’ve owned production pipelines end to end and have built ETL systems at scale.

 - You know the tech stack. You consider yourself an expert in the modern data stack (DBT, Redshift), and consider yourself an expert in SQL, data visualization, and structuring complex database schemas. You are excited about using new AI technologies to enhance your productivity and output.

 - You create and execute your own work: You are relentlessly curious, and want to become an expert in the product and the overall operation so you can create and prove your own hypotheses. You are not satisfied in a role where someone hands you requirements.

 - You do what it takes to get the job done. You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.

 - You move quickly. We move quickly as an organization. This requires an ability to match our pace and not get lost by responding with urgency (both externally to payers and internally to stakeholders), communicating what you are working on, and proactively asking for help or feedback when you need it.

 - You are a “bottom feeder”. You thrive on the details. No task is too small in order to find success, generate revenue, and improve our costs.



We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note:

 - All official communication about roles at Stedi will only come from an @stedi.com http://stedi.com email address, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com http://frompersona.com.

 - If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to contact us directly at careers@stedi.com.

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.



At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

jobs.title: VP, Investor Relations
jobs.description:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry.   Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

Reporting to the Head of Investor Relations, the Vice President, Investment Relations oversees the day-to-day execution of Fortitude Re’s Investor Relations function. The role shapes the company’s external financial narrative with equity partners, the Board and the Executive Committee (ExCo), provides investor relations support across Fortitude Re’s entities as appropriate, and manages the Investor Secondee Program. This is a hands-on leadership role: the VP owns the IR operating calendar and quarterly close deliverables, sets the cadence, assigns ownership, tracks every deliverable to completion and holds contributors across the organization to agreed scope and timelines, collaborating closely with the CFO and senior leadership. The role combines exceptional organizational and project management skills with the presence to engage investors and directors.

What You Will Do:

Investor Relations & Strategic Partner Engagement

• Own the day-to-day relationships with Fortitude Re’s equity partners, serving as the primary point of contact for inbound questions, recurring reporting obligations (e.g., quarterly portfolio-monitoring submissions) and partner events, and move IR from a reactive function to a proactive one that anticipates what our partners need.

• Own the investor query process end to end, from intake and routing to subject matter experts through review and timely response and maintain a reusable Q&A bank so answers stay consistent across partners.

• Deliver a weekly investor interactions summary to the CFO and Head of Strategic Finance so leadership has a current read on equity partner sentiment, open requests and emerging themes.

• Analyze investor feedback, market trends, peer performance and macroeconomic factors to inform Fortitude Re’s strategic positioning and messaging.

• Plan and project-manage equity partner events, including annual investor days and on-site visits, featuring executive presentations, Q&A sessions and deep dives; own the run-of-show, material requests, subject matter expert coordination and internal sign-off.

• Provide investor relations support across all Fortitude Re entities as appropriate, including FCA Re, Fortitude Re’s sidecar reinsurance vehicle, covering investor reporting and communications, onboarding of new investors and diligence requests.

• Coordinate with Treasury (rating agencies and debt investors) and Corporate Development (counterparties) so external messaging is consistent across audiences, and represent Fortitude Re in investor meetings, industry forums and conferences.

Board, ExCo & Quarterly Close

• Own the IR close calendar and quarterly cadence: oversee the production of quarterly earnings materials, the financial supplement, monthly investor reports and the monthly investor meeting (agenda, speakers, materials and distribution), ensuring accuracy, timeliness and alignment with company goals.

• Project-manage Board and ExCo deliverables end to end, including the Board Opener: confirm scope and timeline with the Head of Strategic Finance and the CFO, assign ownership across Finance Business Partners and subject matter experts, run walk-through sessions and lock content ahead of distribution deadlines.

• Translate complex financial, operational and market information into compelling, actionable narratives, incorporating analysis of the external and competitive environment to inform strategic direction.

• Enforce Preparer-to-Reviewer-to-Issuer governance across all IR deliverables, acting as the reviewer and gatekeeper for non-GAAP narratives, and standardize metric definitions (e.g., ANI, MABV Growth, ROE), resolving discrepancies across departments.

• Provide subject matter expertise to senior leadership on financial results, investor queries and performance drivers.

Investor Secondee Program

• Manage the Investor Secondee Program, which hosts secondees from strategic investors: coordinate onboarding and rotations with host functions, and serve as the day-to-day point of contact for each secondee and investor sponsor.

• Maintain the program playbook, and partner with Legal, Compliance and People & Culture on confidentiality protocols and logistics.

Leadership, Collaboration & Automation

• Directly manage and develop the Investor Relations Associate (one direct report), who supports equity partner queries, earnings data analysis, Board materials and competitive intelligence, through coaching, guidance and performance feedback.

• Set and maintain the IR operating rhythm: close calendar working sessions and recurring touchpoints with the Head of Investor Relations, the Head of Strategic Finance and the CFO.

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Finance Business Partners, FP&A, Controllers, Accounting Policy, Investment Accounting, Actuarial, Investments, Treasury and Corporate Development) to align investor communications with business objectives, including periodic in-person time with colleagues across Fortitude Re’s offices.

• Champion AI adoption and automation, including skills, workflows, dashboards and the Q&A bank, in partnership with the Finance Modernization and Data teams.

• Maintain strong control frameworks over the accuracy, confidentiality and approval of investor communications.

jobs.title: Staff Web Designer
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Staff Web Designer who loves solving complex UX challenges, building scalable systems, and turning ideas into real experiences. This role is ideal for a scrappy, systems-minded designer who thrives on ownership, enjoys getting into the details, and is excited to be the primary designer shaping Fivetran's web experiences.

You will own the design strategy and hands-on execution for fivetran.com and getdbt.com, building scalable design systems that balance consistency with flexibility. You'll choose when to use existing patterns, when to evolve them, and when a unique experience calls for something new. To bring your projects to life, you will partner closely with Web Strategy, Web Engineering, Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product teams.

Success in this role requires balancing big-picture systems thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves. You should be comfortable moving between strategy, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems, making thoughtful trade-offs to ship high-quality work quickly. You will champion AI-powered tools and new ways of working, create scalable processes that reduce repetitive work, and help shape how web design operates as the business grows.

We're looking for someone resourceful, opinionated, curious, and energized by building and thinking in systems. You will build the foundations that make great web experiences easier to create, evolve, and scale.

This is a full-time hybrid position based out of our Oakland, Denver, Austin, New York or Philadelphia office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You’ll Use

• Figma

• Webflow

• Sanity

• Claude

• Codex

• Jira

• Google Analytics (GA4)

• Amplitude

• Microsoft Clarity

What You’ll Do

• Own the end-to-end design strategy and execution for Fivetran.com and getdbt.com, translating complex web strategy into scalable design systems from concept through launch.

• Operate as the sole web designer, independently driving high-impact initiatives with a scrappy, pragmatic mindset that balances speed, quality, and technical feasibility.

• Shape and evolve the design systems that power our website, including reusable components, design standards, and interaction patterns that improve consistency and accelerate time to market.

• Lead AI innovation for web design, experimenting with emerging tools and building repeatable workflows that accelerate prototyping, production, and implementation.

• Partner closely with web strategy to connect designs to business outcomes and with web engineering to translate designs into real experiences.

• Champion user-centered design, leveraging user research and competitive insights to identify opportunities and influence web strategy.

• Serve as a trusted design partner across Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Product, and Engineering, challenging assumptions and building alignment around user-centered solutions.

• Establish high standards for usability, interaction, accessibility, and responsive design, creating reusable guidance and documentation that enable quality at scale.

• Proactively improve how the web team operates by anticipating risks, removing bottlenecks, and introducing lightweight processes that make execution faster and more effective.

• Communicate design strategy and outcomes with clarity to influence stakeholders and executive leadership.

Skills We’re Looking For

• Extensive experience in web, product, or UX design, with a proven track record of independently leading high-impact digital experiences from strategy through launch.

• Exceptional systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex problems, design scalable information architecture, and create reusable patterns that work across multiple experiences and use cases. Proven experience building and evolving design systems, component libraries, and scalable design frameworks.

• Deep expertise in UX and interaction design, including user flows, navigation, responsive design, accessibility, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping.

• Experience leveraging AI-powered tools for design, prototyping, design-to-code workflows, or workflow automation, with a strong interest in building more efficient and scalable ways of working.

• Strong technical fluency and understanding of modern web development, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers, evaluate implementation trade-offs, and contribute hands-on to bringing designs to life.

• A resourceful execution mindset with demonstrated success operating independently, navigating ambiguity, prioritizing effectively, and shipping high-quality work in fast-moving environments.

• Exceptional cross-functional communication and influence, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, articulate design decisions, and align stakeholders.

Bonus Skills​

• Experience designing for B2B SaaS, enterprise software, developer tools, or data products.

• Experience working as a solo designer, building design practices and systems from the ground up.

• Curiosity about emerging web technologies, technical product experiences, and new approaches to designing and building for the web.

• Strong business acumen, with the ability to leverage behavioral analytics, user research, and experimentation to inform decisions and improve user journeys.

• Familiarity with experimentation, conversion rate optimization, and behavioral analytics tools such as Optimizely, GA4, Amplitude, or Microsoft Clarity.

Join Unlimited Technologies as a Full-Time Security Installation Technician!

This full-time position offers the opportunity to work alongside some of the best security technicians in the area and grow your skills in a supportive environment.

The Installation Technician will plan and perform security system installations, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting and demolition tasks. jobs.description:

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

As the dedicated Field Service Technician for Formlabs, you will be the primary technical point of contact and face of our company across the North America. This is a role where you will be traveling 80% or more of the time.

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of the customer's on-site experience: from the initial installation and commissioning of equipment to delivering comprehensive user training and performing critical repairs. You are not just fixing machines; you are empowering customers to use them.

• Preventative Maintenance: Manage a schedule of annual maintenance visits, ensuring all warrantied customers are serviced within their 90-day target window.

• Troubleshooting: Employ critical thinking to diagnose electromechanical issues and achieve "single visit resolutions" to minimize travel and downtime.

• Logistics & Reporting

• Visit Volume: Execute a high volume of activity.

• Travel Management: Independently manage a complex travel schedule (flights, trains, hotels, rental cars) and submit expenses on time.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a STEM-related field

• You have hands-on repair experience

• You have a valid passport

• You are capable of performing job function utilizing written procedures, verbal instructions and visual aids

• Ability to work independently with little direct supervision while traveling 80+% of the time

Bonus Skills:

• Experience in Dental/Medical applications

• Experience with CAD/CAM

• Experience with 3D printing technologies and materials.

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

$33.20—$45.83 USD

jobs.title: Inbound Phone Representative
jobs.description:
MOO brings brands to life in a sustainable way, with a range of remarkable print and merchandise products. We combine design, technology, manufacturing and service, so that people can connect in memorable ways. Not online but out there, in real life.
 
We started in 2004. Since then we’ve built an award-winning and much-loved brand, with customer satisfaction and Trustpilot ratings that make most businesses want to give up and hire an army of review bots. We’ve got half a million customers, mostly small and medium businesses in North America, the UK, and Europe – businesses that, like us, get all excited about putting something real and beautiful into people’s hands. Does that make us nerds? Probably, and we’re ok with that. 
 
We’ve been given the highest business award in Britain, ‘The Queen’s Award for Enterprise’. Backed by venture capital, we’re part of Tech Nation’s ‘Future Fifty’, recently passing $1bn in lifetime revenue, and featuring in the Guardian’s top 10 UK start-ups list. Ok, we’ll stop bragging now.
 
Today, we’re more than 400 people with our global HQ in London, UK, while we also have premises in Dagenham. In the US, you’ll find us in Boston, MA, as well as East Providence, RI and Denver, CO and with our most recent office expansion in Cape Town South Africa.


At MOO, we don’t just print business cards; we help people make their mark on the world. We believe great design is for everyone and our goal is to help customers achieve that! 
 
We are looking for an Inbound Call Specialist who is part problem-solver, part design-enthusiast, and 100% dedicated to the customer experience.

jobs.title: Airbag Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

We are currently seeking an Airbags Engineer with a focus on Farside Airbag, also known as FarSAB. This position requires an experienced professional in restraint system development. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches his or her work with vigor and determination.

Candidates will contribute to the growth of a high-performance team, combining their high skills in their respective fields with the company/industry standard to optimize their outcome, maintaining detailed and accessible development history, exposing their Engineering judgements, while acting in a timely manner, possessing the ability to learn quickly and strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

Information: FarSAB is the airbag that is placed in the inboard driver’s seat and intends to protect the occupants from head-to-head contact in a vehicle side impact or rollover crash.

Role:

o Develop various airbags and their integration in the vehicle across the whole product lifetime: from system specification development, sourcing, packaging, drawing release, design validation, sub-system(1) integration, ramp up, manufacturing support to post SOP maintenance.

o FarSAB will be the main focus for the first mission. Other Airbags may be in scope for spot support initially, or become fully in scope depending on candidate future capacity and needs.

o Responsible for achieving product technical excellence as well as economical, timing and quality targets.

o Participate to the airbags commodity knowledge-based activities like teaching, feeding the guidelines and lessons-learned system, identify needs for future platforms, etc…

o Work closely with the design studio, ergonomic, Seat Team and interior engineering teams to develop the optimum restraint system packages for occupant protection performance and interior styling.

o Manage Tier 1 suppliers for both engineering development and program timing. Function as the main point of contact for all restraints design supplier interfaces.

o Create and manage validation plan at L4, L3 and L2 level. Macro plan will be provided in early development stage, then the candidate will translate it into a detailed plan and manage the changes in timing and maturity. It involves the test plan itself, the identification of the parts and fixtures/bucks necessary to support the activity, active support of most tests, analysis and reporting. As sub-system owner, drive the investigation and communications with all involved commodity owners..

o DVPs are defined starting from standard DVP and adjusted based on DFMEA approach.; all risks different from std risks will generate some adjustments in potential failure mode thus validation plan (additions or subtractions). Those adjustments are data driven with documented engineering judgements.

o Provide expertise on restraint system design to meet all vehicle targets (performance, cost, timing, weight, Studio design, quality, manufacturing, etc…).

o Support crash tests and vehicle homologation. Make sure parts are supplied with correct pedigrees for all seats applied in crash test vehicles and other vehicle level validation and homologation needs.

Qualifications:

o Enough experience to demonstrate the capacity to fully meet the role; 3+ years’ experience in airbag engineering and in-depth knowledge about the design, including 1 year experience specifically related to Side Airbag or FarSAB, through direct or indirect experience in automotive OEM and/or Tier 1 suppliers (Airbag field or in key element of the subsystem with active participation in that sub-system performance).

o Able to adopt the Lucid approach:

§ Engineering judgment rather than engineering decisions.

§ Maintain development history rather than making spot decisions.

§ Willing to expose your work, rather than working in isolation.

o Knowledge of latest technology advancement in the field of passive safety.

o Enough CAD skills to package the component models into vehicle models, check interfaces with the rest of the vehicle and make or recommend small modifications if necessary. The ideal candidate should possess enough CAD skills to design simple brackets, fixtures, etc.

o Deep understanding of Mechanical Engineering fundamentals: mechanics of materials, materials properties, dynamics, and biomechanics related to occupant safety, failure mechanics.

o Strong analytical and problem-solving skill to apply the engineering knowledge to solving practical problems.

o Experience using APQP processes (DVP&R, 8D, DFMEA, DRBFM).

o Experience using GD&T and tolerance stack analysis (ASME or ISO).

o Strong oral and written communication skills to be able to articulate highly technical issues for general audiences not in the crash safety field, such as top management, design studio, purchasing team, etc.

o Strong ownership mindset to work independently and fulfill the tasks in a timely manner.

o Excellent people skills to manage suppliers, push the envelope to develop optimal technical solutions, ensure timely delivery of all components.

o Have strong ethics and diligence.

Preferred:

o Knowledge of the latest technological advancement in the field of Airbags.

o In-depth knowledge about the design and engineering of airbags.

o 3+ Years’ experience at automotive OEM and 2+ years’ experience at Tier 1 suppliers.

o Knowledgeable about DFMEA or DRBFM process.

o Experience in program management.

o Experience in testing (crash, airbag deployment, seats, IP and/or upper trims).

o Knowledge of automotive crashworthiness legislation and attributes.

o Knowledge of CAE analysis (e.g., LS-Dyna) and restraint system integration and optimization.

o 6 sigma Green or Black Belt.

Education:

o Bachelor’s degree and above in Mechanical Engineering or other related fields.

Note:

Validation plan structure follows the V-model:

o L4 level: components stand alone (in rigid fixtures)

o L3 level: sub-systems like PAB and KAB in IP, SAB in seat, etc…

o L2 level: multiple sub-systems involved like OOP-TWG, FMVSS 22

jobs.title: Lead COMSEC Manager
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a COMSEC Manager to join our rapidly growing ream in Santa Ana, CA. In this role, you will manage a team of COMSEC personal and provide strategic oversight and operational leadership across business functions ensuring seamless execution of company initiatives and alignment with overall business objectives. In addition to people management, you will be responsible for the day to day communications of classified environments at a variety of classification levels. Responsibilities include drafting policies, implement security procedures, review security practices, and evaluate the organization’s COMSEC program. A successful candidate will maintain and direct the receipt, custody, transfer, safeguarding, accounting, and destruction/disposition of the Communications Security key material. As the leader of a small but growing team, you will be expected to wholly own problem sets, develop solutions, and safeguard the communications security material for the organization as a whole.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

People Management/Leadership Responsibilities

• Lead day-to-day operations to ensure smooth and efficient business activities across departments.

• Develop and implement operational strategies that align with Anduril’s business objectives.

• Manage and mentor diverse teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

• Identify and build processes where none exist, and refine systems to enhance productivity.

• Build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

COMSEC Responsibilities

• Conduct secure equipment (e.g., secure telephone and encryption devices) and classified keying material inventories, inspections and other COMSEC related support and oversight functions.

• Perform installation of secure telephone equipment (STE) and coordinate to deliver encryption device(s) and keying material to select Information Technology (IT) specialists maintaining classified networks.

• Administer a Top Secret inventory and document control program to account for COMSEC equipment and materials.

• Ensure proper physical security accreditation has been issued by designated Program Security Officers for supported facilities.

• Train personnel in COMSEC procedures and the use of related equipment.

• Oversee the secure handling, distribution, and destruction of COMSEC material.

• Courier classified information and author receipts for classified materials.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Leadership experience in general management or operations in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• 5-7 years of experience in a COMSEC Manager role.

• Familiar with COMSEC requirements and procedures to include the acquisition, maintenance, operations and disposition of COMSEC equipment.

• Completed the TRADOC-approved Key Management Infrastructure (KMI) course and the COMSEC Account Manager Course (CAMC).

• Must be familiar with security policy/manuals and the appropriate ICDs/JAFANs/DOD Manuals and other guiding policy documents.

• Experience with Modern Fill Devices (MFD) or Simple Key Loader (SKL).

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain at least an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

• Eligibility for access to Special Access Programs.

• 20-40% Travel required to support multiple geographic locations.

• Ability to work in support of rotating shift work is required for this position - Quarterly rotations between shifts of 8am-2pm and 2pm-10pm

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with the Communications Security Logistics Activity (CSLA), Information System Security Program Application (ISSPA), and COMSEC Automated Registration System (CARS).

• Experience with crypto evaluation reports and maintaining matrices of crypto items / keys.

• Experience with KMI Operating Account (KOA) Agents (KOAAs).

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a Senior Associate to elevate our customer engagement and lifecycle marketing initiatives. THE GAME PLAN

• Develop and manage a lifecycle experimentation roadmap, identifying hypotheses, designing tests and using results to continuously improve customer journeys, engagement and commercial outcomes

• Use customer, behavioral and campaign data to identify opportunities, diagnose performance and develop actionable recommendations for improving lifecycle effectiveness

• Partner cross-functionally with Commercial Analytics, Martech, Operations, Product and Creative to translate lifecycle strategy into compelling customer experiences and ensure high-quality execution

• Share learnings and best practices across Customer Marketing, helping embed a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

• Bachelor’s degree preferred

• 3-5 years of experience in Customer Marketing, lifecycle marketing or similar roles, with the ability to develop strategy and manage complex initiatives from conception through execution

• Strong strategic marketing mindset, with experience identifying customer opportunities, developing lifecycle strategies and translating them into actionable plans

jobs.title: GTME Leader
jobs.description:
Founding GTM Engineering Leader at AltiSales

About the company

AltiSales is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, technology, and operations of Sales and Sales Development. AltiSales lives in the intersection of 3 industries: Software (www.gtmcaddy.io), Consulting & Outsourcing, and Venture Capital. We work with clients to create a sustainable and scalable revenue engine that can later be brought in-house as the teams grow from a few BDEs to dozens of them.

AltiSales was founded in 2012 by Tito Bohrt, who is a well recognized LinkedIn influencer in Business Development and who advocates for strategic & thoughtful outbound, rather than spray & pray. Tito has hired and trained over 200 SDRs including some of the best performers at public companies like Citrix. Today Tito leads AltiSales and writes articles for Sales Hacker, Forbes, and his personal blog on LinkedIn.

Our Core Values are:

• Excellence and Thoughtfulness: We understand that excellence is contagious and inspire others with our thirst for it. Excellence is about thoughtfulness, quality of our work outputs, and the outcomes we deliver, not about the volume of work we produce or the hours we work. The speed and volume of work must be combined with extreme attention to detail and thoughtfulness to be valuable. Sloppy AI-generated work is frowned upon. We hate mediocrity and excuses.

• Company > Team > Individual: We seek what is best for our clients and our company, rather than what's best for ourselves or our group, even when that means closing the vault. We are ego-less in the search for the best ideas. We help others and share information openly.

• Ownership and Accountability: We behave like owners. We never wait to be told what to do, or act like "it's not our job" to do more. We own every mistake made by our direct reports and our AI outputs. We act like leaders, always self-motivating, self-improving and self-disciplined. We make tough decisions without agonizing. We question actions inconsistent with our values.

• Common Sense: We believe that excessive rules make our company less agile and adaptable in a constantly changing world, and therefore we prioritize common sense. We use company resources with common sense and adapt to rapidly changing markets.

• Team, Not Family: We behave as a professional sports team. We want the best player in every position and try to hire, develop, and cut smartly, to optimize team performance.

• Customer Centricity: We strive to make every customer successful, because their success is our success. Empathy is our default. We work hard to augment our clients growth day-in and day-out. We pride ourselves on making a tangible impact on our customers' lives and businesses.

Our Benefits:

• Attractive Compensation Package: We offer a competitive salary, commission, and bonuses in USD, which include performance-based salary increases. Join our prestigious Presidents Club: Achieve your revenue targets and every quarter, we reward you with an exciting trip to destinations like Vegas, Mexico, and Costa Rica. While on these trips, you'll have the opportunity to bond with the team and engage in thrilling activities such as scuba diving, whitewater rafting, and bungee jumping. As a top performer, you'll be celebrated and receive well-deserved recognition.

• Remote-First Culture: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere that suits you best. Our company fully supports remote work, allowing you to choose your ideal location. We go the extra mile by covering your coworking space expenses and providing all the necessary equipment you need to excel in your role.

• Work-Life Balance: Enjoy our open vacation policy that allows you to take time off whenever you need it, as long as you continue to meet your goals. We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance and trust our employees to manage their time effectively.

• Unlimited Professional Growth: Fuel your expertise with our unlimited professional development budget. We cover 100% of the costs for books, courses, conferences, and any other opportunities to enhance your skills.

• Additional Exciting Perks: We offer a range of cool benefits including health reimbursement, fitness stipend, and more.

The role

As a Founding GTM Engineering Leader, you'll own the targeting and data engine behind many of our client programs. We call it "Founding" because for each new client, you'll start from little more than a website and build the go-to-market motion: who to sell to, which accounts matter most, who to talk to inside them and what to say. You'll work across many clients and industries at once, all B2B and mostly enterprise.

Your counterparts will be our SDR Leaders. They are in charge of messaging across channels (phone, email, linkedin, etc), email copy, responses, pipeline management and even SDR & AE training. This role solely covers the "Data Universe" to "Enriched MQL" part of the funnel.

What you'll do

• Map markets. Figure out what a client sells and who buys it, then size the addressable market account by account.

• Build and score account lists. Design fit, intent, and common-ground scoring, and use it to decide where our SDRs spend their time.

• Find the buying committee. Identify the right personas and people at each account, so the outreach is account-based rather than spray-and-pray.

• Enrich for relevance. Pull firmographic, technographic and custom signals from public data, APIs and scrapers, so every message has a real reason behind it.

• Build the systems. Automate the workflows behind all of this, connect tools through APIs and webhooks, and make them repeatable across clients. We need high speed and high quality.

• Close the loop. Use what SDRs hear on calls and what converts to keep improving targeting, scoring and messaging.

What we're looking for:

• You're AI Obsessed. You're at the forefront of technology. You use Claude for everything. You follow people like Jordan Crawford, Erik Nowoslawski, and Kyle Norton.

• You build. You can show us workflows you built in past roles and what they produced. We care more about what you've shipped than what you'd plan. Being a previous founder or having 2+ years of experience as a GTME building strategy for 5+ companies is a big PLUS!

• You're High Agency. Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams, demonstrating strong ownership, self-management, and reliability in delivering outcomes.

• You sweat the details. You have insanely high standards. You hold yourself and others accountable to excellence.

• You're technical. You work comfortably in at least one of Python, JavaScript, TypeScript or SQL, and you've connected systems through APIs and webhooks. You're high agency in the role.

• You think in systems. You see the whole flow from data to meeting, and you think about what breaks downstream when one part fails.

• You think in structure, and sideways. You solve problems step by step, and you also find the angle no one else looked at.

• You communicate clearly. You can explain complex work simply, in writing and out loud, to clients, SDRs and leadership.

• You want feedback. You give it directly and take it well, especially when it's critical.

• You own it. You take projects from start to finish without being chased.

Nice to have

• Experience with Clay, n8n, or similar tools. We don't require it, or a CS degree.

• Previous experience as an SDR Leader, Sales Leader, SDR or AE. Knowing what it's like to be in their shoes helps.

• Background in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM strategy. We want someone beyond a narrow focused GTME role.

• Experience in an agency or SDR environment. Being a previous founder is a plus!

How we hire

• Loom project. Send a 5 to 10 minute Loom of a real project where you found and scored accounts in a small market.

• Intro call. Ask us anything about AltiSales and the role, and we'll align on salary and expectations.

• Take-home 1. Build a target market, buyer list and outbound sequence for one of our active clients (so we have a frame of reference).

• Tiebreaker take-home (only if needed).

Details

• Location: Remote

• Compensation: Competitive Base, plus performance bonuses.

• Reports to: Tito Bohrt, Founder and CEO

To apply, send your Loom to tito@altisales.com...

Step 1: Loom project

Record a 5 to 10 minute Loom walking us through a real project you built.

Pick a project you did with a relatively small TAM (ideally B2B Enterprise, but anything with under 100,000 Accounts in TAM is valid), where finding and ranking the right accounts took real work. Show us:

• How you found the accounts. The sources, tools and workflow you used, and why.

• How you scored them. What makes one account better than another, and how your scoring reflects that.

• What you uncovered. Any signals that made certain accounts more likely to buy, or specific pains you found within this TAM.

Show the actual work on screen, not slides about it. Send the link to tito@altisales.com.

jobs.description:
Come Join Us!

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. Position: DC Supervisor.

Schedule: 10:00PM-6:30AM.

What's the Short Version?

The Distribution Center (DC) Supervisor is responsible for all aspects of department operations including planning, organizing, and monitoring the receiving, storage, order fulfillment, and shipping functions to ensure a smooth and consistent operation. The DC Supervisor provides support to employees and, at the discretion of DC leadership, other departments as necessary.

• Conduct annual performance appraisals and provide continued feedback on overall performance.

• Interview and hire new employees.

• Collaborate across departments to drive optimal productivity.

• Analyze business and performance trends and metrics to develop solutions, programs, and policies.

• Foster an environment in which diverse backgrounds are respected and valued.

• Respond to employee needs, including professionalism, respect, and consideration of others.

• 4-6 years of warehouse experience

• 1-3 years as a lead or supervisor

• Bilingual (Spanish) is a plus.

• Should be able to read, write, and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information and verbally communicate with customers.

• Demonstrated ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require.

• Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.

• Demonstrates flexibility and the ability to quickly adapt to change in the work environment.

• Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors work to ensure quality.

• Strong conflict management skills.

• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Be self-directed and motivated.

• Take initiative to identify and anticipate department needs and make recommendations for implementation.

• Ability to work in high-demand, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines.

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail.

What's Our Offer?

Bonus: You`ll be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus up to 10% of base salary.

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a bi-weekly basis based on hours worked up to 152 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.description:
CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

The Manager, Remote Care Navigation leads the Remote Care Navigator (RCN) team supporting CareDx remote patient monitoring programs. This role is responsible for day-to-day team leadership, clinical operations, quality, workflow consistency, customer support, and scalable execution across transplant center accounts.

The Manager provides leadership and oversight to RCNs while partnering cross-functionally to ensure high-quality patient support, consistent program execution, appropriate clinical escalation, and successful implementation and growth of remote monitoring programs. The manager will also have a patient load approx. 50% compared to staff.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Management

• Lead and manage the Remote Care Navigator team, including workload allocation, coverage, coaching, development, and day-to-day operational support.

• Establish clear expectations, roles, and standardized ways of working across the RCN team.

• Support onboarding, training, and ongoing development of new and existing RCNs.

• Ensure appropriate staffing and coverage as patient volume and acct needs evolve.

Clinical & Patient Operations

• Oversee delivery of remote patient monitoring services across supported transplant programs.

• Ensure RCNs consistently review patient data, conduct clinical assessments, educate patients, coordinate care, and escalate concerns according to established protocols.

• Provide leadership support for complex patient, clinical, or workflow escalations.

• Ensure consistent patient engagement and follow-up practices across accounts.

Quality, Compliance & Operational Excellence

• Establish and monitor quality standards for clinical documentation, patient engagement, escalation, and operational workflows.

• Conduct or oversee clinical quality audits and drive corrective actions and process improvements.

• Ensure appropriate documentation supporting RPM billing and patient eligibility requirements.

• Maintain compliance with applicable company policies, training requirements, and established customer protocols.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, standardization, and scalability.

Account & Program Management

• Partner with transplant center teams to support effective execution of remote monitoring programs.

• Serve as an escalation point for operational and clinical workflow issues.

• Support onboarding and implementation of new AlloHome accounts.

• Partner with customers to refine workflows and ensure successful ongoing program execution.

• Review program performance, compliance reporting, patient engagement trends, and operational needs with internal and external stakeholders.

Growth & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with Product, Commercial, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to support program growth.

• Support product demonstrations, implementations, and customer education as appropriate.

• 2+ years’ prior experience with people leadership, clinical team leadership, or demonstrated experience leading clinical workflows preferred.

• Strong understanding of clinical operations, patient engagement, documentation, quality, and escalation processes.

• Experience working across clinical, operational, commercial, and technology teams.

• Strong communication and relationship-management skills.

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.




ROLE

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Talent and Production Coordinator to join our creative agency and studio. In this role, you will play a crucial part in coordinating talent availability, booking and briefing talent, and ensuring the smooth execution of our projects. 

As a Talent and Production Coordinator, you will be responsible for understanding client briefs, casting the right talent, and maintaining an up-to-date talent database. Additionally, you will be involved in outreach and casting efforts to bring new talent onboard.

 - Coordinate talent availability and manage scheduling for projects, ensuring talent is booked efficiently and effectively.

 - Maintain and update a comprehensive talent database, ensuring accurate and current information for each talent profile.

 - Exposure to talent coordination and casting, preferably in a creative agency or studio setting.

 - Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accurate and efficient talent scheduling.

 - Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively brief and collaborate with talent and internal teams.

 - Resourceful problem solver who can think on their feet and adapt quickly to changing project requirements.
