jobs.title: Partner Account Manager, Eastern Pennsylvania
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager’s primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest’s key accounts and growth opportunities. We're looking for a forward-thinking, meticulously organized, and self-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast-paced environment.  You'll accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth. This role requires someone who is proactive, creative, and can exercise their own discretion and judgment to create their own solutions when needed.

What you get to do every day

• Develop, build, and amplify referral relationships with tech partners, human capital management partners, benefit brokers, CPA's and financial advisors in the SMB space

• Create and build strategic referral networks and partnerships focused on lead generation and new partnership opportunities

• Proactively identify and resolve emerging issues and offer solutions by working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal and Finance

• Collaborate with Partner Marketing to innovate and execute unique initiatives to promote partner sales (e.g, educational events, email, webinars, etc.)

• Work with partners to establish business goals and performance metrics (e.g, depth of sales pipeline and revenue generation) to develop and execute effective go-to-market strategies and demand-generation activities

What you bring to the role

• 2+ years of experience building, developing, and maintaining relationships with tech and human capital management (HCM) partners, benefit brokers, CPA's and financial advisors in the SMB space (including territory sales and business development)

• Successful - Proven track record of success in a quota driven sales environment

• Passionate - You are a highly motivated individual contributor and relationship builder that can operate independently

• Dynamic - You can thrive in a fast-paced, and ever-changing environment

• Resilient—You bounce back from setbacks quickly, are resourceful, and find creative ways to get things done.

• Solutions-oriented - Willingness to get your hands dirty while managing and solving operational partnership issues

• Extraordinary communication and interpersonal skills — people trust you and sense that you are advocating for something you believe.

• Tech-savvy - familiarity using Salesforce to manage sales cycles is preferred

• Growth mindset - You can embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable.

• Coachable- Ability to absorb information, training, and guidance and successfully implement and execute

• Travel - Ability to be In the field 3 days/week. Valid Drivers License required.

• Events - Attend and appropriately execute on all partner-related meetings, corporate and events

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

• Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.

• Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.

• Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!

• An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.

• Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, we consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate pay range for each position, including the cost of labor in different markets across the U.S. The total On Target Earnings (OTE) for the role described in this job posting is $130,000 - $140,000 which includes a base salary of $60,000 - $70,000, and a variable target compensation of $70,000. The specific pay rate offered is based on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. Base pay is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. Additionally, employees receive stock option grants, enhancing long-term financial growth and investment in our company's success.

Benefits -

• A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees

• Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance

• Competitive time off and parental leave

• Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness

• Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents

• Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits

• Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt

• Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend

• Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

• Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)

• Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)

• Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)

• America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)

• A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)

• Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

Human Interest is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws.

We are committed to making every stage of our application process fully accessible to all individuals. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the process, please let us know at applicantaccommodations@humaninterest.com.

Protect yourself against fraud and identity theft. Apply to our open positions directly via our careers page on Greenhouse. Human Interest will never ask applicants for their financial or banking information as part of our application process. All legitimate communication will come from a @humaninterest.com email address. If you have questions, please reach out to us directly at careers@humaninterest.com

Please note Human Interest does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates. We will not consider resumes from vendors, including and without limitation search firms, staffing agencies, fee-based referral services, and recruiting agencies.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We comply with CCPA guidelines.

See more: https://humaninterest.com/disclosures

jobs.title: Senior Global Health Security (GHS) Advisor for Laboratory Strengthening, DOS LEAP Global - Kyrgyzstan
jobs.description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

LEAP Program Description

Global Solutions Ventures (GSV) – a joint-venture partnership between ZemiTek, LLC and Dexis Consulting Group – is implementing the Long-term Exceptional Technical Assistance Project (LEAP Global), a mechanism originally used by USAID to battle against infectious diseases such as malaria, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, neglected tropical diseases, and pandemic influenza. As of July 1, 2025, LEAP Global transitioned to the U.S. Department of State (DOS). This initiative aims to address the complex human resource challenges faced by national infectious disease programs in the USA-supported countries.

The intervention of this project is to hire and embed technical expert advisors and subject matter experts within government entities. By directly embedding the technical expertise within the national programs, LEAP provides long-term, sustainable lifesaving support to empower host governments to lead and manage key aspects of their infectious disease portfolios and improve coordination between the U.S. Government and the host country.

About the Position

The Senior GHS Technical Advisor for Laboratory Strengthening will support the U.S. Department of State (DoS) in advancing the objectives of the America First Global Health Strategy (AFGHS) by providing strategic and technical assistance to strengthen the national laboratory system in the Kyrgyz Republic. The Advisor will focus on enhancing national and subnational capacities to prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats, with particular emphasis on laboratory networks, molecular diagnostics, genomic surveillance, and pathogen sequencing. The Advisor will support the Ministry of Health and Department of State in carrying out life-saving humanitarian assistance (LHA) service delivery in full alignment with the new Presidential Executive Order (EO) directives.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Laboratory System Strengthening

• Provide strategic and technical leadership for the GHS laboratory strengthening component.

• Assess national and subnational laboratory capacities, identify gaps, and support the development of improvement strategies, action plans, and sustainable laboratory networks.

• Provide technical guidance on the implementation and optimization of molecular diagnostic methods, including PCR.

• Strengthen coordination, referral systems, and information sharing across human and animal health laboratories, aligned with IHR, international recommendations, and NAPHS priorities.

Laboratory Diagnostics, Quality Management, and Biosafety

• Support strengthening diagnostic capacities for priority emerging, epidemic-prone, respiratory, and zoonotic diseases.

• Promote standardized diagnostic protocols, SOPs, specimen management, transportation, and timely reporting.

• Support implementation of laboratory quality management systems, external quality assessment, proficiency testing, and accreditation in line with ISO 15189.

• Strengthen biosafety and biosecurity practices, including risk assessment, safe specimen handling, and appropriate containment.

Genomic Surveillance and Pathogen Sequencing

• Lead efforts to establish and strengthen national genomic surveillance and pathogen sequencing capacities, including whole-genome sequencing (WGS).

• Assess and support sequencing infrastructure, technologies, workforce, and bioinformatics capacities, including appropriate platforms such as Illumina, Oxford Nanopore and others.

• Strengthen sequencing workforce, bioinformatics, genomic data analysis, interpretation, data management, and sharing.

• Promote integration of genomic, epidemiological, and clinical data to support pathogen monitoring, outbreak investigations, and public health decision-making.

Laboratory Surveillance and Emergency Preparedness and Response

• Strengthen integration of laboratory and epidemiological surveillance for early detection and response to public health threats.

• Support timely laboratory investigations, outbreak confirmation, and surge testing during public health emergencies.

• Improve communication and reporting between laboratories, surveillance institutions, and emergency response teams.

• Promote the use of laboratory and genomic data in risk assessments, outbreak investigations, and preparedness planning.

Capacity Building, Coordination, and Partnerships

• Assess workforce capacity and support training, mentoring, and professional development in diagnostics, sequencing, bioinformatics, and laboratory management.

• Coordinate with the MoH, national laboratories, academic institutions, and relevant international partners, including FAO, WOAH, and CDC.

• Facilitate One Health collaboration across human, animal, and environmental health sectors and ensure coordination of partner supported activities.

• Provide technical inputs into program strategies, work plans, budgets, and procurement plans.

Reporting and Coordination Arrangements

The Advisor will report to the DoS designated Point of Contact (POC), receive technical guidance from DoS, and coordinate closely with the MoH and its relevant institutions. The Advisor will provide a detailed monthly report to the U.S. Department of State submitted by the 5th day of the following month and participate in regular coordination meetings with DoS and MoH counterparts to review progress, address challenges, and agree on priorities and upcoming activities. The Advisor will support and work closely with the implementing partner to carry out the GHS program within the country. Additionally, the Advisor will submit a weekly progress report to U.S. Embassy/Department of State (and participate in weekly calls) to include a short paragraph about main successes for that week.

Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Virology, Medicine and Laboratory Medicine, Epidemiology, Public Health, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field.

• Specialized training in genomic surveillance, bioinformatics, or laboratory management is an advantage.

• At least 10 years of relevant experience in public health laboratory systems, infectious disease diagnostics, microbiology, or molecular diagnostics.

• Demonstrated experience strengthening laboratory systems and networks, including quality management and accreditation.

• Expertise in PCR-based diagnostics, genomic surveillance, pathogen sequencing, and WGS.

• Experience with Illumina and/or Oxford Nanopore sequencing platforms and bioinformatics is highly desirable.

• Proven ability to support government institutions in developing laboratory strategies, policies, SOPs, and technical guidelines.

• Experience in Global Health Security, IHR implementation, outbreak preparedness and response, and collaboration with government and international partners is an advantage.

• Proven ability to communicate quickly, clearly and concisely – both orally and in writing -- in English is essential.

Benefits

Dexis offers benefits to support employees’ health, financial security, and well-being. The benefits outlined below are for full-time, US-based positions only. These benefits include:

• Medical and prescription drug coverage: A choice of three UnitedHealthcare medical plans, with coverage options for employees and eligible dependents.

• Dental insurance: Dental coverage for employees and eligible dependents, including preventive, basic, major, and orthodontic services, subject to plan limits.

• Company-paid vision insurance: Vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, with premiums paid in full by Dexis.

• Employer-funded health reimbursement arrangement (HRA): Employees who enroll in the Silver HRA medical plan receive an employer-funded HRA to help pay eligible in-network deductible expenses.

• Company-paid life and disability insurance: Basic life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage.

• Optional supplemental insurance: Voluntary supplemental life and AD&D insurance options, including life insurance options for eligible dependents.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Company-paid access to confidential counseling and legal and financial support resources for employees and their families.

• Health and wellness resources: Virtual care, behavioral health resources, and wellness programs available through the medical plan.

• Benefits assistance: Personalized support with benefit enrollment, coverage questions, claims, and finding providers through the Employee Care Center.

Participation, coverage, and employee contributions are subject to applicable benefit plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

Unify is building the first AI-native outbound platform where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40+ sources, and execute personalized, multi-channel outreach—all from a single AI-powered workspace.

Trusted by some of the most innovative go-to-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to 90% time savings on list building and 19% higher output per rep.

We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

Our New Business Representatives (NBRs) generate some of Unify's highest-quality, highest-converting pipeline, and they are among the best-paid outbound reps in the industry. We are scaling the team quickly across New York and San Francisco, and we need a leader to own it.

As our first NBR Manager, you will lead a team of 6+ reps, many of them early in their sales careers. You will own the team's number, build the systems that ramp new hires fast, and coach every rep to own their own number. You will also be a key voice in how Unify sells: what we learn on the phones every day shapes our messaging, our targeting and our product.

This role is for a leader who has carried a quota, knows what good looks like on a cold call, and gets energy from making other people better.



What You'll Do

 - Own the number: Deliver the team's monthly qualified pipeline (S2) target and forecast it accurately. Know at any moment which reps are on pace, which are not, and why.

 - Coach daily: Run weekly 1:1s, call reviews and live mock sessions. Turn every rep into a strong cold caller and a sharp discovery partner for our AEs.

 - Ramp new hires: Own NBR onboarding, from week-one training through certification, so new reps hit ramp targets in their first 90 days.

 - Hire the team: Partner with Recruiting to source, interview and close top NBR talent as we grow.

 - Build the playbook: Codify winning talk tracks, signals and plays inside Unify so every rep benefits from what the best rep learns.

 - Partner across GTM: Work closely with AE leadership on handoffs and meeting quality, with RevOps on territories, routing and reporting, and with Product to feed back what the market is telling us.



What You'll Need

 - Experience: 3+ years in outbound sales (SDR/BDR and/or AE), with a track record of top performance, and 1+ years leading or formally coaching reps. High-velocity B2B SaaS preferred.

 - Coaching ability: You can listen to a cold call or discovery call and give specific, actionable feedback the rep can use on their next dial.

 - Operating rigor: You run your team on data: activity, conversion and pipeline. You spot a problem in the numbers before it shows up in the forecast.

 - Recruiting eye: You can tell who will succeed in an outbound role, including candidates selling for the first time.

 - Tech stack: Fluent in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales engagement tools. Curious about how AI changes the outbound motion.

 - Attitude: You lead from the front. You will pick up the phone alongside your team, hold a high bar and take ownership when results fall short.

jobs.title: Behavior Interventionist
jobs.description:
Centria Autism is hiring Behavior Technicians to work one-on-one with children with autism using Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA therapy). No experience is required. We pay you during your 40-hour training and cover the full cost of your Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

If you've worked in childcare, babysitting, teaching, tutoring, caregiving, or customer service, or you're a student in psychology or education, your skills transfer directly. We'll teach you the rest.

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Why you'll love working here

• Paid training: Earn while you complete your 40-hour RBT online course.

• Get paid fast: Early wage access to employees through Rain - Work today, get paid tomorrow!

jobs.title: Physician-Vein Specialist
jobs.description:
Do you love to help people? Do you want to be a part of something bigger than yourself? Do you wish your voice was heard at work?

If you answered yes to these questions, consider a career at Miller Vein.

Physician-Vein Specialist

Location: Southeast Michigan
Employment Type: Full-Time | Four-Day Workweek
Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Productivity Incentives

About Miller Vein

After 20 years, Miller Vein is ready for the next level. We're looking for physicians who want to help take us there.

For 20 years, Miller Vein has grown into Michigan's largest independent, physician-owned vein practice, with 8 clinics, more than 47,000 patients, more than 3,600 referring physicians, and more than 3,000 five-star Google reviews. Our goal is bold: to become the nation's largest independent vein practice by 2030, without private equity.

We're hiring a Vein Specialist Physician to evaluate and treat patients with venous and lymphatic disease in a modern, office-based procedural practice. You'll join a physician-led team where honest, appropriate care comes first, and where there's real room to grow into leadership, teaching, and new programs as we expand.

Vein experience is not required. We provide full training, and we welcome physicians from any specialty.

What You'll Do

Patient Care

• Evaluate and manage patients with venous and lymphatic disorders.

• Interpret venous duplex ultrasound studies.

• Build individualized treatment plans focused on appropriate care.

Procedures

• Perform office-based, minimally invasive vein procedures.

• Maintain high standards for safety, outcomes, and patient experience.

Team and Practice Growth

• Lead and collaborate with RVTs, APPs, certified lymphedema therapists, and clinical staff.

• Take part in clinical growth initiatives and physician education.

• Help maintain Miller Vein's reputation for outstanding patient care and integrity, and contribute to a positive, team-oriented culture.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• MD or DO degree.

• Eligible for medical licensure in Michigan.

• Board certified or board eligible in your specialty.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• A patient-centered mindset.

• Interest in procedural medicine and longitudinal patient care.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced clinical environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in venous and lymphatic medicine.

• RPVI certification.

• Board certification in Venous and Lymphatic Medicine.

• Experience with ultrasound-guided procedures.

Backgrounds We Welcome

All specialties welcome, including Interventional Radiology, Vascular Surgery, General Surgery, Emergency Medicine, and Venous & Lymphatic Medicine. Full training provided.

Why You'll Want This Role

• You'll practice medicine the way it should be practiced. We're physician-led and independent. Clinical decisions are made by physicians, not by a private-equity platform.

• You'll join an established practice. A full back office handles scheduling, insurance, billing, and authorizations, and a network of more than 3,600 referring physicians supports steady patient demand, so you can focus on patient care.

• You'll do procedures you enjoy, with the tools to do them well. Office-based, minimally invasive care with state-of-the-art ultrasound and an experienced team of RVTs beside you.

• You'll have a life outside work. A four-day workweek, competitive PTO, and paid time off between Christmas and New Year's.

• You won't be practicing alone. You'll be backed by a skilled support team of RVTs, APPs, certified lymphedema therapists, and clinical staff, so your clinic days run smoothly.

• There's room to grow. As we expand, physicians can step into leadership, program development, teaching and mentorship, regional roles, and clinical specialization.

The Challenges Ahead

We want you to know what you're walking into.

• Honest care means sometimes saying no. We tell patients plainly when they do and don't need treatment. You'll need to be comfortable recommending against a procedure when it isn't right for the patient.

• Patient education takes time. We want physicians who are willing to slow down and explain vein disease and its management, so patients understand their options and make good decisions.

• The pace is fast. Four-day weeks are full days, with a steady mix of consultations, ultrasound review, and procedures.

• There's a learning curve if vein care is new to you. Venous duplex interpretation and venous treatment planning take real study. We'll train you, and we'll expect you to put in the work.

• Insurers expect careful documentation. Coverage often depends on clear clinical findings and treatment history, so thorough, accurate notes matter.

• Growth can't change who we are. As we expand, every physician helps protect the quality and integrity our patients count on.

If these sound like the kind of work you want to do, we want to hear from you.

How You'll Work With Others

• Dr. Miller and Physician Colleagues: Share cases, standards, and best practices, and help shape how we deliver care as we grow.

• RVTs: Partner on duplex studies and procedural ultrasound guidance.

• APPs: Share the patient load and provide clinical oversight and collaboration.

• Certified Lymphedema Therapists: Coordinate care for patients with lymphatic disease.

• Director of Clinical Operations: Keep clinics staffed, scheduled, and ready to serve the patients who need us.

Who Thrives Here

• You love procedures and you love explaining things to patients.

• You'd rather do the right thing for a patient than the profitable thing.

• You want to grow with a practice, not just work in one.

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive base salary plus productivity incentives

• 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k)

• Competitive PTO, plus paid time off between Christmas and New Year's

• Four-day workweek

• CME allowance

• Malpractice coverage

• Relocation assistance available

Our Culture – HiTECH Values

We use advanced technology, but our people make the difference.

• Humble Service: We put others first with genuine compassion.

• Integrity: We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

• Teamwork: None of us performs as well as all of us.

• Excellence: We passionately pursue perfection, because our patients deserve nothing less.

• Can-do Positive Attitude: We meet challenges with optimism and energy.

• Happy to Go the Extra Mile: We love exceeding expectations for patients and teammates.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Miller Vein is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Company Background

Miller Vein is a unique healthcare company committed to improving lives, one vein at a time. But we're so much more than a vein clinic. We're a movement. A fast-paced, high-energy team working to make healthcare better for our patients, our teammates, and our communities.

Our patients regularly tell us their experience at Miller Vein wasn't just the best medical visit they've ever had, but one of the best customer service experiences they've ever received. That doesn't happen by accident. It happens because we hire people who genuinely care.

We've earned multiple Best Places to Work awards because we believe exceptional patient care starts with exceptional teammates. We hire for attitude, kindness, and character. Skills can be taught. Genuine compassion cannot.

Our culture is built around six core values. Together, they spell HiTECH, reminding us that while we use advanced technology, it's our people who truly make the difference.

• Humble Service – We put others first with genuine compassion and care.

• Integrity – We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

• Teamwork – None of us performs as well as all of us.

• Excellence – We pursue continuous improvement every day.

• Can-do Positive Attitude – We embrace challenges with optimism, energy, and enthusiasm.

• Happy to Go the Extra Mile – We love exceeding expectations for our patients and teammates.

We're a team of competitive, ambitious people working toward a bold vision: becoming the nation's leading provider of vein care by 2030. We believe the way to achieve that goal is by building the best-trained, happiest workforce imaginable. When our teammates thrive, our patients thrive. That's how we help more people and make an even greater impact.

Miller Vein Perks

• Competitive pay

• 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for eligible employees

• 401(k)

• Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Healthy work-life balance, including four-day weekends every other weekend for many clinic team members

• No evening, weekend, or holiday work (almost never)

• Paid office closure between Christmas and New Year's Day

• Community service opportunities

• Continuing education support

• Positive, upbeat office environments where teammates take care of one another

• Fun company outings

What Success Looks Like at Miller Vein

• Lead with kindness, compassion, and authenticity.

• Deliver an exceptional patient experience every time.

• Stay curious, keep learning, and seek continuous improvement.

• Support your teammates and contribute to a positive team culture.

• Bring a positive attitude and a willingness to help.

• Share ideas, solve problems, and look for better ways to do things.

• Celebrate successes and have fun along the way.

jobs.title: Senior, Vehicle Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Kodiak AI, Inc. (Nasdaq: KDK), founded in 2018, is a leader in Physical AI, developing driverless technology that powers machines that move. Its Kodiak Driver is a vehicle-agnostic autonomous driving system that combines AI-powered software with modular hardware. Today it operates in long-haul trucking, industrial trucking, and defense. In 2024, Kodiak launched commercial Driver-as-a-Service operations with no one in the cab, and plans to launch driverless long-haul service between Dallas and Houston by the end of 2026.

Kodiak has partnered with many of the biggest names in freight, including Bosch for scaled hardware production, AWS, and leading customers including Atlas Energy Solutions, IKEA, Bridgestone, Werner Enterprises, C.R. England, Roehl Transport, and General Dynamics Land Systems.

We are looking for a Senior Vehicle Integration Engineer with deep experience in new platform development and system-level integration. This role is at the forefront of bringing next-generation autonomous vehicle platforms to life — from early-stage concept through integration, validation, and deployment. You will work closely with hardware, systems, and manufacturing teams to drive new platform development, with a focus on integration quality, test rigor, and technical execution.

In this role, you will:

• Lead system-level integration of sensors, compute, actuation, and vehicle systems for new platform development programs

• Drive the full integration lifecycle: architecture definition, build planning, bring-up, validation, and sign-off

• Develop and execute structured test plans to validate new platform functionality, performance, and reliability

• Coordinate and lead cross-functional build and integration events with Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, and Systems teams

• Provide Design-For-Manufacturing and Design-For-Test feedback to ensure new platforms are built for quality and scale

• Develop and maintain comprehensive platform documentation including drawings, schematics, BOMs, build instructions, and test reports

• Identify, triage, and resolve integration issues through systematic debugging and root cause analysis

• Partner with systems and hardware engineering teams to define integration requirements and acceptance criteria for new platforms

What you'll bring:

You should have most of the following to be successful:

• Strong technical background. BS or MS in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering with 6+ years of experience in the autonomous vehicle, automotive, or a related industry

• Demonstrated experience leading new platform or new product integration programs from early development through validation

• Strong systems thinking and problem-solving skills; you are energized by complex, multi-disciplinary integration challenges

• Hands-on. You are equally comfortable with a wrench and a keyboard. Confident with automotive electronics and familiar with communication protocols and tools such as Ethernet and CAN

• Experience with scripting and data analysis languages such as Python or MATLAB

• Understanding of Linux-based systems and computer networking

• CAD experience with packages such as SolidWorks

• A team leader. Whether formally or informally, you have played the lead role on multiple integration or development programs. You take ownership and drive teams to deliver results

• Great communicator. You write clear, concise, and detailed technical documentation, and are skilled at leading and participating in cross-functional design and integration reviews

• Proven ability to drive testing through development, execution, analysis, corrective actions, and final report-outs across all stages of product development

What we offer:

• Competitive compensation package including equity and annual bonuses

• Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision plans through Kaiser Permanente, Cigna, and MetLife (including a medical plan with infertility benefits)

• MetLife Legal Services, Identity & Fraud Protection, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Accident Insurance, & Critical Illness Insurance

• Flexible PTO, 10 paid holidays, and generous parental leave policies

• Our office is centrally located in Mountain View, CA

• Office perks: dog-friendly, free catered lunch, a fully stocked kitchen, and free EV charging

• Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance

• Wellbeing Benefits - Headspace through Cigna, Calm through Kaiser, One Medical, Gympass, Spring Health through Cigna, Rula (mental health navigation)

• Fidelity 401(k)

• Commuter, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, HSA

• Various incentive programs (referral bonuses, patent bonuses, etc.)

The pay range listed below reflects the base salary in our SF/Silicon Valley location, across several internal levels. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors including: work location, experience, relevant training, education, skill level and performance during interview. Total compensation at Kodiak includes base pay, equity, bonus and a competitive benefits package

California Pay Range

$150,000—$185,000 USD

At Kodiak, we strive to build a diverse community working towards our common company goals in a safe and collaborative environment where harassment of any kind is strictly prohibited. Kodiak is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

In alignment with its business operations, Kodiak adheres to all relevant statutes, regulations, and administrative prerequisites. Accordingly, roles that carry more sensitive requirements may be limited to candidates that can satisfy additional scrutiny and eligibility for such positions may hinge on verification of a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status. Should the position require, and Kodiak determines that a candidate’s residence, U.S. person status, and/or citizenship status necessitate an export license, bar the candidate from the position, or otherwise fall under national security-related restrictions, Kodiak will consider the candidate for alternative positions unaffected by such restrictions, under terms and conditions set forth at Kodiak’s sole discretion, or, as an alternative, opt not to proceed with the candidate’s application. If applicable, Kodiak may provide visa sponsorship for eligible candidates.

We use a third-party AI tool (Endorsed) to assist in the initial screening of applications. As part of the evaluation process, we provide Endorsed with job requirements and candidate-submitted applications. Final hiring decisions are made by our human recruitment team, and no automated system makes the ultimate decision regarding hiring. Certain features of the platform may qualify it as an Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) under applicable regulations. We began using Endorsed on January 1, 2026. You can review the independent bias audit report covering our use of Endorsed [here](https://endorsed.com/local-law-144). By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your application may be processed by AI systems as part of the screening and selection process. If you have any questions or would like to request a separate review of your application, please contact careers@kodiak.ai with "Separate Review Request" in the email subject line.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (R, SAS, SQL) - w/ Public Health Data Experience (Job 1528)
jobs.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through scientific research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

DLH Corporation is looking for a Public Health Data Analyst using R, SAS, and SQL to join our talented and innovative team supporting the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in Atlanta, GA. This is a hybrid work environment based in Atlanta. Teleworking most days, with visits to the CDC campus for in-person meetings and office visits.

CDC’s National Center for HIV/AIDS, Viral Hepatitis, STD, and TB Prevention (NCHHSTP), the Division of HIV Prevention (DHP), is charged with preventing HIV infection and reducing the incidence of HIV-related illness and death. The overarching objectives of the contract held by DLH are to assist DHP in addressing its public health mission by providing data management, data governance, data analysis, and data dissemination support to strengthen the nationwide capacity to monitor the HIV epidemic. As such, DLH is seeking an Atlanta-based Data Analyst with the following skills:

Responsibilities

• Work with geospatial and molecular HIV data using R, SAS, SQL, REDCAP or Python.

• Run the recurring weekly and quarterly pipelines; diagnose and fix failures when upstream files, column headers, REDCap fields or database structures change; keep run logs, diagnostics, and reconciliation checks working.

• Add features and new measures to existing tools; consolidate shared code, add tests against the existing synthetic-data demo harness.

• Support the REDCap project: data-dictionary and branching-logic updates, instrument revisions, user and Data Access Group administration, and coordination with the REDCap administrators on migrations or structural changes

• Build and run completeness, consistency, and timeliness checks on submitted forms; identify systematic entry problems; propose and implement form or guidance changes that reduce them; track improvement over time.

• Respond to one-off analytic requests from CDC and its partners using the same data sources — descriptive tabulations, record matching, trend summaries, figures — with documented methods and reproducible code.

• Keep SOPs, in-line annotations, run instructions, and hand-off notes current

• Check every change before release; compare outputs against saved baselines; document any change to a published number.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in public health, statistics, or related field.

• 2 years of strong expertise demonstrated experience with R, SAS, SQL (developing scripts from scratch, not just exposure).

• Familiarity with public health surveillance (familiarity with HIV surveillance desirable)

• Ability to read, audit, test, and safely modify a large existing code base.

• Experience using record linkage and data-cleaning fundamentals (standardizing identifiers, handling format variants, deduplication, documenting match rules).

• Strong critical thinking and communication (written and verbal) skills.

• Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in public health, statistics, or related field.

• Experience with Python and REDCap preferred.

• Knowledge of HIV, molecular data, and public health surveillance systems.

• Experience with large (>500,000 observations), document-based datasets.

• Experience working with molecular disease detection data.

Benefits

DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.

EEO

DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.  DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.

DLH is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic interview process

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, Science
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Click Therapeutics, Inc., develops, validates, and commercializes software as prescription medical treatments for people with unmet medical needs. As a leading innovator of Digital Therapeutics™, Click delivers accessible, clinically proven, FDA-regulated prescription treatments to the smartphone in your hand. Click’s treatments are defined by a commitment to applying technical and scientific rigor and patient-centric design to the development process. This results in uniquely engaging experiences that achieve compelling clinical outcomes for patients seeking new treatment options. Click Therapeutics continuously expands and refines its platform with novel cognitive, behavioral and neuromodulatory mechanisms of action and advanced data-driven tools such as artificial intelligence and machine learning. The digital therapeutics under development on Click’s platform address diverse areas of therapeutic need, including indications in psychiatry, neurology, oncology, immunology, and cardiometabolic diseases. Consistently named a best place to work, Click fosters an inclusive, diverse workforce of innovators, clinicians, scientists, researchers, designers, technologists, engineers and more, united in a common mission to provide patients everywhere access to safe and effective prescription digital therapeutics. For more information, visit www.clicktherapeutics.com and connect with us on LinkedIn.

About the Role:

The Director/Senior Director, Science plays an integral role that bridges scientific innovation, product development, clinical evidence, and commercial strategy. This person will act as a key scientific representative for Click, driving scientific communications and heavily enabling Business Development efforts.

Because we operate in a lean, fast-paced environment, the ideal candidate is highly flexible, action-oriented, and not overly process-driven. You will act as a scientific subject matter expert who can seamlessly pivot to support various products across our pipeline. We are looking for an MD or PhD with a strong academic and publication record who is eager to write, speak, and publish externally to elevate Click’s scientific presence, while actively driving business partnerships forward.

This position can either be based out of Click’s headquarters located in Tribeca, NYC or remote. We have a hybrid working model that consists of at least 4 days in office each week if you are not remote.

Responsibilities:

Scientific Communications & External Leadership

• Publish & Speak: Take a leading role in writing and publishing peer-reviewed papers, white papers, and clinical data presentations. Actively represent Click at external scientific, medical, and industry conferences.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Identify, build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinicians, and academic researchers.

• Bridging Science & Strategy: Translate complex clinical data and evidence-based medicine into compelling scientific narratives for external audiences, ensuring actionable insights are communicated effectively.

Business Development Enablement & Strategic Growth

• BD Support: Provide deep scientific and medical credibility to business development efforts. Partner closely with the commercial and BD teams to evaluate opportunities, conduct scientific diligence, and create compelling proposals for partners.

• Partner Management: Serve as a scientific face of the company for existing and emerging partnerships, acting as a liaison between external stakeholders and internal R&D/product teams.

Cross-Functional Product Support

• Flexible Execution: Operate comfortably in a lean, dynamic startup environment. Provide hands-on scientific and medical leadership across multiple digital therapeutic products and pipeline assets as needed on a day-to-day basis.

• Product Collaboration: Work closely with product, clinical, and regulatory teams to ensure that product development aligns with the latest clinical evidence and market access requirements in a regulated space.

Qualifications:

At Click, we aren't just looking for talent; we are looking for the next evolution of the modern professional. To us, AI is not a future possibility, it is a present-day prerequisite. We expect every Click colleague to have seamlessly integrated AI into their professional workflow and personal productivity, using it as a force multiplier to move faster, think deeper, and deliver superlative results that were previously out of reach. If you do not yet view AI as an essential partner in your daily pursuit of excellence, you will find it impossible to keep pace with our mission. High performers who harness AI technology to transcend traditional boundaries and set new benchmarks for professional excellence will thrive at Click.

• Education: A doctoral/professional degree (MD, PhD, PsyD, PharmD) is required.

• Clinical/Therapeutic Expertise: Deep expertise in a CNS discipline (e.g., psychiatry, neurology, psychology) and experience with evidence-based nonpharmacological / biobehavioral treatment is required. Experience in product development, biometric data, and clinical development is highly preferred. . Clinical practice experience is a plus.

• Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in the life sciences, digital health, or pharmaceutical industry within a regulated space. Prior experience in product development, Medical Affairs, Scientific Affairs, or Commercial/BD enablement is highly desired.

• External Presence: Established record and proven willingness to write, publish, and speak externally.

• Work Style: Highly flexible, adaptable, and action-oriented. Not overly process-driven; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and roll up your sleeves to support various products and initiatives simultaneously.

• Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex scientific and clinical concepts into business opportunities and accessible language for diverse audiences.

Compensation:

The base salary range for this position is between: $165,000 - $195,000. The final base salary will be dependent upon skills, experience and location. In addition to the base salary, Click Therapeutics offers an annual performance-based cash bonus and a generous equity package.

Benefits:

The role includes great benefits and is an excellent wealth-building opportunity at a fast-growing pre-IPO company in a nascent and extremely exciting space.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, USA)
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

• Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.

• Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.

• Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.

• Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.

• Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.

• Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.

• Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.

• Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage

• Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.

• Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.

• A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.

• The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.

• Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.

• You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.

• Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

• Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability

• Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.

• Building self-service infrastructure for application teams

• Running observability for a production platform at scale

• Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure

• You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

#LI-Remote

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: UI/UX Design Lead
jobs.description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

At PMG, our UI/UX team is focused on creating experiences that are as thoughtful and intuitive as they are beautiful. Central to this effort is our design system, the backbone of consistent, scalable, and accessible digital experiences across our enterprise SaaS platform. We believe robust design systems are critical infrastructure that enables teams to deliver exceptional user experiences efficiently and at scale.  You will lead strategic design initiatives, strengthen our design systems practice, and help define how artificial intelligence transforms modern marketing experiences.

This is a senior level design leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems thinking, emerging technology, and human centered design. You will collaborate with product, engineering, data science, and AI experts to create intelligent, scalable experiences that push the boundaries of what marketing technology can be.

We are looking for a design leader with deep expertise in design systems, strong executional craft, and demonstrated fluency in AI driven workflows including Figma Make, large language models, and modern AI powered design tools.  You'll collaborate primarily with front-end engineers, product teams, and fellow designers as the technical bridge between design intent and production reality.

As our UI/UX Design Lead, if you're passionate about systematic design, technical collaboration, and building the infrastructure that enables great experiences at scale, this is where you'll make your most significant impact.

What You Will Do

Strategic Design Leadership

• Lead the design of complex product experiences across the full lifecycle, from discovery and research through delivery and iteration.

• Translate ambiguous ideas into structured workflows, interaction models, and detailed interface specifications.

• Guide cross-functional teams toward user-centered solutions that balance business goals, technical feasibility, and user needs.

• Clearly articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across product, engineering, and executive leadership.

AI-Driven Experience Innovation

• Explore and apply AI/LLM capabilities to enhance product experiences within marketing technology.

• Leverage Figma Make and AI-powered design workflows to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and production.

• Design intelligent, adaptive interfaces that thoughtfully incorporate automation, predictive insights, and generative capabilities.

• Collaborate with data and AI teams to shape user-facing experiences that responsibly leverage machine learning.

• Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools and methodologies to improve both the user experience and the design practice.

User Research & Validation

• Conduct and guide research efforts including user interviews, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations.

• Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.

• Utilize analytics and experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, behavioral analysis) to optimize experience effectiveness.

• Ensure accessibility and inclusive design principles are embedded throughout the product.

Team & Practice Leadership

• Mentor and elevate junior designers through critique, collaboration, and design reviews.

• Contribute to the evolution of PMG’s UX design standards and processes.

• Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and thoughtful risk-taking.

• Present work confidently to internal teams and senior stakeholders, championing design excellence.

What You Will Bring

• 5+ years of product design experience, with demonstrated impact leading complex, multi-surface initiatives across web and platform experiences.

• Proven ability to drive consistency and quality at scale by partnering with Design Systems and Engineering teams to evolve shared patterns, contribute reusable components, and ensure adoption across product areas.

• Experience leading cross-functional collaboration with Product and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences, aligning interaction patterns and UI decisions to both user needs and platform standards.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including deep experience with libraries, variants, auto-layout, and prototyping.

• Solid understanding of front-end technology fundamentals (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) and experience with build tools, package management, and version control (Git).

• Ability to read and review code, contribute to technical discussions, and understand the implications of design decisions on performance and maintainability.

• Deep knowledge of accessibility standards (ADA/WCAG) and practical experience applying them to component design.

• Demonstrated systems thinking, with the ability to connect individual feature work to broader ecosystem implications, platform constraints, and long-term maintainability.

• Strong judgment in balancing craft, speed, and scalability, knowing when to leverage existing patterns versus advocating for new approaches in service of user experience and product clarity.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Penetration Tester
jobs.description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Security Engineer - Penetration Tester

León Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home

Role overview

Ebury is investing heavily in product security across its global financial services. Security engineering is a technical, hands-on team that works with software and platform engineers to build security into what they ship.

We don't own security policies, internal audit or other GRC work, IT security (such as anti-malware) or security operations, including incident response.

We work on engineering problems: vulnerability management, AI threat modeling, SSDLC, DRP, infrastructure hardening and other security engineering projects.

As a Senior Security Engineer Penetration Tester, you will test Ebury's security across web applications, mobile apps, APIs and cloud infrastructure. You'll combine manual testing with continuous automated testing, coordinate third-party pentests, and help engineering teams understand and fix what you find.

Key responsibilities

• Perform manual penetration tests against Ebury's web applications, mobile apps, APIs and cloud infrastructure, including business logic flaws.

• Set up, configure and tune web, mobile, infrastructure and cloud vulnerability assessment tools for continuous automated testing, and monitor Ebury's Internet-exposed surface, alerting stakeholders when needed.

• Emulate an attacker in internal exercises such as table-tops, purple-team drills and disaster recovery simulations.

• Schedule and prepare environments for third-party pentests and vulnerability assessments, for proactive testing or compliance, and coordinate the testers with internal teams.

• Own the inventory of pentest and vulnerability assessment findings, and prioritize them using CVSS or similar.

• Explain findings and their business impact to developers and non-technical stakeholders, guide remediation to the root cause, and re-test fixes.

• Lead threat modeling sessions using STRIDE, PASTA, or similar frameworks to identify web and mobile attack vectors, abuse cases and security test scenarios.

Required qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in pentesting, offensive security, application security, or security research.

• Strong programming skill in at least one language, preferably Python or Golang, to write exploits, automate reconnaissance and build internal tooling.

• Strong understanding of web and mobile vulnerabilities and their root causes, and of modern attacker TTPs.

• Strong understanding of attack paths, misconfigurations and privilege escalation in cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS and GCP, including serverless, Kubernetes and PaaS.

• Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment and automated pentesting tools, and with methodologies such as PTES and OWASP WSTG.

• Strong knowledge of secure architecture patterns and anti-patterns.

• Experience in financial services or high-security environments.

• Ability to evaluate risk against technical and business requirements.

• Clear communication with developers and non-technical stakeholders, and good technical writing for reports and post-mortems.

• Collaborative approach to working with engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with payment systems and transaction security.

• Published security research, CVEs, bug bounty record, or open-source offensive tooling.

• Relevant certifications (OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, and similar).

What we offer

• Work on the security of fintech products used by thousands of businesses, across web, mobile and cloud.

• Work with engineers in 25+ countries.

• Use and build AI-driven internal red-teaming agentic platforms.

• Security tooling and testing infrastructure.

• Investment in professional development and certifications.

• Progression path to Staff and Principal roles.

How to apply

Please submit your application through our careers portal including:

• CV with your penetration testing or red teaming experience.

• Any security research, CVEs, or tool contributions.

#LI-JC1

#LI-HYBRID

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury.
