jobs.title: Red Team Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Red Team Lead to establish our Red Team and strengthen the security culture at Supabase. As the team lead, you'll build the team and work alongside them to plan and execute realistic attack simulations across the entire tech stack. You'll guide the team to turn findings into practical recommendations that drive meaningful security improvements.

This role is ideal for someone who combines technical expertise with thoughtful, people-first leadership. Success in this role means our team brings security at Supabase to new heights.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Develop our Red Team from the ground up.

 - Lead and mentor a team that values technical depth, curiosity, collaboration, and accountability, where people can challenge ideas and learn. Align their efforts with their career growth and organizational security goals.

 - Stay technically connected to the planning and execution of operations. Guide the team to make sound judgment calls and communicate operational impact to various audiences.

 - Define the team's strategic roadmap and operational practices for our environment and threat landscape. Use metrics and impact narratives to communicate the team's success.

 - Build strategic relationships with relevant teams, including Legal, Engineering, IT, HR, and Finance, for cross-functional influence and amplified security impact. Foster a collaborative relationship with defensive teams.

 - Advise leadership on strategic growth beyond the Red Team.

 - Establish Supabase as a thought leader in the security space. Share appropriate research and lessons publicly through writing or talks.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have experience leading adversary emulation teams, especially balancing hands-on work and management as a player-coach.

 - Have experience with global asynchronous teams and can work independently.

 - Are familiar with cloud-native offensive operations, including cloud and CI/CD pipelines, and creating and securely deploying command-and-control (C2), reconnaissance tools, and infrastructure for adversary simulations.

 - Understand attack techniques targeting browsers, cloud infrastructure, databases, SaaS applications, supply chains, Linux and macOS devices, and identity and access systems.

 - Naturally build rapport, trust, and engagement within Security and across the organization.

 - Work collaboratively with kindness and respect.

 - Can clearly communicate complex security concepts to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse - Cardiac Recovery & Observation PACU Full-time Days
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge

jobs.description:
About the Role

Madison Energy Infrastructure (“MEI”) believes in the power of clean energy infrastructure and has quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, asset owner, and operator of distributed generation. We’re expanding our Preconstruction team and looking for a Civil Engineer to join our team of in-house subject-matter experts on civil, environmental, permitting, geotechnical, and survey questions across development, design, acquisitions, and construction, on projects ranging from carports to large ground-mounted systems across the country. In this role, you’ll make sure our projects are buildable, permittable, and cost-effective, and surface risk early enough to do something about it. Working closely with our Development, M&A, and Construction teams and outside survey, civil, geotech, wetlands, and landscape architecture consultants, you’ll use your engineering judgment to inform which projects move forward and shape how they get built, how fast, and at what cost. This position reports to the Senior Civil Engineering Manager.

What You’ll Own

• Civil & Environmental Expertise – Serve as a go-to internal resource on civil design (site layout, grading, stormwater, erosion and sediment control), environmental site constraints (wetlands, endangered species and ecological studies, archaeological and cultural resources), geotechnical engineering, and land surveying

• Site Feasibility & Risk – Assess site feasibility through desktop reviews, identifying constraints that restrict development and the permitting requirements and timelines set by local, county, and state regulations; identify and categorize project risks, including fatal flaws, develop strategies and schedules to de-risk them, and escalate go/no-go considerations to the Development Team and the Sr Civil Engineering Manager

• Permitting – Prepare applications for and coordinate local permitting (site plan approval, special use permits) and state/federal permitting (access permits, WOTUS impacts, ESA compliance) through approval

• Design & Value Engineering – Collaborate on preliminary array layouts that account for site constraints and civil features (roads, stormwater) and meet MEI’s internal design standards; provide civil input on racking selection; value-engineer projects to reduce construction cost and improve schedules while balancing risk

• Consultant & Stakeholder Management – Develop RFPs for external consultants and manage consultant work within approved scope and budget to ensure designs are optimized for PV production; lead project-level meetings with clients, engineers, regulatory officials, and consultants to communicate design concepts

• Project Delivery & Cross-Team Support – Coordinate with the Development Team and other SMEs to map out and drive projects from their current development state to active construction; support the M&A team’s acquisitions with detailed technical reviews of drawings, specifications, studies, reports, and permit approvals, flagging risks, gaps, and key assumptions; support active construction projects by reviewing detailed construction drawing sets, submittals, and RFIs

What Will Help You Succeed

(You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.)

• Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or equivalent education/experience

• Active PE license preferred

• 5+ years civil site design and permitting experience, ideally on photovoltaic projects; land development or other energy infrastructure experience also considered

• Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and in hydrologic and hydraulic (H&H) stormwater modeling

• Ability to communicate design concepts clearly to clients, engineers, regulators, and consultants

• Ability to manage multiple projects across development stages at once while staying detailed and organized

• Schedule flexibility based on project and client needs

• Travel is expected to reach about 10% of working time for company meetings and project site visits

Benefits

• PTO and company holidays

• Medical, dental, vision

• Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance

• 401(k) and company match

• Professional development stipend

• Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth

$125,000 - $140,000 a year

The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.

We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.

Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.

Madison Energy Infrastructure is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Manager of IRA Custody Operations
jobs.description:
MANAGER, BROKERAGE AND RETIREMENT SERVICES



Nonbank IRA Custody  |  Retirement Plan Brokerage Window  |  Series 24 Brokerage Operations




ABOUT ATOMIC BROKERAGE LLC

Atomic Brokerage LLC is a FINRA member broker-dealer and a subsidiary of AtomicVest, Inc. We provide the brokerage infrastructure that powers investing experiences for consumer-facing companies, enabling their customers to access equities, ETFs, and other securities across global markets. As we expand into retirement services, including nonbank IRA custody and retirement plan brokerage windows, we are building a team of operations and fiduciary professionals to launch and scale these offerings. Atomic Brokerage is a remote-first company backed by $55M in venture funding, and we are positioned for rapid growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Atomic Brokerage LLC seeks a Series 24 registered management and brokerage operations professional with extensive IRA and retirement plan services experience.  This person will serve as the designated Head of Atomic Brokerage’s nonbank IRA trust division with responsibility for IRA and retirement plan accounts.

The individual will also perform various other brokerage operations functions as described below.



Location: Atomic is a remote-first company; candidates based in the US are required, with New York metro or San Francisco Bay Area a plus.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




TRUST DIVISION LEADERSHIP  & IRA CUSTODY RESPONSIBILITIES FOLLOWING APPROVAL

 - Exercise supervision of the separate trust division under Treasury Regulation § 1.408-2(e)(5)(i)(D), pursuant to designation and delegation by Atomic’s fiduciary oversight committee, which retains ultimate responsibility for Atomic’s fiduciary powers.

 - Lead IRA opening, acceptance, maintenance, transfers, rollovers, contributions, Roth conversions, beneficiary administration, distributions, withholding, required minimum distribution support, and account closure. Maintain approval records and controls for applicable eligibility and contribution requirements.

 - Oversee accurate account-level records, cash and securities reconciliations, income allocation, corporate actions, asset valuation, statements, and timely Forms 5498 and 1099-R. Resolve breaks, processing errors, complaints, and exceptions with documented corrective action.

 - Safeguard IRA assets and maintain fiduciary books and records separate and distinct from other company records, with complete account histories and appropriate retention and access controls. Prevent unauthorized use of assets and unreasonable delays in investment or distribution.

 - Preserve the trust division’s separate identity, authority, procedures, and fiduciary records. Establish adequate staffing, coverage, and supervision.,Administer delegated custodial duties and applicable fiduciary standards within Atomic’s approved business model.

 - Review related-party arrangements, fees, and potential conflicts, to avoid prohibited transaction; escalate to Legal and Compliance or to Fiduciary Oversight committee as appropriate.

 - Coordinate required fiduciary audits, employee fidelity bonding, examination responses, and remediation.

 - Work with Finance, the FINOP, Legal, and Compliance to monitor applicable financial requirements, approval conditions, and changes requiring IRS notification.

 - Oversee participant-level accounting, funding and withdrawals through authorized plan channels, trading, settlement, corporate actions, reconciliations, statements and data feeds, and exception resolution. Apply plan-specific investment restrictions, authorized instructions, and service requirements; maintain clear procedures, controls, and escalation paths.


BROKERAGE OPERATIONS

 - Perform various assigned brokerage operations and principal supervisory functions, which may include some of the following areas:  onboarding, trade processing, clearing and settlement, margin and credit risk, cash movements, funds transfers,  vendor oversight, corporate actions, escheatment, and exception reviews.

 - Support the operational needs of Atomic’s self-directed retirement plan brokerage window product, including coordinating with plan recordkeepers, trustees or custodians, and service providers. Support implementation, account setup, participant access, statements and data feeds, and interfaces among Atomic and its partners. Maintain clear procedures, controls, and escalation paths.

 - Support Atomic’s application for IRA nonbank custodian status, working with in-house and outside counsel to handle any inquiries or follow-up requests received from the IRS.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Active FINRA Series 24 registration and eligibility to maintain the registrations required for assigned functions at Atomic. Obtain any additional function-specific registrations before assuming duties requiring them.

 - At least 8 years of relevant IRA, ERISA,  or retirement operations experience, including supervisory responsibility, direct IRA administration, and familiarity with self-directed retirement plan brokerage windows.

 - Demonstrated experience administering fiduciary or custodial powers comparable to Atomic’s proposed IRA business, including asset safeguards, account-level accounting, distributions, tax reporting, and controls. Ability to document this expertise for the IRS application and translate it into operational procedures.

 - Working knowledge of IRC §§ 408, 408A, and 4975; Treasury Regulation § 1.408-2(e); IRA prohibited transactions; Regulation T;; and relevant SEC financial responsibility and recordkeeping requirements.

 - Strong judgment, analytical and reconciliation skills, written supervisory documentation, audit and examination experience, and proficiency with brokerage and retirement recordkeeping systems, spreadsheets, and operational data.




NICE TO HAVE

Experience supporting a nonbank custodian application, an IRS-approved IRA custodian, retirement plan brokerage window implementation, carrying or self-clearing operations, additional relevant principal or operations registrations including any of the following Series 4, 6, 27, 57, 79 FINRA licenses would be a bonus.

jobs.description:
WAT JE GAAT DOEN

Wil je meer weten over de functie van Sales Advisor? Luister naar onze Jobcast-aflevering en kom meer te weten over de functie uit eerste hand - rechtstreeks van ons team: Sales Advisor

jobs.title: Senior Product Writer (AI-first)
jobs.description:
Приєднуйся до Zeely як Senior Product Writer і допомагай перетворювати складні продуктові сценарії на простий, зрозумілий та ефективний контент.

Ти впливатимеш на те, як користувачі взаємодіють із Zeely на кожному етапі customer journey — від першого знайомства та onboarding до освоєння AI-функцій і досягнення реальних бізнес-результатів. А також розвиватимеш контентні стандарти та AI-автоматизації, які допоможуть масштабувати ці процеси.

Про нас:
Zeely — агентна AI-платформа для створення, запуску та масштабування платної реклами.

Ми даємо бізнесам будь-якого масштабу те, що раніше мали лише великі бренди з агенціями та власними маркетинговими відділами: повноцінну creative team у вигляді AI.

Сьогодні платформою користуються понад 2 млн бізнесів, а більш як 70% платних клієнтів — зі США. Щомісяця користувачі створюють тут близько 1 млн AI-креативів.

Наступний великий крок: B2B-solution для великих маркетингових команд та enterprise-клієнтів — AI-powered creative production, performance analytics, automation та інструменти для швидшого запуску й масштабування маркетингових процесів.

Цифри, які говорять краще за слова:

 - 4 роки на ринку — стабільна прибуткова компанія з міжнародними інвесторами;

 - ×6 зростання за минулий рік;

 - 2 000 000+ бізнесів уже використовують Zeely;

 - Топ-1 у своїй категорії на ринку США;

 - 250+ спеціалістів у команді;

 - Ринки: США + worldwide.

Ми вже пройшли етап пошуку product-market fit і сьогодні масштабуємо бізнес із доведеною продуктовою моделлю. Тому шукаємо спеціалістів, які готові брати ownership, впливати на ключові метрики та розвивати продукт разом із нами.

Про роль:
Ти станеш частиною Content-команди та тісно співпрацюватимеш із Product, Design, Support і Marketing.

У цій ролі важливо не просто створювати якісні тексти, а впливати на продуктові рішення ще на етапі їх формування — від логіки користувацьких сценаріїв до контентної архітектури, стандартів і автоматизації.

З чим ти працюватимеш:

 - Розвиток Help Center та AI-автоматизація: проводитимеш аудит, оновлюватимеш структуру та контент, впроваджуватимеш AI-рішення для автоматизації створення й оновлення матеріалів.

 - AI-workflows: створюватимеш агентів, skills та автоматизації для генерації контенту, перевірки tone of voice, термінології та якості результатів.

 - UX/UI copy: працюватимеш із текстами для web, mobile та AI-функцій — onboarding, tooltips, empty та error states.

 - Email & Push: створюватимеш продуктові комунікації та покращуватимеш воронки для нових фіч.

 - Content Standards: розвиватимеш voice & tone, глосарій, гайдлайни та шаблони для команди й AI-інструментів.

 - Zeely Academy: створюватимеш tutorials та навчальні матеріали, які допомагають користувачам ефективніше працювати з продуктом.

 - Website & Landing Pages: писатимеш і вдосконалюватимеш контент для сайту та лендингів, зокрема для B2B-аудиторії.

 - Content Analytics: оцінюватимеш вплив контенту через продуктові метрики, фідбек користувачів і звернення до Support.

Що нам важливо в твоєму досвіді:

 - Маєш 5+ років досвіду в product writing, UX writing або content design і знаєш, як працювати з контентом у digital-продуктах.

 - Впевнено працюєш із UX/UI copy, Help Center та навчальними матеріалами — від коротких підказок в інтерфейсі до повноцінних туторіалів.

 - Можеш поділитися кейсами, де твої тексти реально вплинули на продукт: допомогли покращити activation, conversion, retention або зменшити навантаження на Support.

 - Не просто користуєшся AI для написання текстів, а вже створював(-ла) власні AI-workflows: кастомні інструкції, skills, агентів чи автоматизації. І знаєш, як перевіряти якість результату.

 - Любиш порядок у контенті й умієш створювати зрозумілі правила для команди: tone of voice, термінологію, контентні патерни та стандарти якості.

 - Умієш писати просто про складне — коротко, зрозуміло й по суті, щоб користувач одразу розумів, що робити далі та яку цінність отримає.

 - Володієш англійською на рівні B2+ і маєш англомовне портфоліо з прикладами контенту для міжнародної / Tier-1 аудиторії.

 - Не чекаєш готового брифу на кожну задачу: помічаєш можливості для покращення, пропонуєш рішення та доводиш ідеї до результату.

Буде класно, якщо ти також:

 - Працював(-ла) з B2B/SMB SaaS, AI-продуктами, martech або adtech.

 - Маєш досвід з email, push, CRM або lifecycle-комунікаціями.

 - Тестував(-ла) різні варіанти контенту через A/B-тести й аналізував(-ла), що краще працює для користувачів.

 - Створював(-ла) content design system або knowledge base з нуля та знаєш, як підтримувати їх актуальними в продукті, що швидко розвивається.

Чому працювати з нами — цікаво і перспективно:

 - Ownership із реальним впливом. Визначай voice & tone, формуй контентні стандарти та впливай на користувацький досвід і продуктові метрики.

 - Масштабування разом із бізнесом. Розвивай прибуткову AI-платформу з 2M+ користувачів, яка зростає ×6 рік до року та виходить у B2B й enterprise.

 - AI-first підхід. Працюй із сучасними AI-інструментами, впроваджуй автоматизації та масштабуй контентні процеси.

 - Сильна команда. Співпрацюй з A-level спеціалістами, які цінують автономність, обґрунтовані рішення та вимірюваний результат.

 - Remote-first формат. Працюй віддалено з можливістю відвідувати офіси у Варшаві та Києві.

 - Прозорий розвиток. Регулярні performance review, чіткі цілі та data-driven підхід до оцінки результатів і професійного зростання.

Рекрутмент-процес:

Intro Call → Test Task → Final Interview → Reference Check → Offer.

Надсилай резюме та English-first портфоліо — будемо раді познайомитися 💚

jobs.title: Uganda Head of Government Relations and Partnerships
jobs.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

Our Uganda program, founded in 2014, provides more than 34,000 farmers with quality farm supplies as well as fruit trees like avocados. Our team in Uganda is headquartered in Jinja, close to the districts we serve, and supported by a small presence in Kampala. One Acre Fund works in the eastern region of Uganda, primarily in the districts of Iganga, Jinja, Kamuli, and Buikwe.

About the Role

One Acre Fund is looking for an experienced, results-driven leader to serve as Head of Government Relations and Partnerships (GR/P) in Uganda. This role leads the GR/P department, driving strategic government alignment, maintaining regulatory compliance, and building long-term government and private sector partnerships to scale smallholder farmer impact.

Responsibilities

Department & Team Management

• Lead and manage the GR/P department, supervising a team of 5+ full-time staff members.

• Oversee team workload, set performance priorities, and foster career development.

• Manage departmental budgeting, financial tracking, compliance, and monthly reporting.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to country leadership and present departmental priorities to the Steering Committee.

Government Alignment & Advocacy

• Align departmental vision and strategy with macro-environmental trends and overall country program goals.

• Position One Acre Fund Uganda as a primary technical and strategic partner to key government ministries (e.g., MAAIF, MoWE, MoT, MLGD).

• Build and sustain long-term bilateral relationships across national, regional, and district-level government bodies.

• Lead strategic coalitions with development partners, NGOs, and industry groups to champion joint policy advocacy or coalitions for smallholder farmers.

Compliance, Risk & Operations

• Work cross-functionally to identify and address regulatory opportunities and operational bottlenecks affecting program delivery (e.g input policies, seed/fertilizer procurement, importation clearances)

• Ensure strict adherence to Ugandan legal codes, non-government compliance frameworks, and government regulations.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with legal, communications, and field operational teams to ensure smooth program execution.

Partnerships and Stakeholder Management

• Develop and oversee strategies for strategic partnerships, Government champions and other priority stakeholders, including private-sector, development and institutional partners.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen OAF external relationships and access to decision-makers.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

• At least 7 years of relevant professional experience, including 3+ years in a senior leadership or management role involving significant Government engagement, stakeholder management and strategic decision-making.

• Strong people-management skills, with experience developing and coaching high-performing teams.

• Strong background in program planning, resource allocation, risk mitigation, managing departmental budgets, and financial compliance.

• Good understanding of Uganda's government structures, legal codes, non-government compliance frameworks, and public sector decision-making processes, with a strong ability to anticipate regulatory shifts and proactively de-risk operations.

• A fast learner with an open-minded approach, comfortable navigating complex, evolving environments.

jobs.description:
About Job

The Active Directory Engineer provides support, implementation, and design services for Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, and Windows-based systems across the enterprise, including directory and identity management solutions. Resolves and appropriately completes assigned cases and change requests and acts as an escalation for support issues. Applies new solutions through research and collaboration with the team and determines course of action for new application initiatives. Implements new software solutions as required by the business. The core infrastructure technology duties include enterprise Microsoft Active Directory and experience with an Enhanced Security Administrative Environment, (Privileged Access Workstations, Red/Blue Forests design, Domain Hardening, PIM/MIM, Server Core, etc.), global system security and policy configuration, and top-level support for enterprise-wide initiatives.

This role requires an in-depth knowledge of Active Directory, Federation, Windows Server 2019 and Windows Server 2016 R2, Windows security, AD Proxy, Virtual Directory solutions and related technology.

Responsibilities

• Produce enterprise-level designs for Active Directory and Windows File Services for global initiatives following those through to implementation via collaboration with project and support teams.
• Identify opportunities to innovate, extend and enhance service delivery everywhere possible.
• Partner on Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management for corporate Identity Management environment.
• Serves as an escalation point for application support and troubleshooting, provides guidance and direction in resolution of escalated issues and/or complex production, application or system problems.
• Serves as the first line of escalation support for domain technology issues that cannot be resolved by tier one and two server support.
• Perform daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware, server resources, systems and key processes, reviewing system and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs.
• Install, configure, and maintain Active Directory and third-party software utilities for hardware systems within company operational guidelines.
• Create and maintain system documentation for domain technologies, including installation, configuration, and appropriate troubleshooting steps.
• Improve existing processes through solutions to recurring problems and enhancements to existing solutions or documentation.
• Provide training as required
• Manage customer satisfaction through effectively communicating and managing customer expectations
• Manage and secure M365 dependencies on Active Directory and Azure Active Directory

• Experience working with Microsoft Identity technologies including Active Directory, Windows File Services, and Group Policies.
• Expert knowledge in administering Active Directory (AD) and GPO’s.
• Expert knowledge of AD, ADFS, PKI in Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2012 R2/2016.
• Expert understanding of Active Directory FSMO roles and and domain trust relationships
• Expert knowledge of DNS, DHCP, WINS, DFS, in a Windows 2012 landscape.
• Knowledge of DNS technologies, Infoblox, Windows
• Knowledgeable in ongoing Active Directory domain and DNS maintenance and clean-up related activities
• Knowledge of Microsoft Exchange, Quest Active Roles Server (ARS) are preferable.
• Advanced usage of automated scripted administration through Windows PowerShell
• Must have deep and thorough understanding of monitoring best practices, preferably with LogicMonitor and Microsoft System Center Operation Manager (SCOM) understanding and experience.
• Extensive experience with infrastructure and server theories, principles and concepts; application infrastructure and standards; networking fundamentals; Windows; Physical Server architecture; Virtualization Technologies (e.g. Hyper-V, VMware) and LAN/WAN/Firewall/VPN network technologies.
• Develops, documents, and enforces the standards, security procedures, and controls for access to ensure integrity of the Windows Systems, Active Directory, and related systems.
• Knowledge of server virtualization technologies, preferably Microsoft Hyper-V and/or VMware technologies
• ITIL v3 Certification.

jobs.description:
H&M-ში გაყიდვების მრჩეველს (Sales Advisor) მნიშვნელოვანი ადგილი უკავია მომხმარებლისთვის უნიკალური გამოცდილების შექმნის პროცესში. გაყიდვების მრჩეველი ესალმება მომხმარებლებს, უძღვება მათ მაღაზიაში და ეხმარება საჭირო პროდუქტის არჩევაში, ამასთანავე, წარმოაჩენს ჩვენს ასორტიმენტს. კომპანიის ღირებულებების შესაბამისად მოქმედებით, გაყიდვების მრჩეველი ხელს უწყობს როგორც საკუთარ წარმატებას, ასევე კომპანიის განვითარებას.

ძირითადი პასუხისმგებლობები:

• მომხმარებლებისთვის მოდისა და პროდუქტების შესახებ ინფორმაციის გაზიარება, საიმისოდ რომ მათ ინფორმირებული არჩევანი გააკეთონ.
• გუნდთან თანამშრომლობა, მომხმარებლებისთვის მაღაზიაში ვიზიტის ყოველ ეტაპზე საუკეთესო მომსახურების გასაწევად.
• უზრუნველყოფა, რომ სავაჭრო სივრცე და საწყობი იყოს მოწესრიგებული, მომარაგებული და მიმზიდველი.
• თანამშრომლების დახმარება მაღაზიის გახსნისა და დახურვის პროცესში.
• მომხმარებელთან ურთიერთობისას როგორც საკუთარი თავის, ასევე ბრენდის დადებითად წარმოჩენა.

​თანამშრომლობა

მაღაზიები ჩვენი კომპანიის გულს წარმოადგენენ, სადაც მომხმარებლები უშუალოდ ეცნობიან ბრენდს.  მაღაზიის დინამიური გუნდის ყველა წევრი - გაყიდვების მრჩეველი, დეპარტამენტის მენეჯერი, მაღაზიის მენეჯერი, ვზუალური მერჩენდაიზერი, მენეჯერის ასისტენტი, მოლარე თუ მიწოდების თანამშრომელი, - ერთიანად ზრუნავს შთამაგონებელი და სტუმართმოყვარე გარემოს შექმნაზე. როგორც გაყიდვების მრჩეველი ითანამშრომლებ სხვადასხვა გუნდებთან საერთო წარმატების მისაღწევად. თქვენი მოვალეობა იქნება დაეხმაროთ მომხმარებლებს, რომ თავი კომფორტულად იგრძნონ და თავიანთი სტილი გამოხატონ ახალი ტენდენციებითა და კლასიკური ელემენტებით. მაღაზიებში მომხმარებელთან მნიშვნელოვანი კავშირების დამყარებით, ჩვენ ვხდით მოდას ყველასთვის ხელმისაწვდომს და მდგრადს. ​

​ჩვენ ვეძებთ ადამიანებს…​

• მომხმარებელთან მუშაობის გამოცდილებით მოდის, საცალო ვაჭრობის ან მსგავს სფეროებში.

და ადამიანებს, რომლებიც…​

• გატაცებულები არიან მოდით და შეუძლიათ მაღაზიებში განსაკუთრებული გამოცდილების შექმნა ჩვენი პროდუქციის პოპულარიზაციისა და გაყიდვების ზრდის გზით.
• მიისწრაფვიან დინამიური და გუნდური გარემოსკენ.
• არიან კომუნიკაბელური, კრეატიული, ცნობისმოყვარე, აქვთ სწავლისა და განვითარების ძლიერი სურვილი, მათ შორის მაღაზიის ტექნოლოგიასთან მუშაობის კუთხით.
• არიან მოქმედებაზე ორიენტირებულები.

ვინ ვართ ჩვენ

H&M ჯგუფი გლობალური კომპანიაა, რომელიც აერთიანებს მოდის ძლიერ ბრენდებსა და ინოვაციურ პროექტებს. ჩვენი მიზანია დავამტკიცოთ, რომ არ არსებობს კომპრომისი განსაკუთრებულ დიზაინს, ხელმისაწვდომ ფასებსა და მდგრად გადაწყვეტილებებს შორის. ჩვენ გვსურს გავათავისუფლოთ მოდა ყველასთვის, ჩვენი მომხმარებლები კი ჩვენს მიერ მიღებული ყველა გადაწყვეტილების ცენტრში არიან.  ჩვენ ვაერთიანებთ ათასობით ნიჭიერ კოლეგას, რომლებიც ჩვენს საერთო კულტურასა და ღირებულებებს იზიარებენ. გვსურს გამოვიყენოთ ჩვენი ძალა, მასშტაბები და ცოდნა, საიმისოდ რომ მოდის ინდუსტრიას უფრო ინკლუზიური და მდგრადი მომავლისკენ ვუბიძგოთ.​

რატომ შეგიყვარდებათ ჩვენთან მუშაობა?

H&M ჯგუფში ვამაყობთ, რომ წარმოვადგენთ დინამიურ და მეგობრულ კომპანიას. თანამშრომლებს ვთავაზობთ მიმზიდველ სამუშაო პირობებსა და განვითარების ფართო შესაძლებლობებს მთელი მსოფლიოს მასშტაბით.

შემოგვიერთდი

jobs.title: Working Student – Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




YOUR ROLE

Focused Energy seeks a Working Student - Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d) for our Laser Lab in Darmstadt to support laser experiment design and setup. You will assist with cleanroom operations, including preparing and inspecting optical components, setting up support systems, electronics, and measurement equipment, and helping commission cooling and driver units. After setup, you will operate experiments and collect data. This immersive, hands-on role involves daily collaboration with lab and controls engineers in a cleanroom, requiring precision, adherence to




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Assist the Laser Lab team in designing and building laser experiments in the Darmstadt Optical Lab.

 - Support cleanroom operations by setting up support systems and preparing components.

 - Clean and inspect optical and mechanical components according to cleanroom standards.

 - Set up electronics and measurement equipment for experiments.

 - Collaborate with engineers to commission cooling and driver units.

 - Operate experiments and collect data under engineering supervision.

 - Adhere to cleanroom and lab safety protocols, and promptly report any deviations.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Optics/Photonics, Laser Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

 - You possess a basic understanding of optics, lasers, or experimental physics through coursework or laboratory experience.

 - Comfortable with hands-on hardware work, demonstrating careful, precise, and methodical handling of sensitive components.

 - Able to reliably follow structured procedures and safety protocols (such as cleanroom or laboratory guidelines).

jobs.title: Founder Content Producer (Part-Time, NYC)
jobs.description:
About PackageX
PackageX is the execution layer for physical operations. Powered by Vision AI, our workflows guide physical work, verify that it was done correctly, and capture evidence across manufacturing, Distribution & Warehousing, and physical retail. Today, 200+ enterprises use PackageX across 1,500+ facilities. Ground truth at every touch.
The Role
We're looking for a NYC-based Founder Content Producer to help build the online presence of a tech founder at the intersection of AI and the physical world. 
Working directly with PackageX's Founder & CEO, Farrukh Mahboob, you'll turn one weekly filming session into a full week of content across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and X. You'll own the process from filming and editing through publishing.
Our Founder & CEO, shares insights on AI in the physical world through LinkedIn and his weekly newsletter, Ground Truth. We're expanding that content to Instagram, YouTube, and X.
The content covers tech, business, startups, career advice, and travel, with AI in the physical world as the common thread.
Farrukh sets the direction and themes. You execute: each week you film, edit, and prepare every piece for publishing.
One shoot. One week of content. Four platforms. Every week.
What You'll Produce Each Week
Each weekly filming session will result in:
2–3 PackageX pieces: 60–90-second videos on Ground Truth topics and conference content for LinkedIn, the PackageX website, YouTube, and X, and longer when a topic needs detail. Includes titles, audio cleanup, and thumbnail.
1–2 shorter cuts: 15–30-second vertical versions of the PackageX pieces, with strong hooks, clean cuts, and burned-in captions. For Instagram Reels and X.
1–2 Instagram shorts: tech, startups, business, career, and travel, cut from the weekly session or from footage Farrukh films himself.
1–2 graphics: Carousels, quote cards, or supporting visuals based on the week's content.
Publishing and copy: Platform-specific titles, captions, and descriptions written in Farrukh's voice, with every piece ready on the weekly calendar.
What You'll Own
Shoot
Lead a weekly 2–3 hour filming session with Farrukh in Manhattan.
Set up and operate the camera, DJI microphone, gimbal, and lighting; direct takes and capture supporting b-roll.
Occasionally film at customer facilities and industry events.
Edit
Edit long-form and short-form videos using Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.
Create engaging hooks, tight cuts, burned-in captions, and clean audio.
Design supporting graphics and thumbnails.
Turn footage Farrukh films himself, on the road and at events, into polished shorts.
Publish
Prepare and publish content across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and X. For the first 2–3 months, you'll deliver ready-to-post packages (final files, titles, captions, and thumbnails) and we'll post them; scheduling access comes after that.
Manage the weekly calendar: Ground Truth and its accompanying video go live Tuesday, followed by clips and graphics throughout the week. 
Analyze 
Provide a short monthly performance report covering views, engagement, and top- performing content, with recommendations for improvement.
What We're Looking For
Must haves:
2+ years shooting and editing short-form and long-form video for an individual, founder, executive, or brand.
Portfolio with at least 3 examples of published work you've personally filmed and edited on your own, start to finish.
Proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci, plus CapCut or similar.
Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to write engaging hooks and captions that sound natural.
Based in NYC, available for a fixed weekly filming session in Manhattan, and reliable on deadlines.
Nice to haves:
Experience producing founder, executive, or B2B content, particularly for LinkedIn and YouTube.
Comfortable filming in warehouses, distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and retail environments.
Experience designing carousels in Canva or Figma.
Interest in AI, supply chains, and how physical work gets done.
Details
Type: Part-time, independent contractor (1099)
Hours: Approximately 15 hours per week.
Location: Weekly filming in Manhattan; editing and publishing are remote.
Equipment: DJI wireless microphone and gimbal provided; bring your own editing setup.
Compensation: $3,000–$4,000 per month, depending on experience.
Start: $300 paid trial edit (one task, 72-hour turnaround), then an ongoing month-to-month engagement at your agreed monthly rate, paid from the first week. Either side can end it with 7 days' notice.
Application Requirements
Please ensure your resume or cover letter includes the following information:
Portfolio: Links to at least 3 videos you have personally filmed and edited, including view counts or engagement metrics (where available).
Ownership: A brief description of each video, outlining your role and confirming that you handled the filming and editing process yourself, end-to-end.
Compensation: Your expected monthly salary or rate.
Availability: Your availability to work on weekdays, including your preferred working hours.
Interview and Trial Process
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 30-minute Zoom interview, followed by a paid $300 trial. We'll provide about 10 minutes of raw footage, and you'll have 72 hours to return a 60–90-second piece and a 15–30-second vertical cut, both captioned.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door-to-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

What’s happening at Vay

• First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside & currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World.

• We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US.

• We’ve completed over 150,000 trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand!

• ...And soon we’ll be expanding across the US & Europe 🚀

Why this role matters

This is not a back-office seat. You’ll sit beside the people launching new cities, signing suppliers, and shaping our insurance strategy, and your advice will decide how fast we move and how safely. Ours is a first-of-its-kind business, so many of the legal questions are new and there is no playbook. You’ll write it.

You’ll join a small, highly regarded legal team with direct exposure to senior leadership. You’ll report to the General Counsel, partner with every function at every level, and work alongside our legal colleagues in Europe.

The impact you’ll make

• You’ll be the business partner leaders call first. You’ll work hand in hand with Growth, Operations, Finance, and Insurance leaders, turn legal risk into a clear recommendation, and become known for “yes, and here’s how.”

• You’ll clear the road for every new city. From permits to municipal and airport agreements, your work decides how quickly we can launch and how well we operate once we’re there.

• You’ll help shape the rules for driverless mobility. You’ll engage state, local, and federal regulators on a technology the law is still catching up to, and your positions will set precedent for how we operate.

• You’ll make the economics work. Lower insurance cost per unit, stronger fraud prevention, and better collections: your work shows up in the numbers the whole company is measured on.

• You’ll grow with the company. Strong performers lead project teams and expand into new cities and regions, with a path to Senior Legal Counsel.

What you’ll be driving

You’ll be the go-to lawyer for US legal, insurance, and compliance matters, balancing risk against business goals as we launch and scale.

• AV and regulatory: lead US regulatory strategy and compliance for driverless and remote-driving operations, including state autonomous-vehicle authorizations, operating requirements, and engagement with state, local, and federal regulators

• Expansion: launch us in new cities and grow within them, including permitting and municipal and airport agreements

• US procurement and commercial: run the legal side of US supply chain and procurement for vehicles, parts, technology, and services, and negotiate the commercial agreements that keep us moving

• Product: advise on product and service development and deployment, including new features, partnerships, and offerings

• US legal: support our insurance program, claims, and cost-reduction efforts; handle employment, disputes and litigation management, fraud prevention and collections, and US corporate governance and regulatory filings, working with outside counsel as needed

• Data, privacy, and cyber: advise on US privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity for connected-vehicle and remote-driving systems, and coordinate with our EU legal team to align policies, incident response, and cross-border data practices

jobs.title: Manager, Innovation – Grants & AI
jobs.description:
Seaport Therapeutics is a clinical-stage therapeutics company advancing the development of novel neuropsychiatric medicines in areas of high unmet patient needs. The Company has a proven strategy of advancing clinically validated mechanisms previously held back by limitations that are overcome with its proprietary GlyphTM technology platform. All the therapeutic candidates in its pipeline of first and best-in-class medicines are based on the Glyph platform, which is uniquely designed to enable oral bioavailability, bypass first-pass metabolism and reduce hepatotoxicity and other side effects. Seaport is led by an experienced team that invented and advanced important neuropsychiatric medicines and is guided by an extensive network of renowned scientists, clinicians and key opinion leaders. For more information, please visit www.seaporttx.com.

The Role

We are seeking a Manager, Innovation – Grants & AI to join our Innovation team, working at the intersection of non-dilutive funding, applied AI, and early-stage program creation. The Manager, Innovation will lead evaluation of and applications for non-dilutive funding opportunities to support program development. This role will also drive the expansion of Seaport’s AI capabilities, embedding AI into daily workflows across the company to enable faster and more scalable processes. Additionally, the Manager, Innovation will gain hands-on entrepreneurial experience by participating in sourcing and due diligence for Seaport’s next-generation programs, bringing the same innovative approach applied to funding strategy and AI adoption. We seek a highly motivated and results-driven candidate with a passion for working in a fast-paced and evolving organization. The role will report into the Associate Director, Innovation.

The ideal candidate will embrace a collaborative, innovative culture that embodies our values of service to patients impacted by mental health conditions, with a “we own it” mentality, demonstrating entrepreneurial spirit and technical excellence while fostering teamwork and continuous improvement. This position is based in Boston’s Seaport area, with a strong preference for being onsite 4 days per week.

Key Responsibilities:

• Identify opportunities and lead applications for non-dilutive funding to support next-generation and current programs

• Write and manage grant applications and other scientific and strategic documents, including proposals, reports, and regulatory summaries, in collaboration with teams across the company

• Identify and quantify opportunities where AI tools, including LLMs, agents, predictive models, and data automation, can improve processes

• Partner with teams throughout the company to design and deploy agentic systems and workflows

• Identify new applications of Seaport’s scientific platform to drive drug discovery and development, including scientific, clinical, and commercial analysis across therapeutic areas

• Support research portfolio management, including operational support of existing and new programs in partnership with the Program Management function

• Interface with key opinion leaders as part of sourcing and diligence efforts

Qualifications:

• PhD or MD from a top-tier institution in a life sciences related field

• Creativity, intellectual curiosity, and initiative

• 1–2 years of experience in biopharma strategy, biotech venture capital, or life sciences banking preferred

• Demonstrated experience in grant and fellowship writing

• Demonstrated experience in applying AI tools in R&D or life science strategy settings

• Strong project management abilities

• Core technical competencies in Claude and Microsoft Copilot

• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills

• Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and competing priorities

• Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; candidate should feel comfortable interacting with a broad set of stakeholders across the organization

At Seaport, we believe transparency and fairness are key to building a culture of trust, respect, and collaboration. We care deeply about the happiness of our team and strive to ensure our total rewards (monetary and non-monetary) program reflects the value each person brings. The expected salary range for this role is $133,000–$150,000, with the final offer based on experience, market data, and internal equity. We encourage open conversations with our talent acquisition team about compensation early in the process to ensure alignment from the start.

jobs.title: Senior Founding Account Manager (West Coast)
jobs.description:
At Beam, we’re building AI that serves society.


We're a global team of ambitious, hardworking problem solvers, applying fast-moving startup energy to work that makes the world a better place. If you want to apply your talent to the biggest problems society faces, Beam is the place for you.


You’ll be part of a high-performance culture where you'll make a huge impact, rapidly progress your career, and truly enjoy your work.


Over 120,000 frontline workers across 400+ customers already use Beam to take notes, provide live interpretation and handle phone calls, so they can focus on the people who need them most. This is just the beginning.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Beam's first Senior Account Managers in the US, you'll look after some of our biggest and most complex customers and help them get far more out of our products. You'll work closely with senior leadership while the team is still small enough that your results shape how we grow across the US.



Our US customers are counties and states, and you'll be their go-to partner. You'll find growth where it isn't obvious, step in when an account needs a hand, and build the kind of relationships that make leaders want to work with us again. You'll also help set the standard for the team around you. Every account you grow puts Beam in front of more frontline workers, and gives them more time for the people who need them.

This role is fully remote, and candidates must currently live in Mountain or Pacific Time Zone. Please submit one application for the Account Manager opening that matches your current time zone.




YOU'LL BE:

 - Owning Our Largest Accounts: Managing a portfolio that includes some of our biggest and most complex customers, where individual deals can run well beyond $200k.

 - Proving and demonstrating ROI: Making sure Beam’s tools deliver the impact our partners need, and presenting that value back to their leadership

 - Creating Growth Where It Isn't Obvious: Turning customer insight into multi-team, multi-product partnerships across new service areas, then building the case and the proposal.

 - Building Senior Networks: Working with economic buyers, division directors and IT leaders across complex customers and turning them into champions who join us at conferences and on webinars.

 - Leading Rescue on At-Risk Accounts: Spotting risk early and stepping in to protect and rebuild accounts that are going off track.

 - Running the Commercial Process: Owning contracting, procurement and legal from start to finish, with support from our bids team when an RFP comes up, and protecting deal value through creative management of the customer.

 - Making Calls Without a Playbook: Balancing customer, commercial and product trade-offs, and forecasting accurately and independently.

 - Navigating Public Funding: Understanding how state and county budgets work so you can position Beam well within them.

 - Representing Beam in Your States: Becoming a driving force behind our reputation and visibility across a number of states in the US.

 - Raising the Bar: Leading work beyond your own accounts, sharing what you learn and helping shape how account management runs at Beam, while partnering with customer success, sales and product so our learnings shape what we build next.




YOU HAVE:

 - A Record of Growing Complex Accounts: 5+ years in account management or full-cycle sales, with proven success expanding large, high-stakes customer relationships and closing big deals, ideally in B2B SaaS and with a book of a similar size.

 - Senior-Level Presence: Experience building relationships across complex customers, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders because you've earned their trust.

 - Commercial Judgement: You make strong calls without a playbook and protect value through insight and creativity. 

 - Energy and Sharpness: You're curious and quick, and you ask real questions that come out of the conversation, not just ones you'd planned to run through.

 - A Habit of Experimenting: You test ideas, learn from what lands, and continuously iterate upon them.

 - Complex Deal Experience: Comfort with long buying journeys involving procurement, legal and several decision-makers.

 - Startup Pace: The drive to work at speed in an early-stage team, where you'll help define the role as you go.

 - Public Sector Curiosity (Nice to Have): Experience in government, public sector or social care is helpful but not essential. We'll teach you the rest.




SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - Your largest accounts converting, renewing and growing ARR quarter-on-quarter

 - Growth in places it wasn't obvious, through new service areas and multi-product partnerships

 - At-risk accounts recovered, with risks flagged early rather than surfacing late

 - A forecast the business can rely on

 - Senior champions in each account who advocate for Beam and work with us as partners

 - Beam's reputation and visibility growing in your states

 - Colleagues learning from your approach, with your impact reaching beyond your own book

 - Contracts, procurement and legal handled smoothly and on time




COMPENSATION:

 - Basic Salary of $140,000 - $160,000 + competitive commission

 - Competitive range of perks based on geography (please see our careers page for full details)

Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, location and previous experience




INTERVIEW PROCESS:

We have a four-stage interview process, giving you plenty of time to learn about Beam while we get to know you.

 1. A 30-minute call with a member of our talent team

 2. A take-home task

 3. A roleplay/presentation with members of the team

 4. Individual final interviews with Beam's CEO, Alex and CCO, Rachel
    
    


ABOUT BEAM

We’ve picked up an armful of awards for our work, including one from our former Queen. We've also been named by Jack&Jill as one of the world's 100 hottest startups https://www.jackandjill.ai/jill/most-in-demand-startups and by LinkedIn as a Top 15 UK Startup https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2022-15-uk-companies-rise-linkedin-news-uk/?trackingId=9TqxvkXTjF2HSPvSIWLczw%3D%3D. Meanwhile, we've been covered in the media literally thousands of times, including the likes of The FT, BBC, TechCrunch, Forbes and The Guardian https://beam.org/media.



We’re also proud to be backed by some of the world's leading tech investors and entrepreneurs, including the founders of Booking.com http://Booking.com, Calm, Shazam and Dropbox.



Start your journey to a more impactful career today. We're excited to hear from you.



Reasonable adjustments:

Beam is committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and supportive work environment for all employees. This policy extends to our hiring practices.

We recognise that some candidates may need additional support during their hiring process to give them the best chance of being a success. To ensure that all candidates have an equitable opportunity during their process, we are committed to providing reasonable adjustments where required.

If you require a reasonable adjustment to be made during your process, please let your Talent Partner know. We encourage you to share this information, but there is no obligation to do so. 

Please be reassured that any reasonable adjustment requests will not be taken into account when making a decision about your candidacy.

jobs.title: Global Program Delivery & Operations Lead
jobs.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Chicago, Illinois, United States; Kansas City, Missouri, United States; New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

WPP and Adobe are redefining how global brands deliver marketing, harnessing AI to create, personalize and launch campaigns faster, smarter and at unprecedented scale.

We are seeking a Global Program Delivery & Operations Lead who thrives at the intersection of operational architecture, financial governance, and cross-agency delivery to join the team as part of this critical partnership.

This is not a high-level theoretical role, nor is it routine spreadsheet maintenance. It is a critical, “dual-threat” role - acting as both architect and operator. You will partner directly with the Global Business Lead as their operational right hand, establishing the global operating rhythm, automating reporting workflows, bringing financial rigor to burn and forecast tracking, and unifying diverse regional teams and operating companies under one single source of truth.

What will your day look like?

Global Operational Architecture & Ways of Working

• Establish Global Governance: Set, standardise, and roll out universal frameworks, decision rights, and clear escalation paths across all workstreams and regional markets (North America, EMEA, APAC).

• Eliminate Operational Silos: Align diverse agency operating companies to one consistent delivery model, ensuring all markets follow suit.

• Standardise Scoping & Delivery Playbooks: Define shared templates, status definitions, and reporting triggers for both internal operations and contractual client commitments.

• Drive Process Adoption: Champion adoption of a version-controlled central repository, turning operational chaos into predictable, scalable governance.

Rigorous Financial Governance & Central Tracking

• Own the Single Source of Truth: Manage and govern the end-to-end global tracking lifecycle

• Audit & Burn Analysis: Deep dive into burn reports, hours, and rate cards to proactively catch discrepancies, margin slippage, and contractual reporting gaps before they surface to leadership or the client.

• Bridge Delivery & Commercials: Partner closely with regional PMs, workstream leads, and commercial/finance directors (FP&A) to reconcile pipeline conversion, rolling forecasts, and actual delivery velocity.

• Lead Regular Cadence: Run weekly and monthly operational syncs to capture staffing shifts, project risks, and scope revisions across markets.

Workflow Automation & Modernization

• Automate Reporting Ecosystems: Transition manual, multi-spreadsheet workflows into automated, scalable dashboards and pipelines.

• Leverage Modern Tools & AI: Proactively identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation platforms, and advanced data models to make monthly reporting faster, sharper, and less reliant on manual data entry.

Executive & Client-Facing Communications

• QBR & MBR Leadership: Steer the preparation cycle for Quarterly and Monthly Business Reviews, translating complex operational and financial data into cohesive, executive-ready narratives.

• Weekly JPA Executive Updates: Own the consolidation and delivery of weekly Joint Partnership Agreement (JPA) executive reports covering financials, milestones, risks, and required decisions.

• Client Partnering: Step into client-facing dialogues with stakeholders with confidence, precision, and transparency around program status and contractually obligated reporting.

Matrix Leadership

• Provide functional operational direction to regional delivery leads and project managers across multiple markets, fostering accountability and turning discussions into actionable resolutions.

What do you bring to the table?

• The Operational Architect: You have designed and scaled operating models within complex, multi-stakeholder, global matrix environments (e.g., global holding groups, agency networks, consulting firms, or enterprise tech ecosystems).

• Financially Astute Operator: You understand the anatomy of a client contract, margin health, rolling revenue forecasts, utilization, and burn tracking. You can connect a delivery bottleneck directly to its commercial impact.

• Comfortable in Ambiguity & Growth: You understand that rapid scale brings growing pains. You aren't rattled by fragmented systems; instead, you take initiative to build clarity, structure, and order.

• Data & Automation Mindset: You are an advanced Excel/Sheets power user who actively leverages modern automation (e.g., macros, workflow tools, BI dashboards, Generative AI / Copilot) to eliminate repetitive manual legwork.

• Direct, Pragmatic Communicator: You know how to lead effective meetings, cut through the noise, enforce accountability across senior peers, and deliver concise updates to executive sponsors.

Qualifications & Experience

• Relevant Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in Program Management, Business Operations, Delivery Operations, or Commercial Operations within a global agency network, enterprise consultancy, or global technology partnership.

• Financial Acumen: Demonstrated hands-on experience managing project financials, burn rates, scoping conversion, and revenue/capacity forecasting on accounts of scale ($20M+).

• Global Remit: Proven track record of orchestrating cross-functional teams across multiple geographic regions (US, EMEA, APAC).

• Contractual Reporting: Experience managing formal client governance, SLAs, MBRs/QBRs, and contractual compliance.

• Tool Proficiency: Advanced modeling skills in Excel/Google Sheets; proficiency with project management platforms (Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or enterprise equivalents); practical experience or strong interest in applying AI/automation tools to everyday workflows.

• (Bonus) Prior experience working within the Adobe ecosystem or large-scale strategic tech alliances, though a strong cross-account operational foundation is prioritized.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. jobs.title: Corporate Communications & Content Intern
jobs.description:

This role is ideal for someone who wants to build hands-on experience in content creation, social media, internal communications and cross-functional collaboration within a leading FMCG organisation.

As a Corporate Communications Intern, you will:

• Support the development and execution of internal communication campaigns and employee engagement initiatives
• Assist in crafting executive communications, including briefing documents, talking points and messaging frameworks
• Support in creating content for JDE Peet's social media channels, including LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external agencies to produce compelling visual and written content
• Monitor and analyse communication performance metrics to optimize engagement and reach

Skills & Competences

• Clear and engaging content writing abilities for diverse audiences, including press materials and employee-facing content
• Advanced PowerPoint skills for presentation development; proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word) required

• Strong understanding of social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook and Instagram (including current trends, content formats, and audience expectations)
• Fluency in English (spoken and written) / Dutch language skills are a plus
• Passion and affinity for communication, storytelling and brand narratives

• Exposure to both internal and external communications, helping craft messaging that reaches employees and broader audiences

jobs.title: Manager, SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
jobs.description:
Manager of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

Job Overview

The Manager of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting is a key role responsible for supporting the preparation of SEC filings, providing technical accounting guidance, and ensuring compliance with US GAAP and SEC regulations. This position reports to the Director of SEC Reporting.

Key Responsibilities

SEC Reporting

• Prepare and review SEC periodic reports including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K
• Coordinate the SEC filing process and ensure timely submission of all required disclosures
• Draft and review financial statement footnotes and MD&A sections
• Monitor SEC rule changes and assess impact on reporting requirements
• Assist with proxy statements and other regulatory filings

Technical Accounting

• Research and analyze complex accounting issues under US GAAP
• Prepare technical accounting memos documenting conclusions and supporting rationale
• Review significant contracts and transactions to determine proper accounting treatment
• Provide guidance on new accounting standards and implementation requirements
• Support the adoption and implementation of new accounting pronouncements

Financial Reporting & Compliance

• Ensure accuracy and completeness of external financial reporting
• Review quarterly and annual financial statements for GAAP compliance
• Coordinate with external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits
• Maintain accounting policies and procedures documentation
• Support internal controls over financial reporting (SOX compliance)
• Manage statutory financial reporting requirements and cross-collaborate to ensure timely submissions, working with external providers

Team Collaboration & Leadership

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Legal
• Provide training on technical accounting topics to finance team members
• Support special projects and ad hoc reporting requirements

• CPA, Accounting degree
• 5 + years experience in assurance / audit practice of Big 4 firm
• Experience with SEC reporting and public company accounting
• Expert knowledge of US GAAP accounting standards
• Proficiency with SEC reporting requirements
• Advanced Excel skills and financial analysis capabilities
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• High attention to detail and accuracy
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
• Strong research and documentation skills
• Leadership and team development capabilities
