jobs.title: Senior Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Partner Marketing Manager

Prolific

At Prolific, our marketplace is rooted in academia, and that commitment runs deep. Alongside our work to accelerate the future of AI, we’re continuing to redefine how the world conducts academic research.

What started as a research-driven idea has evolved into the world’s most trusted infrastructure for human data. Today, tens of thousands of researchers from top universities across the globe rely on Prolific to power their work, from peer-reviewed studies to the next generation of technological breakthroughs.

We're doubling down on our mission to serve the academic community, deepening relationships, building smarter tools, and making high-quality human data more accessible than ever.

The Role

Partnerships are one of Prolific’s biggest growth engines, and the targets ahead are ambitious. More and more platforms are building Prolific directly into their own products, and we’re investing in a dedicated partner marketing function to turn that momentum into something much bigger.

As our Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll own partner marketing at Prolific. You’ll build the programmes that bring the right new partners through the door and turn existing relationships into joint pipeline and revenue. Working hand in hand with our US-based Partnerships Lead, Sales and CSM teams, you’ll make sure every campaign, event and co-marketing play is pointed at the biggest opportunities.
You’ll own our partner events motion globally, with your main focus on the US. Many of our partners are headquartered in the Bay Area, and they’re already eager to run joint events, dinners and campaigns with us. You’ll be the face of Prolific on the ground, stepping into warm relationships with marketing and event leads at key partners from day one.

This is a revenue-driven role with real autonomy. You’ll shape the strategy, build a programme that scales and see the impact of your work in the numbers.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Building and running ABM programmes and marketing strategies to win new partner logos, a major focus particularly in your first six months.

• Designing co-marketing plans and joint programmes with channel and alliance partners, including events, content, launches and customer stories.

• Shifting focus over time toward expanding revenue with the partners we’ve won, working closely with Partnerships and CSMs.

• Owning the partner events motion globally, with a main focus on the US and the Bay Area, backed by strong strategy rather than one-off activity.

• Partnering with the Partnerships Lead, Sales and CSM teams to align marketing activity to revenue opportunities.

• Building a repeatable partner marketing programme and reporting on pipeline and revenue influenced.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 8+ years in B2B marketing, including 3+ years in partner, channel or alliance marketing.

• A track record of building joint programmes with technology partners, especially partners who integrate your product into theirs, rather than co-branded associations.

• A revenue focus, with experience working alongside sales and partnerships leadership to co-develop programmes tied to pipeline rather than activity for its own sake.

• Comfort working with technical buyers and partners in AI, research tooling, data or developer-adjacent products.

• Experience in fast-paced, small-team B2B SaaS environments, with the confidence to build and iterate without a ready-made playbook.

• Clear, plain communication and strong relationship-building skills, internally and with external partners. Even Better if you have:

• Experience at, or alongside, companies in the AI, research technology or data tooling space.

• An existing network among the types of companies that build on or integrate with platforms like ours.

• Experience running field and event programmes with partners, particularly in the Bay Area.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research.

Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. At Prolific, our compensation packages for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. Many roles also include the opportunity to earn a cash variable element, such as a bonus or commission. Each job posting shows a salary range that reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hires, based on the role’s location as well as your skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will also be happy to share the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Links to More Information

Website

Youtube

Benefits

External Handbook

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal information.

• Participate fully in training programmes, maintain training records, and provide training and support to colleagues to ensure competency and compliance across the team.
• Liaise professionally with internal stakeholders and clients, responding to queries and ensuring services are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance and customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Direct Support Professional
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is currently seeking a Per Diem Direct Support Professional (DSP) to provide direct support to individuals with developmental disabilities. The DSP will provide support with daily activities, including household chores, meal preparation, recreational activities, learning activities, and physical fitness activities. The DSP will represent the needs, wants, and interest of individuals served or supported by the program, and provide input on program planning and implementation for individuals. As part of your role, you may assist individuals with transportation to community activities, helping them build valuable life skills. Depending on program needs, transportation may involve the use of a company vehicle or, when necessary, a personal vehicle—with mileage reimbursement provided as applicable.

Schedule: Per Diem, dependent on program needs. Minimum of 2 shifts per month

Location: Sterling, Holden, Princeton, and Leominster

Qualifications:

• Prior experience working with individuals with disabilities in a professional setting strongly preferred.

• Basic computer skills, experience using Therap a plus!

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Empathy, enthusiasm, and a passion and dedication for helping others.

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• In some locations, a valid US driver’s license and auto insurance may be required, with at least 3 years of driving experience. Access to reliable transportation is required, and some positions may require the use of a personal vehicle to transport supported individuals, depending on program needs.

Employees at Aspire enjoy working with a collaborative and dedicated team that values a culture of belonging and care. We take pride in offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees, including:

• 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan – Save for your future through Aspire's voluntary 403(b) retirement plan.

• Paid Sick Time – Earn paid sick leave in accordance with applicable state and federal laws.

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Access confidential support and resources for personal, family, financial, and work-life needs.

• Professional Development Reimbursment– Take advantage of training and learning opportunities to build your skills and support career growth.

• Meaningful Work & Flexible Scheduling – Enjoy the flexibility of a per diem schedule while making a positive impact in the lives of the individuals and communities we serve.

If you want to join us in making a difference and positively impact the lives of others while charting your own path of development, then we at the Aspire team would love to hear from you.

Pay: $18.50-$19.00/hr based on education and experience

Aspire Living & Learning believes it must play an active role in creating a community of employees that is diverse, inclusive and equitable. Our work benefits greatly from the contributions of people of color, people from working class backgrounds, women, LGBTQ people, and individuals with disabilities. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.

jobs.title: Junior Performance Marketer (Remote - Malta)
jobs.description:
OUR VISION & PRODUCTS

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next



At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!




OUR TEAM

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.



Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23



Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)



Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)



Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)




YOUR ROLE

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


CAMPAIGN EXECUTION AND SCALING SUPPORT:

 - Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

 - Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

 - Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests


PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS AND REPORTING:

 - Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

 - Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

 - Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards


CREATIVE & FUNNEL CONTRIBUTION:

 - Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

 - Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

 - Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue


PARTNERSHIP MANAGEMENT & LEARNING:

 - Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

 - Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

 - Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts




CHALLENGES YOU’LL TACKLE

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

 - Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

 - Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

 - Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

 - Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

 - Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS




HARD SKILLS

 - Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

 - Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

 - Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

 - Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

 - Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

 - Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)




SOFT SKILLS

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition




WHY EVERAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale




WHAT WE OFFER

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows




🎯 TOP TIER TALENT IS OUR MULTIPLIER

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!




To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TiipgWu6yFB5SZ2WnC0dM-RzGvcW1EOB/view.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst GEM
jobs.description:
The position of Regional FP&A Analyst sits comfortably in the Regional Finance Team — diverse team that helps each other learn, grow and develop. As a Regional FP&A Analyst, you will support both short-term planning, including AOP, and long-term strategic planning. You will be responsible for monthly performance analysis, monthly and quarterly projections and providing insights to support business decision-making. For this, we don’t just need you to be a knowledgeable professional but also strongly rely on your interpersonal skills as well as your drive for success.

• Annual Operating Plan & Strategic Planning

• Lead the end-to-end planning process, calendar, and consolidation across clusters, ensuring Group alignment.
• Partner with the Regional Commercial Finance Manager, who owns the commercial assumptions behind the numbers.
• Contribute to the long-term Strategic Plan / Value Creation Plan process.
• Collect, validate, and consolidate inputs from clusters and functions.
• Ensure planning assumptions are consistent, transparent, and aligned with Group guidance.
• Support preparation of financial bridges, key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
• Analyze plan outputs versus prior year, latest view, and strategic ambition.
• Prepare materials and insights for senior management discussions.

• Monthly and Quarterly Projection (Latest Estimate, LE)

• Lead the preparation and consolidation of the monthly and quarterly estimate across country clusters.
• Collect, validate, and consolidate inputs from clusters and functions.
• Support LE materials for management and leadership reviews.
• Develop solutions and recommendations to improve forecast accuracy.

• Cost Discipline and Efficiencies

• Prepare COGS actual development and projection, partnering with the central costing team and coffee and tea sourcing.
• Support the cost efficiency agenda, including SG&A analysis versus prior year, AOP, and regional resource allocation.

• Process Improvement & Ad Hoc Analysis

• Support simplification and standardization of FP&A reporting and planning processes across clusters.
• Maintain and improve Excel models, templates, Power BI reports, and financial tracking files.
• Provide ad hoc analysis to support senior management requests and business decisions.
• Ensure data quality, consistency, and alignment across reporting systems and submissions.

Qualifications

We are looking for strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights, proven experience in stakeholder management, and a strong drive for excellence — someone who holds themselves accountable and doesn’t shy away from responsibility. Given the nature of the role, we feel it's important for you to have 5–7 years of experience in Finance. We thrive in diverse teams and look for people who appreciate that as much as we do. We can give you a list of “must haves,” however that’s not how we view your candidacy — we take into consideration how much experience you have with your analytical skills and stakeholder management experience, but ultimately we look at the bigger picture. To give you a bit of guidance as to what we feel is needed in this role, here’s our “nice to have” list:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
• 5–7 years’ experience in FP&A, controlling, financial analysis, accounting, or management reporting.
• Strong understanding of P&L, Cash Flow, working capital, and financial KPIs.
• Strong analytical skills with ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
• Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI, SAP/BPC, or other planning/reporting systems is a plus.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to work with multiple deadlines.
• Good communication skills and ability to work with stakeholders across regions and functions.
• Proactive mindset, ownership, and willingness to improve processes.
• Strong interpersonal skills and good track record in working across cultures and time zones
• Automation experience — e.g. exposure to RPA, automated reporting/consolidation tools, or driving finance process automation
• Experience working within a country cluster — exposure to a multi-country/regional cluster structure, including cross-country reporting, consolidation or coordination

Your application at JDE Peet's

If you are interested in this career opportunity at JDE Peet's, apply and join us. After receiving your application we will do our utmost to give you quick feedback. Part of the recruitment procedure at JDE Peet's would be an online assessment, followed by interviews. A pre-employment check can be part of the recruitment process.

The future of work is hybrid, with both office and home playing an important role. At JDE Peet's, we value meeting colleagues in the office to unleash the possibilities of coffee and tea together and we enjoy our focus time when working from home. Join us and you will experience both. Because it’s amazing what happens over a cup of coffee.

Whether or not you are with us, two, four or thirty years, it doesn’t matter. We help you build your skillsets and potential career. We offer a solid and competitive base salary and add additional benefits to the mix. To name a few: Learning and development budget, career development, Insurances, pension plans and a minimum of 25 + 12 ADV days of paid holidays (because we care and want to offer you a healthy work – life balance).

#unleashyourpossibility #acupofamazing #LI-Hybrid

JDE Peet’s - now part of Keurig Dr Pepper – is the world’s leading pure-play coffee company, with a presence in more than 100 markets. Guided by our ‘Reignite the Amazing’ strategy, we are focused on brand-led growth across three big bets: Peet’s, L’OR, and our 10 strategically selected local icons led by Jacobs.

jobs.title: Residential Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Aspire Living & Learning, we don't just talk about making an impact, we live it. For more than 40 years, we've supported neurodiverse children and adults across New England and Maryland as they discover their passions, unlock their potential, and live more independently in their communities. Our person-centered services evolve with people's needs, from education and behavioral health to residential and community-based supports. We empower people to live lives shaped by their own interests, choices, and strengths. Join our collaborative, mission-driven team and bring your skills to work that makes a real difference every day.

Aspire Living & Learning is currently seeking a motivated and dedicated Program Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations for adults with developmental disabilities, ensuring that all supported individuals are receiving appropriate clinical and medical services. The Program Manager will mentor, develop and supervise shift supervisors and direct care staff, ensure adherence to all DDS, funding agency, and state regulations, maintains and monitor staffing schedule, assist with writing clinical assessments and overseeing ISP assessments, and assume on-call responsibilities as required. The Program Manager will also assist and instruct individuals in all aspects of their IP, administer medication when required, provide in-house and agency-contracted training and consultation services, adhere to budgetary guidelines, assist and instruct residents with daily living skills, behavioral and habilitative plans, medical, psychiatric and socio-emotional needs, and work with the People Team to plan and implement corrective action when necessary.

Location: Woodbury

Key Responsibilities:

The PM is responsible for programmatic and operational management of services that will enable individuals to reach their fullest potential. This person holds a leadership role, building effective teams through developmental supervision and championing internal and external partnerships. Below outlines key aspects of the roles and responsibilities this position holds:

Relationships and Communication:

• Cultivate a positive and productive workplace atmosphere to enhance team morale and productivity.

• Creates positive relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including employees, peers, local and state agencies as well as parents and guardians

• Ensures all communication is timely and occurs in a manner that is professional, clear and concise

• Builds trust, mutual respect and cohesion around shared mission

Program Management:

• Champions an environment in which supported individuals have choices, are treated with respect and dignity and actively engaged in their community

• Provides ongoing developmental supervision according to agency expectations ensuring employees are meeting programmatic requirements

• Creates a supportive environment in which to retain quality employees and providers

• Ensures adherence to organization-wide policies and procedures and state and federal regulations, meeting licensing and certification standards

• Provides fiscal oversight of the program(s) under the guidance and leadership of the Program Director, this includes managing cash on hand, pex, receipts, etc.

• Coordinates services to provide medical, psychiatric and social-emotional needs of the supported individuals

• Provides programmatic oversight regarding required record keeping and program and vehicle safety.

Leadership and Coordination:

• Fosters an environment where the dignity, decisions and rights of the individuals are valued.

• Foster a positive work environment while championing a culture of teamwork, growth, collaboration and communication.

 - Analyze affiliate results to identify areas of improvement, optimize campaigns for better performance, and find any opportunities to scale

 - Research and recruit new affiliates and business partners to expand the affiliate network

 - Troubleshoot affiliate-related issues and provide solutions in a timely manner

 - Collaborate with internal teams to create tailored affiliate funnels, ensuring maximum conversion rates

 - Regularly review and improve processes to enhance affiliate communication and management

HARD SKILLS

 - 5+ years of experience in affiliate marketing and management

 - Proficiency in affiliate marketing platforms and network

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions

 - Advanced knowledge of digital marketing tactics and strategies on diverse channels (SEO, media buying, paid socials, etc.)

 - Advanced competence with tools like Everflow, Looker Studio, SEMrush, and other reporting systems

 - Excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills for data analysis and reporting

 - Ability to optimize processes for performance efficiency and ROI




SOFT SKILLS

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🔄 Adaptable - comfortable reprioritizing overnight when the landscape shifts

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with complex affiliate tracking systems like postback S2S setup, ad servers and so on

 - Faced strong challenges (Affiliate disputes, tracking issues, fraud, volume drops, etc.)

 - Previous experience scaling affiliate programs from mid-size to enterprise level

 - Knowledge of funnel optimization strategies and A/B testing

 - Experience with subscription-based business models

 - Familiarity with fraud prevention techniques

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

jobs.title: Founders Associate (Business Development)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TACTO

Tacto builds the procurement intelligence platform for manufacturers. AI agents work through order data and part drawings, find savings and automate manual work, so buyers can focus on strategy.

 - 400+ manufacturers run more than $40 billion in purchasing volume on Tacto

 - Founded in Munich; our US team sits in Chicago

 - $65M+ raised from Sequoia and Index Ventures




OUR MISSION AT TACTO

We help American manufacturing win, starting with procurement.

America is reindustrializing: new plants are going up, supply chains are being rebuilt, and a $3 trillion manufacturing base is reinventing itself right now. Every physical product starts as bits, a design, a drawing and a tolerance, and ends as atoms when it comes off the line. Between the two sits the step that decides whether it gets built well: the perfect buy, sourcing every part from the right supplier, in the right quality, at the right cost and in time. More than half of a product’s cost comes from suppliers, yet at most manufacturers this step still runs on spreadsheets and email. Tacto gives procurement teams the AI to make the perfect buy on every part.




YOUR ROLE

You open the conversations with the manufacturers that build America, as our first full-time business development hire in the US.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We entered the US this year and are building the team in Chicago. Procurement is where manufacturers turn reindustrialization into margin, and thousands of them have never heard of us yet. As our Founders Associate (Business Development), you build our first US pipeline: you reach procurement and supply chain leaders, find out what makes them say yes and turn it into the playbook that our next 20 BDRs will run. You work with our US leadership team every day.


WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS

 - You are first. You open the US market for Tacto. Every call you make shapes how America gets to know us.

 - You write the playbook. The scripts, templates and sales material you build are what everyone after you will run.

 - You learn GTM from the people who built it. You work daily with a leadership team that already built a category leader in Europe.

 - You grow as fast as you deliver. After at least 6 to 12 months in business development, you shape your next step (see your career path below).


WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND ISN’T

 - Hands on: You are on the phone, in inboxes and on LinkedIn every day. After two weeks of onboarding, including our cold call academy, you are live.

 - Not a finished machine: There is no playbook yet. You test what works and build it as you go.

 - Not a remote role: You build this in person with the team in our Chicago office, five days a week.

 - The deal: Bring drive and discipline, and we give you a seat on the US founding team and a career path you shape yourself.


YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - Weeks 1 to 2, fast onboarding: Business development onboarding with our cold call academy, product onboarding and an introduction to Tacto’s culture.

 - From week 3, full outreach: You cold call every day, follow up on sendouts and events, and book your first own discovery calls.

 - Week 6, ramp complete: From here, you work toward a clear monthly pipeline target.

 - Month 3: You consistently hold 5+ discovery calls per week, we have a clear answer on cold calling as a channel, and the first version of the US BDR playbook is written.


YOUR CAREER PATH

After at least 6 to 12 months in business development, you shape your path:

 1. Closing: Full-cycle Account Executive, later sales team lead.

 2. Leadership: BDR team lead US, building and coaching the next BDRs on the playbook you wrote.

 3. Generalist: A broader GTM role as the US organization grows.




YOUR TASKS

 - Open the US market: As our first business development hire, you build our pipeline with the manufacturers that make this country run.

 - Own the prospecting pipeline: From identifying to converting new leads, you proactively reach decision-makers in procurement and supply chain by phone, email and social media.

 - Build the playbook: You test new ways to generate outbound and inbound leads and turn what works into call scripts, templates and sales material that everyone after you builds on.

 - Learn the business: You develop a deep understanding of our product, the market and our customers by working with the US leadership team every day.

 - Become AI native: You use AI to speed up your work, experiment with new approaches and share the workflows that work.




YOUR PROFILE

Drive, creativity and persistence matter more to us than a specific background.


EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

 - Experience: You are at the start of your career. First sales or startup experience is a plus, not a requirement

 - Built something: You have already built something of your own, whether a club, a side business or a startup

 - Communication: You are a clear, convincing communicator, on the phone and in writing

 - Languages: Native English


CORE STRENGTHS

 - 0 to 1 person: You are a true self-starter who figures things out when there is no finished playbook

 - Persistent: You stay disciplined when the answer is no

 - Coachable: You take feedback and get better every week

 - Ambitious: You want to go far as a sales leader, CRO or founder and learn what great GTM looks like from first touch to closed deal

 - Curious about manufacturing: You want to understand the industry and the people who run it. A personal connection to that world is a plus

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.




OUR VALUES

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

 - We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

 - Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

 - Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

 - Real passion: Grit and ownership.

 - Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

 - Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

 - Caring is key: We help each other grow.




WHAT WE OFFER


WHAT TO EXPECT

 - A seat on the US founding team: Of a Sequoia- and Index-backed company, working directly with the US leadership.

 - The forefront of industrial AI: You learn how a category leader is built from people who have done it in Europe.

 - A fast start: Two weeks of onboarding, including our cold call academy, then you are live.

 - One team, in person: Our office in River North, Chicago, where the whole team works together.


COMPENSATION

 - $70K to $120K base salary, plus a large variable component and equity

The compensation range reflects the expected salary band for this position. Final compensation is determined individually and may vary with experience, qualifications, skills and location.




HOW YOU APPLY

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

 1. Get-to-know call, 30 min, with Christoph

 2. Deep dive, 30 min, with Christoph (often combined with the first call)

 3. Case study in person in Chicago, 1 hour, with Christoph and Johannes: a cold call role play with a feedback round, plus culture questions

 4. Culture round, 15 min, with André or Robert




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AND DATA PROTECTION

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.




OUR BACKGROUND

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.




WHY IT MATTERS

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.




WHAT WE OFFER

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

 - Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

 - Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

 - Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

 - Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

 - Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

 - Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024.

We’re looking for a Data Engineering Intern to assist in enhancing the quality and reliability of our data collection platform. This role will provide hands-on experience in data engineering, security operations, and cloud infrastructure, with guidance from experienced engineers and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

• Review and validate ETL processes for completeness and data consistency.

• Improve our data-consistency validation processes by migrating legacy and semi-manual validation processes to our new framework.

• Assist in developing monitoring and alerting systems for data consistency and configuration integrity.

• Work with the data team to analyze, streamline, automate, and improve ETL processes, including ingestion of new data sources. In particular, you’ll focus on improving the automation of our data-related channel-launch processes.

• Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge bases related to ETL, validation, and alerting procedures.

• Learn about and contribute to large-scale, cloud-native data systems.

What You Bring

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. GPA of 3.5 or more

• Familiarity with SQL and Python.

• Understanding of basic cloud concepts (AWS preferred).

• Proven experience with industry-grade database solutions and with AWS (1+ years)

• Experience with ETL creation

• Agentic experience when it comes to the above

• 1+ years of relevant past internships

• Strong interest in data analysis and automation..

• Eagerness to learn and contribute to a fast-paced, remote engineering team.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Availability of at least 20 hours per week for at least 6 months

Location

• US/CA Remote

What We Offer

• Paid internship with flexible scheduling.

• Remote-first work culture and support.

• Hands-on mentorship from senior engineers.

AppLovin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or other legally protected characteristics. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send us a request at jobs@applovin.com

AppLovin will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.  If you’re applying for a position in California, learn more here.

jobs.title: PowerPlatform engineer
jobs.description:
Hybrid, with one day a week in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office




ABOUT US


Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.




THE ROLE


Power Platform gives people across Seccl a faster way to build the tools they need. We’re hiring a Power Platform engineer to make it work even harder, reporting to the AI-Automation Engineering Manager in our AI-Automation team. As more people build on the platform, we need someone to set the standards and make sure it’s secure, reliable and genuinely valuable.

You’ll look after our Power Platform Centre of Excellence. That means knowing who’s building what, where and with which connectors, keeping the platform tidy and secure, and making sure changes reach production safely. You’ll also build the bigger solutions that need proper engineering. Working with the product team, you’ll decide when Power Platform is the right tool, then take the work from requirements through to release.

What makes this role interesting is the mix. One week you might be running an ‘App in a Day’ session for colleagues, and the next you could be using AI to improve automation, insight and decision making. You’ll be the person the business turns to for Power Platform knowledge, so your work shapes how everyone builds.


What you’ll own


• Grow the Power Platform Centre of Excellence, so teams can build faster with governance built in

• Manage releases and environments through a proper application lifecycle, so changes reach production safely

• Keep the platform lean and secure, with only the apps and flows it needs, and spot security risks early

• Build the solutions that matter most, from requirements through to testing and release, with the product team

• Champion citizen development through office hours, mentoring and practical guidance colleagues will actually use

• Report on what the platform delivers and find new ways to extend what it can do




THIS ROLE’S FOR YOU IF...


• You’ve delivered high-quality solutions in fast-paced, agile teams, including iterative development and continuous delivery

• You know Power Apps (model-driven apps), Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows) and Dataverse well enough to design and build with them

• You’ve built and governed Power Platform solutions before, and you know how to keep them secure, reliable and well organised as they grow

• You enjoy helping people learn, whether that’s running sessions, mentoring colleagues or writing guidance people actually read

• You have a broad understanding of the Power Platform and can explain it clearly to colleagues who aren’t technical

Desirable: a good understanding of Power BI, Power Pages and Power Platform observability, plus experience of the Power Platform SDLC. Experience applying AI or intelligent automation to workflows, decisions or user experience is valued too.

Certifications such as AB-100 and AB-400 are a plus, but equivalent experience building and governing Power Platform solutions counts just as much. Experience with Azure Pipelines or AWS, JavaScript or TypeScript, automated testing or automated releasing would be a real bonus.




THIS ROLE ISN’T FOR YOU IF...


• You’d rather work on your own. A big part of this job is helping others build well, which means running sessions, answering questions and mentoring people.

• You want to say yes to everything. Governance is part of the job, so you’ll sometimes steer people towards a better approach or push back on a quick fix to keep the platform secure.

• You need clear requirements before you start. Many requests arrive half formed, and part of your work is shaping them into something worth building with the product team.



WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU


We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

 - 💰 A salary between £55 000 and £75 000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

 - 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

 - 💙 Two volunteering days each year

 - 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

 - 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

 - 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

 - 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

 - 👪 Enhanced parental leave

 - 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

 - 📖 Annual learning budget

 - 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

 - 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

 - 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

 - 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing




OUR CULTURE


We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.




INTERVIEW PROCESS


Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

• Talent screen: a first conversation with our talent team about your experience and what you’re looking for.

• Hiring manager interview: a competency-based conversation with the hiring manager about how you’ve worked and what you’ve delivered.

• Technical interview: a conversation with our technical team about how you’ve built and governed Power Platform solutions.

• Bar raiser interview: a conversation with someone from outside the team, who helps make sure we hire to a high standard.

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.



Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior AI Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
About Ivanti

At Ivanti, we are transforming how organizations discover, manage, secure, and service their technology environments. As AI becomes increasingly embedded across our products, services, and internal operations, we are committed to ensuring AI is developed, deployed, and governed responsibly, ethically, and in compliance with evolving global regulations.

The Senior AI Compliance Analyst will play a critical role in building and operating Ivanti's AI governance program. This individual will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure AI systems are compliant, trustworthy, transparent, and aligned with both regulatory requirements and Ivanti's Responsible AI principles.

Our Culture

At Ivanti, our culture is shaped by the values that inspire and guide us every day. We believe that the way we work together, passionately, and authentically is just as important as the results we deliver. Our core values foster collaboration, keep customers at our core, raise the bar for performance, and hold us accountable to the highest standards.

Why we need you

The Senior AI Compliance Analyst is responsible for assessing, monitoring, and governing AI systems across their lifecycle. This role serves as a key advisor to engineering and business teams, helping ensure AI solutions are designed, deployed, and maintained in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, company policies, and ethical standards.

The ideal candidate brings a unique blend of regulatory compliance expertise, analytical thinking, technical aptitude, and the ability to translate complex governance requirements into practical controls and processes.

What you will be doing

• Conducting AI readiness and compliance assessments for new and existing AI-enabled applications, products, and services.

• Evaluating AI systems against internal governance frameworks, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Assist with preparation for future AI-related compliance frameworks, certifications, audits, and assessments, including emerging standards such as ISO 42001.

• Monitor global AI laws, regulations, standards, and regulatory guidance.

• Analyze emerging legal and regulatory developments and assess potential impacts to Ivanti's products, services, and operations.

• Develop and maintain responsible AI policies, standards, controls, processes, and governance documentation.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to operationalize ethical AI principles.

• Support the AI Governance Committee in evaluating AI tools, vendors, models, and solutions proposed for purchase, deployment, or commercialization.

• Perform compliance reviews and document findings, recommendations, approvals, and required remediation actions.

• Establish and monitor ongoing compliance controls for AI systems after launch.

• Ensure post-deployment testing and validation activities are conducted to confirm intended outcomes and business objectives are achieved.

To Be Successful In This Role You Will Have:

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Compliance, Risk Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in compliance, governance, risk management, privacy, cybersecurity, technology audit, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting technology compliance programs in highly regulated environments.

• Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, model lifecycle management, and emerging AI governance frameworks.

• Experience interpreting laws, regulations, and standards and translating requirements into operational controls.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Why Ivanti?

• Friendly flexible working model: Empower excellence whether you’re at home or in the office and support work-life balance.

• Competitive compensation & total rewards: Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family.

• Global, diverse teams: Collaborate with talented people from 23+ countries.

• Learning & development: Grow your skills with access to best-in-class learning tools and programs.

• Equity & belonging: We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world.

What drives us

Ivanti’s mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation.

It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world-class solutions for our customers.

To learn more about Ivanti’s Mission and Core Values.

Inclusion at Ivanti

Ivanti is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. Need adjustments during the process? Reach out to talent@ivanti.com we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: [Intern] Founders Associate Intern (Growth)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TACTO

Tacto builds the procurement intelligence platform for manufacturers. AI agents work through order data and part drawings, find savings and automate manual work, so buyers can focus on strategy.

 - 400+ manufacturers run more than $40 billion in purchasing volume on Tacto

 - Founded in Munich; our US team sits in Chicago

 - $65M+ raised from Sequoia and Index Ventures




OUR MISSION AT TACTO

We help manufacturing win, starting with procurement.

America is reindustrializing: new plants are going up, supply chains are being rebuilt, and a $3 trillion manufacturing base is reinventing itself right now. Every physical product starts as bits, a design, a drawing and a tolerance, and ends as atoms when it comes off the line. Between the two sits the step that decides whether it gets built well: the perfect buy, sourcing every part from the right supplier, in the right quality, at the right cost and in time. More than half of a product’s cost comes from suppliers, yet at most manufacturers this step still runs on spreadsheets and email. Tacto gives procurement teams the AI to make the perfect buy on every part.




YOUR ROLE

You find out how Tacto reaches thousands of American manufacturers faster than anyone expects, working directly with our co-founder.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We entered the US this year and are building the team in Chicago. To win here, we need to get in front of thousands of manufacturers fast, and the channels that work in Europe are only a starting point. As our Founders Associate Intern (Growth), you work directly with Johannes, our co-founder and President and CEO US, on that one question. You find the growth pockets nobody has tapped yet, test the channels that could become our next 10x and turn what works into how Tacto grows in the US.


WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS

 - You own real experiments. You get your own budget and the freedom to run growth experiments your way.

 - You work next to a founder. You see from day one how a market gets opened, and you build the network to start your own company later.

 - What works becomes the playbook. The channels you prove become how Tacto grows in the US.

 - A path to stay. For the right person, there is a clear path to a full-time role on the US team.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND ISN’T

 - Hands on: You design experiments and run them yourself, from target lists and campaign setup to tracking and reporting.

 - Not a coffee-run internship: You own top-of-funnel growth for a new market, with a budget and clear results to show.

 - Not a remote role: You build this in person with the team in our Chicago office, five days a week.

 - The deal: 3 to 6 months full time. Bring ownership and creativity, and you get the closest thing to a founder apprenticeship.




YOUR TASKS

 - Own top-of-funnel growth: You find, test and scale the channels that bring Tacto in front of US manufacturers, from creative campaigns and partnerships to communities, events and content.

 - Find our next 10x channel: You build a pipeline of growth hypotheses, run fast and cheap experiments, measure the results and double down on what works.

 - Run the growth engine: You set up campaigns, build target lists and handle tracking and reporting, so that every experiment produces a clear answer.

 - Shape the strategy: You work directly with our US leadership on priorities and the growth playbook, and learn how a company opens a new market.

 - Become AI native: You use AI to speed up your work, experiment with new approaches and share the workflows that work.




YOUR PROFILE

Drive, creativity and ownership matter more to us than a specific background.


EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

 - Built something: You have already built something of your own, whether a club, a side business or a startup

 - Data-driven: You think in experiments and numbers

 - Experience: First growth, marketing or startup experience is a plus, not a requirement

 - Languages: Native English

 - Availability: Full time for 3 to 6 months


CORE STRENGTHS

 - 0 to 1 person: You are a true self-starter who figures things out when there is no finished playbook

 - Unconventional: You love finding the angle others miss

 - Builder and doer: You are just as happy executing a campaign yourself as designing it

 - Future founder: You want to start your own venture-backed company one day and want to learn how a market gets opened from scratch

 - Curious about manufacturing: You want to understand the industry and the people who run it. A personal connection to that world is a plus

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.




OUR VALUES

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

 - We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

 - Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

 - Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

 - Real passion: Grit and ownership.

 - Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

 - Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

 - Caring is key: We help each other grow.




WHAT WE OFFER


WHAT TO EXPECT

 - A seat on the US founding team: Of a Sequoia- and Index-backed company, working directly with our co-founder and US CEO.

 - A founder apprenticeship: You see how a market gets opened from day one.

 - The forefront of industrial AI: You learn how a category leader is built from people who have done it in Europe.

 - One team, in person: Our office in River North, Chicago, where the whole team works together.


COMPENSATION

 - $3,000 to $5,000 per month

The compensation range reflects the expected pay band for this position. Final compensation is determined individually and may vary with experience, qualifications, skills and location.




HOW YOU APPLY

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

 1. [Step 1, e.g. Intro call, 20 min, with …]

 2. [Step 2, e.g. Interview with Johannes]

 3. [Step 3, e.g. Case: growth experiment design, with …]

 4. [Step 4, e.g. Onsite and meet the team, with …]




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AND DATA PROTECTION

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.




OUR BACKGROUND

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.




WHY IT MATTERS

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.




WHAT WE OFFER

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

 - Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

 - Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

 - Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

 - Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

 - Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

 - Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.description:

Scale our operations for global impact. Build the systems and teams – so our radar tech delivers everywhere it counts.

As our Operational Excellence Director, you own our long-term scalability, industrialisation and global expansion readiness across the entire product lifecycle. You work side-by-side with our Chief Operations Officer, Management Team and peers across Engineering, Procurement, Production, Logistics and Sales – connecting product design with factory execution and scaling external manufacturing capacity. WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Data governance and planning systems: Lead operational data governance and planning system improvements. Provide real-time visibility into lead times, yield, capacity and Sales and Operations Planning inputs.

 - Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): Oversee PLM governance to connect Innovation and Development with Operations. Ensure full product traceability across the complete product delivery and maintenance lifecycle.

 - Global expansion and outsourcing: Lead strategic outsourcing projects with external project leads to scale manufacturing capacity. Prepare manufacturing processes for global expansion, including meeting local US manufacturing regulations and establishing regional assembly centres.

Act as an internal consultant on cross-functional projects, and advise the Management Team with transparent reporting, risk assessments and budget management.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - MSc degree preferred in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related technical field.

 - 12+ years of leadership experience in operational excellence, factory scaling, or manufacturing transformation within high-tech, defense, electronics, or aerospace industries.

 - Proven track record of transitioning a company from low-volume internal assembly to large-scale external contract manufacturing.

 - Deep understanding of how to connect product design (I&D), enterprise planning software (ERP), and factory production execution.

 - Strong business acumen with the ability to model multi-year capacity plans, CAPEX investments, ROI for automation/outsourcing, and unit-cost reduction curves.
