jobs.title: Territory Manager (NJ)
jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

Team InStride Health: Our Core Values

• Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.

• Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.

• Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.

• Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

InStride Health is entering an exciting period of rapid growth. We are looking for a Territory Manager to support our efforts in establishing and expanding partnerships with healthcare providers in northern New Jersey. As a Territory Manager, you will be responsible for driving referral growth by developing new relationships with healthcare providers, strengthening existing referral partnerships, and expanding InStride's presence throughout your territory. You'll serve as a trusted resource to referral partners, helping them understand how InStride can support the children and families they serve.

This is a relationship-driven sales role that combines proactive outreach, strategic account development, and consistent follow-through to achieve referral growth goals.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Referral Growth: Drive consistent growth in referral volume by developing new referral relationships, strengthening existing partnerships, and identifying opportunities to increase referrals from established accounts.

• Outreach & Awareness: Conduct daily outreach to pediatric practices, primary care offices, and school providers to introduce InStride’s services.

• Relationship Support: Maintain a consistent check-in cadence with established referral partners to ensure they have the materials and information they need.

• Pitching & Presentations: Confidently deliver InStride’s value proposition to clinical staff and referral coordinators.

• Event Execution: Assist in the planning and execution of local community events, webinars, and regional conferences to increase brand awareness.

• Data Management: Maintain records in our CRM to track outreach activity and referral trends.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Clinical and Admissions teams to ensure a "warm handoff" for referred families.

• Market Feedback: Gather and communicate referral partner feedback; partner with Product, Engineering, and Client Success to improve the referral experience and InStride’s solutions.

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in healthcare outreach, relationship-based sales, business development, or referral relationship management, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

• Communication: High empathy and excellent verbal communication skills; you enjoy meeting new people and building rapport.

• Organization: Strong "follow-through" skills. You can manage a high volume of tasks and keep a CRM organized without things falling through the cracks.

• Growth Mindset: A desire to learn the complex New York healthcare ecosystem and motivated to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

• Location: Based in Northern New Jersey, with the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory for in-person provider visits, relationship development, and community events.

• Tech Savvy: Comfortable learning new digital tools, including CRM platforms and data reporting dashboards.

The expected annual base salary for this role is 80,000–90,000. Actual starting salary will be based on skills, experience, and other factors. In addition to base compensation, this role offers a target performance-based bonus.

Why Join Our Team

• Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)

• Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment

• Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care

• Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem

• Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

• Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.

• Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly (talent@instride.health) to verify its authenticity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Operating Systems
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Operating Systems Engineer on Apex's Flight Software team, you will design, develop, and own the software that brings our spacecraft to life. You will tackle the hardest problems in autonomous systems and build robust software that enables reliable spacecraft operation 24/7, across every phase of a mission. You will work closely with our mission operations, GNC, and hardware teams to architect new systems, prototype ideas, and turn them into mission-critical software that ultimately flies.

Experience in the space industry is not necessary to thrive at Apex. Instead, we are looking for motivated engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, balance technical rigor with practicality, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The Flight Software team is composed of three interconnected teams: high-level application software, operating system software, and embedded software. There is significant collaboration and crossover across these teams.





RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop the low level software that configures and drives the processor peripherals and communication interfaces on our avionics.

 - Develop, configure, and maintain embedded Linux platforms and bootloader frameworks, including Yocto, Buildroot, WolfBoot, and U-Boot.

 - Design, implement, and validate firmware update mechanisms, including bootloader integration, secure firmware deployment, and recovery procedures.

 - Design and implement security enhancements across complex software architectures to improve system integrity, resilience, and secure operation.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

 - Bachelor's degree in CS, EE or equivalent, or equivalent professional experience.

 - 8+ years writing code for operating systems, ideally Yocto or embedded Linux on spacecraft, robotics, automotive, or other hardware what that interacts with the physical world

 - Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Rust




PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience developing, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting mission-critical satellite software from prototyping through flight operations.

 - Experience with embedded Linux platforms and bootloader frameworks (e.g., Yocto, Buildroot, WolfBoot, U-Boot).

 - Experience bringing up new avionics and flight hardware from initial power-on through functional verification.

 - Experience with hardware/software integration, schematic analysis, and hardware debugging using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

 - Familiarity with spacecraft attitude control systems, including reaction wheels, magnetorquers, thrusters, and associated sensors.

 - Experience designing, implementing, and validating firmware update mechanisms, including bootloader integration, secure firmware deployment, and update recovery.

 - Experience designing secure systems and implementing security enhancements in complex software architectures.

Staff: $200K - $250K

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Money Movements Squad
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Today, roughly 40% of all transactions on the Egyptian Exchange flow through Thndr. Every one of those trades has to be funded, and every pound, dirham, or soon riyal, a user makes has to be money they can actually take back out. Money has to move, into accounts, out to banks, between our own books and the market, accurately and on time, every single time. That is the Money Movements team.

We move more than 1 billion EGP every day across hundreds of thousands of individual movements, and the figure we care about most is how many of them go wrong, which we work relentlessly to keep as close to zero as possible. We connect directly to banks, payment gateways, and payment providers, settle with the exchanges and asset managers, and write and maintain our own backoffice across Egypt and the UAE. Underpinning all of it is our own in-house ledger, built on TigerBeetle, a bleeding-edge financial database that gives us the correctness and throughput this domain demands. We do this across two markets today, with Saudi Arabia coming next.

This is a sensitive system. When money is in motion, uptime and correctness are not nice-to-haves, they are the entire job. A delayed settlement, a double credit, or a balance that does not reconcile is never just a bug, it is real money belonging to real people. You would be working alongside some of our strongest engineers on problems that are unusually hard and unusually consequential, owning systems that the rest of the platform quietly depends on.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design, build, and operate the services that move money in and out of Thndr, including deposits, withdrawals, settlement, and reconciliation, across Egypt and the UAE.

• Own the correctness and reliability of these systems end to end. Money that flows through your code has to land in the right place, in the right amount, every time.

• Build and maintain integrations with banks, payment gateways, payment providers, and asset managers, and handle the messy realities that come with them: timeouts, partial failures, retries, and the occasional provider that goes down at the worst possible moment.

• Raise the bar on quality and operational discipline, with strong observability, sensible on-call, thorough testing, and systems that fail safely when something goes wrong.

• Partner closely with our finance and operations teams, and help bring the same connectivity and rigor to Saudi Arabia as we expand.

 


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• A strong track record of designing, shipping, and operating reliable backend systems in production, used by large numbers of people.

• Real depth in distributed systems, and a clear understanding of what it takes to keep them correct under load and under failure.

• Comfort owning systems end to end, from design through production and on-call. You care not just about writing the code, but about how it behaves at 3am.

• Familiarity with our stack, or the confidence to get there quickly: Python, C#, .NET Core, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, and Redis.

• A high bar for correctness and operational discipline. You understand what it means to run a system where a mistake has real consequences for real people.

• A clear, candid communicator who can hold their own with other engineers and work closely with the finance and operations teams who rely on what you build.

• Strong debugging skills. When a balance is off by 50 cents across a million transactions, you can find the real cause, not just a quick fix.

 


WHO ARE WE?

Thndr was founded on a bold dream to democratize access to investing through smart tech and human-centric design. This is simply our way of saying we give anyone with a smartphone the simple and easy access they need to preserve and grow their wealth. At the same time, we’re shaping the future of investing while actively driving the economies we serve by promoting local investment products.

History has shown that investing is the single greatest way to build long-term wealth, but before Thndr, only a very small percentage of people had access to it due to:

 - High barriers to entry — In the form of excessive minimum account balances, complex, outdated onboarding, and low financial literacy.

 - Irrelevant experience — Catered toward expert traders and financial specialists, therefore alienating the majority of the population.

 - Fragmented offering — Investment products were not gathered in a single, intuitive outlet.

We don't just talk about change, we deliver it. Here's a glimpse into our impact so far:

 - 5.5 million app downloads

 - EGP 1B+ average daily traded value across 2025

 - #1 digital investing platform in Egypt for the third consecutive year

 - 76% of users are first-time investors

 - 40% of our users come from outside of capital cities and have previously had limited access to financial institutions

Building on the success of our core platform, we are continuing to change culture and break down barriers by launching Rumble, the subscription-based investment recommendations platform.

Rumble was born with the vision to empower everyday individuals to build wealth confidently and intelligently through access to timely and in-depth advice from the industry’s top experts.

Going beyond traditional investment advice, it offers long and short-term investment recommendations and financial content through engaging articles and videos that guide users on their financial journey and maximize their returns.

At Thndr, we're looking for people driven by our mission to help us democratize investing across the MENA region.

jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

About the Team

The European Service organization is responsible for delivering a premium ownership experience across Lucid’s growing European footprint. Within this organization, the Body Repair program ensures customers have access to a high-quality network of approved repair partners that meet Lucid’s standards for safety, repair quality and customer experience. The team works cross-functionally with Service Operations, Technical Support, Quality, Warranty and Training to continuously strengthen Lucid’s body repair capabilities across Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for a Body Repair Operations Manager Europe to own the development, performance and continuous improvement of Lucid’s European body repair network. This is a hands-on network management role combining deep body repair expertise with partner development, operational performance and quality management. You will expand network coverage where needed, develop existing partners and ensure Lucid’s repair standards are consistently implemented across Europe. You will also act as a key escalation point for complex body repair and partner-related cases, using operational data and network insights to drive continuous improvement. Based in Amsterdam, this role requires regular travel across Europe.

What You Own

• Network Development: Identify, assess and onboard new body repair partners based on market coverage and business needs, ensuring technical, operational, tooling and training readiness before activation.

• Partner Performance: Own relationships with existing body repair partners, using KPIs such as repair quality, cycle time, first-time-right and customer experience to identify gaps and drive measurable improvements.

• Repair Standards: Drive consistent implementation of Lucid body repair standards, procedures and repair requirements across the European network, addressing compliance gaps and maintaining a high level of repair quality.

• Complex Escalations: Act as the European escalation point for complex body repair and operational cases, connecting partners with the appropriate internal teams and driving issues through to resolution.

• Performance Insights: Monitor network performance, identify trends and risks through operational data, and turn recurring issues into broader network improvement initiatives.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Service Operations, Technical Support, Quality, Warranty, Training and other functions to ensure the body repair network has the support required to operate effectively.

• Tools & Systems: Coordinate the European rollout and effectiveness of body repair systems, diagnostic equipment and specialized tooling, including the Technical Information Portal and Network Management System.

What You Bring

You combine strong technical knowledge of collision and body repair with the ability to build trusted relationships with external partners. You are comfortable working across countries and functions, know how to use operational data to improve performance, and can move between hands-on problem solving and broader network development. You work independently, communicate clearly and are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, international environment.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of automotive experience, including significant experience in body repair, collision repair and/or vehicle painting.

• Strong understanding of body shop operations, repair processes, quality standards and repair performance.

• Proven experience in partner, network or multi-site management, with the ability to manage performance and drive corrective actions.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication and problem-solving skills, with confidence using digital applications, reporting tools and performance data.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly across Europe, up to approximately 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with a premium automotive or electric vehicle brand, or within an OEM-approved or certified collision repair network.

• Experience operating across multiple European markets and within a matrix organization.

• Additional proficiency in German, French, Italian and/or Spanish.

This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager, B2B Marketing (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more.

Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our diverse global team fosters a work environment rich in creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Through technology, experimentation, and ownership, we strive to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Content Marketing Manager to help shape and scale our B2B content marketing efforts.

In this role, you will own the development and execution of a content strategy that strengthens brand awareness, establishes thought leadership, communicates our technology and solutions, and supports business growth across the marketing funnel.

You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Strategy to uncover compelling stories, translate complex business insights into clear narratives, and develop high-impact content for B2B decision-makers.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines strong business acumen, exceptional storytelling, and sharp editorial judgment with the ability to turn strategy into execution. You will play a key role in building a scalable B2B content marketing engine.

Key Responsibilities

1. Content Strategy & Planning

• Own and execute a comprehensive B2B content strategy aligned with brand positioning, business priorities, go-to-market plans, and the customer journey.

• Define key content pillars, editorial priorities, and annual content roadmaps across awareness, consideration, conversion, and customer engagement.

• Identify content opportunities through industry trends, competitive intelligence, customer insights, and business performance data and insights

• Establish content performance metrics and continuously optimize the strategy based on audience engagement, lead generation, lead generation and pipeline contribution.

2. Thought Leadership, Research & Content Development

• Develop compelling, insight-led content that establishes our brand and executives as trusted voices in the B2B travel and technology industry.

• Lead the research, development, and writing of industry trends reports, market insights, original research publications, whitepapers, thought leadership articles, and executive perspectives, translating industry developments, proprietary data, and expert insights into differentiated narratives.

• Proactively identify and develop compelling stories by working with internal experts, commercial teams, and external partners.

• Translate complex technology, product capabilities, data, and business insights into clear, differentiated narratives tailored to senior B2B audiences.

• Repurpose research and thought leadership into engaging formats, including blog posts, executive LinkedIn content, infographics, and other digital content.

3. Customer Proof & Commercial Content

• Lead the development of partner case studies, customer success stories, testimonials, and use cases that demonstrate tangible business outcomes, product value, and partnership success.

• Collaborate with commercial teams and partners to identify compelling success stories, conduct interviews, validate results, and translate customer experiences into credible, persuasive narratives.

• Develop and adapt customer proof into partner-facing marketing and sales enablement assets, including presentations, website content, and other commercial materials.

• Support priority go-to-market initiatives with clear value propositions, solution narratives, and relevant product and business content.

4. Executive Communications, Presentations & Event Content Enablement

• Lead the end-to-end content development of executive keynotes, conference presentations, speaker talking points, panel discussion narratives, and strategic presentations for industry conferences, flagship events, partner summits, and executive engagements.

• Partner directly with senior executives and subject matter experts to shape compelling storylines, synthesize complex information, and translate strategic priorities, industry insights, and business data into persuasive narratives.

• Collaborate with Event Marketing and cross-functional teams to develop event content themes, session narratives, speaker briefs, and partner-facing content aligned with business priorities and audience interests.

• Synthesize key insights, discussions, and takeaways from events into valuable post-event content, including executive summaries, thought leadership articles, partner-facing recaps, and derivative content for digital channels and sales enablement.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs, reconcile stakeholder feedback, and deliver executive-ready content under tight timelines, in collaboration with creative and design teams.

5. Content Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Manage end-to-end content production, from ideation, research, and briefing to development, stakeholder approvals, and publication.

• Work collaboratively across Product, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and other teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.

• Manage external agencies, freelancers, and creative partners, providing clear briefs and actionable editorial feedback.

• Leverage AI tools and scalable content workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and speed of execution while maintaining strong editorial standards.

• Ensure consistency of messaging, tone of voice, and content quality across channels and formats.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of experience in B2B content marketing, corporate communications, business journalism, thought leadership, or related roles, preferably within technology, travel, e-commerce, or B2B services.

• Exceptional research, writing, and editorial skills, with demonstrated experience independently developing long-form, insight-led B2B content such as industry reports, whitepapers, executive thought leadership, and customer case studies.

• Proven ability to develop compelling customer success stories and testimonials by interviewing stakeholders, extracting business insights, and translating results into persuasive narratives.

• Strong ability to synthesize complex business, technology, and market information into clear, engaging content for senior business audiences.

• Experience developing executive presentations, conference keynotes, speaker narratives, and event-derived content is highly desirable.

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly with senior executives and coordinate cross-functional inputs under tight deadlines.

• Experience managing external agencies, research partners, freelancers, and creative teams while maintaining high editorial standards.

• Familiarity with content performance measurement, digital distribution channels, and AI-assisted content development workflows.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with strong attention to detail, editorial judgment, and the ability to adapt tone and messaging across audiences and formats.

• Data-driven mindset: Ability to use research, customer insights, and performance data to inform content decisions and measure effectiveness.

• AI fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate research, content development, editing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining accuracy and originality.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with SEO, content distribution, CRM, marketing automation, and content performance analytics.

• Experience building content processes and scalable editorial workflows in a growing organization.

Why Join Us?

You will have the opportunity to shape the B2B content strategy, work directly with senior business leaders, and create compelling narratives that bring our technology, solutions, and partnerships to life.

This role offers a unique combination of strategic ownership, creative storytelling, and hands-on execution, with the opportunity to build meaningful content programs that influence brand perception and business growth.

jobs.title: Release Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
At WhiteTech, we empower businesses in the financial ecosystem with cutting-edge white-label and SAAS solutions.

Our comprehensive suite of tools is tailored for EMI, PSP, e-commerce, and open banking platforms. With WhiteTech, clients gain access to a platform designed for flexibility, scalability, and seamless integration.

Our mission is to help businesses unlock their full potential in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

Whether scaling your PSP, enhancing your EMI services, or diving into open banking, WhiteTech is your partner for innovation and growth.

We are a remote-first technology company and welcome applications from candidates across Europe, including the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, and other non-EEA European countries such as Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Montenegro, Turkey, and the Western Balkans. We also consider applicants from different locations who can work within Central European Time (CET).

We are looking for an experienced engineer to own release preparation and technical readiness, from integrating changes across teams to validating compatibility and delivering releases to production.

You will work with product code, investigate integration issues, and decide which changes are ready to ship. The role focuses on reviewing and integrating existing code, making small fixes, and ensuring reliable delivery.

What you will do

• Define release scope based on change readiness and dependencies between components.

• Integrate changes across teams, manage branches, and resolve merge conflicts.

• Review code and assess its impact on related modules and existing user flows.

• Run builds and tests, investigate failures, and resolve minor issues independently.

• Work with developers and technical leads to resolve more complex problems.

• Make technical release-readiness decisions, excluding risky changes or stopping a release when necessary.

• Maintain clear visibility into release scope, status, and blockers, and discuss limitations with clients when needed.

• Improve release checks and delivery workflows to reduce waiting time and prevent recurring issues.

What we are looking for

• A software development background and senior-level engineering judgment and independence.

• The ability to confidently read and analyse code in at least one of Go, PHP, or JavaScript. Go is preferred.

• Hands-on code review experience, including identifying risks, assessing the impact of changes, and explaining your findings.

• Solid Git skills: branching, merging, rebasing, cherry-picking, and conflict resolution.

• An understanding of CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes sufficient to work with existing build and delivery workflows.

• The ability to investigate failures using test results and logs.

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to stay focused on complex tasks.

• Ownership of technical decisions and clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, clients.

Nice to have

• Experience in technical leadership, software integration, or release engineering.

• Experience communicating with clients and discussing technical constraints.

• Experience with FinTech products.

• Experience automating checks and improving release workflows.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics.

Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.

About StarTree

StarTree is the company behind StarTree Cloud and a leading contributor to the Apache Pinot ecosystem. StarTree Cloud provides a fully managed, production-ready experience for Apache Pinot, helping customers deploy, scale, and operate real-time analytics with reduced infrastructure complexity.

StarTree is a globally oriented, technically ambitious organization that combines the pace of a growth-stage company with the complexity of operating a sophisticated enterprise technology platform. Team members are encouraged to think ahead, raise the bar, continuously improve how work gets done, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported.

Role Introduction

We are looking for a dynamic and highly organized Executive Assistant to support the founder/CEO. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and excels at multitasking. You will play a crucial role in enabling the efficiency and effectiveness of the CEO. Managing travel and calendar logistics, and partnering with the rest of the leaders in organizing both team and company-wide events. Your role may also include responsibilities in office management, fostering a productive and positive work environment.

Why join StarTree?

At StarTree, you will work at the forefront of real-time analytics, cloud infrastructure, open-source software, and AI-enabled data applications. You will have the opportunity to work closely with the Founder/CEO and senior leadership team while contributing to the systems and operating discipline that help a high-growth technology company scale.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of people, priorities, technology, and execution. Someone who can move fluidly between detailed logistics and high-level business context, remain calm in a fast-changing environment, and continuously find better ways to help the CEO and the organization operate effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide comprehensive support to the CEO, managing calendars, travel, and communications.

• Organize team and cross-functional events, leadership meetings, partnering with R&D, Sales, Marketing, GTM, teams to ensure smooth coordination.

• Collaborate with the Operations team on company-wide events (e.g., holiday parties, happy hours, SKOs) and handle office management to maintain a productive and organized workspace.

• Act as a liaison across departments for company-wide initiatives, supporting ad-hoc projects and fostering a collaborative work environment.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or in a similar role, ideally supporting C-level executives.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with colleagues at all levels.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and calendar management tools. Experience with travel booking and expense management software is a plus.

• Previous experience organizing events and managing logistics for large groups.

• Basic understanding of office management practices, with a proactive attitude toward problem-solving.

• A team player with a positive, can-do attitude who can work effectively with diverse teams across the company.

You will be successful at StarTree if you:

- Bring clarity and structure to complexity.

- Exercise excellent judgment and discretion.

- Anticipate needs rather than simply react to requests.

- Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.

- Build trust across the organization.

- Use technology and AI thoughtfully to improve how work gets done.

- Take ownership while respecting clear roles and decision boundaries.

- Care deeply about quality, follow-through, and the experience of the people you support.

Executive Assistant to the Founder/CEO

Role Type: Contract

Location: Mountain View, Contract

Office Hours: 5 hours a day

Reports to: Chief of Staff

Working closely with: The Founder and Executive Leadership Team

About StarTree:

StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. StarTree was founded by the core software engineering team and inventors of Apache Pinot, which currently powers hundreds of user-facing applications at companies across industries, including LinkedIn, Uber, Target, 7Eleven, Etsy, Walmart, WePay, Factual, Weibo, and more. StarTree Cloud has enabled even more companies to deploy and operate real-time analytics at scale, including Stripe, Sovrn, Roadie, Just Eat Takeaway.com, Dialpad, Guitar Center, Blinkit, and more.

StarTree recently announced our Series B Funding with investment from GGV Capital, Sapphire Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and CRV. We have been named one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups and one of CRN's 10 Coolest Cloud Computing Startup Companies of 2022!

jobs.description:

• Private medical health insurance
• Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
• Flexible work from home hybrid model
• Free language courses
• Birthday day off!

• Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
• Career-development opportunities.

• ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

• Applicable Collective Agreement Comercio del Metal Barcelona

We can’t wait to find our next great talent!

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

jobs.title: 営業支援担当（プロジェクト推進）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7600万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼営業支援部 営業支援1チームの紹介

PayPayの営業支援部は、営業組織が目標達成に向けて動きやすい環境を整えるチームです。営業活動の状況を数値と現場の声の両面から捉え、課題の発見から改善策の実行まで、営業部門や社内関係部署と連携して支援しています。本ポジションが所属するチームでは、営業組織の会議や横断プロジェクトの企画・運営、情報や数値の整理、営業活動に役立つ資料・仕組みづくりを担います。会議を予定どおり進めるだけでなく、議論を整理し、関係者の認識をそろえ、次の行動につなげることを大切にしています。チームには、データ分析、資料作成、業務改善など、それぞれの強みを持つメンバーがいます。営業現場や関係部署と協力しながら、チームで課題解決に取り組んでいます。

▼募集の背景

営業組織の規模や取り組みが広がるなかで、部門間の連携や意思決定をより円滑にし、決まったことを着実に実行へつなげる体制の強化が必要です。会議やプロジェクトの準備、情報整理、進捗確認、運営方法の改善を通じて、営業組織が本来の営業活動に集中できる環境をつくるメンバーを募集します。定型業務を正確に進めるだけでなく、関係者の声や数値から課題を見つけ、運営方法や進め方の改善を提案・実行していただくことを期待しています。

【具体的な業務内容】

■営業支援部
▽加盟店営業部門向け営業支援
加盟店営業を担当する営業組織を支援する業務となり、各種データの分析や営業プロセスの効率化などの営業活動の後方支援を行います。
営業支援部は業務に応じて3チーム（各7名程）で構成されています。メンバー全員がプロジェクトリーダーとして推進する環境となっており、年齢や業務経験問わず活躍しております。

▽具体的な業務内容
営業組織の会議・プロジェクトの企画運営と、営業活動を支える情報整理・仕組みづくりを担当します。
- 営業組織の定例会議、部門横断会議、キックオフなどの企画・運営
- 会議の目的や論点、決定事項を整理し、関係者との調整や進行を行う
- アジェンダ、説明資料、議事録、アクション管理表などの作成
- 各部門から集めた情報や数値を整理し、会議や意思決定に活用できる形にまとめる
- 会議やプロジェクトで決まったアクションの担当者・期限・進捗を確認する
- 全国の営業活動で活用する資料やセールスシートの作成・更新
- 会議や情報共有の進め方を振り返り、運営方法や手順を改善する

▽入社後について
まずはPayPayのサービスや営業活動の流れを理解し、営業現場と関係を構築するところからスタートしていただく想定です。
その後、これまでの経験や得意分野を生かしながら、会議運営や業務改善の取り組みに携わっていただきます。
営業知識や企画業務については、既存メンバーと連携しながら習得いただける環境を想定しています。

▼本ポジションの魅力

営業部門やバックオフィスのさまざまな部門と関わり、現場の状況や課題を理解しながら、組織の意思決定と実行を支えるポジションです。会議や資料を準備するだけでなく、論点の整理、関係者との調整、アクションの進捗管理まで一貫して関わります。自分の工夫によって議論が進み、決定事項が実行に移され、営業組織全体の仕事の進め方が改善していく手応えを得られます。

必要な経験/スキル

・複数の関係者と連携し、期限や優先順位を意識して業務を進めた経験
・相手の意見を聞き、必要な情報や論点を整理して合意形成や業務遂行につなげた経験
・PowerPoint等を用いて、情報を分かりやすい資料にまとめた経験
・会議やプロジェクトの準備・運営、または関係者との調整に携わった経験

あると望ましい経験/スキル

・部門横断の会議、研修、イベント、プロジェクトの企画・運営経験
・営業部門、事業部門、営業企画、営業推進などでの業務経験
・会議運営や業務フローの改善、手順書・テンプレートの整備経験
・Excelやスプレッドシートを用いたデータ整理・集計の経験
・生成AIなどのツールを活用した業務効率化の経験
・会議のファシリテーションや、アクションの進捗管理の経験

PayPayが求める人物像

• PayPay 5 sensesに当てはまる方

勤務時間

• スーパーフレックス制（コアタイム無し）

• 年次有給休暇(初年度14日間、入社月に応じて按分付与。入社日から使用可）

• パーソナル休暇（毎年度５日間付与/初年度入社月により3日間もしくは5日間付与） ※PayPay独自の特別有給休暇制度で、本人/家族/ペットなどの病気/ケガ/通院付き添い等にご使用頂けます。

給与

jobs.title: Distribution Field Admin
jobs.location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are looking for a User Field Admin Coordinator with experience supporting users in obtaining IDs in accordance with government standard procedures and guidelines.

Our mobile money operations are currently hindered by the "ID gap"—customers with missing, damaged, or expired identification. We are seeking a proactive User Field Admin Coordinator who is scrappy, swift, and thorough in helping our user base secure valid replacement identification.

The primary focus of this role is to bridge the gap between our customers and the Commission Electorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI) by streamlining the process of obtaining duplicate or replacement voter IDs to maintain KYC compliance. Additionally, you will coordinate field distributor recruitment via referrals in synergy with the Admin Manager, maintain institutional relationships with local authorities, obtain necessary market access permits, and supervise field branding deployment.

In this role you’ll;

• Serve as the primary point of contact between wave and CENI provincial offices. Navigate administrative hurdles to expedite the issuance of duplicate voter cards for our user base.

• Design and lead "ID Restoration" clinics in high-traffic areas or remote zones where user IDs have expired or been lost.

• Ensure that all collected and processed identification documents meet the Central Bank of Congo (BCC) and telecommunications regulatory standards.

• Hire and manage a team of field agents who will assist users with the physical paperwork, queuing, and biometric verification processes at local administration offices.

• Track the "Conversion Rate" of users with expired IDs to those with updated credentials and provide weekly progress reports to senior management.

• Develop a simplified "step-by-step" guide for users to help them understand the legal requirements for ID replacement in the DRC.

• Organize and boost local referral recruitment for distributors in synergy with the Admin Manager.

• Coordinate the follow-up of referred distributors to the Admin Manager and ensure initial screening on the ground.

• Ensure institutional liaison with local authorities (territorial and municipal) to guarantee smooth and compliant integration.

• Negotiate and obtain necessary access permits and authorizations to operate within public markets and high-traffic areas.

• Supervise the negotiation, deployment, and monitoring of brand visibility and branding in the field.

Key Details

• Location: You'll work from our office in Kinshasa, Kongo Central or Bandundu and may travel to field locations.

• Contract Type: Permanent.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer generous parental leave policies (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized childcare when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space

Requirements

• Proficiency in French is required, with English being a plus as this role involves interacting with non-French-speaking stakeholders. Knowledge of local Congolese languages (Lingala, Kikongo, etc.) is a significant plus.

• CENI Background: Minimum of 3–5 years of professional experience working directly with or within the Commission Électorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI).

• Administrative Navigation: Proven track record of navigating DRC government bureaucracy and provincial administration (Territoires/Communes).

• Mobile Money/Telco Knowledge: Familiarity with KYC requirements for financial services in the DRC.

• Field Recruitment & Network: Solid experience in field recruitment based on word-of-mouth/referrals and direct collaboration with temporary staffing agencies.

• Local Institutional Relations: Proven ability to establish and maintain trusted relationships with local and administrative authorities.

You might be a good fit if you:

• Have a Deep local Knowledge: An intimate understanding of the CENI’s electoral mapping and the specific challenges of ID issuance in both urban (Kinshasa/Kongo Centrali) and rural provinces.

• Have the ability to manage mobile field teams in challenging environments.

• Integrity: High ethical standards, handling sensitive personal data and government relations requires impeccable transparency.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

• Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

• Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

• Over $300 million raised in funding

• 3,000 Tideans globally

• We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Ledger team owns the core ledger. It's the system of record behind every account, balance and payment at Tide. Payments, cards and lending all sit on top of it. If it's slow or wrong, members can't pay people, and that hits their business directly. The team works on this one problem.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Tide is growing into new markets and new products, and the ledger has to scale with that. We're rewriting it and migrating to the new version. The goals are better performance for members and a foundation that keeps up as volumes and products grow. You'll help design it and deliver it.

This is a hands-on role in one team, working on one problem. You'll do architecture, system design, coding and mentoring. You won't have direct reports, but you'll own the technical direction of the ledger. You'll partner closely with the team's Engineering Manager and Product Manager, and lead by example.
We're also changing how we build and test. The team uses AI and agentic tools to deliver working software. We're applying the same approach to functional and performance testing, so we can deliver this work in a fraction of the time it would have taken before. You'll help shape how that works.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

• Design and own the architecture of the new ledger, and make the trade-off calls

• Write production code and review the team's, so the quality bar is clear

• Plan and lead the migration from the current ledger: staged rollouts, parallel running, reconciliation and rollback, with a small blast radius for every change

• Use AI and agentic tools to deliver faster, and help build AI-assisted functional and performance testing

• Own performance and reliability: latency budgets, SLOs and capacity as volumes grow

• Mentor and coach engineers at every level

• Partner with the Engineering Manager and Product Manager, and with the teams that build on the ledger

• Contribute to our Communities of Practice

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Experience and background:

• You've built and run high-volume, real-time distributed systems with hard constraints, such as the time allowed to authorise a transaction

• You've worked on systems that are too important to fail, where an outage stops customers doing business. That could be in payments, FX, trading, gambling, finance or similar. Payments or banking experience is a bonus, not a requirement

• You've changed critical systems safely: rewrites, migrations and rollouts where you kept the blast radius small

• You've used agentic AI tools such as Claude to deliver working software, and changed how you work to get the best out of them. You believe in this approach

• You've mentored other engineers and set technical direction for a team, without being their line manager

Technical depth:

• Strong backend engineering in a strongly typed language. Java is preferred, but design and architecture skills matter more than the language

• Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, ordering and failure modes

• Relational databases at scale, ideally PostgreSQL: transactions, locking, and data modelling for correctness and performance

• Performance engineering: profiling, latency budgets and load testing

• Event-driven and asynchronous design

• Running services in a cloud-native environment (we are AWS-heavy)

• Testing: functional, performance and resilience

How you work:

• You make pragmatic trade-offs and can explain them

• You lead by example

• You coach and develop the engineers around you

• You use your authority well: you explain your decisions and bring people with you

• You can talk to non-technical stakeholders without losing precision

• Our tech stack

• Java and PostgreSQL, running on AWS

• Event-driven architecture with messaging over SNS and SQS

• Observability with Coralogix

• GitHub for CI/CD with automated testing and security scanning. New joiners typically have something in production within their first two weeks

• AI coding and agentic tools, including Claude, as part of everyday engineering

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

• The gross monthly salary for this position ranges from 7500€ to 11000€, depending on your skills and experience

• Private Health Insurance

• 3rd Pillar Pension Fund Contribution

• 25 days Paid Annual Leave

• 3 Paid Days off for Volunteering or L&D Activities

• Parental Leave days

• Family-Friendly Leave

• Personal L&D Budget in the amount of 500€ per year

• Mental wellbeing platform Plumm

• WFH Equipment Allowance

• Sabbatical Leave

• Share options

• Team Events

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:

• Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

• All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.

• Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.

• Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Program Manager US -Remote 
Note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
Neuron7.ai is a fast-growing SaaS company with category-defining AI solutions for customer service, backed by top VCs and a stellar group of angel investors and advisors. Our AI-powered Resolution Intelligence platform helps enterprises make accurate service decisions at scale by leveraging structured data, unstructured data, LLMs, and Agentic AI to diagnose and resolve complex issues in seconds.
We serve some of the world's leading organizations across high-tech, manufacturing, telecommunications, medical devices, industrial equipment, and field service operations.

About the Role: 
 
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager or Project Manager to drive end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives for our customers. 
 
The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering multiple projects or programs while working closely with the internal N7 product, engineering,business, and other cross-functional stakeholders as well as customers. 
 
The role requires strong execution, stakeholder management, risk management, and an understanding of software and product development lifecycles. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
 
- Own end-to-end program or project delivery from initiation and planning through execution, release, and closure. 
 
- Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. 
 
- Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, dependencies, and delivery roadmaps. 
 
- Work closely with Product, Engineering, CSM, Business, Design, QA, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution. 
 
- Track project progress against agreed timelines, milestones, and deliverables and proactively address deviations. 
 
- Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks. 
 
- Drive regular project or program reviews and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders. 
 
- Facilitate Agile or Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog discussions, wherever applicable. 
 
- Ensure effective coordination between multiple teams and manage cross-functional dependencies. 
 
- Collaborate with product and technology teams to understand requirements, priorities, and delivery expectations. 
 
- Maintain project documentation, trackers, action items, RAID logs, and status reports. 
 
- Ensure effective communication of project updates, risks, decisions, and dependencies across stakeholders. 
 
- Support prioritization and resolution of issues that may impact project timelines, quality, or business objectives. 
 
- Contribute to continuous improvement of project management and delivery processes. 
 
- Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business requirements. 

 
Required Skills and Experience: 
 
- 10+years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Technology Project Management, or a similar role. 
 
- Experience working in a product-based or technology-driven organization. 
 
- Strong experience in end-to-end project or program delivery. 
 
- Hands-on experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies. 
 
- Strong understanding of SDLC and software or product development lifecycle. 
 
- Proven experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders. 
 
- Strong understanding of project planning, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk management. 
 
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and execution skills. 
 
- Experience working with project management or collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or similar tools. 
 
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects in a fast-paced environment. 
 
Education: 
 
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Management, Business, or a related discipline. 
 
- PMP Certification 
 
- An MBA or PGDM or relevant project or program management certification will be an added advantage. 
 
Preferred Background: 
 
Experience in the following environments will be preferred: 
 
- Product-Based Technology Companies 
- Consumer Technology 
- E-commerce 
- SaaS 
- FinTech 
- Digital Platforms or Internet Companies 
 
 
Preferred Competencies: 
 
- Strong ownership and execution mindset 
 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management 
 
- Ability to work effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams 
 
- Strong planning and organizational skills 
 
- Ability to identify risks proactively and drive timely resolution 
 
- Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced product environments 
 
- Strong business and technology understanding 
 
- Data-driven and structured approach to problem-solving 

  
What We Do and Value:
At Neuron7.ai, we prioritize integrity, innovation, and a customer-centric approach. Our mission is to enhance service decision-making through advanced AI technology, and we are dedicated to delivering excellence in all aspects of our work.
Company Perks & Benefits:
💰 Competitive salary, equity, and spot bonuses.
🤕 Paid Time-off.
🏥 Comprehensive health insurance.
🍼 Paid parental leave.
🏡 Flexible Hybrid work.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Neuron7.ai is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We ensure equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
