jobs.title: Prodajni savjetnik Kcentar Sub City
jobs.description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?

Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

• Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
• Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
• Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
• Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
• Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

• Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
• Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
• Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

• Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
• Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
• Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
• Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

• 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
• Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
• Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
• Naknada za topli obrok
• Nagrada za umirovljenje
• Dar za vjenčanje
• Program preporuke

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE!

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Capital
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Product Manager, Capital

We have a massive opportunity ahead of us – to scale Adyen’s financial products by 10x, ushering in the next phase of growth for the company. Adyen has built a Financial OS spanning Capital, Banking, and Issuing, powered by our unified global platform, banking licenses, and dynamic identity data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help scale Capital, which will be foundational for Adyen’s next generation Financial Products. The Capital team is on a mission to enable businesses to grow & thrive by providing them innovative financing solutions. The role is based out of San Francisco  and sits within the Capital team, which is part of our Financial Services product team.

Successful candidates will have demonstrated passion for financial technology and are excited about Adyen’s opportunity to build a meaningful Capital business in the next 2-5 yrs. In this role, you will be responsible for building a roadmap and executing on new financing products. You will collaborate closely with our Product, Commercial, Design, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Regulatory, and Compliance teams to deliver customer and business outcomes.

What you’ll do

• Set strategy and roadmap for new Capital products.

• Understand customer needs and make investments in products and features that deliver customer value.

• Lead platform-scale execution working closely with the Engineering, Product, Design, Finance, Operations, Regulatory, and Compliance teams to deliver a highly automated platform that scales globally without compromising reliability or trust.

• Operate with a data and experimentation first mindset defining success metrics for the team and adopting an AI-first product development approach that uses experimentation to measurably improve outcomes.

Who you are

• 8+ years of experience building high-scale products in fast growing tech or fintech environments.

• 4+ years of experience in lending, banking, or adjacent products.

• Track record of delivering complex product and platform initiatives at scale.

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high autonomy and ownership.

• You are able to translate technical complexity back to customer impact and understand the needs of different customers.

• PM at heart with strong product instincts, data-based decision mindset, and highly focused on business impact.

• Demonstrated passion for AI-forward thinking.

• Demonstrated ability of setting vision and strategy for teams.

• Strong sense of initiative and self-motivation.

• A clear, compelling communicator who is comfortable interacting with both internal and external stakeholders from varying disciplines and cultures.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias toward action and ability to move fast in the midst of ambiguity.

Total Rewards & Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $201,600 - $302,400. Compensation is based on factors including qualifications, experience, and location. Total compensation package includes equity (RSUs), 401(k), health, dental, vision, and more.

In-office expectations

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We're an office-first company and expect employees to work in-office at least 3 days a week on average. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while also supporting flexibility.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen

We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen.

If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. If you have specific time constraints, please communicate them with your recruiter, and we’ll do our best to accommodate them where possible.

EEO statement

Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Storage
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb's Online Data organization runs the stores behind every booking, every message, and every payment. Storage Foundation owns the engines underneath those stores. We build and operate Airbnb's source of truth databases for the company's online OLTP traffic, and we own the control plane that provisions, upgrades, and heals them. This is engine work, not fleet administration. When our engines are slow, unavailable, or wrong, so is the product.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead engineers across multiple teams and you will manage managers. You will own the engine strategy, the reliability commitment that every service above you depends on, and the growth of the people who do the work. Your leverage comes from the managers and technical leads on your teams, the bar you hold in design and incident reviews, and the trust you build with the teams who stake their product on us.

The Difference You Will Make:

Set the technical direction for Airbnb's online storage engines

You will set a multi-year technical vision for the engines and the control plane beneath every transactional and key value store at Airbnb, and you will make the calls that follow from it. That includes where we invest in our own engine expertise, where we buy instead of build, how we evaluate alternative engines against real production traffic, and which capabilities have to exist before a workload can safely land on us. You will also make the cost of these systems measurable and attributable, so that investment decisions rest on evidence. You will make these calls alongside senior technical leaders across Online Data and the broader Infrastructure organization.

Make reliability the ground truth of the platform

The services built on your engines commit to availability targets that only hold if the engine underneath them is better than they are. You will own that engine level commitment and the error budgets that feed every product surface above it. You will drive fault isolation so that one tenant cannot degrade everyone else, prove regional failover with scheduled production drills, and treat capacity headroom as a reliability decision. You will own incidents in your area personally, and you will turn each one into a structural fix.

Make routine work disappear

Every ticket is a product team waiting on us and an engineer pulled off platform work. You will push your teams to build API first, so that provisioning, schema changes, grants, and quotas can be driven by an engineer, a tool, or an agent without a human in the loop. You will use AI where it takes real work off your teams.

Build and grow the team

You will coach engineering managers and senior technical leads, and grow the depth of database expertise inside Airbnb. That means taking a forward view of talent needs, building a succession pipeline, hiring senior engineers who can own a complex open source codebase, and creating the conditions where people do the most technically ambitious work of their careers. You will also represent this group to executive leadership and to our customers, and you will make the case for investment in terms the business can act on.

Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of engineering experience with a BS or Masters, or 9+ years with a PhD, including several years managing engineers and experience managing managers or senior technical leads

• Experience leading teams that build and operate Tier 0 distributed systems, with accountability for availability targets, on call health, and incident response at a company where downtime is visible to customers

• Enough technical depth in databases, storage, or comparable stateful infrastructure to set direction, judge tradeoffs, and earn the trust of engineers who work on engine internals, without needing to be the architect of record

• Experience making build versus buy and vendor decisions with evidence, including managing a critical vendor or open source dependency while building more capability in house

• Demonstrated ability to attract, hire, and grow senior technical talent, including other managers

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting strategy, risk, and investment return to executives and explaining complex systems to non technical partners

• Strong cross functional collaboration with customer teams, peer platform teams, and partners who do not report to you, including resolving conflict before it escalates

Nice to have:

• Experience with distributed SQL systems, or with relational engine internals such as query execution, storage engines, replication, or consensus

• Experience running large stateful workloads on Kubernetes

• Experience leading migrations of business critical data under strict availability and correctness requirements

• Experience with upstream open source contribution as a team practice, not just an individual one

• Experience building platform products with internal customers, including onboarding and adoption

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$248,000—$310,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Manufacturing Operations
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Manufacturing Operations exists to build and sustain the production system that enables Anduril to scale manufacturing with speed, quality, and discipline. We don't just support the factory. We are the operating system that makes it run. Our remit spans five pillars: the Anduril Production System (standard work, tiered accountability, KPIs, visual management), optimization and continuous improvement, learning and development, maintenance standards, and analytics. This role reports directly to the VP of Manufacturing Operations.

ABOUT THE JOB

As Manufacturing Program Manager you will drive the cross-functional projects and initiatives that move Anduril from LRIP-era operations to a scalable Full Rate Production model. You will not own a single product line. Instead, you will be the program management engine across all five pillars of the Manufacturing Operations remit, ensuring that strategic initiatives have clear owners, defined timelines, cross-functional alignment, and measurable outcomes.

This is not a traditional project management role. It requires someone who understands manufacturing operations at the floor level and can drive accountability across engineering, supply chain, quality, IT, and leadership to get programs across the finish line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will drive cross-functional projects and initiatives within each of the five areas that define the Manufacturing Operations remit:

Build and Deploy the Anduril Production System

• Drive the cross-functional rollout of standard work, tiered meeting structures (Tier 1/2/3), KPI definitions, and visual management across all manufacturing site

• Coordinate across Manufacturing System & Standards, site leadership, and IT/Digital to sequence deployment line by line and ensure each site is assessed, baselined, and brought to standard

• Build and operationalize the enterprise scorecard architecture (Plan vs. Actual, CTB Attainment, Downtime Pareto, Yield/DRR, OT%) so each level of the organization has the right metric at the right cadence

• Stand up and manage the Leadership SteerCo cadence that governs system priorities and holds the standard

Get Technicians to Certified Operator Faster

• Program manage the initiatives that cut time-from-hire-to-certified-operator, partnering with L&D on structured onboarding, skill certification redesign, and OJT overhaul

• Drive the cross-functional work between L&D, Talent Acquisition, and state/community partners (e.g., JobsOhio) to build a repeatable technician sourcing and hiring pipeline

• Ensure standard work is right-sized and OJT checklists map 1:1 to tasks so qualification is verifiable at every technician level

• Track and report on onboarding volume, certification timelines, and pipeline health across all sites

Upskill Key Front-Line Leaders

• Drive the buildout and cross-site deployment of supervisor and leadership training programs so the leaders closest to the line can run and audit the production system themselves

• Coordinate between L&D, site leadership, and the Optimization team to deliver leadership content and embed real-time coaching and mentoring across all sites

• Track program delivery milestones, cohort completions, and effectiveness metrics for Lead, Own, Grow and future leadership curricula

Support and Optimize the Lines We Run

• Coordinate the deployment of CI and optimization resources across sites, sequencing stabilization and optimization work against business impact

• Manage the CI project portfolio: track active deployments, gap assessments, kaizen events, and value stream mapping initiatives to ensure knowledge transfer sticks after each engagement

• Drive cross-functional alignment on NPI manufacturing readiness so new programs reach rate faster, partnering with Manufacturing Engineering and site teams

• Coordinate surge and recovery support when lines need additional capacity, ensuring the right resources deploy with clear scope and exit criteria

Build Maintenance into the System

• Drive the cross-functional standup of maintenance as a discipline within the production system: preventative maintenance programs, spare parts strategy, work order management, and technician skill development

• Coordinate the integration of maintenance KPIs (uptime, MTBF, MTTR, PM completion rate) into site-level scorecards and tiered meetings

• Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to define and document handoff criteria in the MDP/Launch Playbook so maintenance boundaries are clear from day one

Across all five pillars:

• Own the interfaces between Manufacturing Operations and partner organizations (Quality, ME, Supply Chain, IT/Digital, EHS) to keep boundary agreements current and escalation paths clear

• Standardize the work product for all outward reporting on behalf of Manufacturing Operations, ensuring leadership has consistent, quantitative visibility into program status, risks, and outcomes

• Drive resolution on open cross-functional governance questions (production scheduling ownership, shop-floor safety program ownership, MES system of record)

HOW THIS ROLE DIFFERS

From a Product Program Manager (PPM): A PPM is focused on cross-functional teams in relation to one product line with actions that are tactical in nature. This role drives global strategic initiatives for the manufacturing operations organization as a whole and does not focus on any specific product.

From an Engineering PM: Will partner with Engineering PM on global initiatives that impact both teams but is focused primarily on items that impact the production workforce and the support structure around it. The work centers on floor-level execution, not product development.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATION

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field

• 5+ years of experience in operations program management, production, or manufacturing, preferably in defense, aerospace, or complex hardware industries

• Direct experience deploying production systems, lean manufacturing frameworks, or operational excellence programs at the site or enterprise level

• Strong understanding of manufacturing metrics (OEE, yield, takt, cycle time, downtime Pareto) and tiered accountability structures

• Experience managing workforce development or training programs in a manufacturing environment

• Track record of driving cross-functional alignment across operations, engineering, supply chain, and quality organizations

• Proficiency in project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent)

• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate floor-level detail into executive-level reporting

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with evolving priorities

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in defense, aerospace, or automotive manufacturing at scale (LRIP to FRP transition experience highly valued)

• Experience with ERP, MRP, MES, or PLM systems

• Lean, Six Sigma, or TPS certification or equivalent practical experience

• Experience building or deploying standardized work programs, skill certification systems, or maintenance management programs

• Familiarity with tiered daily management systems and visual management deployment

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Talent & People Operations Administrator
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
This is a rare opportunity for a sharp, curious, and driven person to join our team and learn how to build high-performing teams. No prior recruitment or HR experience is needed – you will get direct access to our proven playbook for finding, evaluating, and building world-class teams.
At Beaver Group, we believe recruiting the best talent and creating an environment where great people do amazing things is the #1 way to build great businesses. Operating across all businesses in our group, this role goes well beyond standard recruiting – while mastering how to find and attract top talent is your initial focus, you will also learn how we structure high-performing teams, onboard and develop people, and build an elite workplace culture. This is a standout chance to build a high-impact career inside a supportive, fast-moving group.
 
The Role
This is the entry-point role into our Talent & People Operations team, designed to help us recruit A-Player talent, build great teams, develop and retain our people, and support managers to lead high-performing teams. By strengthening our most important asset – our team – you will directly help drive Beaver Group's growth while rapidly building your own capability.
The role follows a clear, staged development pathway into Talent & People Operations Partner over 3 years:
Year 1
· Learn the fundamentals of Talent Acquisition and our Beaver A-Player Hiring Methodology.
· Learn how to use our modern, AI-enabled recruitment and candidate assessment tech stack.
· Learn to run the end-to-end hiring process for individual contributor (advertised) roles – from reviewing applications and conducting initial phone screens to coordinating interviews and keeping candidate records accurate.
· Learn how to conduct candidate research to support proactive sourcing, while assisting with day-to-day People Operations administrative tasks.
· Graduate to Talent & People Operations Coordinator.
Year 2
· Learn to run proactive sourcing campaigns (with direct oversight) for non-advertised roles to engage passive candidates.
· Develop deeper expertise in our candidate assessment tools and structured interviewing to evaluate role and cultural fit.
· Learn to build complete Job Packs for individual contributor roles, while continuing to support foundational People Operations administration.
Year 3
· Run proactive sourcing campaigns independently across the group, including for more senior, complex, and international or global roles.
· Learn and take on initial People Operations responsibilities – such as structured onboarding workflows, people systems administration, feedback and review cycles, and training coordination.
· At the end of Year 3, graduate to Talent & People Operations Partner, operating as a self-sufficient talent and people operator.
You will report to our Talent & People Operations Manager, with structured, hands-on training and day-to-day mentorship led by our experienced Talent & People Operations Partner, alongside valuable exposure to our Founder and senior leaders across the group.
 
Ideal Candidate
You don’t need any prior Talent Acquisition or HR experience – or a university degree – to succeed here. We hire for smarts, character, work ethic, and a genuine desire to learn, and we will teach you everything you need to know.
We are looking for someone who is:
· Curious & Eager to Learn: You are bright, inquisitive, and genuinely interested in learning how businesses work, what makes different roles succeed, and how to master new frameworks.
· Comfortable & Resilient Communicator: You are articulate and happy talking with lots of new people every day via phone, email, and messages – and you take busy pipelines and the normal ups and downs of recruiting in your stride.
· Driven & Fast-Paced: You have a strong internal motor, enjoy staying busy, move with urgency, and hate leaving tasks unfinished.
· Organised & Detail-Focused: You take quiet pride in getting the details right – from scheduling interviews cleanly to keeping candidate records accurate.
· Tech & AI Savvy: You are confident with computers and spreadsheets, pick up new software quickly, and enjoy using AI tools to work smarter.
· Humble & Coachable: You have a low ego, welcome direct feedback, enjoy being part of a supportive team, and get excited about helping build great teams.
You will bring 3+ years of full-time work experience in any fast-paced office-based role, along with a clear motivation to build a long-term career in Talent & People Operations.
 
What’s Special About This Role?
This is not a standard office admin job – it is a structured launchpad into a high-impact career:
· True Career Launchpad: Break into an in-house Talent & People Operations career with no prior experience required – we invest heavily in structured training and 1-on-1 mentorship to teach you the craft from the ground up.
· Modern, AI-Enabled Tech Stack: Learn how modern talent teams operate using AI-enabled sourcing, tracking, and assessment tools rather than outdated paper-pushing.
· Clear 3-Year Progression Pathway: Follow a transparent roadmap from Administrator to Coordinator in Year 1, and Talent & People Operations Partner by the end of Year 3.
· Group-Wide Scope: Work across all operating businesses in our growing private group, gaining great exposure to our Founder, General Managers, and Hiring Managers.
· Friendly, High-Trust Culture: Join a supportive, high-performing team that backs each other, values straight talk and hard work, and operates without corporate red tape.

jobs.title: Manager, Manufacturing Optimization
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Manufacturing Operations Team plays a vital role in driving operational excellence and delivering high-quality products that support Anduril's mission of advancing defense capabilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Manufacturing Optimization Manager to support in the development and deployment of the Anduril Production System (APS) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across our manufacturing sites in the US. This role will work closely with manufacturing/production leadership teams to develop, implement, and sustain lean manufacturing systems, coach frontline leaders, and build tools to help drive operational performance in the business.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in manufacturing operations and would have held roles leading production teams on a shop floor. The candidate should have a strong working knowledge and application of metric board tracking, KPI and target development, problem solving, and a demonstrated proficiency in daily management in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing setting. You will be responsible for building capabilities in frontline production leaders (Supervisor and Team Leader) and creating sustainable systems in Manufacturing Excellence that drive long-term performance improvements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing professional ready to make an impact by coaching, teaching, and developing others through a hands-on approach.

A successful candidate will be expected to work out of Costa Mesa, CA. Based on eligibility, relocation assistance may be available. Travel up to 50% may be required for training, cross-site collaboration, or supporting continuous improvement initiatives at other Anduril facilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Establish a scalable operating/manufacturing/production system (tiered accountability, daily management, KPI trees, visual management, problem solving, governance) aligned to Safety, People, Quality, Delivery, and Cost

• Strengthen cross-functional execution by integrating Operations, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Test into shared problem-solving and prioritized action plans

• Standardize processes, tools, and templates that will be used by all Operations teams across the company

• Coach and develop Managers, Supervisors and Team Leaders through daily Gemba, leader standard work, and structured feedback

• Capture and deploy best practices across lines/cells/sites via playbooks, standard work libraries, and replication mechanisms with clear ownership and audit cadence

• Develop practical tools and structures (dashboards, hour-by-hour boards, problem queues, skills boards) that improve visibility, prioritization, and decision speed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience as a Production Supervisor or Manager running a shop floor in a high-volume environment

• Possesses strong working knowledge and application of LEAN tools and principles, 5S, and Six Sigma to eliminate waste

• Clear demonstration of scaling products from NPI to high volume

• Strong working knowledge of standard work development, writing, and creation for frontline hourly teams on the shop floor

• Organized and detail-oriented with excellent verbal & written communication skills

• Passion for employee development and enjoy the process of training and developing both new hires and veteran production staff

• Experience supporting process development and optimization

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

• Proficient with MS Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (engineering, business, or applied science), organizational development, or leadership

• Lean six sigma green belt certified

• Working knowledge of AS9100 standards and OSHA laws

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret Security Clearance

• Experience in small electronic assembly and drones a plus

• Ability to develop cross functional relationships as a well-respected, trusted partner

US Salary Range

$132,000—$175,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Human Resources Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Human Resources Operations Manager

Location: Bolingbrook, IL

Job Type: Full-Time | Initially Remote, Transitioning to Onsite (5 Days per Week)

Work Arrangement: This position will begin remotely while the organization establishes its new office in Bolingbrook, IL. Once the office is operational, the role will transition to a fully onsite schedule, Monday through Friday. Candidates must be comfortable with this future onsite requirement.

Job Reports To: Vice President, Talent Management

Salary Range: $110,000-$140,000 DOE plus excellent benefits package

About Jaan Health/Phamily

Jaan Health is a leading AI-based care management company serving healthcare providers. For nearly a decade, the company has leveraged its easy-to-use, proprietary technology to enable health systems, medical groups, and ACOs to deliver high-quality, high-ROI proactive care to hundreds of thousands of previously underserved patients.

Phamily, the company's core technology platform, has transformed chronic disease management with clinically tested AI and easy-to-use technology that enables physicians and care teams to offer high-touch, individualized patient care that has been proven to reduce investment in extra labor and the overall cost of care.  Phamily helps ensure healthcare providers are compensated fairly for providing high-quality care between office visits, while improving the lives of patients with chronic diseases. Learn more at phamily.com.

Job/Role Description:

The HR Operations Manager will own and scale the systems, processes, programs, and data infrastructure that power our People function. You will lead and partner on the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational processes and systems that support the full employee lifecycle—from recruiting  to offboarding. This is a highly hands-on role for an HR Operations leader who is equally comfortable running payroll, managing benefits, implementing HR technology, auditing complex data, and turning workforce data into actionable business insights.

This role ensures our HR operations are compliant, secure, data-driven, and built to scale, while also providing a seamless employee experience. This is a hands-on individual contributor role partnering with cross-functional stakeholders and building the foundation of our core HR functions including compensation, benefits, HRIS, payroll, and compliance.  This role will report to Vice President, Talent Management.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own and execute end-to-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, payroll, benefits, compensation, performance management, learning and development, and offboarding.

• Manage full-cycle payroll for salaried and hourly employees, including timecards, payroll changes, deductions, audits, reconciliations, and issue resolution to ensure accurate and timely payroll.

• Own administration and continuous improvement of employee benefits, 401(k), equity, lifestyle perks, and other total rewards programs.

• Lead annual open enrollment and benefits initiatives, including vendor management, employee communications, system configuration, audits, and identifying creative ways to enhance benefit offerings.

• Lead the end-to-end selection and implementation of a new HRIS and payroll vendor, from requirements gathering and vendor selection through configuration, integrations, data migration, auditing, testing, launch, go-live, and optimization.

• Own and optimize the People team's HR technology ecosystem, including HRIS/payroll, Lattice, EasyLlama, Notion, and other HR tools and systems.

• Develop, streamline, and automate scalable HR processes, workflows, methodologies, templates, and toolkits that improve operational efficiency and the employee experience.

• Build and maintain dashboards and reporting across headcount, turnover, hiring, compensation, payroll, benefits, performance, compliance, and workforce planning. Identify business insights, risks, and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.

• Lead cross-functional HR projects from planning through execution, establishing clear milestones, ownership, timelines, documentation, and measurable outcomes.

• Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, providing timely HR support, guidance on policies and procedures, and effective resolution of HR Operations issues.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of progressive HR management and leadership experience, with direct ownership and accountability for HR Operations, programs, systems, processes, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong hands-on experience managing full-cycle payroll for salaried and hourly employees, including timecards, audits, reconciliations, deductions, and issue resolution.

• Demonstrated experience leading HRIS and/or payroll system implementations or migrations, including vendor selection, project management, configuration, data migration, testing, and launch.

• Hands-on experience managing employee benefits, 401(k), equity, open enrollment, and total rewards programs.

• Strong HR technology experience with platforms such as Justworks, Lattice, EasyLlama, Notion, or comparable HR systems.

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and HR analytics skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data reconciliation, and analysis across multiple datasets.

• Demonstrated ability to build dashboards and workforce reporting, identify trends, and translate HR data into actionable business insights for leadership.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. employment laws and HR compliance, with excellent project management, problem-solving, attention to detail, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred requirements:

• Experience leading HR Operations within a high-growth, startup environment.

• Proven experience independently leading an end-to-end HRIS and/or payroll vendor selection and implementation.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, and/or HR certification such as SHRM-CP/SCP or PHR/SPHR.

• Entrepreneurial DNA: a ‘builder’ mentality with the ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments where processes may not be fully fleshed out.

Work style & logistics:

We are a fast-growing, early-stage company with a bold mission and significant work ahead; every employee at Jaan Health must embody growth company DNA. This means you have proven success in a high-performing environment: high velocity, strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a true growth mindset.

You are both a playbook builder and executor, able to design scalable approaches for today while anticipating what the business will need tomorrow, and then follow through to deliver results.

Our culture is built on five principles that shape how we work, lead, and grow:

• Care: We care deeply about each other, our colleagues, patients, providers, clients, and communities we serve, knowing that what we do has a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

• Curiosity: We stay curious, are bothered by limitations, and never settle for complacency because yesterday’s answers won’t solve tomorrow’s problems.

• Clarity: We get concrete and create clarity through focused thinking, direct communication, and decisive action so great teams can move fast.

• Craftsmanship: We believe excellence and innovation are habits.

• Commitment: We are relentlessly committed to winning together the right way.

Our Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive compensation based on experience and impact

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents at a low cost

• Generous Paid Time Off: up to 35 paid days off each year so you can recharge, recover, and give back, including: 12 vacation days accrued annually for rest, travel, and personal time Up to 9 sick/wellness days to prioritize your health and well-being 12 paid company holidays throughout the year 2 Paid Give-Back Days to volunteer and make a meaningful impact in the communities you care about

• HSA and FSA account options

• 401(k) with company match after 6 months of full-time employment 100% match on the first 3% contributed, and 50% match on the next 2% contributed

• A collaborative, mission-driven team helping transform healthcare at scale

If you take pride in delivering results, embrace challenges, and proactively seek improvement, then this is the place for you. You’ll join a smart, humble, and collaborative team dedicated to improving healthcare.

This position is responsible for complying with all organizational security, privacy, and compliance policies applicable to the role, including separation of duties requirements, and for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the information and systems they access.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Phamily is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Director of Development
jobs.description:
About aiEDU

The AI Education Project (aiEDU) is a growing 501(c)(3) non-profit that creates equitable educational experiences to excite and empower learners everywhere with AI literacy. We educate students—especially those disproportionately impacted by artificial intelligence and automation—with the conceptual knowledge and skills they need to thrive as future workers, creators, consumers, and citizens. Join us to make a difference in education and help shape a brighter future for today's and tomorrow's learners.

About the Role

As the Director, Development at The AI Education Project (aiEDU), you will help to lead and execute a comprehensive development strategy across philanthropic, corporate and individual donors. aiEDU brought in close to $20M in new funding this year, so a substantial part of this role is ongoing stewardship of existing funders, alongside sourcing and cultivating new funder relationships.

This role will work closely with our CEO and leadership team and manage a Lead of Development. You will set annual fundraising targets, diversify our fundraising pipeline, lead grant writing efforts and manage reporting and relationships for existing funders. Additionally, you will oversee fundraising events and campaigns and leverage thought leadership to attract new funders. You will manage a Lead of Development. If you're passionate about innovative fundraising strategies and advancing AI education, we invite you to join our team and make a meaningful impact.

⭐ Role Details

• Location: This full-time, exempt position can be done on a flexible schedule remotely from home

• Travel: ~20% for funder engagement and events

• Compensation: The baseline compensation for this role is $155,000 - $175,000

• Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including full health, dental, and vision for you and any dependents, plus life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance, flexible work hours and location, flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, a generous annual stipend for home office expenses and professional development, and a 401k match of 4% vested immediately. For more details regarding our benefits, visit: aiedu.org/careers

• Reports to: Alex Kotran, CEO

• Manages: Lead, Development

• Start date: We’d like a candidate to start as soon as possible after receiving an offer, though there is some flexibility.

✅ Your Responsibilities:

Fundraising Strategy 25%

• Work with executive leadership team to set annual fundraising goals and ensure alignment with overall organizational strategy

• Serve as a thought partner and multiplier for the CEO on fundraising, including setting cultivation goals, conducting research, preparing briefing materials, and managing follow-up for funder meetings.

• Identify and expand new revenue streams beyond grants (e.g., corporate partnerships, high-net worth individuals, community-based fundraising, in-kind donations)

Existing Funder Stewardship & Grant Management 30%

• Oversee grant deliverables, reports, and deadlines, and work with program and operations teams to ensure we hit major milestones and file timely, accurate reports.

• Draft communications to potential and current funders (e.g. email outreach, monthly funder updates, funder briefing calls, and other touch points).

• Develop personalized stewardship plans for funders to deepen engagement over time and secure renewals and follow-on funding.

New Pipeline Development 30%

• Build and manage overall universe of funders and ensure aiEDU is consistently engaging with high quality touch points aligned to each funders’ priorities

• In partnership with the CEO, steward large donors from initial conversations through to successful close.

• Partner with executive leadership to ensure all new grant applications are aligned with existing priorities and resourcing is appropriately scoped.

• Conduct research into new funders and identify ways to tailor messaging and pitches for their respective focus areas.

• Organize funder convenings, roundtables, or special engagement opportunities.

Public & Thought Leadership in Fundraising 15%

• Position aiEDU as a trusted advisor and thought leader in the philanthropy space, through participation in briefings, speaking opportunities, and other external convenings.

• Keep up with trends in philanthropy, education, and nonprofit funding to inform strategy.

🚀 About You

Before reading, please remember that there is no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. If you are on the fence about applying because you are unsure whether you are qualified, we would strongly encourage you to apply. Share your relevant experiences in a thoughtful cover letter!

You might be a great match for this role if you have:

• 8+ years of experience in fundraising, development, or donor relations, preferably within the nonprofit or education sector.

• Proven ability to communicate a clear and compelling story; exceptional writing skills

• Proven track record of successfully meeting fundraising goals and developing diverse revenue streams.

• Experience stewarding large institutional grants, including reporting, compliance, and renewals.

• Experience working closely with a CEO or executive director as a fundraising partner.

• Experience managing and developing staff.

• Strong understanding of current trends in philanthropy, nonprofit funding, and corporate social responsibility (CSR).

• Expertise in grant writing, including research, proposal development, and submission.

• Experience in managing corporate and foundation partnerships

• Ability to build and manage an effective funder pipeline, ensuring high-quality, strategic engagement with donors.

• Proficiency in using CRM systems (we currently use Airtable) for donor tracking and reporting.

• Familiarity with metrics and data analysis to assess fundraising performance and inform strategy.

• Ability to develop personalized stewardship plans for individual funders, building long-term relationships.

• Comfort with public speaking and representing the organization at events, panels, and other speaking engagements.

• Passion for AI education and commitment to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion within the nonprofit sector.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The AI Education Project is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that building and empowering a diverse team is a strategic imperative in our work, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.  This policy applies with regard to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits and termination. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification

If you need an accommodation during the application process, please contact assistant@aiedu.org.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
About Every Cure:

Every Cure is an AI-driven nonprofit, biotech organization on a mission to save and improve lives by repurposing existing medicines for diseases with significant unmet need. We are working to create a world where every drug is used to treat every disease it possibly can, so that no patient suffers when an existing treatment could help them. Rather than starting with a single disease or drug, we take an “all-vs-all" approach, systematically looking across every FDA-approved drug and every known disease to surface repurposing opportunities most likely to help patients. We are also the first organization to take end-to-end ownership of that process: from identifying promising repurposing opportunities, to validating it in the lab and/or clinic, to working with physicians, payers, and patient advocacy groups to get it to the patients who need it. We are filling a gap left by the current biomedical system, which doesn’t systematically pursue new uses for old drugs. Every Cure pairs AI-driven prediction with rigorous review from our medical team, plus close collaboration with healthcare professionals and patient advocacy groups, to unlock the full potential of existing medicines to treat every disease and every patient we possibly can.

Inspired by Every Cure’s co-founders' work repurposing drugs for Castleman disease and other rare diseases, Every Cure is advancing repurposed treatments for neglected diseases and has been featured in The New Yorker, The New York Times, USA Today, Good Morning America, Nature, and other news media. Led by a talented leadership team and an outstanding Board of Directors, Every Cure is supported through funding from leading philanthropic organizations like Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, TED’s Audacious Project, as well as the federal agency ARPA-H.

Our approach:

• AI-Powered Identification: We use advanced artificial intelligence to analyze the world’s biomedical knowledge and identify FDA-approved drugs that can be repurposed for conditions with unmet needs. This cutting-edge technology enables us to explore new therapeutic possibilities efficiently.

• Open-Source Commitment: Many of our methods' code, quality-checking tools, and knowledge graph pipeline are open-source, and our drug list, disease list, and knowledge graph-based drug-disease scores are freely available. We aim to foster collaboration and transparency within the scientific community and unlock the potential for discovering new treatments.

• High-Impact Focus: We prioritize drug repurposing opportunities that will relieve the most suffering and have the greatest impact possible.

• Rigorous Validation: Promising opportunities are thoroughly validated through laboratory and clinical studies to confirm their efficacy and safety before advancing to broader application.

• Strategic Marketing and Access: We disseminate information about effective repurposed treatments through multiple channels and are committed to ensuring that new cures are accessible to all patients.

Every Cure is seeking a mission-driven Director of Human Resources to lead and strengthen our people operations, build scalable HR systems, and foster a high-performing, engaged team dedicated to advancing our mission of saving and improving lives.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role serves as a strategic partner to leadership while overseeing the day-to-day human resources function. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in HR strategy, talent acquisition, employee relations, learning & development, organizational planning, and compliance, along with the ability to build and scale processes in a growing organization.

Working closely with executive leadership and teams across Every Cure, this person will help shape the employee experience, strengthen organizational effectiveness, and ensure our people practices support both individual development and long-term organizational success. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can balance strategic planning with operational execution and serve as a trusted resource to employees and managers.

The strongest candidates will be collaborative, strategic, solutions-oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building a positive, continuously learning culture within a fast-moving, mission-driven organization.

How you will make an impact:

• Lead HR Strategy & Planning: Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and initiatives aligned with Every Cure's mission, organizational goals, and long-term growth. Partner with executive leadership to anticipate workforce needs and strengthen organizational effectiveness.

• Oversee Talent Acquisition & Recruitment: Partner with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, develop job descriptions, and implement recruitment strategies that attract and retain exceptional talent. Oversee hiring processes to ensure a consistent, effective, and positive candidate experience.

• Manage Employee Hiring & Onboarding: Oversee offer letters, background checks, new-hire documentation, and onboarding processes. Ensure new employees have the resources, systems access, and support needed to integrate successfully into the organization.

• Support Payroll Administration: Collaborate with Finance and external providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, employee record management, and effective use of HR management systems.

• Strengthen Employee Relations & Engagement: Foster a positive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace culture. Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers, addressing concerns, navigating workplace challenges, and supporting fair and consistent resolutions.

• Drive Organizational Development & Training: Identify employee development needs and implement training, professional development, and career growth initiatives. Support leadership development and succession planning as the organization evolves.

• Lead Performance Management: Oversee performance management processes, including goal setting, employee evaluations, feedback, and performance improvement planning. Equip managers with the tools and guidance needed to support employee success.

• Oversee Compensation & Benefits Administration: Manage competitive and cost-effective compensation and benefits programs. Partner with vendors, brokers, and external administrators to evaluate benefits offerings, coordinate renewals, and ensure effective administration.

• Ensure HR Compliance & Policy Development: Maintain compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations, and HR best practices. Develop, update, and implement employee policies, procedures, and the employee handbook while providing guidance on sensitive HR matters.

• Strengthen HR Systems & Reporting: Implement and optimize HR technology, processes, and reporting tools. Track workforce metrics, including retention, turnover, and employee engagement, to identify opportunities for improvement and inform organizational decisions.

What you bring to the team:

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.

• Master's degree in a related discipline is valued but not required.

• Professional HR certifications, such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR, are advantageous.

Experience

• 5+ years of progressive human resources experience, including experience as an HR Manager, Head of HR, Director of Human Resources, or in a comparable HR leadership role.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing HR strategies, policies, and processes that support organizational growth.

• Hands-on experience across multiple HR functions, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, benefits administration, and HR compliance.

• Experience advising leadership and managers on employee relations, organizational development, and people management matters.

• Experience overseeing employee onboarding, payroll coordination, HR systems, and benefits administration.

• Experience scaling HR processes within a startup, early-stage, or rapidly growing organization.

• Experience managing external vendors, benefits providers, consultants, or third-party administrators.

Skills

• Strong understanding of HR principles, employment laws, regulations, and best practices.

• Ability to develop and implement people strategies that align with organizational priorities and business objectives.

• Strong employee relations skills, including conflict resolution, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to navigate sensitive situations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with employees, managers, and executive leadership.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and manage multiple HR responsibilities.

• Ability to design, implement, and improve HR policies, workflows, and systems.

• Experience using HR management software and technology to streamline processes, maintain accurate records, and improve operational efficiency.

• Ability to analyze HR metrics, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish trust across all levels of an organization.

• Comfortable using AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and work product, with appropriate judgment regarding confidentiality and sensitive employee information.

What will help you stand out

• Experience leading HR functions within a nonprofit, biotech, healthcare, biomedical, technology, or research-focused organization.

• Experience establishing or scaling an HR function within an early-stage or rapidly growing organization.

• Demonstrated success developing employee engagement, retention, and organizational culture initiatives.

• Experience implementing HR information systems, payroll platforms, performance management tools, or other HR technologies.

• Experience designing and facilitating employee training, leadership development, or professional growth programs.

• Experience managing compensation benchmarking, benefits renewals, and vendor relationships.

• Familiarity with HR compliance requirements across multiple states.

• Experience partnering directly with executive leadership on workforce planning and organizational development.

• Professional HR certification, such as SHRM-SCP or SPHR.

• Experience leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve HR operations while maintaining appropriate privacy and compliance standards.

How you work

• Mission-driven and genuinely motivated by supporting the people who advance Every Cure's mission of improving patient outcomes.

• A trusted, approachable, and supportive resource who builds meaningful relationships with employees and leadership.

• Strategic in your thinking while remaining hands-on and willing to manage the day-to-day details of HR operations.

• Collaborative and focused on team success over individual recognition.

• Empathetic, fair, and thoughtful when navigating employee concerns, difficult conversations, and sensitive situations.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of balancing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to identify challenges, recommend improvements, and take ownership of implementation.

• Comfortable building processes from scratch and adapting existing practices as organizational needs evolve.

• An effective communicator who can explain complex HR matters clearly, professionally, and with discretion.

• Committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive, and high-performing workplace where employees feel valued and empowered to succeed.

• Adaptable and comfortable operating in an evolving organization where priorities and responsibilities may shift.

• Intellectually curious and eager to continuously improve people practices, employee experiences, and organizational effectiveness.

• Comfortable adopting AI and emerging technologies to work more effectively and efficiently.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Your paycheck: Competitive salary based on experience, ranging from $135,000 - $150,000 annually.

• Health and wellness: Comprehensive plans with medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for eligible healthcare expenses.

• Future nest egg: A 403(b)-retirement plan with an employer match of 3.5% helps you save for your future.

• Relax and recharge: Generous time off, including paid time off, paid holidays, and Winter Break.

• We have you covered: Comprehensive paid leave for family and medical needs, ensuring you have the support you need during important times.

This role is based in Philadelphia, PA, or Cambridge, MA with an expectation of minimum 3 days per week in office.
